String.Source: I did my best, but it's kinda hard to cook mortal food. My ideas of "taste" and "smell" don't really match yours.
String.Dest: I did my best, but it's kinda hard to cook mortal food. My ideas of "taste" and "smell" don't really match yours.

String.Source: Hehe, the kids helped taste test this for us.
String.Dest: Hehe, the kids helped taste test this for us.

String.Source: Of course. This one is used to cooking for long journeys.
String.Dest: Of course. This one is used to cooking for long journeys.

String.Source: That's really more of a task for a thrall, but I suppose we haven't got one of those... Heh, thankfully I happen to enjoy cooking.
String.Dest: That's really more of a task for a thrall, but I suppose we haven't got one of those... Heh, thankfully I happen to enjoy cooking.

String.Source: Of course. It is a joy to share a meal.
String.Dest: Of course. It is a joy to share a meal.

String.Source: Of course it has. It's me we're talking about, darling. I even saved some for you.
String.Dest: Of course it has. It's me we're talking about, darling. I even saved some for you.

String.Source: It has. Here. This one kept your share safe.
String.Dest: It has. Here. This one kept your share safe.

String.Source: I'm getting the hang of this Illusion magic. People actually notice me when shopping!
String.Dest: I'm getting the hang of this Illusion magic. People actually notice me when shopping!

String.Source: It has. Here. I kept its share safe while it was out adventuring.
String.Dest: It has. Here. I kept its share safe while it was out adventuring.

String.Source: Better than I dreamed! I might actually be able to do this mother thing... As long as my Illusion spell holds.
String.Dest: Better than I dreamed! I might actually be able to do this mother thing... As long as my Illusion spell holds.

String.Source: Honestly, I'm terrified my true form will show... I mean, I'm kinda... well, scary, aren't I?
String.Dest: Honestly, I'm terrified my true form will show... I mean, I'm kinda... well, scary, aren't I?

String.Source: Well... If that happens, it's up to you to come up with an excuse!
String.Dest: Well... If that happens, it's up to you to come up with an excuse!

String.Source: Great! I think. I'm still not the best at reading mortals other than you...
String.Dest: Great! I think. I'm still not the best at reading mortals other than you...

String.Source: Better than I dared to hope.
String.Dest: Better than I dared to hope.

String.Source: I'll do whatever is needed to protect our happiness. I promise.
String.Dest: I'll do whatever is needed to protect our happiness. I promise.

String.Source: I'm not exactly the nurturing type, you know. I've been thinking how much easier they'd be to raise with a vampirism infection...
String.Dest: I'm not exactly the nurturing type, you know. I've been thinking how much easier they'd be to raise with a vampirism infection...

String.Source: Heh, I kid. They're doing fine. I'm thinking I should start training them to hunt, though... It's a useful skill to learn.
String.Dest: Heh, I kid. They're doing fine. I'm thinking I should start training them to hunt, though... It's a useful skill to learn.

String.Source: I always wanted children, but eggs rarely hatched in the Old Lands. It is a joy to raise your young.
String.Dest: I always wanted children, but eggs rarely hatched in the Old Lands. It is a joy to raise your young.

String.Source: They brim with energy. It is tiring to keep up! But it is a good tiring.
String.Dest: They brim with energy. It is tiring to keep up! But it is a good tiring.

String.Source: Good. The children of this land are born with strength. Their claws grow in sharp.
String.Dest: Good. The children of this land are born with strength. Their claws grow in sharp.

String.Source: Hehehe... Hehehehehehee... Heheheh... It still doesn't feel real!
String.Dest: Hehehe... Hehehehehehee... Heheheh... It still doesn't feel real!

String.Source: Me, a bride? If I could sleep, I'd think I was dreaming!
String.Dest: Me, a bride? If I could sleep, I'd think I was dreaming!

String.Source: Hehe... Heh... Ahem.
String.Dest: Hehe... Heh... Ahem.

String.Source: Well... I, uh... I guess I'm moving in with you, huh?
String.Dest: Well... I, uh... I guess I'm moving in with you, huh?

String.Source: Where is home, anyway?
String.Dest: Where is home, anyway?

String.Source: Well, that's that. I suppose we should discuss living accommodations, hm?
String.Dest: Well, that's that. I suppose we should discuss living accommodations, hm?

String.Source: I'd prefer not to return to that forest shack, if it's all the same to you.
String.Dest: I'd prefer not to return to that forest shack, if it's all the same to you.

String.Source: Married. It was not a future this one expected, but it is a good one.
String.Dest: Married. It was not a future this one expected, but it is a good one.

String.Source: Where shall we live? This one's old home would not be suitable for a family.
String.Dest: Where shall we live? This one's old home would not be suitable for a family.

String.Source: The sun shines brightly in my heart. This is a day of great joy.
String.Dest: The sun shines brightly in my heart. This is a day of great joy.

String.Source: We are bonded now. All that remains is to select where we will make our nest.
String.Dest: We are bonded now. All that remains is to select where we will make our nest.

String.Source: You know I don't have pockets, right?
String.Dest: You know I don't have pockets, right?

String.Source: Careful; you might lose a hand...
String.Dest: Careful; you might lose a hand...

String.Source: Whatever you're looking for, you'll be disappointed.
String.Dest: Whatever you're looking for, you'll be disappointed.

String.Source: You need practice. I saw you coming, and I don't even have eyes.
String.Dest: You need practice. I saw you coming, and I don't even have eyes.

String.Source: ...Sure, help yourself...
String.Dest: ...Sure, help yourself...

String.Source: Hya!
String.Dest: Hya!

String.Source: Take... this!
String.Dest: Take... this!

String.Source: Taste my power!
String.Dest: Taste my power!

String.Source: Graah!
String.Dest: Graah!

String.Source: Grrr...
String.Dest: Grrr...

String.Source: Ha! This is easy!
String.Dest: Ha! This is easy!

String.Source: You're finished!
String.Dest: You're finished!

String.Source: Let's see some blood!
String.Dest: Let's see some blood!

String.Source: Let's take this elsewhere.
String.Dest: Let's take this elsewhere.

String.Source: Sure, help yourself.
String.Dest: Sure, help yourself.

String.Source: Could have asked first.
String.Dest: Could have asked first.

String.Source: Just... need a quick rest.
String.Dest: Just... need a quick rest.

String.Source: Wheee, everything's spinning.
String.Dest: Wheee, everything's spinning.

String.Source: Uh... Take over for me, okay?
String.Dest: Uh... Take over for me, okay?

String.Source: Ugh, that's gonna chip my casing...
String.Dest: Ugh, that's gonna chip my casing...

String.Source: I hope you can see me. It's good to see your killer.
String.Dest: I hope you can see me. It's good to see your killer.

String.Source: You'll be forgotten before your body hits the ground.
String.Dest: You'll be forgotten before your body hits the ground.

String.Source: I'll show you what I'm capable of.
String.Dest: I'll show you what I'm capable of.

String.Source: When I'm done with you, there won't even be a soul left.
String.Dest: When I'm done with you, there won't even be a soul left.

String.Source: If you beg for mercy, I might let you run.
String.Dest: If you beg for mercy, I might let you run.

String.Source: Just die already!
String.Dest: Just die already!

String.Source: You won't even get an afterlife when I'm done with you.
String.Dest: You won't even get an afterlife when I'm done with you.

String.Source: To the Void with you.
String.Dest: To the Void with you.

String.Source: One of me is plenty, thanks!
String.Dest: One of me is plenty, thanks!

String.Source: Oh, get in the scrap pile already!
String.Dest: Oh, get in the scrap pile already!

String.Source: Ha, biting me won't do anything except break your fangs.
String.Dest: Ha, biting me won't do anything except break your fangs.

String.Source: How do you like being the prey?
String.Dest: How do you like being the prey?

String.Source: Poor things. What did they do to you...?
String.Dest: Poor things. What did they do to you...?

String.Source: Back to your graves!
String.Dest: Back to your graves!

String.Source: Poor things. I'll send you to your rest.
String.Dest: Poor things. I'll send you to your rest.

String.Source: Daedra versus Void, huh? I'll show you who's stronger!
String.Dest: Daedra versus Void, huh? I'll show you who's stronger!

String.Source: If you won't land voluntarily, I'll just take out your wings.
String.Dest: If you won't land voluntarily, I'll just take out your wings.

String.Source: You idiots really think you understand what's beyond the world?
String.Dest: You idiots really think you understand what's beyond the world?

String.Source: Reality might be unmade one day, but it won't be by you!
String.Dest: Reality might be unmade one day, but it won't be by you!

String.Source: Aw, do we have to kill these little guys? They're kinda cute.
String.Dest: Aw, do we have to kill these little guys? They're kinda cute.

String.Source: I'll tear that false heart from your chest.
String.Dest: I'll tear that false heart from your chest.

String.Source: Gah, more root monsters?
String.Dest: Gah, more root monsters?

String.Source: You're lucky I don't hold a grudge.
String.Dest: You're lucky I don't hold a grudge.

String.Source: Gah! Warn me first next time!
String.Dest: Gah! Warn me first next time!

String.Source: Padomay's blood, that's loud!
String.Dest: Padomay's blood, that's loud!

String.Source: Agkh! You mortals really don't realize the damage Shouting does to reality, do you?
String.Dest: Agkh! You mortals really don't realize the damage Shouting does to reality, do you?

String.Source: Just promise me you'll never learn the Dragon word for "no."
String.Dest: Just promise me you'll never learn the Dragon word for "no."

String.Source: So... Now that I can leave the Old Lands... Can I ask you to help me with something else?
String.Dest: So... Now that I can leave the Old Lands... Can I ask you to help me with something else?

String.Source: Mind if I ask for a favor? Nothing big, I promise.
String.Dest: Mind if I ask for a favor? Nothing big, I promise.

String.Source: This place... This is where I was made.
String.Dest: This place... This is where I was made.

String.Source: This is the spot. There's a breach here.
String.Dest: This is the spot. There's a breach here.

String.Source: I've seen people try to ring the bells before... Most never made it back from the forest. The rest got killed by dro-m'Athra.
String.Dest: I've seen people try to ring the bells before... Most never made it back from the forest. The rest got killed by dro-m'Athra.

String.Source: The bells sure are spread out around the plane. Forest to the north, church to the west, ruins to the east. Which do we hit first?
String.Dest: The bells sure are spread out around the plane. Forest to the north, church to the west, ruins to the east. Which do we hit first?

String.Source: I actually tried ringing the bells myself once. I got to one of them just fine, but it just... wouldn't ring for me.
String.Dest: I actually tried ringing the bells myself once. I got to one of them just fine, but it just... wouldn't ring for me.

String.Source: I wonder why the Hollow Princess created the bells. Maybe she was planning to gather cultists to follow her?
String.Dest: I wonder why the Hollow Princess created the bells. Maybe she was planning to gather cultists to follow her?

String.Source: Anagach went mining around the village wall, right? The outside perimeter to the east seems likely. We should check there.
String.Dest: Anagach went mining around the village wall, right? The outside perimeter to the east seems likely. We should check there.

String.Source: Why would the dro-m'Athra steal a chisel? What a pain...
String.Dest: Why would the dro-m'Athra steal a chisel? What a pain...

String.Source: If I understand that tablet, the dro-m'Athra are doing some ritual here to... torture the souls of their victims, I think? We should stop that.
String.Dest: If I understand that tablet, the dro-m'Athra are doing some ritual here to... torture the souls of their victims, I think? We should stop that.

String.Source: Burning that skull should free the trapped souls, but unless we deal with the dro-m'Athra in charge, they'll just start the ritual again.
String.Dest: Burning that skull should free the trapped souls, but unless we deal with the dro-m'Athra in charge, they'll just start the ritual again.

String.Source: Huh, the dro-m'Athra are supposed to serve Namira. Wonder how this group started working for Vaermina? Daedric politics are interesting.
String.Dest: Huh, the dro-m'Athra are supposed to serve Namira. Wonder how this group started working for Vaermina? Daedric politics are interesting.

String.Source: Imagine having your soul kidnapped while you're dreaming... Let's free those dreamers.
String.Dest: Imagine having your soul kidnapped while you're dreaming... Let's free those dreamers.

String.Source: I think that's all of them. Let's take out the Rajaska of this place so they can't do this again.
String.Dest: I think that's all of them. Let's take out the Rajaska of this place so they can't do this again.

String.Source: Why is there a dro-m'Athra ruin so close to the swamp? Is their influence spreading?
String.Dest: Why is there a dro-m'Athra ruin so close to the swamp? Is their influence spreading?

String.Source: Ugh. Magically corrupting the corpses of rival priests... Yeah, that's pretty in-character for Namira followers.
String.Dest: Ugh. Magically corrupting the corpses of rival priests... Yeah, that's pretty in-character for Namira followers.

String.Source: Whatever Daedric politics happened between Namira and Azura, I think the moon-priests have suffered enough. They deserve to rest.
String.Dest: Whatever Daedric politics happened between Namira and Azura, I think the moon-priests have suffered enough. They deserve to rest.

String.Source: The moon shrines around the desert keep getting corrupted by Daedric magic... I wonder if it's the doing of this place's Rajaska.
String.Dest: The moon shrines around the desert keep getting corrupted by Daedric magic... I wonder if it's the doing of this place's Rajaska.

String.Source: "Imprisoning the wind?" Is that a thing you can do? It definitely sounds bad.
String.Dest: "Imprisoning the wind?" Is that a thing you can do? It definitely sounds bad.

String.Source: Huh... I can feel the wind now. Maybe we really did free it... If so, we should probably take down the Rajaska in charge so they can't seal it again.
String.Dest: Huh... I can feel the wind now. Maybe we really did free it... If so, we should probably take down the Rajaska in charge so they can't seal it again.

String.Source: That's all four of the dro-m'Athra ruins dealt with. Hopefully, it's a first step toward driving the dro-m'Athra out entirely.
String.Dest: That's all four of the dro-m'Athra ruins dealt with. Hopefully, it's a first step toward driving the dro-m'Athra out entirely.

String.Source: What the heck was that?! I've heard of the "Moon Beast" from Khajiit legends... were the dro-m'Athra trying to summon a replica of it?
String.Dest: What the heck was that?! I've heard of the "Moon Beast" from Khajiit legends... were the dro-m'Athra trying to summon a replica of it?

String.Source: OK, going into this cave was a bad idea.
String.Dest: OK, going into this cave was a bad idea.

String.Source: "Oh no, this one won't let you ring the bell right in this one's attic! You must do chores for this one first!"
String.Dest: "Oh no, this one won't let you ring the bell right in this one's attic! You must do chores for this one first!"

String.Source: Well, I guess it makes sense Zenkali-Dra doesn't think ringing the bells will help. So many people have tried and died before...
String.Dest: Well, I guess it makes sense Zenkali-Dra doesn't think ringing the bells will help. So many people have tried and died before...

String.Source: I know she attacked us, but I still feel a little guilty about killing her... We did provoke her by breaking in.
String.Dest: I know she attacked us, but I still feel a little guilty about killing her... We did provoke her by breaking in.

String.Source: For a minute there, I was worried we'd have to kill the priestess. Glad I was wrong.
String.Dest: For a minute there, I was worried we'd have to kill the priestess. Glad I was wrong.

String.Source: I hope the Church uses the Meat wisely. The miners couldn't exactly afford to spare it.
String.Dest: I hope the Church uses the Meat wisely. The miners couldn't exactly afford to spare it.

String.Source: I wonder where that portal in the Mines was connected to. It must be a Daedric plane, right?
String.Dest: I wonder where that portal in the Mines was connected to. It must be a Daedric plane, right?

String.Source: You know... We closed the portal in the Meat Mines, but what if there were more portals below the other xanmeers?
String.Dest: You know... We closed the portal in the Meat Mines, but what if there were more portals below the other xanmeers?

String.Source: Nalpa-Kur... This place is dangerous. Tainted by Void magic.
String.Dest: Nalpa-Kur... This place is dangerous. Tainted by Void magic.

String.Source: Look, heroics are all well and good, but let's grab the staff and go. Quush is not someone you want to notice you.
String.Dest: Look, heroics are all well and good, but let's grab the staff and go. Quush is not someone you want to notice you.

String.Source: The Blood shortage had already started when I first woke up, but the Meat only started running low when the monsters showed up.
String.Dest: The Blood shortage had already started when I first woke up, but the Meat only started running low when the monsters showed up.

String.Source: I wonder why the dro-m'Athra were so determined to guard the bell. Are they working for the Hollow Princess?
String.Dest: I wonder why the dro-m'Athra were so determined to guard the bell. Are they working for the Hollow Princess?

String.Source: The monsters in the swamp only appeared recently. There were always Drowned and voriplasms, but the rest are new.
String.Dest: The monsters in the swamp only appeared recently. There were always Drowned and voriplasms, but the rest are new.

String.Source: So, these are the Meat Mines... Impressive atmosphere. Too bad about the monsters.
String.Dest: So, these are the Meat Mines... Impressive atmosphere. Too bad about the monsters.

String.Source: Did you see that?! The whole side of the cliff just exploded!
String.Dest: Did you see that?! The whole side of the cliff just exploded!

String.Source: Do you hear that? The screaming...
String.Dest: Do you hear that? The screaming...

String.Source: Ggkgk? Kkhggkk... Ack. How does Vix even make those sounds?
String.Dest: Ggkgk? Kkhggkk... Ack. How does Vix even make those sounds?

String.Source: Should I show myself to Kalsesh? I bet we'd get along.
String.Dest: Should I show myself to Kalsesh? I bet we'd get along.

String.Source: Oh no. We're going back to Iceblood Academy? That place is like... an infection on the rest of the plane. Can't the Glassringer just go on her own?
String.Dest: Oh no. We're going back to Iceblood Academy? That place is like... an infection on the rest of the plane. Can't the Glassringer just go on her own?

String.Source: Okay, let's just do whatever we came here for quickly, OK? Whatever cursed this place might still be watching it. If it sees new souls here...
String.Dest: Okay, let's just do whatever we came here for quickly, OK? Whatever cursed this place might still be watching it. If it sees new souls here...

String.Source: Uh... I think that Glassringer lady can see me. OK, she definitely can; she just grinned when I said that.
String.Dest: Uh... I think that Glassringer lady can see me. OK, she definitely can; she just grinned when I said that.

String.Source: Okay, great, the Glassringer got the thing. Can we leave now? I can definitely sense something watching us now.
String.Dest: Okay, great, the Glassringer got the thing. Can we leave now? I can definitely sense something watching us now.

String.Source: You know... if the reason nobody can see me is because of an enchantment on this body, maybe I could use an Illusion spell to make myself visible?
String.Dest: You know... if the reason nobody can see me is because of an enchantment on this body, maybe I could use an Illusion spell to make myself visible?

String.Source: Okay, we're in a town. I'll use that spell I was working on. If this works, people should be able to see me. Though I'm not sure what they'll see...
String.Dest: Okay, we're in a town. I'll use that spell I was working on. If this works, people should be able to see me. Though I'm not sure what they'll see...

String.Source: Oh! That person looked at me! ...No, never mind. They were looking behind me.
String.Dest: Oh! That person looked at me! ...No, never mind. They were looking behind me.

String.Source: Well... I think I can get people to see me if I focus the spell on one person at a time. Just need to add a Calm spell so I don't startle them.
String.Dest: Well... I think I can get people to see me if I focus the spell on one person at a time. Just need to add a Calm spell so I don't startle them.

String.Source: Aww, a tame hyena! Can we keep her?
String.Dest: Aww, a tame hyena! Can we keep her?

String.Source: Who knew there was a tunnel here all along?
String.Dest: Who knew there was a tunnel here all along?

String.Source: Hm. The air ahead feels... cold? But we're in a desert...
String.Dest: Hm. The air ahead feels... cold? But we're in a desert...

String.Source: No wonder nobody's ever returned from the Hollow Palace. It's more than just a building... It's like an extension of the Princess herself.
String.Dest: No wonder nobody's ever returned from the Hollow Palace. It's more than just a building... It's like an extension of the Princess herself.

String.Source: All those suits of armor... Is that what happened to the followers of the Hollow Princess? Forced to stand guard until they decayed into nothing?
String.Dest: All those suits of armor... Is that what happened to the followers of the Hollow Princess? Forced to stand guard until they decayed into nothing?

String.Source: The Hist might have been corrupted, but it was still a Hist, you know? I hope the Argonians will be okay without it.
String.Dest: The Hist might have been corrupted, but it was still a Hist, you know? I hope the Argonians will be okay without it.

String.Source: Rukar's spell was keeping me from fully helping before, but I can resist it now. To start... I'll unlock his door so we can search the place.
String.Dest: Rukar's spell was keeping me from fully helping before, but I can resist it now. To start... I'll unlock his door so we can search the place.

String.Source: Wow, Rukar really must not plan on coming back if he lowered his concealment spell. This whole house just screams "evil" now.
String.Dest: Wow, Rukar really must not plan on coming back if he lowered his concealment spell. This whole house just screams "evil" now.

String.Source: No escape now, Rukar. I'll make you regret trying to use me...
String.Dest: No escape now, Rukar. I'll make you regret trying to use me...

String.Source: I hope destroying those wards was a good idea. We might have just attracted the attention of whatever made them.
String.Dest: I hope destroying those wards was a good idea. We might have just attracted the attention of whatever made them.

String.Source: Let's not stop here. This place is creeping me out.
String.Dest: Let's not stop here. This place is creeping me out.

String.Source: Ugh. Everything here sounds like... I don't know how to describe it. Water dripping on glass? You're lucky you can't hear it.
String.Dest: Ugh. Everything here sounds like... I don't know how to describe it. Water dripping on glass? You're lucky you can't hear it.

String.Source: If you could see what the Iceblood's souls look like... Actually, you're lucky you can't.
String.Dest: If you could see what the Iceblood's souls look like... Actually, you're lucky you can't.

String.Source: The names the Icebloods were muttering... those were Void Spirits. Tellijih, Likirani, Sondra Drel... How did they learn those names?
String.Dest: The names the Icebloods were muttering... those were Void Spirits. Tellijih, Likirani, Sondra Drel... How did they learn those names?

String.Source: Thorntaker's a Vigilant, Mehela's a vampire... What other secrets do you think the villagers are hiding?
String.Dest: Thorntaker's a Vigilant, Mehela's a vampire... What other secrets do you think the villagers are hiding?

String.Source: Why would the Vampyrum Order care what's happening in an Oblivion demiplane? There's something he's not telling us.
String.Dest: Why would the Vampyrum Order care what's happening in an Oblivion demiplane? There's something he's not telling us.

String.Source: I took a peek at Capiton's notes. He's looking for information on something called "Varladimath." Whatever that means.
String.Dest: I took a peek at Capiton's notes. He's looking for information on something called "Varladimath." Whatever that means.

String.Source: Why are vampires always feuding with each other? If they just teamed up, they'd overwhelm the mortals easily.
String.Dest: Why are vampires always feuding with each other? If they just teamed up, they'd overwhelm the mortals easily.

String.Source: Well, destroying the Voidsuckers is probably good for everyone, but I still don't like doing the Vampyrum Order's dirty work for them...
String.Dest: Well, destroying the Voidsuckers is probably good for everyone, but I still don't like doing the Vampyrum Order's dirty work for them...

String.Source: A mine filled with red mist... Yeah, this is the place.
String.Dest: A mine filled with red mist... Yeah, this is the place.

String.Source: This place definitely feels familiar.
String.Dest: This place definitely feels familiar.

String.Source: Don't look down. You don't know what might look back up at you...
String.Dest: Don't look down. You don't know what might look back up at you...

String.Source: I'm glad Ancheta is in charge of the Church now. She always cared about the villagers more than Zenkali-Dra.
String.Dest: I'm glad Ancheta is in charge of the Church now. She always cared about the villagers more than Zenkali-Dra.

String.Source: I knew Ma'Jaka was investigating the ruins, but I never realized why...
String.Dest: I knew Ma'Jaka was investigating the ruins, but I never realized why...

String.Source: What a strange place... Is it a shrine to the Princess?
String.Dest: What a strange place... Is it a shrine to the Princess?

String.Source: I read about a place called Arkthzand in Rukar's notes. It was a place where the Dwemer studied the Void. As if they weren't bad enough already.
String.Dest: I read about a place called Arkthzand in Rukar's notes. It was a place where the Dwemer studied the Void. As if they weren't bad enough already.

String.Source: Peace between the miners and the Church... I hope it lasts.
String.Dest: Peace between the miners and the Church... I hope it lasts.

String.Source: As if the villagers didn't have enough problems, now they have to worry about raiders coming from Tamriel, too?
String.Dest: As if the villagers didn't have enough problems, now they have to worry about raiders coming from Tamriel, too?

String.Source: One bell down. It's a good start!
String.Dest: One bell down. It's a good start!

String.Source: Two bells rung, one to go. We can do this!
String.Dest: Two bells rung, one to go. We can do this!

String.Source: All three bells rung. All that's left is the one in the village.
String.Dest: All three bells rung. All that's left is the one in the village.

String.Source: Leilani... I remember her. She was the only child in the village...
String.Dest: Leilani... I remember her. She was the only child in the village...

String.Source: I don't really know much about the afterlife, but... I hope Duraeg and Laelani are content. I don't sense their ghosts, at least.
String.Dest: I don't really know much about the afterlife, but... I hope Duraeg and Laelani are content. I don't sense their ghosts, at least.

String.Source: You're part of the Cronvangr, right? I bet one of them would be interested in those journals we found.
String.Dest: You're part of the Cronvangr, right? I bet one of them would be interested in those journals we found.

String.Source: I remember reading about the Nighthollow. A clan of vampires that somehow fed on the Void itself. I guess the Voidsuckers are descended from them?
String.Dest: I remember reading about the Nighthollow. A clan of vampires that somehow fed on the Void itself. I guess the Voidsuckers are descended from them?

String.Source: I hope Kalsesh doesn't betray us after we help her.
String.Dest: I hope Kalsesh doesn't betray us after we help her.

String.Source: It would be nice if Kalsesh is able to cure herself. Having to hide out in that shack forever would be depressing.
String.Dest: It would be nice if Kalsesh is able to cure herself. Having to hide out in that shack forever would be depressing.

String.Source: Kalsesh cured herself? Let's go visit her!
String.Dest: Kalsesh cured herself? Let's go visit her!

String.Source: I can finally leave the Old Lands... Where should we go first?
String.Dest: I can finally leave the Old Lands... Where should we go first?

String.Source: Best to let the leaders of the village take care of telling the others about the Hist. They might not react well to hearing it from an outsider.
String.Dest: Best to let the leaders of the village take care of telling the others about the Hist. They might not react well to hearing it from an outsider.

String.Source: I know we don't want to anger Kalarix, but knowingly putting parasites in people's food is still... Well, I'm glad I'm not made of flesh.
String.Dest: I know we don't want to anger Kalarix, but knowingly putting parasites in people's food is still... Well, I'm glad I'm not made of flesh.

String.Source: Blech. That's the last of the meals contaminated. Let's tell Kalarix we did her job and get it over with, okay?
String.Dest: Blech. That's the last of the meals contaminated. Let's tell Kalarix we did her job and get it over with, okay?

String.Source: Destroying the eggs is probably the right move, but... Sure you want to risk it? Kalarix won't be happy...
String.Dest: Destroying the eggs is probably the right move, but... Sure you want to risk it? Kalarix won't be happy...

String.Source: I read a book once called "Jokes of Daggerfall." They weren't funny at all, but... Well, probably exactly the sort of jokes that Ledges likes.
String.Dest: I read a book once called "Jokes of Daggerfall." They weren't funny at all, but... Well, probably exactly the sort of jokes that Ledges likes.

String.Source: So, this is the Hollow Palace... How does it feel to be the first mortal to enter here in... Centuries? Millennia?
String.Dest: So, this is the Hollow Palace... How does it feel to be the first mortal to enter here in... Centuries? Millennia?

String.Source: I guess we're lucky the Hollow Princess didn't see us as a threat before now. Imagine if she'd set all the roots in the land against us.
String.Dest: I guess we're lucky the Hollow Princess didn't see us as a threat before now. Imagine if she'd set all the roots in the land against us.

String.Source: If the Hollow Princess was connected to the Hist all this time... She could see everything happening anywhere a root was growing? Disturbing...
String.Dest: If the Hollow Princess was connected to the Hist all this time... She could see everything happening anywhere a root was growing? Disturbing...

String.Source: Huh... You know, in a way, it's like the Princess was doing the same thing I was. Treating everything that happened like a show...
String.Dest: Huh... You know, in a way, it's like the Princess was doing the same thing I was. Treating everything that happened like a show...

String.Source: I'm glad I met someone I can communicate with. If the alternative was ending up like her, just seeing mortals as toys...
String.Dest: I'm glad I met someone I can communicate with. If the alternative was ending up like her, just seeing mortals as toys...

String.Source: So... this is Skyrim. I'm finally here.
String.Dest: So... this is Skyrim. I'm finally here.

String.Source: Rukar's note was to someone he called 'N," right? Think we'll have to deal with that someday, too?
String.Dest: Rukar's note was to someone he called 'N," right? Think we'll have to deal with that someday, too?

String.Source: Ooh. A home inside a xanmeer... The mage who made this place had ambition.
String.Dest: Ooh. A home inside a xanmeer... The mage who made this place had ambition.

String.Source: The villagers are living their lives the same as ever. I guess the truth hasn't really sunk in yet.
String.Dest: The villagers are living their lives the same as ever. I guess the truth hasn't really sunk in yet.

String.Source: Even after everything that happened, life goes on as normal for the villagers. I guess it all comes down to what you're used to.
String.Dest: Even after everything that happened, life goes on as normal for the villagers. I guess it all comes down to what you're used to.

String.Source: Vix and I are sisters, right? What do sisters... You know, do together? Most of the books I read just had them killing each other over inheritances.
String.Dest: Vix and I are sisters, right? What do sisters... You know, do together? Most of the books I read just had them killing each other over inheritances.

String.Source: As Vix's big sister, I need to be a good influence on her. But... how do I do that?
String.Dest: As Vix's big sister, I need to be a good influence on her. But... how do I do that?

String.Source: I hope Thorntaker and Ancheta manage to cure the villagers' Hist Sap addiction. I'd like to see the village revive one day.
String.Dest: I hope Thorntaker and Ancheta manage to cure the villagers' Hist Sap addiction. I'd like to see the village revive one day.

String.Source: Ugh. Dwemer. Never let a race of nihilists get tonal architecture again.
String.Dest: Ugh. Dwemer. Never let a race of nihilists get tonal architecture again.

String.Source: It's strange. When it was just me, I could treat what happened like it was a play. When I'm with you... I care what happens to others.
String.Dest: It's strange. When it was just me, I could treat what happened like it was a play. When I'm with you... I care what happens to others.

String.Source: I wonder what the Church was like in its prime? By the time I first woke up, it was already like this...
String.Dest: I wonder what the Church was like in its prime? By the time I first woke up, it was already like this...

String.Source: I feel sorry for Mehela. Living here as a vampire can't be easy. Especially when you're terrible at hiding it.
String.Dest: I feel sorry for Mehela. Living here as a vampire can't be easy. Especially when you're terrible at hiding it.

String.Source: Promise you won't let the Vigilants find out about me? I don't think they'd approve.
String.Dest: Promise you won't let the Vigilants find out about me? I don't think they'd approve.

String.Source: I hope Mehela fits in with the clan. It would be nice for her to have somewhere to belong.
String.Dest: I hope Mehela fits in with the clan. It would be nice for her to have somewhere to belong.

String.Source: Azzah-Ko and Aeodgam are a couple, you know. No idea why they try to hide it.... Not like the other villagers would object.
String.Dest: Azzah-Ko and Aeodgam are a couple, you know. No idea why they try to hide it.... Not like the other villagers would object.

String.Source: I always tried to avoid the forest. The creatures there... I don't think they could really see me, but they definitely noticed my presence somehow.
String.Dest: I always tried to avoid the forest. The creatures there... I don't think they could really see me, but they definitely noticed my presence somehow.

String.Source: I don't usually go down to the swamp. Swimming doesn't work too well when you're hollow...
String.Dest: I don't usually go down to the swamp. Swimming doesn't work too well when you're hollow...

String.Source: A mosquito just flew inside my neck. Can we leave now?
String.Dest: A mosquito just flew inside my neck. Can we leave now?

String.Source: How do you put up with all that noise? Oh, right... Mortals can't hear it.
String.Dest: How do you put up with all that noise? Oh, right... Mortals can't hear it.

String.Source: I hate automatons. They're the relatives I never wanted.
String.Dest: I hate automatons. They're the relatives I never wanted.

String.Source: I hate how artificial this place is. It's like a mockery of reality.
String.Dest: I hate how artificial this place is. It's like a mockery of reality.

String.Source: Grab any Dwarven Oil you see. That stuff is great for my joints.
String.Dest: Grab any Dwarven Oil you see. That stuff is great for my joints.

String.Source: They say if you dig down too deep, you'll run into the original framework of the world. Or maybe just die in a cave-in.
String.Dest: They say if you dig down too deep, you'll run into the original framework of the world. Or maybe just die in a cave-in.

String.Source: Mzhtnth... Ztklth... Knthklkhmng... Ugh, this Dwemer phrasebook is useless.
String.Dest: Mzhtnth... Ztklth... Knthklkhmng... Ugh, this Dwemer phrasebook is useless.

String.Source: I love caves. They're so dark and oppressive.
String.Dest: I love caves. They're so dark and oppressive.

String.Source: There's something so nostalgic about caves... I wonder why...
String.Dest: There's something so nostalgic about caves... I wonder why...

String.Source: When you think about it, caves are basically giant blood vessels. Too bad the world's out of blood.
String.Dest: When you think about it, caves are basically giant blood vessels. Too bad the world's out of blood.

String.Source: How far down do you think this goes?
String.Dest: How far down do you think this goes?

String.Source: Something's dripping on me. I hope it's water.
String.Dest: Something's dripping on me. I hope it's water.

String.Source: There's something so mysterious about caves, isn't there? Like you're exploring somewhere the world doesn't want you to see.
String.Dest: There's something so mysterious about caves, isn't there? Like you're exploring somewhere the world doesn't want you to see.

String.Source: This must be a lot less fun for people who can't see in the dark... You... can see in the dark, right?
String.Dest: This must be a lot less fun for people who can't see in the dark... You... can see in the dark, right?

String.Source: This cold is not good for my joints.
String.Dest: This cold is not good for my joints.

String.Source: I hope we find some trolls in here. They're fun to kill.
String.Dest: I hope we find some trolls in here. They're fun to kill.

String.Source: Ugh, I think some snow got inside my body.
String.Dest: Ugh, I think some snow got inside my body.

String.Source: Bandit camps are the best. Nobody minds if we slaughter the lot of them.
String.Dest: Bandit camps are the best. Nobody minds if we slaughter the lot of them.

String.Source: These bandits must be a nasty bunch. I sense a lot of suffering happened here.
String.Dest: These bandits must be a nasty bunch. I sense a lot of suffering happened here.

String.Source: Tch. Here I am, made of valuable bone ceramic, and not one bandit's tried to steal me yet.
String.Dest: Tch. Here I am, made of valuable bone ceramic, and not one bandit's tried to steal me yet.

String.Source: I can smell it... The opportunity for slaughter...
String.Dest: I can smell it... The opportunity for slaughter...

String.Source: To be fair to vampires, blood is delicious. Or at least the aura it gives off is - not like I can taste things the way mortals do.
String.Dest: To be fair to vampires, blood is delicious. Or at least the aura it gives off is - not like I can taste things the way mortals do.

String.Source: Thinking about it, the Nighthollow vampires were basically my ancestors, weren't they?
String.Dest: Thinking about it, the Nighthollow vampires were basically my ancestors, weren't they?

String.Source: I feel sorry for the vampire cattle... but I also feel hungry when I look at them. It's a little worrying.
String.Dest: I feel sorry for the vampire cattle... but I also feel hungry when I look at them. It's a little worrying.

String.Source: Don't worry; none of these people can see me.
String.Dest: Don't worry; none of these people can see me.

String.Source: Don't worry; none of these people can see me... Unless I want them to.
String.Dest: Don't worry; none of these people can see me... Unless I want them to.

String.Source: They say you never know what goes on behind closed doors...
String.Dest: They say you never know what goes on behind closed doors...

String.Source: Where are we off to now?
String.Dest: Where are we off to now?

String.Source: I think something is watching us. Might not be on this plane, though.
String.Dest: I think something is watching us. Might not be on this plane, though.

String.Source: Think there's any treasure around here?
String.Dest: Think there's any treasure around here?

String.Source: (Humming)
String.Dest: (Humming)

String.Source: Sorry if I'm talking too much. I'm not used to having anyone actually be able to hear me.
String.Dest: Sorry if I'm talking too much. I'm not used to having anyone actually be able to hear me.

String.Source: It's sweet, the way Anagach and Kelsrah care for each other.
String.Dest: It's sweet, the way Anagach and Kelsrah care for each other.

String.Source: Ri'nakku and Ma'Jaka work so well together. I wonder what having a sibling is like...
String.Dest: Ri'nakku and Ma'Jaka work so well together. I wonder what having a sibling is like...

String.Source: Let's go kill something.
String.Dest: Let's go kill something.

String.Source: Well. This is a pleasant place.
String.Dest: Well. This is a pleasant place.

String.Source: A realm of Oblivion is the same as its owner. So... We're walking inside Molag Bal right now.
String.Dest: A realm of Oblivion is the same as its owner. So... We're walking inside Molag Bal right now.

String.Source: Isn't Coldharbour supposed to be... well, cold? I can't really feel temperature the way mortals do, but this seems hot to me.
String.Dest: Isn't Coldharbour supposed to be... well, cold? I can't really feel temperature the way mortals do, but this seems hot to me.

String.Source: Hehehe... Can you feel it? This whole kingdom is positively soaked with corruption.
String.Dest: Hehehe... Can you feel it? This whole kingdom is positively soaked with corruption.

String.Source: The Void is seeping through the barriers here... I can practically taste it.
String.Dest: The Void is seeping through the barriers here... I can practically taste it.

String.Source: "And this is how the world will end. Not with fire and tempest, but with a collective sigh of a failed passion and lost hope."
String.Dest: "And this is how the world will end. Not with fire and tempest, but with a collective sigh of a failed passion and lost hope."

String.Source: "That which is whole and sweet can only shrivel and sour. It is the fate of all things that they are bound to time, and time is twin to decay."
String.Dest: "That which is whole and sweet can only shrivel and sour. It is the fate of all things that they are bound to time, and time is twin to decay."

String.Source: "Despair all ye nations, deny not that we're sick, for our blood is like water where once it was thick."
String.Dest: "Despair all ye nations, deny not that we're sick, for our blood is like water where once it was thick."

String.Source: "Despair all ye nations, the Corrupter has come, and the sad days of this world are nearing their sum."
String.Dest: "Despair all ye nations, the Corrupter has come, and the sad days of this world are nearing their sum."

String.Source: If you could see the souls of the people here... Heheheh.
String.Dest: If you could see the souls of the people here... Heheheh.

String.Source: This entire land is practically buzzing with the energies of the Void... I hope this body can contain it.
String.Dest: This entire land is practically buzzing with the energies of the Void... I hope this body can contain it.

String.Source: This place feels so familiar... Must be Namira's influence.
String.Dest: This place feels so familiar... Must be Namira's influence.

String.Source: All this corrupted flesh... It's making me hungry.
String.Dest: All this corrupted flesh... It's making me hungry.

String.Source: This is the same as the Meat from the Old Lands. The Meat Mines really were part of the Scuttling Void, I guess.
String.Dest: This is the same as the Meat from the Old Lands. The Meat Mines really were part of the Scuttling Void, I guess.

String.Source: Hm... being a Void entity myself, is Namira my mother? My sister? Or what?
String.Dest: Hm... being a Void entity myself, is Namira my mother? My sister? Or what?

String.Source: We should move quickly... You don't want to know what this place is doing to your soul.
String.Dest: We should move quickly... You don't want to know what this place is doing to your soul.

String.Source: You'd think they'd put some guardrails around here...
String.Dest: You'd think they'd put some guardrails around here...

String.Source: Watch your step... Wouldn't want you to fall down here.
String.Dest: Watch your step... Wouldn't want you to fall down here.

String.Source: Those gears... They're dead spirits. Et'Ada who sacrificed everything to build the world.
String.Dest: Those gears... They're dead spirits. Et'Ada who sacrificed everything to build the world.

String.Source: These Fabricants creep me out... It's like looking into a twisted mirror.
String.Dest: These Fabricants creep me out... It's like looking into a twisted mirror.

String.Source: The ocean... I read that it's made of memories. The deeper you sink... the older and more forgotten the memories.
String.Dest: The ocean... I read that it's made of memories. The deeper you sink... the older and more forgotten the memories.

String.Source: Odd... Namira's influence is stronger here than it was in Arnima...
String.Dest: Odd... Namira's influence is stronger here than it was in Arnima...

String.Source: You know, everyone expects graveyards to be haunted. They are, but inns actually have a lot more ghosts than graveyards do.
String.Dest: You know, everyone expects graveyards to be haunted. They are, but inns actually have a lot more ghosts than graveyards do.

String.Source: Old stone buildings are fascinating... The stones are positively steeped in memories.
String.Dest: Old stone buildings are fascinating... The stones are positively steeped in memories.

String.Source: SHUT UP! Uh... sorry. Not you. The ghosts here are really talkative.
String.Dest: SHUT UP! Uh... sorry. Not you. The ghosts here are really talkative.

String.Source: The ghosts here seem... frightened. I wonder what they're hiding from.
String.Dest: The ghosts here seem... frightened. I wonder what they're hiding from.

String.Source: Huh... It's a cemetery, but... I don't see any ghosts...
String.Dest: Huh... It's a cemetery, but... I don't see any ghosts...

String.Source: There's a ghost here. She wants you to know that Hrigvild Stone-Smasher killed her... Any clue who that is?
String.Dest: There's a ghost here. She wants you to know that Hrigvild Stone-Smasher killed her... Any clue who that is?

String.Source: Don't let the veneer of elegance fool you. This place is dripping with malice.
String.Dest: Don't let the veneer of elegance fool you. This place is dripping with malice.

String.Source: ...He wanted me to Mantle that?!
String.Dest: ...He wanted me to Mantle that?!

String.Source: For all its beauty, the Reach is probably the most corrupted place in all of Skyrim. This is Namira's domain.
String.Dest: For all its beauty, the Reach is probably the most corrupted place in all of Skyrim. This is Namira's domain.

String.Source: So... We're killing a priest of Arkay for Namira? We're actually doing this?
String.Dest: So... We're killing a priest of Arkay for Namira? We're actually doing this?

String.Source: Be careful. Some of the trees here... aren't.
String.Dest: Be careful. Some of the trees here... aren't.

String.Source: All these mountains... If I fall and shatter, you're in charge of finding me a new Vessel.
String.Dest: All these mountains... If I fall and shatter, you're in charge of finding me a new Vessel.

String.Source: I have to admit, I sympathize with the Forsworn. Their blood has a deep tie to this land.
String.Dest: I have to admit, I sympathize with the Forsworn. Their blood has a deep tie to this land.

String.Source: The people of the Reach should be more concerned about the Forsworn. Those hagravens are tied to some very evil power.
String.Dest: The people of the Reach should be more concerned about the Forsworn. Those hagravens are tied to some very evil power.

String.Source: I doubt we're seeing this place the same, but even so... this landscape is quite beautiful, isn't it?
String.Dest: I doubt we're seeing this place the same, but even so... this landscape is quite beautiful, isn't it?

String.Source: Some corruption never fades. I can still feel the Void clinging to all these Dwarven buildings.
String.Dest: Some corruption never fades. I can still feel the Void clinging to all these Dwarven buildings.

String.Source: Do you feel it? The tension under the surface... Like violence will erupt any second.
String.Dest: Do you feel it? The tension under the surface... Like violence will erupt any second.

String.Source: If mortals could see the sort of things that are drawn to these old cities... Well, you'd all live in wood huts instead.
String.Dest: If mortals could see the sort of things that are drawn to these old cities... Well, you'd all live in wood huts instead.

String.Source: Does the Blue Palace have to be blue? What if the Jarl wanted to paint it?
String.Dest: Does the Blue Palace have to be blue? What if the Jarl wanted to paint it?

String.Source: The people here live quite well, don't they?
String.Dest: The people here live quite well, don't they?

String.Source: I'm sensing something odd from below us... is there something in the sewers?
String.Dest: I'm sensing something odd from below us... is there something in the sewers?

String.Source: The ghosts of the Wolf Queen's victims are still all around us. I doubt they'll ever be able to rest.
String.Dest: The ghosts of the Wolf Queen's victims are still all around us. I doubt they'll ever be able to rest.

String.Source: We should stop by the Bards College while we're here.
String.Dest: We should stop by the Bards College while we're here.

String.Source: Keep a close eye on your purse. This whole city tastes like concentrated greed... I guess you don't know what that tastes like, though.
String.Dest: Keep a close eye on your purse. This whole city tastes like concentrated greed... I guess you don't know what that tastes like, though.

String.Source: There's something sad about Riften. It has millennia of history, and yet... All it is now is a den of crime.
String.Dest: There's something sad about Riften. It has millennia of history, and yet... All it is now is a den of crime.

String.Source: So you hear about a place called "The Ratway" and your first instinct is to explore it?
String.Dest: So you hear about a place called "The Ratway" and your first instinct is to explore it?

String.Source: I'm so glad I can't smell.
String.Dest: I'm so glad I can't smell.

String.Source: I'm amazed no Daedric cults have taken root here. This city is ripe for corrupting.
String.Dest: I'm amazed no Daedric cults have taken root here. This city is ripe for corrupting.

String.Source: This is the sort of place where you can find anything, isn't it? Anything legal, at least...
String.Dest: This is the sort of place where you can find anything, isn't it? Anything legal, at least...

String.Source: Gah. This place is not to my taste.
String.Dest: Gah. This place is not to my taste.

String.Source: Can we leave, please? The energy here does not agree with me.
String.Dest: Can we leave, please? The energy here does not agree with me.

String.Source: The floor is talking to me. And it's a terrible conversationalist.
String.Dest: The floor is talking to me. And it's a terrible conversationalist.

String.Source: Ever since that whole Hist incident, I've been uncomfortable around roots...
String.Dest: Ever since that whole Hist incident, I've been uncomfortable around roots...

String.Source: Keep your distance from those mushrooms. They're not as innocent as they look.
String.Dest: Keep your distance from those mushrooms. They're not as innocent as they look.

String.Source: Can you stop breathing for a while? You don't want those spores inside you.
String.Dest: Can you stop breathing for a while? You don't want those spores inside you.

String.Source: Amazing... The Dark Heart was expelled a thousand years ago, but I can still hear it beating.
String.Dest: Amazing... The Dark Heart was expelled a thousand years ago, but I can still hear it beating.

String.Source: Do you feel that? The pulse of the Void.
String.Dest: Do you feel that? The pulse of the Void.

String.Source: Well, they might not have the details right, but I'm sure Sithis appreciates the sacrifices anyway. Probably.
String.Dest: Well, they might not have the details right, but I'm sure Sithis appreciates the sacrifices anyway. Probably.

String.Source: Sure, spiders are neat, but who decided "let's devote our whole existence to spiders?"
String.Dest: Sure, spiders are neat, but who decided "let's devote our whole existence to spiders?"

String.Source: The Cronvangr think assassinations are more noble than combat? Bet there's an interesting story behind that.
String.Dest: The Cronvangr think assassinations are more noble than combat? Bet there's an interesting story behind that.

String.Source: Since I'm hollow, do I need to worry the spiders will lay their eggs inside my body? I... wish I hadn't had that thought.
String.Dest: Since I'm hollow, do I need to worry the spiders will lay their eggs inside my body? I... wish I hadn't had that thought.

String.Source: That's the tenth spider web I've walked into in the last minute.
String.Dest: That's the tenth spider web I've walked into in the last minute.

String.Source: I'd be worried about living in a Dwemer ruin. Who knows what might be sleeping there?
String.Dest: I'd be worried about living in a Dwemer ruin. Who knows what might be sleeping there?

String.Source: The lights here are really pretty.
String.Dest: The lights here are really pretty.

String.Source: I'm not a fan of that waterfall. It's pretty, but if it knocks you off the bridge, there's no coming back.
String.Dest: I'm not a fan of that waterfall. It's pretty, but if it knocks you off the bridge, there's no coming back.

String.Source: I wouldn't trust these automatons if I were the Quarra. No telling when they'll turn on you.
String.Dest: I wouldn't trust these automatons if I were the Quarra. No telling when they'll turn on you.

String.Source: What sort of woman was Volrina, to inspire this much posthumous loyalty?
String.Dest: What sort of woman was Volrina, to inspire this much posthumous loyalty?

String.Source: I swear Malielle can see me. She keeps looking this way.
String.Dest: I swear Malielle can see me. She keeps looking this way.

String.Source: So this whole tomb was built on top of the Iceblood Clan's old home... I wonder what the ancient Nords thought that would accomplish?
String.Dest: So this whole tomb was built on top of the Iceblood Clan's old home... I wonder what the ancient Nords thought that would accomplish?

String.Source: Can I be second in command of the clan?
String.Dest: Can I be second in command of the clan?

String.Source: So much for the famous courage of the Vigilants...
String.Dest: So much for the famous courage of the Vigilants...

String.Source: This is a bad idea. You realize that, right? Nobody sane wants to talk to Mehrunes Dagon.
String.Dest: This is a bad idea. You realize that, right? Nobody sane wants to talk to Mehrunes Dagon.

String.Source: So now that you're in charge, what's the plan for the clan? Heh... that rhymed.
String.Dest: So now that you're in charge, what's the plan for the clan? Heh... that rhymed.

String.Source: I always feel a little left out when I see people drinking. I can't help but wonder what it feels like.
String.Dest: I always feel a little left out when I see people drinking. I can't help but wonder what it feels like.

String.Source: Isn't it weird to sleep in a bed that some stranger was just sleeping in?
String.Dest: Isn't it weird to sleep in a bed that some stranger was just sleeping in?

String.Source: No. No more magic trees and magic sap. We've had enough of that.
String.Dest: No. No more magic trees and magic sap. We've had enough of that.

String.Source: No matter where you travel, there's always an inn for people to socialize in, huh?
String.Dest: No matter where you travel, there's always an inn for people to socialize in, huh?

String.Source: You have to wonder how the ancient Argonians built a place like this.
String.Dest: You have to wonder how the ancient Argonians built a place like this.

String.Source: I read that in Black Marsh, xanmeers are considered cursed. Unlucky places. Nobody would enter them intentionally.
String.Dest: I read that in Black Marsh, xanmeers are considered cursed. Unlucky places. Nobody would enter them intentionally.

String.Source: I've read that the xanmeers were supposed to be indestructible. Eternal. Reminds me of Dwarven architecture, come to think of it.
String.Dest: I've read that the xanmeers were supposed to be indestructible. Eternal. Reminds me of Dwarven architecture, come to think of it.

String.Source: I wonder if the Voskrona are anything like me? Like... the way they were created, I mean.
String.Dest: I wonder if the Voskrona are anything like me? Like... the way they were created, I mean.

String.Source: The Argonians who built the xanmeers thought they could even resist Sithis. Instead, they became dens of Void magic.
String.Dest: The Argonians who built the xanmeers thought they could even resist Sithis. Instead, they became dens of Void magic.

String.Source: I hope that was water I just stepped in... and not a voriplasm.
String.Dest: I hope that was water I just stepped in... and not a voriplasm.

String.Source: What do you think the purpose of this place was?
String.Dest: What do you think the purpose of this place was?

String.Source: I wonder what the Magna-Ge thought about the Ayleids using their starlight for power.
String.Dest: I wonder what the Magna-Ge thought about the Ayleids using their starlight for power.

String.Source: Think we'll see any flesh gardens? I read that the Ayleids were famous for those.
String.Dest: Think we'll see any flesh gardens? I read that the Ayleids were famous for those.

String.Source: Do you think the Ayleids were really all daedra worshippers?
String.Dest: Do you think the Ayleids were really all daedra worshippers?

String.Source: I don't understand why the Ayleids would want to become liches. Trapped forever in a decaying shell... Actually, that's all mortals, isn't it?
String.Dest: I don't understand why the Ayleids would want to become liches. Trapped forever in a decaying shell... Actually, that's all mortals, isn't it?

String.Source: Do you hear music?
String.Dest: Do you hear music?

String.Source: It's strange, the way Khajiit are more vulnerable to Namira than everyone else.
String.Dest: It's strange, the way Khajiit are more vulnerable to Namira than everyone else.

String.Source: If the dro-m'Athra are ever pushed back enough, the villagers should destroy these ruins. Namira's magic is written into every carving.
String.Dest: If the dro-m'Athra are ever pushed back enough, the villagers should destroy these ruins. Namira's magic is written into every carving.

String.Source: I read a story once about a man who upset Vaermina. Every time he slept, his nightmares manifested in the real world...
String.Dest: I read a story once about a man who upset Vaermina. Every time he slept, his nightmares manifested in the real world...

String.Source: I don't get why mortals aren't more afraid of dreaming. Your soul get dragged to Quagmire every night!
String.Dest: I don't get why mortals aren't more afraid of dreaming. Your soul get dragged to Quagmire every night!

String.Source: If I had my own plane of Oblivion, I'd make it way more interesting than this.
String.Dest: If I had my own plane of Oblivion, I'd make it way more interesting than this.

String.Source: If you could pick any form for yourself, why would you choose a big rock?
String.Dest: If you could pick any form for yourself, why would you choose a big rock?

String.Source: There's so many books here! Can we stop and read some?
String.Dest: There's so many books here! Can we stop and read some?

String.Source: Do you feel that? There's powerful magic inside the ash.
String.Dest: Do you feel that? There's powerful magic inside the ash.

String.Source: Ugh, there's ash collecting inside my body. This will take ages to clean out.
String.Dest: Ugh, there's ash collecting inside my body. This will take ages to clean out.

String.Source: There's a strange aura over this island. Something's trying to suppress people's thoughts...
String.Dest: There's a strange aura over this island. Something's trying to suppress people's thoughts...

String.Source: Th - this whole plane of reality is shaking! Whatever Ancano's doing, we have to stop it!
String.Dest: Th - this whole plane of reality is shaking! Whatever Ancano's doing, we have to stop it!

String.Source: I'm not qualified to understand Skyrim politics. I'll follow whichever side you say is right.
String.Dest: I'm not qualified to understand Skyrim politics. I'll follow whichever side you say is right.

String.Source: Those... Grr, how dare they arrest you over that?! Come on, let's find a way out of here!
String.Dest: Those... Grr, how dare they arrest you over that?! Come on, let's find a way out of here!

String.Source: Seriously? We're going to murder a jarl?
String.Dest: Seriously? We're going to murder a jarl?

String.Source: You aren't really going to ask Clavicus for something, are you? Every story about him says that always ends badly...
String.Dest: You aren't really going to ask Clavicus for something, are you? Every story about him says that always ends badly...

String.Source: All... all hail the brave warrior, slayer of dragons, marryier of hagravens!
String.Dest: All... all hail the brave warrior, slayer of dragons, marryier of hagravens!

String.Source: Heheh, that's the Night Mother? Hehe... No, I'm not going to tell you what I sensed. It's funnier to keep it secret.
String.Dest: Heheh, that's the Night Mother? Hehe... No, I'm not going to tell you what I sensed. It's funnier to keep it secret.

String.Source: I can't really hate Astrid. She punished herself worse than anything we can do.
String.Dest: I can't really hate Astrid. She punished herself worse than anything we can do.

String.Source: Wow... Killing the Emperor. The Dark Brotherhood really is reviving, isn't it?
String.Dest: Wow... Killing the Emperor. The Dark Brotherhood really is reviving, isn't it?

String.Source: I don't think something like me would be welcome in Sovngarde. I'll wait for you to return, so make sure you win.
String.Dest: I don't think something like me would be welcome in Sovngarde. I'll wait for you to return, so make sure you win.

String.Source: Nocturnal is a part of the Void, you know. The shadow of Namira. You really shouldn't pledge anything to her...
String.Dest: Nocturnal is a part of the Void, you know. The shadow of Namira. You really shouldn't pledge anything to her...

String.Source: I'm not fond of murder, but if anyone ever deserved it...
String.Dest: I'm not fond of murder, but if anyone ever deserved it...

String.Source: Does every town have a secret Daedric cult? I'm getting tired of these ambushes.
String.Dest: Does every town have a secret Daedric cult? I'm getting tired of these ambushes.

String.Source: There's something about this town... Something wrong.
String.Dest: There's something about this town... Something wrong.

String.Source: I love books. When I couldn't leave the Old Lands, books were my one escape.
String.Dest: I love books. When I couldn't leave the Old Lands, books were my one escape.

String.Source: The Vampyrum Order was manipulating the whole feud, huh... Personally, I've had enough of being someone's puppet.
String.Dest: The Vampyrum Order was manipulating the whole feud, huh... Personally, I've had enough of being someone's puppet.

String.Source: The Bards College deserves more respect. Passing down stories is important.
String.Dest: The Bards College deserves more respect. Passing down stories is important.

String.Source: I always wanted to attend the College of Winterhold. I wonder if any of the mages here can sense me?
String.Dest: I always wanted to attend the College of Winterhold. I wonder if any of the mages here can sense me?

String.Source: I have to get ready for our wedding. I'll meet you at the Temple of Mara when it's time.
String.Dest: I have to get ready for our wedding. I'll meet you at the Temple of Mara when it's time.

String.Source: Mind if I ask for a favor? Nothing big, I promise.
String.Dest: Mind if I ask for a favor? Nothing big, I promise.

String.Source: So... Now that I can leave the Old Lands... Can I ask you to help me with something else?
String.Dest: So... Now that I can leave the Old Lands... Can I ask you to help me with something else?

String.Source: Well... We have a wedding to plan, huh? Heh...
String.Dest: Well... We have a wedding to plan, huh? Heh...

String.Source: Don't ask me to lead a jailbreak. Even if they can't see me, the guards would notice you strolling out after I open the door.
String.Dest: Don't ask me to lead a jailbreak. Even if they can't see me, the guards would notice you strolling out after I open the door.

String.Source: That, uh... Is that an Amulet of Mara?
String.Dest: That, uh... Is that an Amulet of Mara?

String.Source: Hehehe... What is it, my love?
String.Dest: Hehehe... What is it, my love?

String.Source: Need something, darling?
String.Dest: Need something, darling?

String.Source: You should... Probably put something on. Skin rips easily, you know.
String.Dest: You should... Probably put something on. Skin rips easily, you know.

String.Source: You look different... Did you forget your outer skin?
String.Dest: You look different... Did you forget your outer skin?

String.Source: Did you forget to get dressed today? I can loan you one of my dresses...
String.Dest: Did you forget to get dressed today? I can loan you one of my dresses...

String.Source: Uh... I can see you, you know. And I don't even have eyes.
String.Dest: Uh... I can see you, you know. And I don't even have eyes.

String.Source: Mhm?
String.Dest: Mhm?

String.Source: Something up?
String.Dest: Something up?

String.Source: What's up?
String.Dest: What's up?

String.Source: Where to next?
String.Dest: Where to next?

String.Source: Let's not waste time talking, okay?
String.Dest: Let's not waste time talking, okay?

String.Source: Not now, alright?
String.Dest: Not now, alright?

String.Source: I'm glad you're the one who could see me.
String.Dest: I'm glad you're the one who could see me.

String.Source: This adventuring stuff is fun!
String.Dest: This adventuring stuff is fun!

String.Source: We make a good team, don't you think?
String.Dest: We make a good team, don't you think?

String.Source: Ow!
String.Dest: Ow!

String.Source: Ghh!
String.Dest: Ghh!

String.Source: Ghk...
String.Dest: Ghk...

String.Source: Hehehe... Good!
String.Dest: Hehehe... Good!

String.Source: Kyahah! Is that your best?
String.Dest: Kyahah! Is that your best?

String.Source: Hehehe... Hahahaha!
String.Dest: Hehehe... Hahahaha!

String.Source: If you think I can die, you're sorely mistaken.
String.Dest: If you think I can die, you're sorely mistaken.

String.Source: Fine, you got a good hit in. Now it's my turn.
String.Dest: Fine, you got a good hit in. Now it's my turn.

String.Source: Heh. Nice try!
String.Dest: Heh. Nice try!

String.Source: Hehehe. Keep trying!
String.Dest: Hehehe. Keep trying!

String.Source: Ha! So weak!
String.Dest: Ha! So weak!

String.Source: Are you trying to make me pity you?
String.Dest: Are you trying to make me pity you?

String.Source: Barely worth my attention!
String.Dest: Barely worth my attention!

String.Source: Didn't even scratch my chassis!
String.Dest: Didn't even scratch my chassis!

String.Source: We're not alone here...
String.Dest: We're not alone here...

String.Source: No hiding from me!
String.Dest: No hiding from me!

String.Source: Hm. Never mind, I guess.
String.Dest: Hm. Never mind, I guess.

String.Source: Guess they ran off.
String.Dest: Guess they ran off.

String.Source: Heh, scared?
String.Dest: Heh, scared?

String.Source: Mhm.
String.Dest: Mhm.

String.Source: Back to it.
String.Dest: Back to it.

String.Source: Let's get moving.
String.Dest: Let's get moving.

String.Source: Ah, a fellow vampire. Please, enter.
String.Dest: Ah, a fellow vampire. Please, enter.

String.Source: I think you've come to the wrong place, friend. I advise you leave... quickly. It's rather dangerous here.
String.Dest: I think you've come to the wrong place, friend. I advise you leave... quickly. It's rather dangerous here.

String.Source: Capiton Esdrecus, at your service. You may consider me a... scholar of vampiric matters. I'm researching the so-called "Old Blood," you see.
String.Dest: Capiton Esdrecus, at your service. You may consider me a... scholar of vampiric matters. I'm researching the so-called "Old Blood," you see.

String.Source: You'd best depart quickly, friend. It's not safe here.
String.Dest: You'd best depart quickly, friend. It's not safe here.

String.Source: Welcome to my humble study.
String.Dest: Welcome to my humble study.

String.Source: Pardon me. Did you need something?
String.Dest: Pardon me. Did you need something?

String.Source: My, isn't that the Bloodfire Amulet? You must be quite the explorer to have recovered that.
String.Dest: My, isn't that the Bloodfire Amulet? You must be quite the explorer to have recovered that.

String.Source: Forgive me, but I consider it indelicate to discuss such matters. Consider me a representative of myself and no other.
String.Dest: Forgive me, but I consider it indelicate to discuss such matters. Consider me a representative of myself and no other.

String.Source: Oh! Heh, pardon my rudeness, my friend.
String.Dest: Oh! Heh, pardon my rudeness, my friend.

String.Source: Indeed, I am but one of her agents. Barely worth noting - in fact, I doubt my mistress knows my name - but I do my best.
String.Dest: Indeed, I am but one of her agents. Barely worth noting - in fact, I doubt my mistress knows my name - but I do my best.

String.Source: However, you must forgive me if I refrain from discussing the details of my mission here. If you've met my mistress, you will understand.
String.Dest: However, you must forgive me if I refrain from discussing the details of my mission here. If you've met my mistress, you will understand.

String.Source: Suffice to say, I am here to see whether the vampires here... these "Old Blood" Voidsuckers and their Dryblood minions - are worth our attention.
String.Dest: Suffice to say, I am here to see whether the vampires here... these "Old Blood" Voidsuckers and their Dryblood minions - are worth our attention.

String.Source: And I am pleased to say they are not. These vampires are nothing but animals - not worth any further thought. I'm sure you agree.
String.Dest: And I am pleased to say they are not. These vampires are nothing but animals - not worth any further thought. I'm sure you agree.

String.Source: At present? I am conducting a study on this "Old Blood."
String.Dest: At present? I am conducting a study on this "Old Blood."

String.Source: In fact, I recently completed my alchemical analysis. Suffice to say, it is not worth our time - or that of any self-respecting vampire.
String.Dest: In fact, I recently completed my alchemical analysis. Suffice to say, it is not worth our time - or that of any self-respecting vampire.

String.Source: It could only be considered blood in the metaphorical sense.
String.Dest: It could only be considered blood in the metaphorical sense.

String.Source: It's sap. Hist sap.
String.Dest: It's sap. Hist sap.

String.Source: Not pure, of course. There's a great deal of other compounds mixed in, lending it its "bloody" appearance and taste.
String.Dest: Not pure, of course. There's a great deal of other compounds mixed in, lending it its "bloody" appearance and taste.

String.Source: In fact, if one were foolish enough to ingest it, it would likely suffice as a makeshift Potion of Blood... albeit a highly addictive one.
String.Dest: In fact, if one were foolish enough to ingest it, it would likely suffice as a makeshift Potion of Blood... albeit a highly addictive one.

String.Source: I'd like a bit longer to finish my studies before I say for sure. But I certainly wouldn't advise drinking it.
String.Dest: I'd like a bit longer to finish my studies before I say for sure. But I certainly wouldn't advise drinking it.

String.Source: Indeed. Those "Bloodroots" we see around this realm are, I believe, the roots of that very Hist.
String.Dest: Indeed. Those "Bloodroots" we see around this realm are, I believe, the roots of that very Hist.

String.Source: Though I doubt the tree is in good health. The composition of its sap makes it clear that it is quite mutated.
String.Dest: Though I doubt the tree is in good health. The composition of its sap makes it clear that it is quite mutated.

String.Source: Of course, I don't know where it is, but I'm sure it's somewhere around this realm.
String.Dest: Of course, I don't know where it is, but I'm sure it's somewhere around this realm.

String.Source: Likely wherever reality is weakest... I've detected the influence of Void magic within this sap, so I assume this Hist is tightly linked to the Void.
String.Dest: Likely wherever reality is weakest... I've detected the influence of Void magic within this sap, so I assume this Hist is tightly linked to the Void.

String.Source: I'm no scholar of Void magic, though. I shouldn't speculate further - I'm simply not qualified.
String.Dest: I'm no scholar of Void magic, though. I shouldn't speculate further - I'm simply not qualified.

String.Source: Either way, it's of no relevance to my purposes here. I'm simply here to see if this "Blood" would be useful... and it is not.
String.Dest: Either way, it's of no relevance to my purposes here. I'm simply here to see if this "Blood" would be useful... and it is not.

String.Source: I'll be departing this place soon. Feel free to help yourself to my supplies.
String.Dest: I'll be departing this place soon. Feel free to help yourself to my supplies.

String.Source: Fear the Old Blood... Heh.
String.Dest: Fear the Old Blood... Heh.

String.Source: I'll forgive your foolishness this once.
String.Dest: I'll forgive your foolishness this once.

String.Source: Challenging me was foolish!
String.Dest: Challenging me was foolish!

String.Source: Your blood is mine!
String.Dest: Your blood is mine!

String.Source: You'll make a fine meal!
String.Dest: You'll make a fine meal!

String.Source: Forgive me, Mistress...
String.Dest: Forgive me, Mistress...

String.Source: Take... this!
String.Dest: Take... this!

String.Source: Worthless thinblood!
String.Dest: Worthless thinblood!

String.Source: A cave! A gaping wound in the flesh of the world... Let's go in!
String.Dest: A cave! A gaping wound in the flesh of the world... Let's go in!

String.Source: Oh, another cave. Shall we explore?
String.Dest: Oh, another cave. Shall we explore?

String.Source: The mountains of Skyrim sure do have a lot of caves. What do you think is inside this one?
String.Dest: The mountains of Skyrim sure do have a lot of caves. What do you think is inside this one?

String.Source: Ugh... A Dwarven ruin... Do we have to go in?
String.Dest: Ugh... A Dwarven ruin... Do we have to go in?

String.Source: You can always tell when the Dwemer were present... The whole world just starts to feel "empty."
String.Dest: You can always tell when the Dwemer were present... The whole world just starts to feel "empty."

String.Source: It would be safer for everyone if we just collapsed the entrance to every Dwemer ruin we found... Do we have to go in?
String.Dest: It would be safer for everyone if we just collapsed the entrance to every Dwemer ruin we found... Do we have to go in?

String.Source: I can sense the undead... Must be draugr nearby.
String.Dest: I can sense the undead... Must be draugr nearby.

String.Source: I respect the ancient Nords much more than the Dwemer. The Nords knew how to use the Voice properly, not like those tonal architects.
String.Dest: I respect the ancient Nords much more than the Dwemer. The Nords knew how to use the Voice properly, not like those tonal architects.

String.Source: Another Nord tomb. Think anyone would mind if I ate a few draugr's souls?
String.Dest: Another Nord tomb. Think anyone would mind if I ate a few draugr's souls?

String.Source: Mortal politics make no sense to me... but I do sympathize with the Forsworn. The Reach is their ancient home.
String.Dest: Mortal politics make no sense to me... but I do sympathize with the Forsworn. The Reach is their ancient home.

String.Source: Let's be cautious. The Heart still echoes here.
String.Dest: Let's be cautious. The Heart still echoes here.

String.Source: Impressive. Very impressive.
String.Dest: Impressive. Very impressive.

String.Source: Oh, I like this place.
String.Dest: Oh, I like this place.

String.Source: This seems like a good place for a rest. I'll keep an eye out if you want... metaphorically speaking.
String.Dest: This seems like a good place for a rest. I'll keep an eye out if you want... metaphorically speaking.

String.Source: Hmm... I smell blood. Lots of blood.
String.Dest: Hmm... I smell blood. Lots of blood.

String.Source: I can sense something up ahead... Weapons ready.
String.Dest: I can sense something up ahead... Weapons ready.

String.Source: There was a massacre here. The souls are restless.
String.Dest: There was a massacre here. The souls are restless.

String.Source: I can sense the Void...
String.Dest: I can sense the Void...

String.Source: My, how sad... It seems I've missed all the excitement.
String.Dest: My, how sad... It seems I've missed all the excitement.

String.Source: An Amulet of Mara, hm? Is there something you'd like to ask me?
