String.Dest: An Amulet of Mara, hm? Is there something you'd like to ask me?

String.Source: How may I serve?
String.Dest: How may I serve?

String.Source: A hungry glint in thine eyes... I fear my blood shan't sate thee, however.
String.Dest: A hungry glint in thine eyes... I fear my blood shan't sate thee, however.

String.Source: Something troubles thee?
String.Dest: Something troubles thee?

String.Source: Be there something on thy mind?
String.Dest: Be there something on thy mind?

String.Source: Dost something trouble thy thoughts?
String.Dest: Dost something trouble thy thoughts?

String.Source: Mm?
String.Dest: Mm?

String.Source: Hm? Didst thou say something?
String.Dest: Hm? Didst thou say something?

String.Source: Hm? Pardon, my thoughts were elsewhere.
String.Dest: Hm? Pardon, my thoughts were elsewhere.

String.Source: I am a Glassringer. 'Tis my sacred duty to serve as guardian to the Glass Asylum and to ensure that none of our charges... escape.
String.Dest: I am a Glassringer. 'Tis my sacred duty to serve as guardian to the Glass Asylum and to ensure that none of our charges... escape.

String.Source: 'Tis a place for those poor souls fallen victim to the Glass.
String.Dest: 'Tis a place for those poor souls fallen victim to the Glass.

String.Source: The Void still clings to you... To ask further questions would be unwise. Thy soul is not yet prepared.
String.Dest: The Void still clings to you... To ask further questions would be unwise. Thy soul is not yet prepared.

String.Source: Sadly, some do not see the value of our purpose... They seek to return to a world in which they no longer belong.
String.Dest: Sadly, some do not see the value of our purpose... They seek to return to a world in which they no longer belong.

String.Source: Thus enter the Glassringers, that our bells may put an end to matters.
String.Dest: Thus enter the Glassringers, that our bells may put an end to matters.

String.Source: I was curious. The surge of Void magic was intriguing.
String.Dest: I was curious. The surge of Void magic was intriguing.

String.Source: Sadly, it seems I've arrived too late. You've already put an end to this scheme, have you not?
String.Dest: Sadly, it seems I've arrived too late. You've already put an end to this scheme, have you not?

String.Source: Well, I see no reason to waste my trip. Even with the curse broken, there are still interesting sights to see here.
String.Dest: Well, I see no reason to waste my trip. Even with the curse broken, there are still interesting sights to see here.

String.Source: And as for you... Hm, meeting you may be beneficial.
String.Dest: And as for you... Hm, meeting you may be beneficial.

String.Source: You see... I'm afraid I've rather overpacked. Perhaps you'd like to take some things off my hands?
String.Dest: You see... I'm afraid I've rather overpacked. Perhaps you'd like to take some things off my hands?

String.Source: I doubt you've seen the likes of these before.
String.Dest: I doubt you've seen the likes of these before.

String.Source: Oh? What's this? You can see me?
String.Dest: Oh? What's this? You can see me?

String.Source: Well. This is surprising. You're the first one who could perceive me at all.
String.Dest: Well. This is surprising. You're the first one who could perceive me at all.

String.Source: Well, since I'm not talking to myself anymore... Introductions, I suppose?
String.Dest: Well, since I'm not talking to myself anymore... Introductions, I suppose?

String.Source: Call me Audrey. I'm afraid I'm not sure what my real name is.
String.Dest: Call me Audrey. I'm afraid I'm not sure what my real name is.

String.Source: Oh, and don't worry. Despite appearances, I don't bite.
String.Dest: Oh, and don't worry. Despite appearances, I don't bite.

String.Source: I think I might have read that name somewhere? I just liked how it sounded.
String.Dest: I think I might have read that name somewhere? I just liked how it sounded.

String.Source: Hm... Well, with that little ring you've got, I guess you might be able to eat it... But once you do, it'll be part of you forever.
String.Dest: Hm... Well, with that little ring you've got, I guess you might be able to eat it... But once you do, it'll be part of you forever.

String.Source: You're clearly special, considering that you can see me. Why risk your soul? Heheh.
String.Dest: You're clearly special, considering that you can see me. Why risk your soul? Heheh.

String.Source: You haven't been influenced by the Blood yet, so consuming the Meat would be...
String.Dest: You haven't been influenced by the Blood yet, so consuming the Meat would be...

String.Source: Not meat, Meat. There's a distinction.
String.Dest: Not meat, Meat. There's a distinction.

String.Source: Freshly dug up from the Meat Mines.
String.Dest: Freshly dug up from the Meat Mines.

String.Source: Regardless... I wouldn't recommend eating that. The locals here might think eating it "moistens the Blood," but...
String.Dest: Regardless... I wouldn't recommend eating that. The locals here might think eating it "moistens the Blood," but...

String.Source: Not unless they're all really good at playing dumb.
String.Dest: Not unless they're all really good at playing dumb.

String.Source: I've been here... oh, probably ten years by now. Nobody's been able to see or hear me yet.
String.Dest: I've been here... oh, probably ten years by now. Nobody's been able to see or hear me yet.

String.Source: At first I thought it was something about this place corrupting the locals, but...
String.Dest: At first I thought it was something about this place corrupting the locals, but...

String.Source: Well, every now and then someone wanders in from outside, and other than you, none of them could perceive me either.
String.Dest: Well, every now and then someone wanders in from outside, and other than you, none of them could perceive me either.

String.Source: There must be something unique about you... How interesting.
String.Dest: There must be something unique about you... How interesting.

String.Source: Hm... Is that what I seem like to you?
String.Dest: Hm... Is that what I seem like to you?

String.Source: Hehehe, alright then. Let's go with that.
String.Dest: Hehehe, alright then. Let's go with that.

String.Source: At least you can see me, even if that's what you're seeing...
String.Dest: At least you can see me, even if that's what you're seeing...

String.Source: Hehe... I wouldn't eat that if I were you...
String.Dest: Hehe... I wouldn't eat that if I were you...

String.Source: Hm... that doesn't sound good.
String.Dest: Hm... that doesn't sound good.

String.Source: Shall we investigate?
String.Dest: Shall we investigate?

String.Source: Drybloods, mostly. When someone becomes reliant on the Old Blood... At first it strengthens them, but eventually it...
String.Dest: Drybloods, mostly. When someone becomes reliant on the Old Blood... At first it strengthens them, but eventually it...

String.Source: Well, it's as the name says. Once their blood is fully replaced with the Old Blood, it starts to dry up... The pain drives them to madness.
String.Dest: Well, it's as the name says. Once their blood is fully replaced with the Old Blood, it starts to dry up... The pain drives them to madness.

String.Source: The village guards try to keep them out, but they're always finding new ways in.
String.Dest: The village guards try to keep them out, but they're always finding new ways in.

String.Source: This isn't a good place to explain... and I'm really not the one who should be explaining, anyway.
String.Dest: This isn't a good place to explain... and I'm really not the one who should be explaining, anyway.

String.Source: Let's get outside. The villagers can answer your questions... If they survived the Dryblood attack.
String.Dest: Let's get outside. The villagers can answer your questions... If they survived the Dryblood attack.

String.Source: Well now. When I realized I'd missed some Drybloods, I figured they'd already killed you. You're hardier than you look.
String.Dest: Well now. When I realized I'd missed some Drybloods, I figured they'd already killed you. You're hardier than you look.

String.Source: Don't see Duraeg with you, though. Drybloods get him?
String.Dest: Don't see Duraeg with you, though. Drybloods get him?

String.Source: Well, I'm sure you did what you could... I'll have the healer come fetch the body.
String.Dest: Well, I'm sure you did what you could... I'll have the healer come fetch the body.

String.Source: But before I do, can you spare a moment for an old man?
String.Dest: But before I do, can you spare a moment for an old man?

String.Source: We call it the Old Lands. The ones who first founded this village said it was where the world began.
String.Dest: We call it the Old Lands. The ones who first founded this village said it was where the world began.

String.Source: According to the mages who sometimes visit from Tamriel, this place is... what was the term?
String.Dest: According to the mages who sometimes visit from Tamriel, this place is... what was the term?

String.Source: A "demiplane." That's the word. They say it's another realm, somewhere between Nirn and... something else.
String.Dest: A "demiplane." That's the word. They say it's another realm, somewhere between Nirn and... something else.

String.Source: Can't say I get it myself, but magic's not my business. I've picked here to settle, and that's all I need to know.
String.Dest: Can't say I get it myself, but magic's not my business. I've picked here to settle, and that's all I need to know.

String.Source: If you want to ask someone with more knowledge of magic, try Ahodsil Thorntaker, our healer.
String.Dest: If you want to ask someone with more knowledge of magic, try Ahodsil Thorntaker, our healer.

String.Source: From what I hear, you fell.
String.Dest: From what I hear, you fell.

String.Source: Twisted Root Cave's our connection back to Skyrim. From the sounds of it, the cave must've collapsed when you came through.
String.Dest: Twisted Root Cave's our connection back to Skyrim. From the sounds of it, the cave must've collapsed when you came through.

String.Source: Well, not like we can go back to Skyrim anyway. The Old Blood can't leave this realm, and we can't leave the Blood.
String.Dest: Well, not like we can go back to Skyrim anyway. The Old Blood can't leave this realm, and we can't leave the Blood.

String.Source: Still, the guards went to work clearing the rubble right away. We do rely on some trade with the tribes of the Reach, after all.
String.Dest: Still, the guards went to work clearing the rubble right away. We do rely on some trade with the tribes of the Reach, after all.

String.Source: Always forget you outsiders don't know about it.
String.Dest: Always forget you outsiders don't know about it.

String.Source: It's the Blood of the world. The sacred liquid that keeps Mundus alive.
String.Dest: It's the Blood of the world. The sacred liquid that keeps Mundus alive.

String.Source: And this is the only place you can still tap into it. The Roots sticking out of the ground here are filled with the Old Blood.
String.Dest: And this is the only place you can still tap into it. The Roots sticking out of the ground here are filled with the Old Blood.

String.Source: Or at least... They used to be.
String.Dest: Or at least... They used to be.

String.Source: The Blood is drying out. Most of the Roots only give us a few drops now.
String.Dest: The Blood is drying out. Most of the Roots only give us a few drops now.

String.Source: The people who became one with the Blood are suffering the most. Many have already become Drybloods. Mindless beasts.
String.Dest: The people who became one with the Blood are suffering the most. Many have already become Drybloods. Mindless beasts.

String.Source: Everyone else is stockpiling as much as they can get, but it won't last long. If a new source isn't found, everyone here will become a Dryblood.
String.Dest: Everyone else is stockpiling as much as they can get, but it won't last long. If a new source isn't found, everyone here will become a Dryblood.

String.Source: Hm... Say. You seem like the adventurous sort.
String.Dest: Hm... Say. You seem like the adventurous sort.

String.Source: Might I ask you for a favor?
String.Dest: Might I ask you for a favor?

String.Source: Name's Rukar.
String.Dest: Name's Rukar.

String.Source: I'm a hunter. Last one left around here.
String.Dest: I'm a hunter. Last one left around here.

String.Source: I help the guards protect the village... But I'm getting old. Can't fight like I used to... as you can see.
String.Dest: I help the guards protect the village... But I'm getting old. Can't fight like I used to... as you can see.

String.Source: Even if you were just defending yourself, you still avenged Duraeg. You've got my thanks for that.
String.Dest: Even if you were just defending yourself, you still avenged Duraeg. You've got my thanks for that.

String.Source: Like I said... the Old Blood is drying up. If things don't change, everyone here will die.
String.Dest: Like I said... the Old Blood is drying up. If things don't change, everyone here will die.

String.Source: Now, I know you're not one of us. You've got no obligations - though I'll mention we did patch you up after you landed here.
String.Dest: Now, I know you're not one of us. You've got no obligations - though I'll mention we did patch you up after you landed here.

String.Source: My point is we need help. Most of the folk here are too weak to do anything without the Blood, and the rest are busy keeping us alive.
String.Dest: My point is we need help. Most of the folk here are too weak to do anything without the Blood, and the rest are busy keeping us alive.

String.Source: You, though... You're in fine health, and you seem like the sort who likes a good fight.
String.Dest: You, though... You're in fine health, and you seem like the sort who likes a good fight.

String.Source: If you could explore - go to the places we can't survive ourselves - and either find out why the Blood is drying or find a way to break its hold...
String.Dest: If you could explore - go to the places we can't survive ourselves - and either find out why the Blood is drying or find a way to break its hold...

String.Source: Well, I can't promise you a reward just now, but I'll find some way to compensate you. Hunter's word.
String.Dest: Well, I can't promise you a reward just now, but I'll find some way to compensate you. Hunter's word.

String.Source: That's all I ask.
String.Dest: That's all I ask.

String.Source: Fair enough. Tell you what... Look around a bit, and if you change your mind, you know where to find the bells.
String.Dest: Fair enough. Tell you what... Look around a bit, and if you change your mind, you know where to find the bells.

String.Source: If not... You should still be able to leave. The Blood hasn't taken hold of you yet.
String.Dest: If not... You should still be able to leave. The Blood hasn't taken hold of you yet.

String.Source: Though I'd advise you to not linger too long before you decide.
String.Dest: Though I'd advise you to not linger too long before you decide.

String.Source: The core of the problem is the Old Blood itself. The Roots no longer provide what we need.
String.Dest: The core of the problem is the Old Blood itself. The Roots no longer provide what we need.

String.Source: Either the flow of Blood must resume or the influence of the Blood over this village must be broken. Either way, the solution is the same.
String.Dest: Either the flow of Blood must resume or the influence of the Blood over this village must be broken. Either way, the solution is the same.

String.Source: The source of the Blood must be found.
String.Dest: The source of the Blood must be found.

String.Source: In some ways, it's easier than you might think.
String.Dest: In some ways, it's easier than you might think.

String.Source: Do you see those distant spires? That is the palace of the Hollow Princess.
String.Dest: Do you see those distant spires? That is the palace of the Hollow Princess.

String.Source: Countless ages ago, the Princess founded this settlement. She brought mortals to this realm.
String.Dest: Countless ages ago, the Princess founded this settlement. She brought mortals to this realm.

String.Source: And according to legend, she built her palace atop the source of the Blood to ensure herself a limitless supply.
String.Dest: And according to legend, she built her palace atop the source of the Blood to ensure herself a limitless supply.

String.Source: But of course, if we could simply enter the palace, we would have done so long ago.
String.Dest: But of course, if we could simply enter the palace, we would have done so long ago.

String.Source: The gates of the palace are sealed by ancient magic. In all the ages this settlement has existed, none have breached its walls.
String.Dest: The gates of the palace are sealed by ancient magic. In all the ages this settlement has existed, none have breached its walls.

String.Source: Though it is not that the method of breaking it is unknown... simply that none here can achieve it.
String.Dest: Though it is not that the method of breaking it is unknown... simply that none here can achieve it.

String.Source: You see, entry to the palace required the agreement of each of the clans that once dwelled in this realm... none of whom exist any longer.
String.Dest: You see, entry to the palace required the agreement of each of the clans that once dwelled in this realm... none of whom exist any longer.

String.Source: Each clan was possessed of a great bell, forged of pure Blood Iron. According to the myths, when all of the bells ring, the palace doors will open.
String.Dest: Each clan was possessed of a great bell, forged of pure Blood Iron. According to the myths, when all of the bells ring, the palace doors will open.

String.Source: Sadly, circumstances have rendered most of the bells out of our reach. Though not, I hope, out of yours.
String.Dest: Sadly, circumstances have rendered most of the bells out of our reach. Though not, I hope, out of yours.

String.Source: There are five bells in total. When the founders of this village were cast out of the palace, they took three bells with them.
String.Dest: There are five bells in total. When the founders of this village were cast out of the palace, they took three bells with them.

String.Source: One can be found in the village square, though sadly it has been damaged by the passage of time... I am working to repair it, but it will take time.
String.Dest: One can be found in the village square, though sadly it has been damaged by the passage of time... I am working to repair it, but it will take time.

String.Source: One can be found in the Church of the Old Blood, located in the northwest of the village, though I fear the Priestess may not be amenable.
String.Dest: One can be found in the Church of the Old Blood, located in the northwest of the village, though I fear the Priestess may not be amenable.

String.Source: And one remains in the ruins of the old settlement to the east. The ruins are infested by Drybloods... and worse.
String.Dest: And one remains in the ruins of the old settlement to the east. The ruins are infested by Drybloods... and worse.

String.Source: The guard at the gates can tell you more.
String.Dest: The guard at the gates can tell you more.

String.Source: As for the fourth, it lies in the forest that surrounds the palace.
String.Dest: As for the fourth, it lies in the forest that surrounds the palace.

String.Source: But none who venture into the forest's depths have returned... Many eldritch forces dwell there. Servants of the Hollow Princess.
String.Dest: But none who venture into the forest's depths have returned... Many eldritch forces dwell there. Servants of the Hollow Princess.

String.Source: The exact whereabouts of that bell are unknown to me, I'm afraid.
String.Dest: The exact whereabouts of that bell are unknown to me, I'm afraid.

String.Source: The ancient legends say the bells share a connection, so perhaps once the others are rung, the fifth will reveal itself?
String.Dest: The ancient legends say the bells share a connection, so perhaps once the others are rung, the fifth will reveal itself?

String.Source: If not... Well, we can deal with that when that time comes.
String.Dest: If not... Well, we can deal with that when that time comes.

String.Source: For now, if you are willing to attempt the journey, I would suggest ringing the three accessible bells first.
String.Dest: For now, if you are willing to attempt the journey, I would suggest ringing the three accessible bells first.

String.Source: Mhm... It's strange.
String.Dest: Mhm... It's strange.

String.Source: I wasn't awake at the time, but... I remember this place anyway. This is where I was... born, I guess.
String.Dest: I wasn't awake at the time, but... I remember this place anyway. This is where I was... born, I guess.

String.Source: Whatever sort of spirit I used to be... It possessed this body here, in this cave.
String.Dest: Whatever sort of spirit I used to be... It possessed this body here, in this cave.

String.Source: If... it's alright with you, I'd like to explore here for a bit. I think there's something up ahead.
String.Dest: If... it's alright with you, I'd like to explore here for a bit. I think there's something up ahead.

String.Source: Of course, Your Majesty. This mere peasant will keep her mouth shut.
String.Dest: Of course, Your Majesty. This mere peasant will keep her mouth shut.

String.Source: Heh, sorry. I'll keep my thoughts to myself unless they're important.
String.Dest: Heh, sorry. I'll keep my thoughts to myself unless they're important.

String.Source: Oops, sorry. Hope I wasn't being annoying.
String.Dest: Oops, sorry. Hope I wasn't being annoying.

String.Source: Craving my insight, hm? Heheh.
String.Dest: Craving my insight, hm? Heheh.

String.Source: Heh, I knew you'd miss our chats.
String.Dest: Heh, I knew you'd miss our chats.

String.Source: Oh, now you want to hear me? Maybe I don't want to talk to you.
String.Dest: Oh, now you want to hear me? Maybe I don't want to talk to you.

String.Source: While the Voidsucker vampires shouldn't pose any direct threats to the stability of Skyrim's clans, it's always better to be sure.
String.Dest: While the Voidsucker vampires shouldn't pose any direct threats to the stability of Skyrim's clans, it's always better to be sure.

String.Source: With their "Blood" running out, the Voidsucker vampires have begun searching for new prey - including venturing into Skyrim.
String.Dest: With their "Blood" running out, the Voidsucker vampires have begun searching for new prey - including venturing into Skyrim.

String.Source: Based on Vigilant reports we intercepted, one Voidsucker already made it into the Reach and attacked several caravans.
String.Dest: Based on Vigilant reports we intercepted, one Voidsucker already made it into the Reach and attacked several caravans.

String.Source: Thankfully, it was written off as an isolated feral vampire, but the last thing we need is for further attacks to rile up the prey.
String.Dest: Thankfully, it was written off as an isolated feral vampire, but the last thing we need is for further attacks to rile up the prey.

String.Source: At this juncture, the prudent measure is to simply eliminate the clan. They're too feral to be negotiated with.
String.Dest: At this juncture, the prudent measure is to simply eliminate the clan. They're too feral to be negotiated with.

String.Source: First, we need to examine their movements. I've noticed many of their hunters seemingly searching the forest of late.
String.Dest: First, we need to examine their movements. I've noticed many of their hunters seemingly searching the forest of late.

String.Source: We should discover what they're searching for. Ambush their hunters and search their remains for clues.
String.Dest: We should discover what they're searching for. Ambush their hunters and search their remains for clues.

String.Source: Along with the Argonian settlement in the swamp, it's the sole remaining bastion of civilization here.
String.Dest: Along with the Argonian settlement in the swamp, it's the sole remaining bastion of civilization here.

String.Source: Everywhere else is ruins. Overrun by Drybloods or worse.
String.Dest: Everywhere else is ruins. Overrun by Drybloods or worse.

String.Source: But even the village has decayed. Many of the people have died, and many more have become Drybloods. Most of the buildings have fallen to ruin.
String.Dest: But even the village has decayed. Many of the people have died, and many more have become Drybloods. Most of the buildings have fallen to ruin.

String.Source: If a new source of Blood can be found - or if we can find a cure for our reliance upon it - the village may survive.
String.Dest: If a new source of Blood can be found - or if we can find a cure for our reliance upon it - the village may survive.

String.Source: If not... before long, this village will become just another Dryblood ruin.
String.Dest: If not... before long, this village will become just another Dryblood ruin.

String.Source: Oh, I've been here a good twenty years at this point.
String.Dest: Oh, I've been here a good twenty years at this point.

String.Source: I grew up hearing tales of the Old Lands from the Vateshran of my clan, but I never believed it was real.
String.Dest: I grew up hearing tales of the Old Lands from the Vateshran of my clan, but I never believed it was real.

String.Source: If only I'd come here when I was younger, perhaps I could have done more...
String.Dest: If only I'd come here when I was younger, perhaps I could have done more...

String.Source: "Was" might be a better word.
String.Dest: "Was" might be a better word.

String.Source: According to legend, she was an Ayleid priestess. One of the long-extinct Cyrodiil elves.
String.Dest: According to legend, she was an Ayleid priestess. One of the long-extinct Cyrodiil elves.

String.Source: They say she brought her people here, to the Old Lands, following a vision granted to her by the ancient spirits.
String.Dest: They say she brought her people here, to the Old Lands, following a vision granted to her by the ancient spirits.

String.Source: She founded the village, built the Hollow Palace. Shaped the entire land into a home for her followers.
String.Dest: She founded the village, built the Hollow Palace. Shaped the entire land into a home for her followers.

String.Source: Of course, being an Ayleid, she was also a cruel sadist. Her tortures for those who opposed her were so severe that people still fear her today.
String.Dest: Of course, being an Ayleid, she was also a cruel sadist. Her tortures for those who opposed her were so severe that people still fear her today.

String.Source: But she lived back in the Merethic Era. If any aspect of her still exists, it's certainly not something you could call "alive."
String.Dest: But she lived back in the Merethic Era. If any aspect of her still exists, it's certainly not something you could call "alive."

String.Source: Let's go outside first. It's not safe in here.
String.Dest: Let's go outside first. It's not safe in here.

String.Source: Didn't you hear the scream? Not a good time to talk...
String.Dest: Didn't you hear the scream? Not a good time to talk...

String.Source: Hehehe.
String.Dest: Hehehe.

String.Source: Uh... I mean, I am, but... Well, look at me.
String.Dest: Uh... I mean, I am, but... Well, look at me.

String.Source: Do you really think a possessed doll is a good candidate for marriage?
String.Dest: Do you really think a possessed doll is a good candidate for marriage?

String.Source: Yeah. Let's, uh... Let's pretend this conversation never happened.
String.Dest: Yeah. Let's, uh... Let's pretend this conversation never happened.

String.Source: Uh... So, wait. You're... actually interested in me?
String.Dest: Uh... So, wait. You're... actually interested in me?

String.Source: You... Are you just teasing me?
String.Dest: You... Are you just teasing me?

String.Source: Agh, fine. Let's pretend this never happened, okay?
String.Dest: Agh, fine. Let's pretend this never happened, okay?

String.Source: Uh. I... You know what? What the heck. Let's do it.
String.Dest: Uh. I... You know what? What the heck. Let's do it.

String.Source: I don't know if the other people at the wedding will even be able to see me, but if you're okay looking like a lunatic, I'm with you.
String.Dest: I don't know if the other people at the wedding will even be able to see me, but if you're okay looking like a lunatic, I'm with you.

String.Source: I guess I should get ready. I'll meet you at the Temple of Mara!
String.Dest: I guess I should get ready. I'll meet you at the Temple of Mara!

String.Source: I am trying VERY hard not to stab you right now. It's not easy.
String.Dest: I am trying VERY hard not to stab you right now. It's not easy.

String.Source: You- What is WRONG with you!?
String.Dest: You- What is WRONG with you!?

String.Source: I should have killed you while you were trapped under all that rubble!
String.Dest: I should have killed you while you were trapped under all that rubble!

String.Source: Get... Get away from me!
String.Dest: Get... Get away from me!

String.Source: You... Hah. Fine... I must be crazy, but okay.
String.Dest: You... Hah. Fine... I must be crazy, but okay.

String.Source: Let's do it right this time, okay?
String.Dest: Let's do it right this time, okay?

String.Source: Hehehe. When I'm with you, how can I not smile?
String.Dest: Hehehe. When I'm with you, how can I not smile?

String.Source: Trust me; it's just appearances. There's nothing fun about being stuck with you.
String.Dest: Trust me; it's just appearances. There's nothing fun about being stuck with you.

String.Source: Still better than nobody being able to perceive me, though, so we're stuck together anyway.
String.Dest: Still better than nobody being able to perceive me, though, so we're stuck together anyway.

String.Source: I don't really have a choice, do I? My face isn't flesh like yours. It's bone ceramic.
String.Dest: I don't really have a choice, do I? My face isn't flesh like yours. It's bone ceramic.

String.Source: Frankly, I'm just glad my mouth can move at all.
String.Dest: Frankly, I'm just glad my mouth can move at all.

String.Source: You're the first person I've met who can actually see me.
String.Dest: You're the first person I've met who can actually see me.

String.Source: You can't begin to imagine how lonely that gets... No matter what you do, nobody even realizes you exist.
String.Dest: You can't begin to imagine how lonely that gets... No matter what you do, nobody even realizes you exist.

String.Source: Besides... you've got an aura about you. I think we have similar goals, at least for now.
String.Dest: Besides... you've got an aura about you. I think we have similar goals, at least for now.

String.Source: Don't worry. I won't get in your way.
String.Dest: Don't worry. I won't get in your way.

String.Source: Ah! Wait! Don't move!
String.Dest: Ah! Wait! Don't move!

String.Source: You see that reddish dirt up ahead? The spot that's glowing a little?
String.Dest: You see that reddish dirt up ahead? The spot that's glowing a little?

String.Source: That means the Bloodroots under there are damaged. If you step too close, it will start draining the blood right out through your flesh.
String.Dest: That means the Bloodroots under there are damaged. If you step too close, it will start draining the blood right out through your flesh.

String.Source: I once saw a man in full armor turned into a lifeless husk by those patches.
String.Dest: I once saw a man in full armor turned into a lifeless husk by those patches.

String.Source: So, uh... Watch your step, I guess.
String.Dest: So, uh... Watch your step, I guess.

String.Source: "Oh, Mehela, go to the Old Lands! There's so much blood there it pours from the ground!" Yeah, great advice, Hafdring...
String.Dest: "Oh, Mehela, go to the Old Lands! There's so much blood there it pours from the ground!" Yeah, great advice, Hafdring...

String.Source: Drybloods getting restless again. Screams in the night...
String.Dest: Drybloods getting restless again. Screams in the night...

String.Source: Another... fine day.
String.Dest: Another... fine day.

String.Source: Ah, Mehela. Do you have a moment?
String.Dest: Ah, Mehela. Do you have a moment?

String.Source: Actually, I have to pick up some -
String.Dest: Actually, I have to pick up some -

String.Source: This won't be long.
String.Dest: This won't be long.

String.Source: It seems one of the guests at your inn was complaining of strange fevers and nightmares afterward. And he swears something bit him while he slept.
String.Dest: It seems one of the guests at your inn was complaining of strange fevers and nightmares afterward. And he swears something bit him while he slept.

String.Source: Er... Well, nightmares and illnesses are common when staying in an unfamiliar place, right?
String.Dest: Er... Well, nightmares and illnesses are common when staying in an unfamiliar place, right?

String.Source: Thankfully, some Bloodcrab Chitin and Hawk Feathers cleared everything up... this time.
String.Dest: Thankfully, some Bloodcrab Chitin and Hawk Feathers cleared everything up... this time.

String.Source: Well, I'm glad to hear it. Is that all?
String.Dest: Well, I'm glad to hear it. Is that all?

String.Source: Just a reminder to be cautious. This village faces enough dangers from the outside already.
String.Dest: Just a reminder to be cautious. This village faces enough dangers from the outside already.

String.Source: Oh, and Mehela... You've been looking very hungry lately. I'm glad to see you look more satisfied today.
String.Dest: Oh, and Mehela... You've been looking very hungry lately. I'm glad to see you look more satisfied today.

String.Source: Er, yes. Thank you.
String.Dest: Er, yes. Thank you.

String.Source: I'll... just be going now.
String.Dest: I'll... just be going now.

String.Source: Because I'm like you! I'm a vam- oh, you mean why isn't the Old Blood enough?
String.Dest: Because I'm like you! I'm a vam- oh, you mean why isn't the Old Blood enough?

String.Source: It keeps me from going feral, but it just tastes disgusting! It's like eating metallic sap!
String.Dest: It keeps me from going feral, but it just tastes disgusting! It's like eating metallic sap!

String.Source: Blood Potions might not be as satisfying as actual blood, but it's better than only ever drinking that sludge.
String.Dest: Blood Potions might not be as satisfying as actual blood, but it's better than only ever drinking that sludge.

String.Source: I can't even feed on the villagers! I mean, for one thing, they'd kill me, but also they've used the Old Blood for so long they taste like it too!
String.Dest: I can't even feed on the villagers! I mean, for one thing, they'd kill me, but also they've used the Old Blood for so long they taste like it too!

String.Source: I'll- I'll buy whatever you have! One? Five? Ten?
String.Dest: I'll- I'll buy whatever you have! One? Five? Ten?

String.Source: Yes! Thank you!
String.Dest: Yes! Thank you!

String.Source: Yes! This will last me a while!
String.Dest: Yes! This will last me a while!

String.Source: Really? You mean it? You're sure?
String.Dest: Really? You mean it? You're sure?

String.Source: Wh- Bu- bu- but-
String.Dest: Wh- Bu- bu- but-

String.Source: The Reachmen say that the Void is not good or evil. It is raw potential and can be shaped for good or ill.
String.Dest: The Reachmen say that the Void is not good or evil. It is raw potential and can be shaped for good or ill.

String.Source: In ancient Khajiit myths - long before the Riddle'Thar Epiphany - we had similar beliefs. There was Namiira, the Dark Heart - and there was Lorkhaj.
String.Dest: In ancient Khajiit myths - long before the Riddle'Thar Epiphany - we had similar beliefs. There was Namiira, the Dark Heart - and there was Lorkhaj.

String.Source: When under the influence of Namiira, Lorkhaj was the terrible Moon Beast, the first dro-m'Athra.
String.Dest: When under the influence of Namiira, Lorkhaj was the terrible Moon Beast, the first dro-m'Athra.

String.Source: But purged of Namiira, Lorkhaj embodies the potential of the Great Darkness. The ability to grow, to change.
String.Dest: But purged of Namiira, Lorkhaj embodies the potential of the Great Darkness. The ability to grow, to change.

String.Source: Our ancestors' teachings were wrong only because they followed Namiira. Had they followed Lorkhaj, they may have achieved their dreams.
String.Dest: Our ancestors' teachings were wrong only because they followed Namiira. Had they followed Lorkhaj, they may have achieved their dreams.

String.Source: AGGH!
String.Dest: AGGH!

String.Source: This one takes no pleasure in death, but such things are sometimes necessary.
String.Dest: This one takes no pleasure in death, but such things are sometimes necessary.

String.Source: With the Darkwalkers gone, traders from Skyrim will know it is safe to travel to Twisted Root again. You have ensured we will not go hungry.
String.Dest: With the Darkwalkers gone, traders from Skyrim will know it is safe to travel to Twisted Root again. You have ensured we will not go hungry.

String.Source: You have this one's gratitude, five-claw. Hopefully this is sufficient compensation.
String.Dest: You have this one's gratitude, five-claw. Hopefully this is sufficient compensation.

String.Source: Mehela, this one is concerned.
String.Dest: Mehela, this one is concerned.

String.Source: Concer- Oh no, did I forget to change the bedsheets again?
String.Dest: Concer- Oh no, did I forget to change the bedsheets again?

String.Source: Mehela, you are as stealthy as an elephant. Do not insult this one's intelligence.
String.Dest: Mehela, you are as stealthy as an elephant. Do not insult this one's intelligence.

String.Source: This one understands your situation, but this one also has an inn to run.
String.Dest: This one understands your situation, but this one also has an inn to run.

String.Source: If any guests... fall ill... this one will not be pleased.
String.Dest: If any guests... fall ill... this one will not be pleased.

String.Source: I- I understand.
String.Dest: I- I understand.

String.Source: This one is glad to hear it. Now go change the sheets.
String.Dest: This one is glad to hear it. Now go change the sheets.

String.Source: The Crow-Watcher Clan. It's a very small clan, mostly subservient to the larger clans.
String.Dest: The Crow-Watcher Clan. It's a very small clan, mostly subservient to the larger clans.

String.Source: Though I'm not sure I'm still part of it, to be honest.
String.Dest: Though I'm not sure I'm still part of it, to be honest.

String.Source: Most of the clan joined the Forsworn. Those of us who didn't want a war with the Nords were exiled.
String.Dest: Most of the clan joined the Forsworn. Those of us who didn't want a war with the Nords were exiled.

String.Source: Not so loud! Someone might overhear!
String.Dest: Not so loud! Someone might overhear!

String.Source: Well... I guess Azzah-Ko probably knows already.
String.Dest: Well... I guess Azzah-Ko probably knows already.

String.Source: Anyway, I'm clanless as far as that goes. I was bitten by a stray, so I guess that makes me a stray too.
String.Dest: Anyway, I'm clanless as far as that goes. I was bitten by a stray, so I guess that makes me a stray too.

String.Source: I'm certainly not crazy enough to try and join the Voidsuckers.
String.Dest: I'm certainly not crazy enough to try and join the Voidsuckers.

String.Source: Strength... I'm not really that strong, to be honest. I was always more of a mage.
String.Dest: Strength... I'm not really that strong, to be honest. I was always more of a mage.

String.Source: Do you think the Quarra would have me?
String.Dest: Do you think the Quarra would have me?

String.Source: The Cronvangr... I do try to be stealthy when I feed, but I'm not sure how good I am at it. Last time I accidentally headbutted my prey.
String.Dest: The Cronvangr... I do try to be stealthy when I feed, but I'm not sure how good I am at it. Last time I accidentally headbutted my prey.

String.Source: Do you really think the Cronvangr would have me?
String.Dest: Do you really think the Cronvangr would have me?

String.Source: Well, if you vouch for me to them...
String.Dest: Well, if you vouch for me to them...

String.Source: You know what? I'll do it. I bet they'll be happy to have a member here in the Old Lands!
String.Dest: You know what? I'll do it. I bet they'll be happy to have a member here in the Old Lands!

String.Source: And maybe I'll have an easier time getting blood! Actual mortal blood!
String.Dest: And maybe I'll have an easier time getting blood! Actual mortal blood!

String.Source: I didn't think so. I'm just not cut out for a clan.
String.Dest: I didn't think so. I'm just not cut out for a clan.

String.Source: The Volkihar! I thought they were a myth!
String.Dest: The Volkihar! I thought they were a myth!

String.Source: Would they really have me?
String.Dest: Would they really have me?

String.Source: Without this, my crafting would suffer. Allow me to repay your kindness.
String.Dest: Without this, my crafting would suffer. Allow me to repay your kindness.

String.Source: You saw the ore veins where you rescued me from the demon cats, yes? They are not exhausted just yet. Gather two chunks of dried Blood from them.
String.Dest: You saw the ore veins where you rescued me from the demon cats, yes? They are not exhausted just yet. Gather two chunks of dried Blood from them.

String.Source: Judging by Thorntaker's report, I believe you've resolved the danger.
String.Dest: Judging by Thorntaker's report, I believe you've resolved the danger.

String.Source: With the mutant Hist that sustained the realm dead, the plane will eventually be reabsorbed by the creatia of Oblivion.
String.Dest: With the mutant Hist that sustained the realm dead, the plane will eventually be reabsorbed by the creatia of Oblivion.

String.Source: Until then, the main concern would be ensuring that those unfortunates who were addicted to the mutant sap get treatment.
String.Dest: Until then, the main concern would be ensuring that those unfortunates who were addicted to the mutant sap get treatment.

String.Source: Thorntaker's report says he's already working on a treatment plan now that he knows what he's dealing with. I'll see if Raelynne can assist him.
String.Dest: Thorntaker's report says he's already working on a treatment plan now that he knows what he's dealing with. I'll see if Raelynne can assist him.

String.Source: But I believe you've done more than anyone could have asked of you already. Thorntaker can handle the rest.
String.Dest: But I believe you've done more than anyone could have asked of you already. Thorntaker can handle the rest.

String.Source: I think they're... Well, at first I thought they were right.
String.Dest: I think they're... Well, at first I thought they were right.

String.Source: The Crow-Watchers suffered a lot under the Silver-Bloods. They drove us out of our ancestral home to open a mine. Anyone who resisted was killed.
String.Dest: The Crow-Watchers suffered a lot under the Silver-Bloods. They drove us out of our ancestral home to open a mine. Anyone who resisted was killed.

String.Source: At first, I was all for revenge. I went undercover in Markarth, looking for ways to hurt the Nords.
String.Dest: At first, I was all for revenge. I went undercover in Markarth, looking for ways to hurt the Nords.

String.Source: I saw the results of my actions.
String.Dest: I saw the results of my actions.

String.Source: Every time the Forsworn struck, the Silver-Bloods grew harsher. More guards on the streets. More raids against the tribes. More slaves for the mines.
String.Dest: Every time the Forsworn struck, the Silver-Bloods grew harsher. More guards on the streets. More raids against the tribes. More slaves for the mines.

String.Source: Eventually, I realized that there were only two possible fates for me: either I died or I'd be sent to the mines.
String.Dest: Eventually, I realized that there were only two possible fates for me: either I died or I'd be sent to the mines.

String.Source: I couldn't go back to my tribe as a failure, and I couldn't stay in Markarth, so... I came here.
String.Dest: I couldn't go back to my tribe as a failure, and I couldn't stay in Markarth, so... I came here.

String.Source: Vampirism, honestly.
String.Dest: Vampirism, honestly.

String.Source: I was recruited into a scheme to blow up Markarth's smelter. I was supposed to scout the area first.
String.Dest: I was recruited into a scheme to blow up Markarth's smelter. I was supposed to scout the area first.

String.Source: I screwed up and alerted the guards. I had to hide... and I chose a bad spot.
String.Dest: I screwed up and alerted the guards. I had to hide... and I chose a bad spot.

String.Source: I ducked into an abandoned house. Turns out some vampires were already hiding there.
String.Dest: I ducked into an abandoned house. Turns out some vampires were already hiding there.

String.Source: It's funny. Once you're a vampire, you stop caring about mortal business as much. I started seeing both the Forsworn and the Silver-Bloods as food.
String.Dest: It's funny. Once you're a vampire, you stop caring about mortal business as much. I started seeing both the Forsworn and the Silver-Bloods as food.

String.Source: Potions, medicine, ingredients... Things to keep you alive.
String.Dest: Potions, medicine, ingredients... Things to keep you alive.

String.Source: Still no sign of him?
String.Dest: Still no sign of him?

String.Source: Nothing. This one is sorry, but... if your husband has not returned yet, he is most likely-
String.Dest: Nothing. This one is sorry, but... if your husband has not returned yet, he is most likely-

String.Source: Only finish that sentence if you want to lose your teeth.
String.Dest: Only finish that sentence if you want to lose your teeth.

String.Source: My husband is a fighter. Whatever is keeping him, he can overcome it.
String.Dest: My husband is a fighter. Whatever is keeping him, he can overcome it.

String.Source: But if matters are so dangerous, maybe you guards should go investigate!
String.Dest: But if matters are so dangerous, maybe you guards should go investigate!

String.Source: You know that is not possible. We don't even have enough guards to properly defend the village.
String.Dest: You know that is not possible. We don't even have enough guards to properly defend the village.

String.Source: Sending a scout into the ruins would be suicide. Especially now - the dro-m'Athra have grown far more active these past dozen moons.
String.Dest: Sending a scout into the ruins would be suicide. Especially now - the dro-m'Athra have grown far more active these past dozen moons.

String.Source: If we don't even know where to look for your husband-
String.Dest: If we don't even know where to look for your husband-

String.Source: Tch. Useless. That's what you guards are. How are we supposed to keep the village armed and armored if we can't go out to gather ore?!
String.Dest: Tch. Useless. That's what you guards are. How are we supposed to keep the village armed and armored if we can't go out to gather ore?!

String.Source: You'd better hope my husband makes it back safely, or you'll be fighting off the Drybloods and dro-m'Athra in your underclothes.
String.Dest: You'd better hope my husband makes it back safely, or you'll be fighting off the Drybloods and dro-m'Athra in your underclothes.

String.Source: Ah, you heard that argument, outsider?
String.Dest: Ah, you heard that argument, outsider?

String.Source: It's my husband, Anagach. We're the village Blood-Sculptors - he gathers the dried Blood, I refine it, then he makes it into weapons and armor.
String.Dest: It's my husband, Anagach. We're the village Blood-Sculptors - he gathers the dried Blood, I refine it, then he makes it into weapons and armor.

String.Source: But he hasn't come back since he left early this morning. He was going to check a new Vein out by the ruins... I'm worried about the dro-m'Athra.
String.Dest: But he hasn't come back since he left early this morning. He was going to check a new Vein out by the ruins... I'm worried about the dro-m'Athra.

String.Source: The Old Blood can't be consumed once it dries, but it's still filled with Lorkh's magic. Useful for weapons and armor.
String.Dest: The Old Blood can't be consumed once it dries, but it's still filled with Lorkh's magic. Useful for weapons and armor.

String.Source: My husband and I are the sole Blood-Sculptors in the village, so you'd think those idiot guards would know how important finding him is.
String.Dest: My husband and I are the sole Blood-Sculptors in the village, so you'd think those idiot guards would know how important finding him is.

String.Source: Bent Cats. Khajiit demons. They infest the desert ruins outside the walls.
String.Dest: Bent Cats. Khajiit demons. They infest the desert ruins outside the walls.

String.Source: Many thanks, outsider.
String.Dest: Many thanks, outsider.

String.Source: I don't know exactly where he went, but he said the new Vein he found was near the walls, so I'd try checking the village perimeter.
String.Dest: I don't know exactly where he went, but he said the new Vein he found was near the walls, so I'd try checking the village perimeter.

String.Source: Watch out for the cat spirits. They'll attack anyone who enters the ruins.
String.Dest: Watch out for the cat spirits. They'll attack anyone who enters the ruins.

String.Source: If you help my husband, we'll both be in your debt.
String.Dest: If you help my husband, we'll both be in your debt.

String.Source: Anagach said he found a new Vein near the walls of the village. Try searching around the outside perimeter.
String.Dest: Anagach said he found a new Vein near the walls of the village. Try searching around the outside perimeter.

String.Source: Any luck finding my husband?
String.Dest: Any luck finding my husband?

String.Source: My thanks for the rescue, outsider. Didn't expect these damn demons to come right up to the walls.
String.Dest: My thanks for the rescue, outsider. Didn't expect these damn demons to come right up to the walls.

String.Source: Kelsrah's concern made sure that I'm not. If you'd gotten here any later, those demons might have broken my guard.
String.Dest: Kelsrah's concern made sure that I'm not. If you'd gotten here any later, those demons might have broken my guard.

String.Source: The only loss was my chisel. It's a family heirloom - enchanted to aid in Blood-Sculpting. One of those demons grabbed it and ran off in the chaos.
String.Dest: The only loss was my chisel. It's a family heirloom - enchanted to aid in Blood-Sculpting. One of those demons grabbed it and ran off in the chaos.

String.Source: I can work without it, but the quality will suffer.
String.Dest: I can work without it, but the quality will suffer.

String.Source: I'm not foolish enough to charge into the ruins after it - I'll head back to the village. You, though... You're clearly a skilled warrior.
String.Dest: I'm not foolish enough to charge into the ruins after it - I'll head back to the village. You, though... You're clearly a skilled warrior.

String.Source: Ah, excellent. You've got a talent for this - the quality is flawless.
String.Dest: Ah, excellent. You've got a talent for this - the quality is flawless.

String.Source: I think you've got it in you to become a proper Blood-Sculptor.
String.Dest: I think you've got it in you to become a proper Blood-Sculptor.

String.Source: Crafting with the Blood is a bit different from normal ores. It's got a different texture. It needs different heat, a different amount of force.
String.Dest: Crafting with the Blood is a bit different from normal ores. It's got a different texture. It needs different heat, a different amount of force.

String.Source: If you've ever crafted with Amber, it's similar to that. Use a low heat to soften the Blood. It should loosen, but don't let it become liquid.
String.Dest: If you've ever crafted with Amber, it's similar to that. Use a low heat to soften the Blood. It should loosen, but don't let it become liquid.

String.Source: Once it becomes viscous, shape it as desired. Keep adding liquid to maintain the texture - if it cracks, it's useless.
String.Dest: Once it becomes viscous, shape it as desired. Keep adding liquid to maintain the texture - if it cracks, it's useless.

String.Source: As you firm it up, slowly raise the heat. Don't strike with the hammer too hard - it takes a gentle touch.
String.Dest: As you firm it up, slowly raise the heat. Don't strike with the hammer too hard - it takes a gentle touch.

String.Source: I know not how you entered this place, but you should flee while you can. The curse will take note of you soon.
String.Dest: I know not how you entered this place, but you should flee while you can. The curse will take note of you soon.

String.Source: We were invited to this realm by the Hollow Princess. Many of our clan had been slain by the people of Ysgramor, preventing us from feeding.
String.Dest: We were invited to this realm by the Hollow Princess. Many of our clan had been slain by the people of Ysgramor, preventing us from feeding.

String.Source: The Princess promised us safety from the Atmorans and a replacement for the blood of mortals - the Old Blood.
String.Dest: The Princess promised us safety from the Atmorans and a replacement for the blood of mortals - the Old Blood.

String.Source: We soon realized it was a trap. The Old Blood is not blood at all, but a curse tied to the Void. One controlled by the Princess.
String.Dest: We soon realized it was a trap. The Old Blood is not blood at all, but a curse tied to the Void. One controlled by the Princess.

String.Source: But by the time we realized our error, we were already reliant on the Old Blood. We could not return to Tamriel. And so we sought an alternative.
String.Dest: But by the time we realized our error, we were already reliant on the Old Blood. We could not return to Tamriel. And so we sought an alternative.

String.Source: This is Iceblood Academy. Eons ago, we scholars of the Iceblood vampires built this place to plumb the depths of the Void.
String.Dest: This is Iceblood Academy. Eons ago, we scholars of the Iceblood vampires built this place to plumb the depths of the Void.

String.Source: Yes... to our great sorrow.
String.Dest: Yes... to our great sorrow.

String.Source: From the depths of the Void, our scholars called forth a Glass Star, which shone with Light so cold as to freeze time itself.
String.Dest: From the depths of the Void, our scholars called forth a Glass Star, which shone with Light so cold as to freeze time itself.

String.Source: What you see before you is the result. We were cursed by the Light of that foul Star - trapped eternally between life and death.
String.Dest: What you see before you is the result. We were cursed by the Light of that foul Star - trapped eternally between life and death.

String.Source: A name that once filled the Atmorans with fear. As a clan of Snow Elf vampires, the name seemed fitting.
String.Dest: A name that once filled the Atmorans with fear. As a clan of Snow Elf vampires, the name seemed fitting.

String.Source: We were not indiscriminate hunters, however. We were scholars before becoming infected.
String.Dest: We were not indiscriminate hunters, however. We were scholars before becoming infected.

String.Source: Even once we became vampires, we retained our hunger for knowledge. We devoted ourselves to finding a cure.
String.Dest: Even once we became vampires, we retained our hunger for knowledge. We devoted ourselves to finding a cure.

String.Source: Sadly, that left us vulnerable to the promises of the Hollow Princess.
String.Dest: Sadly, that left us vulnerable to the promises of the Hollow Princess.

String.Source: Hm, perhaps. I regret that I know nothing of what has transpired in Tamriel after the Atmorans drove us out.
String.Dest: Hm, perhaps. I regret that I know nothing of what has transpired in Tamriel after the Atmorans drove us out.

String.Source: But it would not surprise me if the people of Ysgramor chose to warp our onetime home into a tomb.
String.Dest: But it would not surprise me if the people of Ysgramor chose to warp our onetime home into a tomb.

String.Source: It has always been the way of conquerors to transform the homes of the conquered.
String.Dest: It has always been the way of conquerors to transform the homes of the conquered.

String.Source: I don't like it here. This whole place feels... wrong.
String.Dest: I don't like it here. This whole place feels... wrong.

String.Source: Ugh... It's like reality itself is trying to reject this place. Let's get out of here quickly.
String.Dest: Ugh... It's like reality itself is trying to reject this place. Let's get out of here quickly.

String.Source: This place is shining on every layer of reality. Not the good kind of shine, though. It's more like... spilled oil.
String.Dest: This place is shining on every layer of reality. Not the good kind of shine, though. It's more like... spilled oil.

String.Source: Indeed... The Bloodfire Amulet. The holder of that amulet was honored by all the clans.
String.Dest: Indeed... The Bloodfire Amulet. The holder of that amulet was honored by all the clans.

String.Source: It has been so long... I cannot even recall who made it. But I remember the Amulet.
String.Dest: It has been so long... I cannot even recall who made it. But I remember the Amulet.

String.Source: Tell me, which clan do you serve? Who now leads the vampires of Skyrim?
String.Dest: Tell me, which clan do you serve? Who now leads the vampires of Skyrim?

String.Source: The Vigilants? I'm afraid I've not heard of you. A newer organization, I assume.
String.Dest: The Vigilants? I'm afraid I've not heard of you. A newer organization, I assume.

String.Source: You are vampire hunters, then? I'm afraid you'll find no prey here. The Glass Star's curse has already done far worse to us.
String.Dest: You are vampire hunters, then? I'm afraid you'll find no prey here. The Glass Star's curse has already done far worse to us.

String.Source: The Cronvangr? The name is vaguely familiar... Ah! Interesting that such a small clan now leads Skyrim's vampires.
String.Dest: The Cronvangr? The name is vaguely familiar... Ah! Interesting that such a small clan now leads Skyrim's vampires.

String.Source: The Quarra? I'm afraid I don't recognize the name.
String.Dest: The Quarra? I'm afraid I don't recognize the name.

String.Source: Well, that's to be expected. Thousands of years have passed since I last walked Tamriel... No doubt the vampire clans are all quite different.
String.Dest: Well, that's to be expected. Thousands of years have passed since I last walked Tamriel... No doubt the vampire clans are all quite different.

String.Source: Ah, the Volkihar. They were a force to be reckoned with even in my time.
String.Dest: Ah, the Volkihar. They were a force to be reckoned with even in my time.

String.Source: I suppose it's no surprise that they managed to cling to power all this time.
String.Dest: I suppose it's no surprise that they managed to cling to power all this time.

String.Source: Beating... Eating... Beating... EATING!
String.Dest: Beating... Eating... Beating... EATING!

String.Source: The Root is the Blood is the Root is the Blood is the Root is the Blood...
String.Dest: The Root is the Blood is the Root is the Blood is the Root is the Blood...

String.Source: The mountain is bleeding!
String.Dest: The mountain is bleeding!

String.Source: I am the worm.
String.Dest: I am the worm.

String.Source: Out of the darkness.
String.Dest: Out of the darkness.

String.Source: Crack... crack...
String.Dest: Crack... crack...

String.Source: Mother of Worms... Mother of Rot...!
String.Dest: Mother of Worms... Mother of Rot...!

String.Source: Scratch the skies... Bleed... Bleed...
String.Dest: Scratch the skies... Bleed... Bleed...

String.Source: Blood rains... Blood reigns...
String.Dest: Blood rains... Blood reigns...

String.Source: Sweet poison... Sweet death!
String.Dest: Sweet poison... Sweet death!

String.Source: Consume... I must...
String.Dest: Consume... I must...

String.Source: Consume... This one must...
String.Dest: Consume... This one must...

String.Source: Sustain us.
String.Dest: Sustain us.

String.Source: Let us feed.
String.Dest: Let us feed.

String.Source: The Root is hollow.
String.Dest: The Root is hollow.

String.Source: Snap... Crack... Crunch...
String.Dest: Snap... Crack... Crunch...

String.Source: Rip... Tear... Drink...
String.Dest: Rip... Tear... Drink...

String.Source: The Blood is thick with screams!
String.Dest: The Blood is thick with screams!

String.Source: Feeeeeed...
String.Dest: Feeeeeed...

String.Source: She tastes us all... Our blood, our death...!
String.Dest: She tastes us all... Our blood, our death...!

String.Source: Tassssste the rot... Feed us...
String.Dest: Tassssste the rot... Feed us...

String.Source: Feed - feed - feed - feed - feed - feeeeed!
String.Dest: Feed - feed - feed - feed - feed - feeeeed!

String.Source: Huurrgh!
String.Dest: Huurrgh!

String.Source: Haargh!
String.Dest: Haargh!

String.Source: Ha ha!
String.Dest: Ha ha!

String.Source: Your form is for swine!
String.Dest: Your form is for swine!

String.Source: The power of the Void!
String.Dest: The power of the Void!

String.Source: Void strike you down!
String.Dest: Void strike you down!

String.Source: Namiira comes for you!
String.Dest: Namiira comes for you!

String.Source: Namiira beckons! This one is Her Claw!
String.Dest: Namiira beckons! This one is Her Claw!

String.Source: Khashool! Dro-sha zargo!
String.Dest: Khashool! Dro-sha zargo!

String.Source: We will kill you! It is Her will!
String.Dest: We will kill you! It is Her will!

String.Source: Namiira will devour your suffering... so make it sweet!
String.Dest: Namiira will devour your suffering... so make it sweet!

String.Source: Your pain is bright as moon sugar! Yeees...
String.Dest: Your pain is bright as moon sugar! Yeees...

String.Source: Take it!
String.Dest: Take it!

String.Source: Hsss!
String.Dest: Hsss!

String.Source: Scratch! Bite! Swing! Dance with us!
String.Dest: Scratch! Bite! Swing! Dance with us!

String.Source: The Bent Cats will watch you break!
String.Dest: The Bent Cats will watch you break!

String.Source: Come... Join the dance.
String.Dest: Come... Join the dance.

String.Source: The Moons cannot reach here.
String.Dest: The Moons cannot reach here.

String.Source: Enter the Darkness.
String.Dest: Enter the Darkness.

String.Source: Embrace Namiira.
String.Dest: Embrace Namiira.

String.Source: Souls for the Darkness.
String.Dest: Souls for the Darkness.

String.Source: Her Embrace is warm as sand. Do not fear it.
String.Dest: Her Embrace is warm as sand. Do not fear it.

String.Source: Namiira speaks, and we obey.
String.Dest: Namiira speaks, and we obey.

String.Source: She commands we dance! She will have your death!
String.Dest: She commands we dance! She will have your death!

String.Source: The great Darkness is come... Why do you run to find only scraps of the light?
String.Dest: The great Darkness is come... Why do you run to find only scraps of the light?

String.Source: She will hold you as corpse or as kitten... Do not fear Her Dance...
String.Dest: She will hold you as corpse or as kitten... Do not fear Her Dance...

String.Source: Hssss... We crave the taste of misery!
String.Dest: Hssss... We crave the taste of misery!

String.Source: We will not be bested! Death is an art, and this one holds the brush...
String.Dest: We will not be bested! Death is an art, and this one holds the brush...

String.Source: This one longs for Blood... For tears and tendons, rent with all Her Rot!
String.Dest: This one longs for Blood... For tears and tendons, rent with all Her Rot!

String.Source: Hmph. You finally woke up.
String.Dest: Hmph. You finally woke up.

String.Source: You came close to death, you know. We had to dig you out of the rubble. If Rukar hadn't spotted you, you'd still be buried.
String.Dest: You came close to death, you know. We had to dig you out of the rubble. If Rukar hadn't spotted you, you'd still be buried.

String.Source: Guess you're just unlucky. The tunnel to Tamriel's been unstable for a while, but we didn't think it'd actually collapse.
String.Dest: Guess you're just unlucky. The tunnel to Tamriel's been unstable for a while, but we didn't think it'd actually collapse.

String.Source: Well, the healer did what he could to patch you back up, and the miners should have the rubble cleared before long.
String.Dest: Well, the healer did what he could to patch you back up, and the miners should have the rubble cleared before long.

String.Source: Until then... Well, we don't have much, but you'll have to make do. There's some Meat on the table if you like... Should perk you right back up.
String.Dest: Until then... Well, we don't have much, but you'll have to make do. There's some Meat on the table if you like... Should perk you right back up.

String.Source: Might have some spare Blood down in the cellar... I'll go check.
String.Dest: Might have some spare Blood down in the cellar... I'll go check.

String.Source: Hm... Not getting rid of me that easily!
String.Dest: Hm... Not getting rid of me that easily!

String.Source: You're not ditching me that easily. We've got work to do.
String.Dest: You're not ditching me that easily. We've got work to do.

String.Source: Fine, whatever. I might still be here when you get back.
String.Dest: Fine, whatever. I might still be here when you get back.

String.Source: I'll be here if you need me.
String.Dest: I'll be here if you need me.

String.Source: Okay, don't be too long!
String.Dest: Okay, don't be too long!

String.Source: Try not to forget about me.
String.Dest: Try not to forget about me.

String.Source: I was starting to worry you forgot me.
String.Dest: I was starting to worry you forgot me.

String.Source: You... Are you joking, or are you that arrogant and stupid?!
String.Dest: You... Are you joking, or are you that arrogant and stupid?!

String.Source: Follow you?! You're lucky I don't kill you!
String.Dest: Follow you?! You're lucky I don't kill you!

String.Source: Let me make it clear. GET. LOST.
String.Dest: Let me make it clear. GET. LOST.

String.Source: Fine, fine...
String.Dest: Fine, fine...

String.Source: Right behind you!
String.Dest: Right behind you!

String.Source: Let's have some fun.
String.Dest: Let's have some fun.

String.Source: Off to adventure.
String.Dest: Off to adventure.

String.Source: Murder and mayhem await.
String.Dest: Murder and mayhem await.

String.Source: I'll follow you anywhere.
String.Dest: I'll follow you anywhere.

String.Source: Of course, my love.
String.Dest: Of course, my love.

String.Source: I'll see you back home then!
String.Dest: I'll see you back home then!

String.Source: Meet you back home, darling!
String.Dest: Meet you back home, darling!

String.Source: Don't be gone too long, darling.
String.Dest: Don't be gone too long, darling.

String.Source: Summon me if you need me.
String.Dest: Summon me if you need me.

String.Source: I'll head back to the village for now, then.
String.Dest: I'll head back to the village for now, then.

String.Source: It's... It's my own fault for getting my hopes up... considering what I am.
String.Dest: It's... It's my own fault for getting my hopes up... considering what I am.

String.Source: Al- Alright. Let's... let's just pretend none of this happened, okay?
String.Dest: Al- Alright. Let's... let's just pretend none of this happened, okay?

String.Source: At least I got to feel wanted... for a little while.
String.Dest: At least I got to feel wanted... for a little while.

String.Source: It is. Even after we realized the Hollow Princess had betrayed us, we could not bear to discard the Old Blood - not until we found an alternative.
String.Dest: It is. Even after we realized the Hollow Princess had betrayed us, we could not bear to discard the Old Blood - not until we found an alternative.

String.Source: Our belltower is in the great courtyard, on the far side of the academy.
String.Dest: Our belltower is in the great courtyard, on the far side of the academy.

String.Source: Sadly, the passage of time has collapsed the main chamber. You will need to take the long way through the academy to reach the courtyard.
String.Dest: Sadly, the passage of time has collapsed the main chamber. You will need to take the long way through the academy to reach the courtyard.

String.Source: Be wary. Most of my fellows have long since been driven mad by our curse.
String.Dest: Be wary. Most of my fellows have long since been driven mad by our curse.

String.Source: Khkkh.
String.Dest: Khkkh.

String.Source: Heheheh.
String.Dest: Heheheh.

String.Source: Khhee?
String.Dest: Khhee?

String.Source: Khehehe.
String.Dest: Khehehe.

String.Source: Hehehe.
String.Dest: Hehehe.

String.Source: Kheheheh.
String.Dest: Kheheheh.

String.Source: Khhh?
String.Dest: Khhh?

String.Source: Heheheh.
String.Dest: Heheheh.

String.Source: Kehehe.
String.Dest: Kehehe.

String.Source: Kekeheh.
String.Dest: Kekeheh.

String.Source: Ehehe.
String.Dest: Ehehe.

String.Source: Khhh.
String.Dest: Khhh.

String.Source: Heeee...
String.Dest: Heeee...

String.Source: Hehehehe.
String.Dest: Hehehehe.

String.Source: Ghhhhk.
String.Dest: Ghhhhk.

String.Source: Ghhhk.
String.Dest: Ghhhk.

String.Source: This one and his brother Ri'nakkhu help defend the village from the dro-m'Athra. We may not be Twilight Cantors, but we have the Way of Jone.
String.Dest: This one and his brother Ri'nakkhu help defend the village from the dro-m'Athra. We may not be Twilight Cantors, but we have the Way of Jone.

String.Source: This one helps defend the village from the dro-m'Athra. This one may not be a Twilight Cantor, but he has the Way of Jone.
String.Dest: This one helps defend the village from the dro-m'Athra. This one may not be a Twilight Cantor, but he has the Way of Jone.

String.Source: That is so. He got the fighting prowess, but this one got the handsomeness. This one got the better end of the deal, no?
String.Dest: That is so. He got the fighting prowess, but this one got the handsomeness. This one got the better end of the deal, no?

String.Source: They are the Bent Cats. Khajiit who dance to the beat of the Dark Heart. It shatters their souls, allowing the Void to possess them.
String.Dest: They are the Bent Cats. Khajiit who dance to the beat of the Dark Heart. It shatters their souls, allowing the Void to possess them.

String.Source: They can be considered a type of daedra in service to Namiira - to the Dark Behind the World.
String.Dest: They can be considered a type of daedra in service to Namiira - to the Dark Behind the World.

String.Source: Dro-m'Athra are cruel, evil beings. They exist only to prey on innocents... and so it is the duty of all cats to oppose them.
String.Dest: Dro-m'Athra are cruel, evil beings. They exist only to prey on innocents... and so it is the duty of all cats to oppose them.

String.Source: This one is... not welcome in Elsweyr. He and Ri'nakkhu were rather foolish in their youth and angered the Thalmor.
String.Dest: This one is... not welcome in Elsweyr. He and Ri'nakkhu were rather foolish in their youth and angered the Thalmor.

String.Source: We did not want to cause further trouble for our people, so we left.
String.Dest: We did not want to cause further trouble for our people, so we left.

String.Source: As for why we came to the Old Lands, it was because of the dro-m'Athra. We wished to prove our valor by fighting the Bent Cats.
String.Dest: As for why we came to the Old Lands, it was because of the dro-m'Athra. We wished to prove our valor by fighting the Bent Cats.

String.Source: We had heard of the Old Lands in half-remembered legends, and with nowhere else to go after leaving Elsweyr, it seemed a worthwhile trip.
String.Dest: We had heard of the Old Lands in half-remembered legends, and with nowhere else to go after leaving Elsweyr, it seemed a worthwhile trip.

String.Source: Khehe!
String.Dest: Khehe!

String.Source: Hey, mortal speech is hard.
String.Dest: Hey, mortal speech is hard.

String.Source: Instead of nice simple mathforms or magical pulses, you do this weird thing where you use your face to vibrate the air. That's hard to imitate!
String.Dest: Instead of nice simple mathforms or magical pulses, you do this weird thing where you use your face to vibrate the air. That's hard to imitate!

String.Source: It took me a good few years to figure out how to mimic it. Give her time.
String.Dest: It took me a good few years to figure out how to mimic it. Give her time.

String.Source: Besides, she clearly understands Tamrielic even if she can't speak it. That's enough for now, right?
String.Dest: Besides, she clearly understands Tamrielic even if she can't speak it. That's enough for now, right?

String.Source: Only Twilight Cantors can perform the Way of Jode - permanently dispelling the dro-m'Athra through song.
String.Dest: Only Twilight Cantors can perform the Way of Jode - permanently dispelling the dro-m'Athra through song.

String.Source: Other cats must rely on the Way of Jone: Driving away the dro-m'Athra with our claws. It is not permanent, but it is enough.
String.Dest: Other cats must rely on the Way of Jone: Driving away the dro-m'Athra with our claws. It is not permanent, but it is enough.

String.Source: Has it been so long since you last walked the sands of Elsweyr?
String.Dest: Has it been so long since you last walked the sands of Elsweyr?

String.Source: This one is not surprised you have not heard of them.
String.Dest: This one is not surprised you have not heard of them.

String.Source: The Twilight Cantors are followers of Azurah. Their songs purge the Great Darkness from the dro-m'Athra, banishing the Bent Cats.
String.Dest: The Twilight Cantors are followers of Azurah. Their songs purge the Great Darkness from the dro-m'Athra, banishing the Bent Cats.

String.Source: Of course, you will not find any Cantors here. Few of us are truly loyal to the old teaching of the False Moon, but we have little trust in Azurah.
String.Dest: Of course, you will not find any Cantors here. Few of us are truly loyal to the old teaching of the False Moon, but we have little trust in Azurah.

String.Source: A heretical cult that believed Azurah had deceived the Khajiit. That the true creator of the Khajiit was Namiira, and Azurah merely usurped her.
String.Dest: A heretical cult that believed Azurah had deceived the Khajiit. That the true creator of the Khajiit was Namiira, and Azurah merely usurped her.

String.Source: The cult believed that rather than being creatures of Namiira, the dro-m'Athra were a curse inflicted by Azurah on cats who saw through her lies.
String.Dest: The cult believed that rather than being creatures of Namiira, the dro-m'Athra were a curse inflicted by Azurah on cats who saw through her lies.

String.Source: The False Moon cult came to the Old Lands in the hope that the magic of the Old Blood would reconnect them with Namiira - without Azurah interfering.
String.Dest: The False Moon cult came to the Old Lands in the hope that the magic of the Old Blood would reconnect them with Namiira - without Azurah interfering.

String.Source: Of course, you can see the result by looking at the ruins of their city. The cultists became dro-m'Athra, and the survivors fled to this village.
String.Dest: Of course, you can see the result by looking at the ruins of their city. The cultists became dro-m'Athra, and the survivors fled to this village.

String.Source: Ah, good! You can see me!
String.Dest: Ah, good! You can see me!

String.Source: Monsters from the Void not enough for you? Haha, the World-Eater won't know what hit him!
String.Dest: Monsters from the Void not enough for you? Haha, the World-Eater won't know what hit him!

String.Source: Good to see you, friend! A hero like you deserves to be here.
String.Dest: Good to see you, friend! A hero like you deserves to be here.

String.Source: I wish I could help you fight the World-Eater, friend. But Shor ordered us all to remain here! Hit that beast extra hard for me, would you?
String.Dest: I wish I could help you fight the World-Eater, friend. But Shor ordered us all to remain here! Hit that beast extra hard for me, would you?

String.Source: You there! Have you got a moment to help a dead man?
String.Dest: You there! Have you got a moment to help a dead man?

String.Source: It's a bit of an embarrassing story, sorry to say.
String.Dest: It's a bit of an embarrassing story, sorry to say.

String.Source: For decades, I've prided myself on my battle prowess. Wiped out whole covens of hagravens all on my own!
String.Dest: For decades, I've prided myself on my battle prowess. Wiped out whole covens of hagravens all on my own!

String.Source: So when I heard tell of a vicious Void witch hiding out in this cave, I figured it would make for another fitting trophy.
String.Dest: So when I heard tell of a vicious Void witch hiding out in this cave, I figured it would make for another fitting trophy.

String.Source: Well, as you can see, it didn't go as planned. Voidmother Maalfrejja's as strong as she is cruel. Killed me before I could land a hit.
String.Dest: Well, as you can see, it didn't go as planned. Voidmother Maalfrejja's as strong as she is cruel. Killed me before I could land a hit.

String.Source: I was all set to go to Sovngarde, but I noticed something horrid: that witch was stealing the clothes off my corpse!
String.Dest: I was all set to go to Sovngarde, but I noticed something horrid: that witch was stealing the clothes off my corpse!

String.Source: Now, I don't know if she wants them for some evil ritual or if she keeps them as trophies, but I can't stand before Shor in my underclothes!
String.Dest: Now, I don't know if she wants them for some evil ritual or if she keeps them as trophies, but I can't stand before Shor in my underclothes!

String.Source: Here, your reward. I hope to see you again in Sovngarde, my friend!
String.Dest: Here, your reward. I hope to see you again in Sovngarde, my friend!

String.Source: Quush! Grant me power!
String.Dest: Quush! Grant me power!

String.Source: I will return us to the Elder Days!
String.Dest: I will return us to the Elder Days!

String.Source: The Corruptor will emerge!
String.Dest: The Corruptor will emerge!

String.Source: The shadows will consume you!
String.Dest: The shadows will consume you!

String.Source: Is something the matter?
String.Dest: Is something the matter?

String.Source: Hm... The villagers usually stay well away from the forest. Nothing there but monsters and death.
String.Dest: Hm... The villagers usually stay well away from the forest. Nothing there but monsters and death.

String.Source: Come to think of it, though... One of the miners went into the forest a few days back. Kheereth-Lah. Said he was looking for new Blood.
