String.Dest: Come to think of it, though... One of the miners went into the forest a few days back. Kheereth-Lah. Said he was looking for new Blood.

String.Source: He was carrying something with him when he came back, so he must have found some Bloodroots that hadn't dried yet.
String.Dest: He was carrying something with him when he came back, so he must have found some Bloodroots that hadn't dried yet.

String.Source: You're too late, dryskin! With this scepter, the Corruptor's power is mine!
String.Dest: You're too late, dryskin! With this scepter, the Corruptor's power is mine!

String.Source: You're too late, dryskin! With this scepter, the Corruptor's power is mine!
String.Dest: You're too late, dryskin! With this scepter, the Corruptor's power is mine!

String.Source: The lorekeepers of the Reach.
String.Dest: The lorekeepers of the Reach.

String.Source: The tribes of the Reach rarely keep written records, so it falls to the Vateshrans to remember our histories.
String.Dest: The tribes of the Reach rarely keep written records, so it falls to the Vateshrans to remember our histories.

String.Source: The songs and poems of the Vateshrans have been passed down since the dawn of civilization. They have knowledge that no scholar will ever learn.
String.Dest: The songs and poems of the Vateshrans have been passed down since the dawn of civilization. They have knowledge that no scholar will ever learn.

String.Source: The forest. A cursed place, crawling with nameless monsters.
String.Dest: The forest. A cursed place, crawling with nameless monsters.

String.Source: The only things you'll find there are the Hollow Palace, the cursed ruins, and endless abominations from the depths of the Void.
String.Dest: The only things you'll find there are the Hollow Palace, the cursed ruins, and endless abominations from the depths of the Void.

String.Source: If you plan to enter the forest, know that nobody will be coming to save you.
String.Dest: If you plan to enter the forest, know that nobody will be coming to save you.

String.Source: The ruins. When this land was first founded, the Khajiit built their own city, neighboring the Reachfolk territory.
String.Dest: The ruins. When this land was first founded, the Khajiit built their own city, neighboring the Reachfolk territory.

String.Source: But the city was overrun by dro-m'Athra. The surviving Khajiit fled to the village, and the city fell into ruin.
String.Dest: But the city was overrun by dro-m'Athra. The surviving Khajiit fled to the village, and the city fell into ruin.

String.Source: Nothing we do can expel the dro-m'Athra for good, so all we can do is guard the gates and keep them from leaving the village.
String.Dest: Nothing we do can expel the dro-m'Athra for good, so all we can do is guard the gates and keep them from leaving the village.

String.Source: Hmm. That is most concerning.
String.Dest: Hmm. That is most concerning.

String.Source: I can sense dark magic coming from those eggs. I imagine simply discarding them would not be possible...
String.Dest: I can sense dark magic coming from those eggs. I imagine simply discarding them would not be possible...

String.Source: Hm. It's a bit of a trek, but I suspect your best hope for disposing of them would be the Temple of Kynareth in Whiterun.
String.Dest: Hm. It's a bit of a trek, but I suspect your best hope for disposing of them would be the Temple of Kynareth in Whiterun.

String.Source: As the patron of healing, Kynareth's influence can likely overpower the magic keeping those eggs bound to you.
String.Dest: As the patron of healing, Kynareth's influence can likely overpower the magic keeping those eggs bound to you.

String.Source: You've gotten the attention of Kalarix Brood. A spirit of the Void and a close ally of Namira.
String.Dest: You've gotten the attention of Kalarix Brood. A spirit of the Void and a close ally of Namira.

String.Source: I fear that my own magic will not be enough to help you destroy these eggs... and I suspect any attempt to simply discard them will end poorly.
String.Dest: I fear that my own magic will not be enough to help you destroy these eggs... and I suspect any attempt to simply discard them will end poorly.

String.Source: Your best hope would be to enlist the aid of someone blessed by the spirits of healing. The Temple of Kynareth in Whiterun, perhaps.
String.Dest: Your best hope would be to enlist the aid of someone blessed by the spirits of healing. The Temple of Kynareth in Whiterun, perhaps.

String.Source: You'd best make haste. The longer the Writhing Mother's gaze is upon you, the more danger you will be in.
String.Dest: You'd best make haste. The longer the Writhing Mother's gaze is upon you, the more danger you will be in.

String.Source: As you said, the Voidsuckers are trying to find the key to the depths of Varsel. If we want to preempt them, we'll need to get that key first.
String.Dest: As you said, the Voidsuckers are trying to find the key to the depths of Varsel. If we want to preempt them, we'll need to get that key first.

String.Source: They seem to be searching at random. A more methodical approach will benefit us.
String.Dest: They seem to be searching at random. A more methodical approach will benefit us.

String.Source: From my studies of the ruins here, one in particular seems promising: Vanua Agea. Loosely translated, it means "Hall of Secrets."
String.Dest: From my studies of the ruins here, one in particular seems promising: Vanua Agea. Loosely translated, it means "Hall of Secrets."

String.Source: That name certainly implies a place for hiding things. Perhaps including that key.
String.Dest: That name certainly implies a place for hiding things. Perhaps including that key.

String.Source: Hm. Being bossed around by a Void Spirit isn't really a good position to be in.
String.Dest: Hm. Being bossed around by a Void Spirit isn't really a good position to be in.

String.Source: The safest option would be to do as she says. Contaminate the food of all the jarls and let them suffer the consequences.
String.Dest: The safest option would be to do as she says. Contaminate the food of all the jarls and let them suffer the consequences.

String.Source: Not exactly ethical, but it'll make sure you don't end up on her bad side.
String.Dest: Not exactly ethical, but it'll make sure you don't end up on her bad side.

String.Source: On the other hand, if you want to risk defying her... Well, just throwing away the eggs won't work. Magical objects tend to be clingy.
String.Dest: On the other hand, if you want to risk defying her... Well, just throwing away the eggs won't work. Magical objects tend to be clingy.

String.Source: You'd need to find someone who can counter that magic and destroy the eggs. Since they're parasites... Maybe a healer could help?
String.Dest: You'd need to find someone who can counter that magic and destroy the eggs. Since they're parasites... Maybe a healer could help?

String.Source: Thank you for bringing me into the Cronvangr! It's wonderful to have a place to belong.
String.Dest: Thank you for bringing me into the Cronvangr! It's wonderful to have a place to belong.

String.Source: I've been talking with Narina. I think we were both turned by the same clan.
String.Dest: I've been talking with Narina. I think we were both turned by the same clan.

String.Source: Rakoslod said he'll make me some new clothes. But... I mean... wearing spider silk? I guess I'll have to get used to it...
String.Dest: Rakoslod said he'll make me some new clothes. But... I mean... wearing spider silk? I guess I'll have to get used to it...

String.Source: I stand corrected. Spider silk is really comfortable.
String.Dest: I stand corrected. Spider silk is really comfortable.

String.Source: Velfred's been telling me the history of the clan. I hope he doesn't expect me to remember it, though...
String.Dest: Velfred's been telling me the history of the clan. I hope he doesn't expect me to remember it, though...

String.Source: I've been practicing my stealth. Pretty soon, I'll be ready to join the hunters.
String.Dest: I've been practicing my stealth. Pretty soon, I'll be ready to join the hunters.

String.Source: It's so refreshing to have someone else to hunt with.
String.Dest: It's so refreshing to have someone else to hunt with.

String.Source: Ever since Malielle found out I have access to the Old Lands, she's been trying to convince me to smuggle things for her...
String.Dest: Ever since Malielle found out I have access to the Old Lands, she's been trying to convince me to smuggle things for her...

String.Source: There's something nostalgic about all these Dwemer automatons. Reminds me of the Reach.
String.Dest: There's something nostalgic about all these Dwemer automatons. Reminds me of the Reach.

String.Source: It's so exciting to be part of the Quarra! I hope I can become as strong as Volrina.
String.Dest: It's so exciting to be part of the Quarra! I hope I can become as strong as Volrina.

String.Source: Agrius has so many stories. All these different clan feuds... The Quarra certainly made a lot of enemies, didn't they?
String.Dest: Agrius has so many stories. All these different clan feuds... The Quarra certainly made a lot of enemies, didn't they?

String.Source: One of the guards told me that Dwemer ghosts show up here. He... was just joking, right?
String.Dest: One of the guards told me that Dwemer ghosts show up here. He... was just joking, right?

String.Source: To think I was recruited by the Broodfather himself! I'll do my best to live up to your expectations.
String.Dest: To think I was recruited by the Broodfather himself! I'll do my best to live up to your expectations.

String.Source: To think I was recruited by the Broodmother herself! I'll do my best to live up to your expectations.
String.Dest: To think I was recruited by the Broodmother herself! I'll do my best to live up to your expectations.

String.Source: To think I was recruited by the Clanlady herself! I'll do my best to live up to your expectations.
String.Dest: To think I was recruited by the Clanlady herself! I'll do my best to live up to your expectations.

String.Source: To think I was recruited by the Clanlord himself! I'll do my best to live up to your expectations.
String.Dest: To think I was recruited by the Clanlord himself! I'll do my best to live up to your expectations.

String.Source: For now, yes. As the only member of the clan with easy access to the Old Lands, I'm useful here.
String.Dest: For now, yes. As the only member of the clan with easy access to the Old Lands, I'm useful here.

String.Source: And unfortunately, I've been eating the Old Blood long enough that I'm reliant on it. I can't go without for too long.
String.Dest: And unfortunately, I've been eating the Old Blood long enough that I'm reliant on it. I can't go without for too long.

String.Source: I'll still visit the clan hall whenever I can, though. I hope I'll see you there!
String.Dest: I'll still visit the clan hall whenever I can, though. I hope I'll see you there!

String.Source: I am a miner. I dig in the Mines.
String.Dest: I am a miner. I dig in the Mines.

String.Source: Xanmeers. Remnants of the first Saxhleel to arrive in these lands.
String.Dest: Xanmeers. Remnants of the first Saxhleel to arrive in these lands.

String.Source: You dryskins call us "Argonians," but we are Saxhleel. People of the Root.
String.Dest: You dryskins call us "Argonians," but we are Saxhleel. People of the Root.

String.Source: Even here, far from Black Marsh, our souls are shaped by the Hist. Our connection to the Roots of the world helps us find the Meat.
String.Dest: Even here, far from Black Marsh, our souls are shaped by the Hist. Our connection to the Roots of the world helps us find the Meat.

String.Source: You're a fellow Saxhleel, yet you don't know the name?
String.Dest: You're a fellow Saxhleel, yet you don't know the name?

String.Source: I pity you. Even far from Black Marsh, I feel the Hist in my soul. Have you lost that connection?
String.Dest: I pity you. Even far from Black Marsh, I feel the Hist in my soul. Have you lost that connection?

String.Source: I am the first of the scouts. When a new tunnel is opened, I follow after the Meat-Finder.
String.Dest: I am the first of the scouts. When a new tunnel is opened, I follow after the Meat-Finder.

String.Source: If we encounter enemies, be they monsters, voriplasms, or drowned, it is my task to fend them off.
String.Dest: If we encounter enemies, be they monsters, voriplasms, or drowned, it is my task to fend them off.

String.Source: I listen for the flow of Blood. The Roots tell me where to go.
String.Dest: I listen for the flow of Blood. The Roots tell me where to go.

String.Source: I have an affinity for the Roots. Now I understand why. The Hist must have connected with me.
String.Dest: I have an affinity for the Roots. Now I understand why. The Hist must have connected with me.

String.Source: Even if it was corrupted - even if its culling was necessary for the health of the world - I still wish to honor it for the world it gave us.
String.Dest: Even if it was corrupted - even if its culling was necessary for the health of the world - I still wish to honor it for the world it gave us.

String.Source: And so, I will use my connection to find the remaining Roots. I will protect them from the monsters and Drybloods until they can naturally decay.
String.Dest: And so, I will use my connection to find the remaining Roots. I will protect them from the monsters and Drybloods until they can naturally decay.

String.Source: It asks a question with more than one answer. Does it ask what my duty is, or my passion?
String.Dest: It asks a question with more than one answer. Does it ask what my duty is, or my passion?

String.Source: I am a miner, as are all Saxhleel who dwell here. But that is only my duty. It is not my true desire.
String.Dest: I am a miner, as are all Saxhleel who dwell here. But that is only my duty. It is not my true desire.

String.Source: I am a scholar of the xanmeers. My fellow Saxhleel see no value in history, but the ancient stones fascinate me.
String.Dest: I am a scholar of the xanmeers. My fellow Saxhleel see no value in history, but the ancient stones fascinate me.

String.Source: Why were they made? Why were they abandoned? Where does the Meat spring from? My mind creates many questions.
String.Dest: Why were they made? Why were they abandoned? Where does the Meat spring from? My mind creates many questions.

String.Source: I oversee the mines. I guide where we dig, protect the miners, and ensure nobody steals any Meat.
String.Dest: I oversee the mines. I guide where we dig, protect the miners, and ensure nobody steals any Meat.

String.Source: It is difficult to describe to one not of these lands. The term refers in part to the xanmeers... but also not.
String.Dest: It is difficult to describe to one not of these lands. The term refers in part to the xanmeers... but also not.

String.Source: In caves and chambers below the xanmeers, we find the Meat. Thus, those are the Meat Mines.
String.Dest: In caves and chambers below the xanmeers, we find the Meat. Thus, those are the Meat Mines.

String.Source: Hm. What does it want to know?
String.Dest: Hm. What does it want to know?

String.Source: I am in charge of transport. The Meat is dug from the xanmeers here, but it must then be taken to the village so the others can make use of it.
String.Dest: I am in charge of transport. The Meat is dug from the xanmeers here, but it must then be taken to the village so the others can make use of it.

String.Source: I am a miner, like all others in the swamp. But I am also a student of comedy.
String.Dest: I am a miner, like all others in the swamp. But I am also a student of comedy.

String.Source: I am a Meat-Finder. With the main Veins within the Mines difficult to reach, I search for other places we can dig.
String.Dest: I am a Meat-Finder. With the main Veins within the Mines difficult to reach, I search for other places we can dig.

String.Source: There are many xanmeers around the swamp, and we have yet to excavate many of them. It's my job to decide which ones are viable.
String.Dest: There are many xanmeers around the swamp, and we have yet to excavate many of them. It's my job to decide which ones are viable.

String.Source: The xanmeers are the only place we can find the Meat, but...
String.Dest: The xanmeers are the only place we can find the Meat, but...

String.Source: Opening a xanmeer is dangerous. And digging deeper into an already-open one is even more dangerous.
String.Dest: Opening a xanmeer is dangerous. And digging deeper into an already-open one is even more dangerous.

String.Source: Strange monsters haunt the depths. If we are reckless, we might unleash more than we can handle.
String.Dest: Strange monsters haunt the depths. If we are reckless, we might unleash more than we can handle.

String.Source: It's up to me to decide what xanmeers are worth the risk to open... and once we open them, where we should dig to seek the deeper chambers.
String.Dest: It's up to me to decide what xanmeers are worth the risk to open... and once we open them, where we should dig to seek the deeper chambers.

String.Source: Hard.
String.Dest: Hard.

String.Source: There is no Meat left in the upper levels. One must seek the deepest parts of the Mines to find even a small amount.
String.Dest: There is no Meat left in the upper levels. One must seek the deepest parts of the Mines to find even a small amount.

String.Source: And now the Mines are filled with monsters. Many miners die.
String.Dest: And now the Mines are filled with monsters. Many miners die.

String.Source: Strange things. I have never seen their like before.
String.Dest: Strange things. I have never seen their like before.

String.Source: They first appeared several years ago, but their frequency increases of late.
String.Dest: They first appeared several years ago, but their frequency increases of late.

String.Source: But there is nothing we can do. I must dig, or we will all become Drybloods.
String.Dest: But there is nothing we can do. I must dig, or we will all become Drybloods.

String.Source: Anyone who knows that died long ago.
String.Dest: Anyone who knows that died long ago.

String.Source: The xanmeers predate Duskfall. Before elves or men ever came to Tamriel.
String.Dest: The xanmeers predate Duskfall. Before elves or men ever came to Tamriel.

String.Source: No words from those days remain. Only the stone ruins, the Meat in the depths... and the monsters.
String.Dest: No words from those days remain. Only the stone ruins, the Meat in the depths... and the monsters.

String.Source: Not often. Few are foolish enough to rob the Mines.
String.Dest: Not often. Few are foolish enough to rob the Mines.

String.Source: Drybloods are most likely to try, but the guards and that hunter keep them out.
String.Dest: Drybloods are most likely to try, but the guards and that hunter keep them out.

String.Source: Though... Recently, several crates of Meat have vanished.
String.Dest: Though... Recently, several crates of Meat have vanished.

String.Source: Indeed. None see the culprit, but the Meat vanishes like a Haj Mota below the water.
String.Dest: Indeed. None see the culprit, but the Meat vanishes like a Haj Mota below the water.

String.Source: We searched all the miners' homes, of course, as well as the nearby swamps.
String.Dest: We searched all the miners' homes, of course, as well as the nearby swamps.

String.Source: And the guards say none enter the swamp through the road during that time. And yet, the Meat is gone.
String.Dest: And the guards say none enter the swamp through the road during that time. And yet, the Meat is gone.

String.Source: Are we done? I must return to work.
String.Dest: Are we done? I must return to work.

String.Source: Well, you already know my true purpose. Beyond that...
String.Dest: Well, you already know my true purpose. Beyond that...

String.Source: Ah, I perform many tasks here.
String.Dest: Ah, I perform many tasks here.

String.Source: Indeed... Though let us not speak too freely about that where others can hear. This is a plane of Oblivion... We are in enemy territory.
String.Dest: Indeed... Though let us not speak too freely about that where others can hear. This is a plane of Oblivion... We are in enemy territory.

String.Source: The same as you, I imagine. Investigating a potential Daedric threat to Tamriel.
String.Dest: The same as you, I imagine. Investigating a potential Daedric threat to Tamriel.

String.Source: Though I fear the daedra are not the only danger in this realm... The Void has a strong grip on this land.
String.Dest: Though I fear the daedra are not the only danger in this realm... The Void has a strong grip on this land.

String.Source: That which is beyond even Oblivion. Generally, we leave such matters to the Psijics and other esoteric orders, but...
String.Dest: That which is beyond even Oblivion. Generally, we leave such matters to the Psijics and other esoteric orders, but...

String.Source: Well. The Daedric Prince Namira is closely tied to the Void. If this realm belongs to her, the Vigil has a duty to face it.
String.Dest: Well. The Daedric Prince Namira is closely tied to the Void. If this realm belongs to her, the Vigil has a duty to face it.

String.Source: Newcomer to the village? Make sure you pay your respects at the Church of the Old Blood.
String.Dest: Newcomer to the village? Make sure you pay your respects at the Church of the Old Blood.

String.Source: Greet- oh! You're the one Ciirta mentioned!
String.Dest: Greet- oh! You're the one Ciirta mentioned!

String.Source: Apologies, my friend! I didn't realize you were with Ciirta!
String.Dest: Apologies, my friend! I didn't realize you were with Ciirta!

String.Source: Greetings, friend. How can I help?
String.Dest: Greetings, friend. How can I help?

String.Source: If you ever need medicines, please come visit my home. I sell anything you could need there.
String.Dest: If you ever need medicines, please come visit my home. I sell anything you could need there.

String.Source: Psst. Any chance you have any Blood Potions? I've got money...
String.Dest: Psst. Any chance you have any Blood Potions? I've got money...

String.Source: Always good to see you, friend.
String.Dest: Always good to see you, friend.

String.Source: Khajiit is pleased to see you, walker.
String.Dest: Khajiit is pleased to see you, walker.

String.Source: What are you plotting?
String.Dest: What are you plotting?

String.Source: What in Oblivion...?
String.Dest: What in Oblivion...?

String.Source: Hands and eyes to yourself, got it?
String.Dest: Hands and eyes to yourself, got it?

String.Source: You're not hiding from anything down there.
String.Dest: You're not hiding from anything down there.

String.Source: Trying to creep up on me?
String.Dest: Trying to creep up on me?

String.Source: This one sees you. You are a poor hider.
String.Dest: This one sees you. You are a poor hider.

String.Source: Up to no good, by the look of it.
String.Dest: Up to no good, by the look of it.

String.Source: Ma'Jaka is pleased to see you. So few can match how wonderful he is, but you come close.
String.Dest: Ma'Jaka is pleased to see you. So few can match how wonderful he is, but you come close.

String.Source: You chose to marry Ri'nakkhu, hm? This one is not sure why, but he hopes you are pleased.
String.Dest: You chose to marry Ri'nakkhu, hm? This one is not sure why, but he hopes you are pleased.

String.Source: Do not let Ri'nakkhu sharpen his claws on your furniture. This one speaks from experience.
String.Dest: Do not let Ri'nakkhu sharpen his claws on your furniture. This one speaks from experience.

String.Source: Welcome to the Desert Delights! How may this one serve?
String.Dest: Welcome to the Desert Delights! How may this one serve?

String.Source: This one has much to manage. Speak quickly, newcomer.
String.Dest: This one has much to manage. Speak quickly, newcomer.

String.Source: A bed for the night? Food? Medicine? What is it?
String.Dest: A bed for the night? Food? Medicine? What is it?

String.Source: Pay Mehela no mind, five-claw. This one works her hard but fair.
String.Dest: Pay Mehela no mind, five-claw. This one works her hard but fair.

String.Source: My husband died... life will be lonely without him.
String.Dest: My husband died... life will be lonely without him.

String.Source: My wife died... life will be lonely without her.
String.Dest: My wife died... life will be lonely without her.

String.Source: Something you need?
String.Dest: Something you need?

String.Source: How can I serve?
String.Dest: How can I serve?

String.Source: Questions?
String.Dest: Questions?

String.Source: Yes, five-claw?
String.Dest: Yes, five-claw?

String.Source: Guests sometimes say they feel something biting them at night, but it's just the beds. The, um, wood isn't polished enough.
String.Dest: Guests sometimes say they feel something biting them at night, but it's just the beds. The, um, wood isn't polished enough.

String.Source: It's not healthy to sleep in full armor. Much better for you to sleep unclothed.
String.Dest: It's not healthy to sleep in full armor. Much better for you to sleep unclothed.

String.Source: I promise you'll sleep soundly here.
String.Dest: I promise you'll sleep soundly here.

String.Source: Our sheets are softer than any in the village! So soft you won't feel a thing but comfort all night.
String.Dest: Our sheets are softer than any in the village! So soft you won't feel a thing but comfort all night.

String.Source: Visitors often say they hear strange sounds at night, but it's just their imaginations.
String.Dest: Visitors often say they hear strange sounds at night, but it's just their imaginations.

String.Source: Yes, I know about Mehela. Don't worry about her - Azzah-Ko keeps her on a tight leash, and we have bigger issues to deal with for now.
String.Dest: Yes, I know about Mehela. Don't worry about her - Azzah-Ko keeps her on a tight leash, and we have bigger issues to deal with for now.

String.Source: I heard from Ciirta. My condolences about Father Jacob - whatever his flaws, he was a true Vigilant.
String.Dest: I heard from Ciirta. My condolences about Father Jacob - whatever his flaws, he was a true Vigilant.

String.Source: I hear you've been appointed Keeper of Stuhn's Ravine. You've got quite a lot on your plate, friend.
String.Dest: I hear you've been appointed Keeper of Stuhn's Ravine. You've got quite a lot on your plate, friend.

String.Source: I never met Altano personally, but everything I heard made him sound like a loyal Vigilant. What could have happened?
String.Dest: I never met Altano personally, but everything I heard made him sound like a loyal Vigilant. What could have happened?

String.Source: Li'Rakka can finally rest. One day, we will see her again.
String.Dest: Li'Rakka can finally rest. One day, we will see her again.

String.Source: This one hears.
String.Dest: This one hears.

String.Source: This one listens.
String.Dest: This one listens.

String.Source: The soil is dead. Nothing but the fruits of blood grow here.
String.Dest: The soil is dead. Nothing but the fruits of blood grow here.

String.Source: The bloodberries taste foul, but they will sate your thirst for a time.
String.Dest: The bloodberries taste foul, but they will sate your thirst for a time.

String.Source: If not for mages seeking to trade for the berries, this one would not waste time growing them.
String.Dest: If not for mages seeking to trade for the berries, this one would not waste time growing them.

String.Source: Don't be fooled by their appearance - the bloodberries are no substitute for the Old Blood found in the Roots.
String.Dest: Don't be fooled by their appearance - the bloodberries are no substitute for the Old Blood found in the Roots.

String.Source: Help yourself to the berries, if you desire. They grow like weeds here.
String.Dest: Help yourself to the berries, if you desire. They grow like weeds here.

String.Source: What this one would give to be able to grow Moon Sugar...
String.Dest: What this one would give to be able to grow Moon Sugar...

String.Source: Hard to believe this place used to be thriving. Nothing but ruins now.
String.Dest: Hard to believe this place used to be thriving. Nothing but ruins now.

String.Source: Most of the folk who lived here are Drybloods now. Nobody to complain if I salvage what I can.
String.Dest: Most of the folk who lived here are Drybloods now. Nobody to complain if I salvage what I can.

String.Source: I used to be rich, you know? Damn Silver-Bloods took everything from me.
String.Dest: I used to be rich, you know? Damn Silver-Bloods took everything from me.

String.Source: Still have nightmares of Cidnha Mine... I'll become a Dryblood before I let myself get sent back there.
String.Dest: Still have nightmares of Cidnha Mine... I'll become a Dryblood before I let myself get sent back there.

String.Source: Don't need more of you outsiders. Enough of you back in the Reach.
String.Dest: Don't need more of you outsiders. Enough of you back in the Reach.

String.Source: Guards don't care if we scavenge here. Not like the owners are still around.
String.Dest: Guards don't care if we scavenge here. Not like the owners are still around.

String.Source: Three decades ago, this village was thriving. Then the Blood dried up.
String.Dest: Three decades ago, this village was thriving. Then the Blood dried up.

String.Source: I remember the folks who lived here. Good people. All dead now.
String.Dest: I remember the folks who lived here. Good people. All dead now.

String.Source: I don't go past the walls. Can't handle seeing the faces of my friends... All gone Dryblood now.
String.Dest: I don't go past the walls. Can't handle seeing the faces of my friends... All gone Dryblood now.

String.Source: Searching the rubble keeps me sane. Keeps me connected to the people who used to live here.
String.Dest: Searching the rubble keeps me sane. Keeps me connected to the people who used to live here.

String.Source: We always kept the faith in the Old Blood. What did we do to deserve this?
String.Dest: We always kept the faith in the Old Blood. What did we do to deserve this?

String.Source: Say whatever you want about the Blood. I'll hold to the faith.
String.Dest: Say whatever you want about the Blood. I'll hold to the faith.

String.Source: Without something to keep my mind busy, I'd be a Dryblood already.
String.Dest: Without something to keep my mind busy, I'd be a Dryblood already.

String.Source: This place used to be our shelter from the oppressors in the Reach. Now we're imprisoned again... by people who used to be our family.
String.Dest: This place used to be our shelter from the oppressors in the Reach. Now we're imprisoned again... by people who used to be our family.

String.Source: Please, come and browse our goods. Azzah-Ko will be only too happy to dazzle you...
String.Dest: Please, come and browse our goods. Azzah-Ko will be only too happy to dazzle you...

String.Source: Many fine things for sale. Many beds to take your rest!
String.Dest: Many fine things for sale. Many beds to take your rest!

String.Source: Warm beds, sweet food, odds and ends... light pockets... whatever you desire!
String.Dest: Warm beds, sweet food, odds and ends... light pockets... whatever you desire!

String.Source: Constant vigilance. You hear me?
String.Dest: Constant vigilance. You hear me?

String.Source: Little time for chit-chat. Monsters about.
String.Dest: Little time for chit-chat. Monsters about.

String.Source: Faring well? Staying out of trouble?
String.Dest: Faring well? Staying out of trouble?

String.Source: If you're seeking guidance, the Church of the Old Blood will always provide.
String.Dest: If you're seeking guidance, the Church of the Old Blood will always provide.

String.Source: Old Blood keeping you safe, I see? Our prayers do not go unanswered. Nor does my blade.
String.Dest: Old Blood keeping you safe, I see? Our prayers do not go unanswered. Nor does my blade.

String.Source: A lie... was everything a lie?
String.Dest: A lie... was everything a lie?

String.Source: My husband's savior. What can I do for you?
String.Dest: My husband's savior. What can I do for you?

String.Source: Don't worry about Snips, he doesn't sting. We trained him better than that!
String.Dest: Don't worry about Snips, he doesn't sting. We trained him better than that!

String.Source: Wares for all your affairs! Need an ore, I've got it in store. Hmph... Anagach really thinks that's how to make a sale? What do you need?
String.Dest: Wares for all your affairs! Need an ore, I've got it in store. Hmph... Anagach really thinks that's how to make a sale? What do you need?

String.Source: Anything catch your eye, harrier?
String.Dest: Anything catch your eye, harrier?

String.Source: All for sale. Maybe a haggle, if you play your cards right.
String.Dest: All for sale. Maybe a haggle, if you play your cards right.

String.Source: Anything in particular?
String.Dest: Anything in particular?

String.Source: The news about that Hist was a shock to Anagach. Doesn't matter much to me, as long as the ores are real.
String.Dest: The news about that Hist was a shock to Anagach. Doesn't matter much to me, as long as the ores are real.

String.Source: So Anagach and I've been working with amber this whole time? Well, amber's valuable in its own right.
String.Dest: So Anagach and I've been working with amber this whole time? Well, amber's valuable in its own right.

String.Source: Ores to have you in awe! Or so my husband would have ye believe.
String.Dest: Ores to have you in awe! Or so my husband would have ye believe.

String.Source: Time's scarce, but I'll listen.
String.Dest: Time's scarce, but I'll listen.

String.Source: No matter what happens to the realm, Kelsrah and I will remain here. This is our home.
String.Dest: No matter what happens to the realm, Kelsrah and I will remain here. This is our home.

String.Source: Tools, wares, and weapons. Blood-Sculpted by my own hand. Quality.
String.Dest: Tools, wares, and weapons. Blood-Sculpted by my own hand. Quality.

String.Source: You'll find no finer Blood-Sculpting anywhere in Oblivion. I should know.
String.Dest: You'll find no finer Blood-Sculpting anywhere in Oblivion. I should know.

String.Source: This one welcomes you to the Desert Delights. And more welcome is your coin!
String.Dest: This one welcomes you to the Desert Delights. And more welcome is your coin!

String.Source: Goods, wares, beds, and more! All can be yours, friend.
String.Dest: Goods, wares, beds, and more! All can be yours, friend.

String.Source: Whatever you desire, this one shall serve. It is only a matter of coin, five-claw.
String.Dest: Whatever you desire, this one shall serve. It is only a matter of coin, five-claw.

String.Source: Slow.
String.Dest: Slow.

String.Source: This is a Daedric realm - we cannot simply destroy it as we would a cult back on Mundus. Likewise, I see no way to close the portal to Tamriel.
String.Dest: This is a Daedric realm - we cannot simply destroy it as we would a cult back on Mundus. Likewise, I see no way to close the portal to Tamriel.

String.Source: Instead, our opposition must target the source of this realm's power... the Blood.
String.Dest: Instead, our opposition must target the source of this realm's power... the Blood.

String.Source: In my role as healer, I do what I can to treat the locals' addiction to the Blood and purge them of its influence...
String.Dest: In my role as healer, I do what I can to treat the locals' addiction to the Blood and purge them of its influence...

String.Source: But as long as the Blood continues to flow from the ground, they cannot escape their addictions.
String.Dest: But as long as the Blood continues to flow from the ground, they cannot escape their addictions.

String.Source: It would be like a skooma addict trying to recover while living in a skooma den.
String.Dest: It would be like a skooma addict trying to recover while living in a skooma den.

String.Source: Ciirta speaks highly of your fighting prowess... Perhaps you are the help I've been hoping for.
String.Dest: Ciirta speaks highly of your fighting prowess... Perhaps you are the help I've been hoping for.

String.Source: In the long term, uncovering the source of the Blood and putting a stop to it. In the short term...
String.Dest: In the long term, uncovering the source of the Blood and putting a stop to it. In the short term...

String.Source: Well, you've already dealt with the primary issue by cutting down that foul Hist. As for the remaining issues...
String.Dest: Well, you've already dealt with the primary issue by cutting down that foul Hist. As for the remaining issues...

String.Source: Well, I have a number of tasks. Shall we take them in order?
String.Dest: Well, I have a number of tasks. Shall we take them in order?

String.Source: Ah, but first... Here. I jotted down all my notes during my investigation of this realm. Perhaps they will help.
String.Dest: Ah, but first... Here. I jotted down all my notes during my investigation of this realm. Perhaps they will help.

String.Source: You've no doubt noticed the unusual plants that grow here, especially those found in the woods.
String.Dest: You've no doubt noticed the unusual plants that grow here, especially those found in the woods.

String.Source: I've been studying them - working on a way to monitor the evil magic in the forest based on how it affects the plants.
String.Dest: I've been studying them - working on a way to monitor the evil magic in the forest based on how it affects the plants.

String.Source: Unfortunately, age is catching up with me. I struggle to defend myself from the things that dwell there.
String.Dest: Unfortunately, age is catching up with me. I struggle to defend myself from the things that dwell there.

String.Source: If you should venture into the forest, please try to gather half a dozen Bloodberries and three Bloodroots. Healthy, not dry.
String.Dest: If you should venture into the forest, please try to gather half a dozen Bloodberries and three Bloodroots. Healthy, not dry.

String.Source: That should be more than sufficient for me to finish this study.
String.Dest: That should be more than sufficient for me to finish this study.

String.Source: Well, I could always use more ingredients for my medicines.
String.Dest: Well, I could always use more ingredients for my medicines.

String.Source: If you can bring me ten Blue Dartwings, Marshmerrows, or Flame Stalks, I'll happily compensate you for them.
String.Dest: If you can bring me ten Blue Dartwings, Marshmerrows, or Flame Stalks, I'll happily compensate you for them.

String.Source: Ten of the same, to be clear. Though which doesn't matter.
String.Dest: Ten of the same, to be clear. Though which doesn't matter.

String.Source: As before, I'll pay you for medicinal ingredients.
String.Dest: As before, I'll pay you for medicinal ingredients.

String.Source: Ten Blue Dartwings, Marshmerrows, or Flame Stalks.
String.Dest: Ten Blue Dartwings, Marshmerrows, or Flame Stalks.

String.Source: My foremost job is to attend to the well-being of the locals. Injuries and illness are common in these lands, so I'm kept quite busy.
String.Dest: My foremost job is to attend to the well-being of the locals. Injuries and illness are common in these lands, so I'm kept quite busy.

String.Source: The miners have it worst. The Mines are full of strange and violent monsters.
String.Dest: The miners have it worst. The Mines are full of strange and violent monsters.

String.Source: But everyone in the Old Lands must contend with Dryblood attacks, dro-m'Athra escaping from the ruins... and sometimes, the things from the forest.
String.Dest: But everyone in the Old Lands must contend with Dryblood attacks, dro-m'Athra escaping from the ruins... and sometimes, the things from the forest.

String.Source: Without my skill in Restoration, many would have perished.
String.Dest: Without my skill in Restoration, many would have perished.

String.Source: Well, it's nothing that can't wait, but...
String.Dest: Well, it's nothing that can't wait, but...

String.Source: I've brewed a number of medicines, but I haven't had time to deliver them.
String.Dest: I've brewed a number of medicines, but I haven't had time to deliver them.

String.Source: If you wouldn't mind handling that task, I can give you some spare healing draughts.
String.Dest: If you wouldn't mind handling that task, I can give you some spare healing draughts.

String.Source: Thank my upbringing for that. The Vateshran of my clan taught me about the Old Lands as a child.
String.Dest: Thank my upbringing for that. The Vateshran of my clan taught me about the Old Lands as a child.

String.Source: Not the average Reachman, perhaps. But the elders - the Vateshrans of the clans - they know many of the Reach's secrets.
String.Dest: Not the average Reachman, perhaps. But the elders - the Vateshrans of the clans - they know many of the Reach's secrets.

String.Source: Truth be told, the Old Lands are not the only realm that can be entered from the Reach... but it would be unwise to say more.
String.Dest: Truth be told, the Old Lands are not the only realm that can be entered from the Reach... but it would be unwise to say more.

String.Source: The other portals are best left undisturbed and hidden.
String.Dest: The other portals are best left undisturbed and hidden.

String.Source: A good question, and not one with a known answer. My personal theory is that it is tied to Namira.
String.Dest: A good question, and not one with a known answer. My personal theory is that it is tied to Namira.

String.Source: The Reachfolk do not distinguish between aedra, daedra, and other entities as most of Tamriel does. There are simply the mortals and the spirits.
String.Dest: The Reachfolk do not distinguish between aedra, daedra, and other entities as most of Tamriel does. There are simply the mortals and the spirits.

String.Source: In traditional Reach legend, the mundane world was created when Namira, Ruler of Spirits, granted Lorkh a place in the Void.
String.Dest: In traditional Reach legend, the mundane world was created when Namira, Ruler of Spirits, granted Lorkh a place in the Void.

String.Source: Lorkh created a cruel, dangerous world, one that would teach mortals through suffering, tempering them into better forms.
String.Dest: Lorkh created a cruel, dangerous world, one that would teach mortals through suffering, tempering them into better forms.

String.Source: Because of this, Namira is closely linked with the lands where Lorkh's people dwell - that is to say, with the Reach.
String.Dest: Because of this, Namira is closely linked with the lands where Lorkh's people dwell - that is to say, with the Reach.

String.Source: Or, for a less mythical reason, one could blame the Dark Heart.
String.Dest: Or, for a less mythical reason, one could blame the Dark Heart.

String.Source: A relic of Namira. A condensed sphere of pure Void, formed as a dark reflection of the Heart of Lorkhan.
String.Dest: A relic of Namira. A condensed sphere of pure Void, formed as a dark reflection of the Heart of Lorkhan.

String.Source: In the legends of the Khajiit, when Lorkhan - Lorkhaj, as they call him, lost his Heart, the Void filled the emptiness, creating the Dark Heart.
String.Dest: In the legends of the Khajiit, when Lorkhan - Lorkhaj, as they call him, lost his Heart, the Void filled the emptiness, creating the Dark Heart.

String.Source: To stop Lorkhaj's corruption by the Void - or rather, Namira, as the Khajiit draw no distinction between them - Azura tore the Darkness from him.
String.Dest: To stop Lorkhaj's corruption by the Void - or rather, Namira, as the Khajiit draw no distinction between them - Azura tore the Darkness from him.

String.Source: The Dark Heart was cast away and came to land in Skyrim.
String.Dest: The Dark Heart was cast away and came to land in Skyrim.

String.Source: Whether the myth itself has any truth, that part is a fact: the Dark Heart once rested below the Reach.
String.Dest: Whether the myth itself has any truth, that part is a fact: the Dark Heart once rested below the Reach.

String.Source: In the Second Era, an army of undead known as the Gray Host attacked the Reach, seeking the Heart.
String.Dest: In the Second Era, an army of undead known as the Gray Host attacked the Reach, seeking the Heart.

String.Source: The details of what ensued are hazy, but the Host was wiped out, and the Dark Heart vanished from Mundus.
String.Dest: The details of what ensued are hazy, but the Host was wiped out, and the Dark Heart vanished from Mundus.

String.Source: Still, between the formation of the world and the time of the Host, the Dark Heart had thousands of years for its influence to seep into the world.
String.Dest: Still, between the formation of the world and the time of the Host, the Dark Heart had thousands of years for its influence to seep into the world.

String.Source: I suspect that is why Namira has always had such influence in the Reach and why the walls between Mundus and Oblivion are weaker there.
String.Dest: I suspect that is why Namira has always had such influence in the Reach and why the walls between Mundus and Oblivion are weaker there.

String.Source: Hm. Whatever we just did, it feels like... Some remnant of Rukar's spell just fell away.
String.Dest: Hm. Whatever we just did, it feels like... Some remnant of Rukar's spell just fell away.

String.Source: I feel stronger. More... free.
String.Dest: I feel stronger. More... free.

String.Source: Kkgh!
String.Dest: Kkgh!

String.Source: Ghhka!
String.Dest: Ghhka!

String.Source: Khhhh!
String.Dest: Khhhh!

String.Source: Hssss!
String.Dest: Hssss!

String.Source: Khehe... Ghehehe!
String.Dest: Khehe... Ghehehe!

String.Source: Have you ever heard of the Void Spirits?
String.Dest: Have you ever heard of the Void Spirits?

String.Source: Hrm. Unsurprising that you haven't heard much - trying to describe such beings in detail is an exercise in futility.
String.Dest: Hrm. Unsurprising that you haven't heard much - trying to describe such beings in detail is an exercise in futility.

String.Source: Such terms are not relevant here. Aedra, daedra - those are terms from the ancient Aldmer. Arbitrary distinctions.
String.Dest: Such terms are not relevant here. Aedra, daedra - those are terms from the ancient Aldmer. Arbitrary distinctions.

String.Source: To the people of the Reach, there are simply the spirits. Some may dwell in Aetherius, some in Oblivion - some may walk among us on Mundus.
String.Dest: To the people of the Reach, there are simply the spirits. Some may dwell in Aetherius, some in Oblivion - some may walk among us on Mundus.

String.Source: And some exist outside reality altogether. The Void.
String.Dest: And some exist outside reality altogether. The Void.

String.Source: The Void is the infinite darkness beyond reality, beyond even Oblivion. A realm of infinite possibility.
String.Dest: The Void is the infinite darkness beyond reality, beyond even Oblivion. A realm of infinite possibility.

String.Source: To even describe the spirits of the Void as "existing" is an oxymoron, but it is the best mortal tongues can muster.
String.Dest: To even describe the spirits of the Void as "existing" is an oxymoron, but it is the best mortal tongues can muster.

String.Source: The types of spirits are as infinite as the possibilities within the Void. Some are so alien that they would unmake reality with a glance.
String.Dest: The types of spirits are as infinite as the possibilities within the Void. Some are so alien that they would unmake reality with a glance.

String.Source: But some are close enough to reality that they can infiltrate the Aurbis. The weaker ones often end up in service to various daedra, but others...
String.Dest: But some are close enough to reality that they can infiltrate the Aurbis. The weaker ones often end up in service to various daedra, but others...

String.Source: Several especially dangerous Void entities have managed to claim their own territory within Oblivion - and have an interest in Nirn.
String.Dest: Several especially dangerous Void entities have managed to claim their own territory within Oblivion - and have an interest in Nirn.

String.Source: Millamaste the Golden. Tellijih the Silent. Likirani the Radiant. Zelondra Quush, the Corruptor... There are at least a dozen such spirits.
String.Dest: Millamaste the Golden. Tellijih the Silent. Likirani the Radiant. Zelondra Quush, the Corruptor... There are at least a dozen such spirits.

String.Source: The barriers between the planes ensure they are not as directly powerful, nor as influential, as a true Daedric Prince.
String.Dest: The barriers between the planes ensure they are not as directly powerful, nor as influential, as a true Daedric Prince.

String.Source: But they are just as dangerous to mortals.
String.Dest: But they are just as dangerous to mortals.

String.Source: Relics associated with these spirits are rare, but from what I know of the ancient Ayleids, they possessed several - including the Scepter of Quush.
String.Dest: Relics associated with these spirits are rare, but from what I know of the ancient Ayleids, they possessed several - including the Scepter of Quush.

String.Source: I fear that Kheereth-Lah plans to use it to summon the Corruptor.
String.Dest: I fear that Kheereth-Lah plans to use it to summon the Corruptor.

String.Source: On Nirn, I would say no. Even on many of the other planes of reality, the rules of the Aurbis would make it difficult.
String.Dest: On Nirn, I would say no. Even on many of the other planes of reality, the rules of the Aurbis would make it difficult.

String.Source: But the Old Lands are closely linked to Namira.
String.Dest: But the Old Lands are closely linked to Namira.

String.Source: In the myths of the Reach, Namira is more than a spirit of Oblivion - she is a sovereign of the Void.
String.Dest: In the myths of the Reach, Namira is more than a spirit of Oblivion - she is a sovereign of the Void.

String.Source: In a realm belonging to Namira, summoning the Void Spirits may be possible.
String.Dest: In a realm belonging to Namira, summoning the Void Spirits may be possible.

String.Source: We cannot risk Kheereth-Lah unleashing the power of the Void. With the Old Lands linked to Tamriel, such a summoning could be disastrous.
String.Dest: We cannot risk Kheereth-Lah unleashing the power of the Void. With the Old Lands linked to Tamriel, such a summoning could be disastrous.

String.Source: We must find where Kheereth-Lah has gone - before he can use the Scepter.
String.Dest: We must find where Kheereth-Lah has gone - before he can use the Scepter.

String.Source: Xuth! That fool probably entered the Cursed Xanmeer. He obsesses over it for weeks - insisting he can sense huge stores of Meat in there.
String.Dest: Xuth! That fool probably entered the Cursed Xanmeer. He obsesses over it for weeks - insisting he can sense huge stores of Meat in there.

String.Source: It is certain he is missing? This is not good... He must have entered the Cursed Xanmeer.
String.Dest: It is certain he is missing? This is not good... He must have entered the Cursed Xanmeer.

String.Source: I have not seen him in several days. He acts odd for some time before that... Obsessed with the Cursed Xanmeer. Insisting we need to open it.
String.Dest: I have not seen him in several days. He acts odd for some time before that... Obsessed with the Cursed Xanmeer. Insisting we need to open it.

String.Source: I haven't spoken to him lately. He mostly talks to Ah-Khajat or Lizka-Rosh. Or the Overseer, of course.
String.Dest: I haven't spoken to him lately. He mostly talks to Ah-Khajat or Lizka-Rosh. Or the Overseer, of course.

String.Source: I hear he asks many questions about Nalpa-Kur, the Cursed Xanmeer...
String.Dest: I hear he asks many questions about Nalpa-Kur, the Cursed Xanmeer...

String.Source: My clan places a high value on hunting dangerous monsters. Slaying magical beasts before they can harm others brings honor.
String.Dest: My clan places a high value on hunting dangerous monsters. Slaying magical beasts before they can harm others brings honor.

String.Source: The fiends within this realm are a fitting prey for a hunter... and would wreak havoc if they ever escaped into Tamriel.
String.Dest: The fiends within this realm are a fitting prey for a hunter... and would wreak havoc if they ever escaped into Tamriel.

String.Source: There is great honor in fighting them.
String.Dest: There is great honor in fighting them.

String.Source: That sound... You've rung the bell!
String.Dest: That sound... You've rung the bell!

String.Source: I'm glad you're here. I need your help - it's quite important.
String.Dest: I'm glad you're here. I need your help - it's quite important.

String.Source: We have no Blood for you, stranger. The Veins have run dry - we have barely enough for our own people.
String.Dest: We have no Blood for you, stranger. The Veins have run dry - we have barely enough for our own people.

String.Source: If you seek the Blood, speak with Zenkali-Dra.
String.Dest: If you seek the Blood, speak with Zenkali-Dra.

String.Source: I'm just an acolyte. It's the Priestess you want.
String.Dest: I'm just an acolyte. It's the Priestess you want.

String.Source: I'm sorry; I'm still in training. The Priestess can help you.
String.Dest: I'm sorry; I'm still in training. The Priestess can help you.

String.Source: Forgive me. I have many tasks to attend to.
String.Dest: Forgive me. I have many tasks to attend to.

String.Source: It was quite sudden, but I now bear responsibility for the Church. I will do my best.
String.Dest: It was quite sudden, but I now bear responsibility for the Church. I will do my best.

String.Source: May you be blessed by the spirits. What do you need?
String.Dest: May you be blessed by the spirits. What do you need?

String.Source: Zenkali-Dra... No, I cannot blame you. You were only defending yourself.
String.Dest: Zenkali-Dra... No, I cannot blame you. You were only defending yourself.

String.Source: Kah! You and every other clawless sellsword.
String.Dest: Kah! You and every other clawless sellsword.

String.Source: It is useless. None can enter the Hollow Palace - the ancient curse will kill any who try. All you accomplish is further angering the spirits.
String.Dest: It is useless. None can enter the Hollow Palace - the ancient curse will kill any who try. All you accomplish is further angering the spirits.

String.Source: New Blood cannot be forced. We must pray and hope the Hollow Princess forgives our transgressions.
String.Dest: New Blood cannot be forced. We must pray and hope the Hollow Princess forgives our transgressions.

String.Source: You make it sound so simple. The Blood is drying, monsters that have never been seen before are killing our people, the dro-m'Athra grow bolder...
String.Dest: You make it sound so simple. The Blood is drying, monsters that have never been seen before are killing our people, the dro-m'Athra grow bolder...

String.Source: You ask this one to endanger us even further by provoking the wrath of the Hollow Princess?!
String.Dest: You ask this one to endanger us even further by provoking the wrath of the Hollow Princess?!

String.Source: Perhaps if the immediate dangers could be lessened a bit, the risk would be possible...
String.Dest: Perhaps if the immediate dangers could be lessened a bit, the risk would be possible...

String.Source: You are not the first to be so boastful. You would die just like all the others.
String.Dest: You are not the first to be so boastful. You would die just like all the others.

String.Source: Perhaps, were this one to be convinced of your strength...
String.Dest: Perhaps, were this one to be convinced of your strength...

String.Source: What choice do we have?! The Hollow Princess rules over the source of Blood. If the Blood is drying up, it must be her punishing us!
String.Dest: What choice do we have?! The Hollow Princess rules over the source of Blood. If the Blood is drying up, it must be her punishing us!

String.Source: And we would not need to worry about it "taking too long" if not for those feckless jekosiits at the Mines!
String.Dest: And we would not need to worry about it "taking too long" if not for those feckless jekosiits at the Mines!

String.Source: Hmm. Perhaps there is a way...
String.Dest: Hmm. Perhaps there is a way...

String.Source: Without a full supply of Blood, we have fallen back on Meat. Magic flesh, carved from below the ancient ruins of the Meat Mines.
String.Dest: Without a full supply of Blood, we have fallen back on Meat. Magic flesh, carved from below the ancient ruins of the Meat Mines.

String.Source: The Bloodroots burrowed their way through the mines for eons, soaking the flesh there with the Blood. Even with the Roots dry, the Meat holds power.
String.Dest: The Bloodroots burrowed their way through the mines for eons, soaking the flesh there with the Blood. Even with the Roots dry, the Meat holds power.

String.Source: It is not a permanent substitute for Blood, but it staves off the Dryblood symptoms. If we had enough Meat, we could endure longer.
String.Dest: It is not a permanent substitute for Blood, but it staves off the Dryblood symptoms. If we had enough Meat, we could endure longer.

String.Source: But those greedy lizards in the Mines hoard the Meat! They demand I share our meager Blood stores with them if we want to survive!
String.Dest: But those greedy lizards in the Mines hoard the Meat! They demand I share our meager Blood stores with them if we want to survive!

String.Source: A blessing granted by the Old Lands. The flesh of the world itself.
String.Dest: A blessing granted by the Old Lands. The flesh of the world itself.

String.Source: The Meat is the Meat. It holds the power of the Old Blood and thus keeps us sane, even when the Blood itself runs dry.
String.Dest: The Meat is the Meat. It holds the power of the Old Blood and thus keeps us sane, even when the Blood itself runs dry.

String.Source: We do not question the blessings we are granted. To do so risks having them taken away.
String.Dest: We do not question the blessings we are granted. To do so risks having them taken away.

String.Source: Consuming the Meat was always a sacred communion. And in times when the Blood was plentiful, we ate the Meat to avoid the perils of overconsumption.
String.Dest: Consuming the Meat was always a sacred communion. And in times when the Blood was plentiful, we ate the Meat to avoid the perils of overconsumption.

String.Source: But only since the Blood began to dry did the Meat become vital to our survival.
String.Dest: But only since the Blood began to dry did the Meat become vital to our survival.

String.Source: The Old Blood is filled with powerful magic, the primal magic of the ancient times. Mortal bodies cannot truly handle it.
String.Dest: The Old Blood is filled with powerful magic, the primal magic of the ancient times. Mortal bodies cannot truly handle it.

String.Source: Small doses elevate the soul, moving us closer to the Old Spirits. But to overindulge would destroy mind and body alike.
String.Dest: Small doses elevate the soul, moving us closer to the Old Spirits. But to overindulge would destroy mind and body alike.

String.Source: As it happens, there's still a matter here I'd like to investigate.
String.Dest: As it happens, there's still a matter here I'd like to investigate.

String.Source: I sense the taint of the Glass from that tunnel... and my order is familiar with the tale of the Iceblood Clan.
String.Dest: I sense the taint of the Glass from that tunnel... and my order is familiar with the tale of the Iceblood Clan.

String.Source: I believe there remains a mystery to solve within the frozen ruins. Wouldst thou care to accompany me?
String.Dest: I believe there remains a mystery to solve within the frozen ruins. Wouldst thou care to accompany me?

String.Source: No need to answer. Should I see thee travel to the ruins of the Iceblood Academy once more, I shall consider that my answer.
String.Dest: No need to answer. Should I see thee travel to the ruins of the Iceblood Academy once more, I shall consider that my answer.

String.Source: Let's move away from these corpses. I'll explain while we walk.
String.Dest: Let's move away from these corpses. I'll explain while we walk.

String.Source: We call this place the Old Lands. According to the legends of the Reach, this is where Lorkh first created the physical realm.
String.Dest: We call this place the Old Lands. According to the legends of the Reach, this is where Lorkh first created the physical realm.

String.Source: For thousands of years, those who know of this realm have made pilgrimages here, seeking the Old Blood.
String.Dest: For thousands of years, those who know of this realm have made pilgrimages here, seeking the Old Blood.

String.Source: The Old Blood is said to be the Blood of Lorkh... the last Blood He shed after He lost His Heart.
String.Dest: The Old Blood is said to be the Blood of Lorkh... the last Blood He shed after He lost His Heart.

String.Source: By ingesting the Old Blood, we elevate our souls. Transform ourselves, becoming closer to Lorkh and the other spirits.
String.Dest: By ingesting the Old Blood, we elevate our souls. Transform ourselves, becoming closer to Lorkh and the other spirits.

String.Source: However, there is a danger to this. If one is cut off from the Old Blood after the transformation begins, they become a Dryblood.
String.Dest: However, there is a danger to this. If one is cut off from the Old Blood after the transformation begins, they become a Dryblood.

String.Source: Drybloods lose any sense of self. They become mad, violent monsters, seeking nothing but more Blood.
String.Dest: Drybloods lose any sense of self. They become mad, violent monsters, seeking nothing but more Blood.

String.Source: In the old times, this was rare. Drybloods were mostly those who went back to Tamriel or who became trapped by accidents.
String.Dest: In the old times, this was rare. Drybloods were mostly those who went back to Tamriel or who became trapped by accidents.

String.Source: Now, however...
String.Dest: Now, however...

String.Source: The Old Blood once flowed freely through the Roots that grow all throughout the world.
String.Dest: The Old Blood once flowed freely through the Roots that grow all throughout the world.

String.Source: Of late, however, the Blood has dried up. The Roots offer only a few tiny drops.
String.Dest: Of late, however, the Blood has dried up. The Roots offer only a few tiny drops.

String.Source: Many of the villagers have already become Drybloods. The rest struggle to preserve what Blood remains and must rely on Meat from the mines.
String.Dest: Many of the villagers have already become Drybloods. The rest struggle to preserve what Blood remains and must rely on Meat from the mines.

String.Source: Consuming the Meat holds back the madness for a while, but not forever. Without a new source of Old Blood, everyone here will eventually succumb.
String.Dest: Consuming the Meat holds back the madness for a while, but not forever. Without a new source of Old Blood, everyone here will eventually succumb.

String.Source: Action must be taken, but none remain who can do what is needed.
String.Dest: Action must be taken, but none remain who can do what is needed.

String.Source: The villagers already struggle from the lack of Blood. The guards are kept occupied fighting the Drybloods... and worse.
String.Dest: The villagers already struggle from the lack of Blood. The guards are kept occupied fighting the Drybloods... and worse.

String.Source: I do what I can, but I'm old. I lack the strength to do what is needed.
String.Dest: I do what I can, but I'm old. I lack the strength to do what is needed.

String.Source: You are a stranger here, but you clearly possess strength.
String.Dest: You are a stranger here, but you clearly possess strength.

String.Source: I won't ask you to commit yourself to this, but... Would you consider lending us your aid?
String.Dest: I won't ask you to commit yourself to this, but... Would you consider lending us your aid?

String.Source: If you are willing to help, I promise you a generous reward.
String.Dest: If you are willing to help, I promise you a generous reward.

String.Source: Do you really think finding the source will be enough to fix this?
String.Dest: Do you really think finding the source will be enough to fix this?

String.Source: What if we can't restore the Blood? Is it really possible to cure people's reliance on it?
String.Dest: What if we can't restore the Blood? Is it really possible to cure people's reliance on it?

String.Source: It will be a pleasure to finally tear his soul apart.
String.Dest: It will be a pleasure to finally tear his soul apart.

String.Source: That bastard created me to be his weapon? I'll show him just what he created.
String.Dest: That bastard created me to be his weapon? I'll show him just what he created.

String.Source: It's frustrating that we can't just break in, but we need to play along for now.
String.Dest: It's frustrating that we can't just break in, but we need to play along for now.

String.Source: Let's hope we can resolve this Meat shortage quickly.
String.Dest: Let's hope we can resolve this Meat shortage quickly.

String.Source: The ruins are swarming with dro-m'Athra. We should be careful.
String.Dest: The ruins are swarming with dro-m'Athra. We should be careful.

String.Source: They say the forest is the Hollow Princess's realm.
String.Dest: They say the forest is the Hollow Princess's realm.

String.Source: I don't know if that's true, but there's definitely an evil aura over the whole place...
String.Dest: I don't know if that's true, but there's definitely an evil aura over the whole place...

String.Source: We should move slowly and carefully. Don't miss any details.
String.Dest: We should move slowly and carefully. Don't miss any details.

String.Source: I don't know, but I don't like it.
String.Dest: I don't know, but I don't like it.

String.Source: There's something very wrong here, and whatever it is, it's not related to the rest of this realm.
String.Dest: There's something very wrong here, and whatever it is, it's not related to the rest of this realm.

String.Source: I want to get out of here as soon as possible.
String.Dest: I want to get out of here as soon as possible.

String.Source: I know that, but... Honestly, who would have me?
String.Dest: I know that, but... Honestly, who would have me?

String.Source: I remember when she was first taken in by the Vigil. I was staying at the Vigilant outpost in Stuhn's Ravine when we found her.
String.Dest: I remember when she was first taken in by the Vigil. I was staying at the Vigilant outpost in Stuhn's Ravine when we found her.

String.Source: She'd been abandoned by her parents - or perhaps some evil fate befell them and they managed to get her to safety.
String.Dest: She'd been abandoned by her parents - or perhaps some evil fate befell them and they managed to get her to safety.

String.Source: Either way, Father Jacob felt it was a sign from Stendarr. He decided to raise her in the ways of the Vigil.
String.Dest: Either way, Father Jacob felt it was a sign from Stendarr. He decided to raise her in the ways of the Vigil.

String.Source: My work kept me busy dealing with Daedric cults in the Reach, but I stopped by regularly enough.
String.Dest: My work kept me busy dealing with Daedric cults in the Reach, but I stopped by regularly enough.

String.Source: I was delighted to hear she'd been put in charge of Stendarr's Beacon. She truly does Jacob's training proud.
String.Dest: I was delighted to hear she'd been put in charge of Stendarr's Beacon. She truly does Jacob's training proud.

String.Source: Probably the right choice. Everyone relies on the miners. Without them, the village is doomed.
String.Dest: Probably the right choice. Everyone relies on the miners. Without them, the village is doomed.

String.Source: Still... let's hope we can get the Priestess to see it that way...
String.Dest: Still... let's hope we can get the Priestess to see it that way...

String.Source: Hm. Well, that is the fastest way to get us into the Church, I guess.
String.Dest: Hm. Well, that is the fastest way to get us into the Church, I guess.

String.Source: Dunno if the Miners really can spare that much Meat, though...
String.Dest: Dunno if the Miners really can spare that much Meat, though...

String.Source: Well, hopefully we can resolve this whole shortage before it becomes a problem!
String.Dest: Well, hopefully we can resolve this whole shortage before it becomes a problem!

String.Source: Oh. I guess that... explains where the monsters are coming from.
String.Dest: Oh. I guess that... explains where the monsters are coming from.

String.Source: Those gems look like they're keeping the portal open. I say we smash them.
String.Dest: Those gems look like they're keeping the portal open. I say we smash them.

String.Source: Damn, the darkness is shielding the gems? Let's get the lights back on, quick!
String.Dest: Damn, the darkness is shielding the gems? Let's get the lights back on, quick!

String.Source: The lights are on! Quick, smash the gem!
String.Dest: The lights are on! Quick, smash the gem!

String.Source: Ugh. That took forever.
String.Dest: Ugh. That took forever.

String.Source: Next time, I say we just climb the building from outside and break in that way.
String.Dest: Next time, I say we just climb the building from outside and break in that way.

String.Source: Well, I guess it's a good thing we dealt with those monsters in the Mines, at least?
String.Dest: Well, I guess it's a good thing we dealt with those monsters in the Mines, at least?

String.Source: It wears an Amulet of Mara! It has not yet taken a mate? This is a surprise.
String.Dest: It wears an Amulet of Mara! It has not yet taken a mate? This is a surprise.

String.Source: I erect the spine of greeting.
String.Dest: I erect the spine of greeting.

String.Source: If it seeks Meat, there is little to share.
String.Dest: If it seeks Meat, there is little to share.

String.Source: What does it need?
String.Dest: What does it need?

String.Source: The mines are dangerous, but the river flows no other way.
String.Dest: The mines are dangerous, but the river flows no other way.

String.Source: Does it come to aid our labors? There are sufficient picks.
String.Dest: Does it come to aid our labors? There are sufficient picks.

String.Source: Where do these monsters emerge...?
String.Dest: Where do these monsters emerge...?

String.Source: Is it up to mischief down there?
String.Dest: Is it up to mischief down there?

String.Source: It had better keep its hands to itself...
String.Dest: It had better keep its hands to itself...

String.Source: By the Hist, what's it doing now...?
String.Dest: By the Hist, what's it doing now...?

String.Source: It would make a very poor Shadowscale...
String.Dest: It would make a very poor Shadowscale...

String.Source: Is it any good with a pick? Toil is to harden the spine, but ours is all worn out.
String.Dest: Is it any good with a pick? Toil is to harden the spine, but ours is all worn out.

String.Source: Yes, dryskin?
String.Dest: Yes, dryskin?

String.Source: Tidings, dryskin.
String.Dest: Tidings, dryskin.

String.Source: Greetings, egg-brother.
String.Dest: Greetings, egg-brother.

String.Source: Greetings, egg-sister.
String.Dest: Greetings, egg-sister.

String.Source: I nod in fair greeting, moist one.
String.Dest: I nod in fair greeting, moist one.

String.Source: I extend the claw of good greeting, egg-friend.
String.Dest: I extend the claw of good greeting, egg-friend.

String.Source: It has the marsh in its veins, friend. It seems... whole. With plentiful Blood, we are the same. Without the Blood, our veins know not the marsh.
String.Dest: It has the marsh in its veins, friend. It seems... whole. With plentiful Blood, we are the same. Without the Blood, our veins know not the marsh.

String.Source: Its scales still have the water's shine... Ours are dulled by dust and death...
String.Dest: Its scales still have the water's shine... Ours are dulled by dust and death...

String.Source: Ours is to smile at its greeting, moist one.
String.Dest: Ours is to smile at its greeting, moist one.

String.Source: If it wishes to help ease our burden, Ah-Khajat offers work to anyone willing.
String.Dest: If it wishes to help ease our burden, Ah-Khajat offers work to anyone willing.

String.Source: No long distractions, yes? Ah-Khajat will have our tail.
String.Dest: No long distractions, yes? Ah-Khajat will have our tail.

String.Source: Pay no mind to Falls-off-Ledges. His egg had too much shade...
String.Dest: Pay no mind to Falls-off-Ledges. His egg had too much shade...

String.Source: Do not fear Ajim-Vash. She hisses loud but seldom bites... or speaks.
String.Dest: Do not fear Ajim-Vash. She hisses loud but seldom bites... or speaks.

String.Source: It has the look of a fighter... Digs-the-Depths will welcome your arrival.
String.Dest: It has the look of a fighter... Digs-the-Depths will welcome your arrival.

String.Source: It would think Hears-the-Roots only a hatchling for her prattle. Wanders like a stream to meet with Trouble River...
String.Dest: It would think Hears-the-Roots only a hatchling for her prattle. Wanders like a stream to meet with Trouble River...

String.Source: Kaoc... What?
String.Dest: Kaoc... What?

String.Source: Xuth, more talk?
String.Dest: Xuth, more talk?

String.Source: Speak quickly. Our tail twitches...
String.Dest: Speak quickly. Our tail twitches...

String.Source: By the egg... What?!
String.Dest: By the egg... What?!

String.Source: Will it also mine the Meat in exchange for our attention?
String.Dest: Will it also mine the Meat in exchange for our attention?

String.Source: The more it speaks, the more it dries our scales...
String.Dest: The more it speaks, the more it dries our scales...

String.Source: No news from the Church? Good...
String.Dest: No news from the Church? Good...

String.Source: Ah-Khajat seeks you. It would be good to see him.
String.Dest: Ah-Khajat seeks you. It would be good to see him.

String.Source: It may wish to put on some clothes. Swamps are filled with disease.. and insects.
String.Dest: It may wish to put on some clothes. Swamps are filled with disease.. and insects.

String.Source: Does it need something?
String.Dest: Does it need something?

String.Source: Sitting beneath its swaying leaves, hearing its words within the breeze... Speak, hear the Hist speak... Hear the Hist speak its words to us...
String.Dest: Sitting beneath its swaying leaves, hearing its words within the breeze... Speak, hear the Hist speak... Hear the Hist speak its words to us...

String.Source: From its sap we gain our life... By its judgement we end strife... Tribe and Hist, sky and sun... All connected, all are one...
String.Dest: From its sap we gain our life... By its judgement we end strife... Tribe and Hist, sky and sun... All connected, all are one...

String.Source: Halt! It's time you pay for your crimes.
String.Dest: Halt! It's time you pay for your crimes.

String.Source: There's no escape, criminal. Time to surrender.
String.Dest: There's no escape, criminal. Time to surrender.

String.Source: The only mistake was committing your crimes here, outsider.
String.Dest: The only mistake was committing your crimes here, outsider.

String.Source: Hold it right there, outsider. Time to pay for your crimes.
String.Dest: Hold it right there, outsider. Time to pay for your crimes.

String.Source: Fine, fine. Not worth my time anyway.
String.Dest: Fine, fine. Not worth my time anyway.

String.Source: Heh. Now that's what I like to see. Be on your way.
String.Dest: Heh. Now that's what I like to see. Be on your way.

String.Source: Very good. You can go about your day.
String.Dest: Very good. You can go about your day.

String.Source: Ah, this one likes what this one sees. You may go.
String.Dest: Ah, this one likes what this one sees. You may go.

String.Source: Halt! It's time you pay for your crimes.
String.Dest: Halt! It's time you pay for your crimes.

String.Source: Drop your weapons and surrender!
String.Dest: Drop your weapons and surrender!

String.Source: Come quietly or face the consequences.
String.Dest: Come quietly or face the consequences.

String.Source: Glad to hear it. Hand over your stolen goods and get out of here.
String.Dest: Glad to hear it. Hand over your stolen goods and get out of here.

String.Source: Smart of you, outsider. Hand over your stolen goods, and you're free to go.
String.Dest: Smart of you, outsider. Hand over your stolen goods, and you're free to go.

String.Source: Fine, fine. I'm needed to keep out the Drybloods, not deal with petty crimes.
String.Dest: Fine, fine. I'm needed to keep out the Drybloods, not deal with petty crimes.

String.Source: This one has better things to deal with anyway. There is no end to the Dryblood attacks.
String.Dest: This one has better things to deal with anyway. There is no end to the Dryblood attacks.

String.Source: Another fool that's gone Dryblood.
String.Dest: Another fool that's gone Dryblood.

String.Source: And so you die.
String.Dest: And so you die.

String.Source: I'll toss your corpse into the Mines!
String.Dest: I'll toss your corpse into the Mines!

String.Source: We don't have a "jail" here, outsider. Enjoy your time in the Mines.
String.Dest: We don't have a "jail" here, outsider. Enjoy your time in the Mines.

String.Source: Hm, let me think.
String.Dest: Hm, let me think.

String.Source: Let's do one at a time. Trying to remember too much makes me dizzy.
String.Dest: Let's do one at a time. Trying to remember too much makes me dizzy.

String.Source: Hm. I can't think of anywhere... But it's hard to say. Maybe something will come to me later?
String.Dest: Hm. I can't think of anywhere... But it's hard to say. Maybe something will come to me later?

String.Source: Or maybe we got them all... My memories from then are pretty hazy...
String.Dest: Or maybe we got them all... My memories from then are pretty hazy...

String.Source: I remember... a mine. There was red mist everywhere.
String.Dest: I remember... a mine. There was red mist everywhere.

String.Source: In the northern part of the Rift, I think.
String.Dest: In the northern part of the Rift, I think.

String.Source: I think I saw ore, too... iron? Or maybe ebony? It was hard to tell through the mist...
String.Dest: I think I saw ore, too... iron? Or maybe ebony? It was hard to tell through the mist...

String.Source: There was somewhere very dark. A cave... in a mountain somewhere? There were ruins nearby.
String.Dest: There was somewhere very dark. A cave... in a mountain somewhere? There were ruins nearby.

String.Source: Somewhere in the Reach. And I think... Forsworn symbols?
String.Dest: Somewhere in the Reach. And I think... Forsworn symbols?

String.Source: Hm... A Dwemer ruin, but... mostly caved in. The entrance might have been blocked, actually?
String.Dest: Hm... A Dwemer ruin, but... mostly caved in. The entrance might have been blocked, actually?
