String.Source: I think there was some Aetherium Ore there, though.
String.Dest: I think there was some Aetherium Ore there, though.

String.Source: I remember... A very large tree. A sacred feeling.
String.Dest: I remember... A very large tree. A sacred feeling.

String.Source: An actual tree, not a Hist. It was in a cave, I think?
String.Dest: An actual tree, not a Hist. It was in a cave, I think?

String.Source: Of course. Any would be honored to make a nest with it.
String.Dest: Of course. Any would be honored to make a nest with it.

String.Source: The question is whether that interest is returned.
String.Dest: The question is whether that interest is returned.

String.Source: Truly? If it truly shares our desire, then we will make an excellent couple.
String.Dest: Truly? If it truly shares our desire, then we will make an excellent couple.

String.Source: I lower my spine in sadness. I am lessened for lacking its companionship.
String.Dest: I lower my spine in sadness. I am lessened for lacking its companionship.

String.Source: It is cruel, to raise our hopes like that.
String.Dest: It is cruel, to raise our hopes like that.

String.Source: I erect the spine of joy. This is a grand day.
String.Dest: I erect the spine of joy. This is a grand day.

String.Source: Let us prepare the ceremony. I will go to the Temple of Mara at once.
String.Dest: Let us prepare the ceremony. I will go to the Temple of Mara at once.

String.Source: Its tone makes it clear this will not be good news.
String.Dest: Its tone makes it clear this will not be good news.

String.Source: Continue. I am prepared.
String.Dest: Continue. I am prepared.

String.Source: Ah, this? It's called a Shillelagh - or a "knobby stick," in casual conversation. It's a traditional Reachfolk weapon, mainly used by the Vateshrans.
String.Dest: Ah, this? It's called a Shillelagh - or a "knobby stick," in casual conversation. It's a traditional Reachfolk weapon, mainly used by the Vateshrans.

String.Source: If you'd like, I can make one for you. I just need the right materials - one piece of Firewood and a Hawk Beak.
String.Dest: If you'd like, I can make one for you. I just need the right materials - one piece of Firewood and a Hawk Beak.

String.Source: You seem to have the requisite items, so certainly. I'll take them off your hands and get to work. Is that acceptable?
String.Dest: You seem to have the requisite items, so certainly. I'll take them off your hands and get to work. Is that acceptable?

String.Source: I'm afraid I'd need the materials - a Hawk Beak and a piece of Firewood. If you can provide those, I'd be happy to make you one.
String.Dest: I'm afraid I'd need the materials - a Hawk Beak and a piece of Firewood. If you can provide those, I'd be happy to make you one.

String.Source: Certainly. This won't take long...
String.Dest: Certainly. This won't take long...

String.Source: There we are. I hope it helps.
String.Dest: There we are. I hope it helps.

String.Source: Very well. Let me know if you change your mind.
String.Dest: Very well. Let me know if you change your mind.

String.Source: Where would they go? Even if they had not become reliant on the Old Blood, they would never be welcome back in Elsweyr.
String.Dest: Where would they go? Even if they had not become reliant on the Old Blood, they would never be welcome back in Elsweyr.

String.Source: For those of us in the modern age, all have their own reasons for staying.
String.Dest: For those of us in the modern age, all have their own reasons for staying.

String.Source: Some hope the Old Blood can help connect with Lorkhaj. Some seek power. Some are descended from the old cultists and feel a connection to this place.
String.Dest: Some hope the Old Blood can help connect with Lorkhaj. Some seek power. Some are descended from the old cultists and feel a connection to this place.

String.Source: And some simply have nowhere else to go.
String.Dest: And some simply have nowhere else to go.

String.Source: Heh. This one simply finds value in fighting the dro-m'Athra. Is defending innocents from monsters not a noble goal?
String.Dest: Heh. This one simply finds value in fighting the dro-m'Athra. Is defending innocents from monsters not a noble goal?

String.Source: You know the reason. This one was seeking Li'Rakka.
String.Dest: You know the reason. This one was seeking Li'Rakka.

String.Source: Excellent! Thank you, my friend. I will begin studying these at once.
String.Dest: Excellent! Thank you, my friend. I will begin studying these at once.

String.Source: A full study will take time, but I can already tell that there has been a change since my last observation. A pulse of Void magic...
String.Dest: A full study will take time, but I can already tell that there has been a change since my last observation. A pulse of Void magic...

String.Source: Hm, if I'm correct, the source would be... Yes, I think I know our next step.
String.Dest: Hm, if I'm correct, the source would be... Yes, I think I know our next step.

String.Source: Indeed. I think everyone in the village sensed it - the entire realm seemed to shudder.
String.Dest: Indeed. I think everyone in the village sensed it - the entire realm seemed to shudder.

String.Source: Tell me, what was the source? You're likely the first living being since the Merethic Era to have beheld it.
String.Dest: Tell me, what was the source? You're likely the first living being since the Merethic Era to have beheld it.

String.Source: I'd like to investigate deeper into the source of the corruption in the woods. Specifically, the Ayleid ruins.
String.Dest: I'd like to investigate deeper into the source of the corruption in the woods. Specifically, the Ayleid ruins.

String.Source: Based on what I've observed from my studies of the plants, it seems there has been a recent surge of Void magic in the ruin known as Angawyll.
String.Dest: Based on what I've observed from my studies of the plants, it seems there has been a recent surge of Void magic in the ruin known as Angawyll.

String.Source: I'd like you to investigate Angawyll and see if there's anything unusual there.
String.Dest: I'd like you to investigate Angawyll and see if there's anything unusual there.

String.Source: Hist Tree...? Ha! Of course!
String.Dest: Hist Tree...? Ha! Of course!

String.Source: In retrospect, it's obvious. Why else would the "Blood" flow from roots?
String.Dest: In retrospect, it's obvious. Why else would the "Blood" flow from roots?

String.Source: Actually, I would say this is good news. Medicine has no cure for "possession by the Blood of ancient Gods," but Hist sap addiction...
String.Dest: Actually, I would say this is good news. Medicine has no cure for "possession by the Blood of ancient Gods," but Hist sap addiction...

String.Source: The next caravan from Tamriel should arrive before long. They often deliver messages for us.
String.Dest: The next caravan from Tamriel should arrive before long. They often deliver messages for us.

String.Source: I will send some missives to Black Marsh as well as some acquaintances of mine at the Temple of Kynareth. Treating the villagers should be possible.
String.Dest: I will send some missives to Black Marsh as well as some acquaintances of mine at the Temple of Kynareth. Treating the villagers should be possible.

String.Source: Thank you, friend. This information is most helpful.
String.Dest: Thank you, friend. This information is most helpful.

String.Source: It is called Nalpa-Kur. The name means "Rotten Water" - fitting for a place so foul.
String.Dest: It is called Nalpa-Kur. The name means "Rotten Water" - fitting for a place so foul.

String.Source: Any competent Meat-Finder could sense the dark magic within it. Even if we tried to harvest Meat there, any we found would be tainted.
String.Dest: Any competent Meat-Finder could sense the dark magic within it. Even if we tried to harvest Meat there, any we found would be tainted.

String.Source: Kheereth-Lah used to know that. Then his patrol takes him too close to the xanmeer... Ever since, he raves that he must get in.
String.Dest: Kheereth-Lah used to know that. Then his patrol takes him too close to the xanmeer... Ever since, he raves that he must get in.

String.Source: If he breaks the seals on Nalpa-Kur, the darkness within may be released. Do whatever is needed to stop him.
String.Dest: If he breaks the seals on Nalpa-Kur, the darkness within may be released. Do whatever is needed to stop him.

String.Source: It should not want to know. The Cursed Xanmeer - Nalpa-Kur, the "rotten water."
String.Dest: It should not want to know. The Cursed Xanmeer - Nalpa-Kur, the "rotten water."

String.Source: Even I would not be so foolish as to enter there. Nalpa-Kur is filled with an unnatural darkness. The ones who built it sealed something within.
String.Dest: Even I would not be so foolish as to enter there. Nalpa-Kur is filled with an unnatural darkness. The ones who built it sealed something within.

String.Source: Kheereth-Lah is strangely curious about Nalpa-Kur. Endless questions to which we have no answers!
String.Dest: Kheereth-Lah is strangely curious about Nalpa-Kur. Endless questions to which we have no answers!

String.Source: If that fool has broken the seals, he is doomed. Do whatever is needed to keep the darkness from escaping.
String.Dest: If that fool has broken the seals, he is doomed. Do whatever is needed to keep the darkness from escaping.

String.Source: Nalpa-Kur, the rotten water. The ones who built this land sealed something of true evil there.
String.Dest: Nalpa-Kur, the rotten water. The ones who built this land sealed something of true evil there.

String.Source: The Saxhleel rarely keep written records, so little has been passed down. But there is a clear warning written at the entrance of Nalpa-Kur.
String.Dest: The Saxhleel rarely keep written records, so little has been passed down. But there is a clear warning written at the entrance of Nalpa-Kur.

String.Source: "A foul darkness sleeps here. Those who open the door shall unleash the Drowned One."
String.Dest: "A foul darkness sleeps here. Those who open the door shall unleash the Drowned One."

String.Source: Whatever is in there, Kheereth-Lah became strangely fixated on it after his patrol takes him near the Cursed Xanmeer.
String.Dest: Whatever is in there, Kheereth-Lah became strangely fixated on it after his patrol takes him near the Cursed Xanmeer.

String.Source: If he tries to release something sealed there, do not allow it. Stop him at all costs.
String.Dest: If he tries to release something sealed there, do not allow it. Stop him at all costs.

String.Source: It is as the name says. We stay away from it - any Meat within is beyond claiming.
String.Dest: It is as the name says. We stay away from it - any Meat within is beyond claiming.

String.Source: Lizka-Rosh, Ah-Khajat, or the Overseer would know more.
String.Dest: Lizka-Rosh, Ah-Khajat, or the Overseer would know more.

String.Source: Dig... Dig... Dig...
String.Dest: Dig... Dig... Dig...

String.Source: I sense the power deep below. It will be mine.
String.Dest: I sense the power deep below. It will be mine.

String.Source: I hear your call, Mistress. Just a bit longer... In time, I will dig my way into the lowest levels...
String.Dest: I hear your call, Mistress. Just a bit longer... In time, I will dig my way into the lowest levels...

String.Source: Deeper... I must go deeper. The darkness calls...
String.Dest: Deeper... I must go deeper. The darkness calls...

String.Source: Let's not spend longer than needed here. We'll talk back at my hideout.
String.Dest: Let's not spend longer than needed here. We'll talk back at my hideout.

String.Source: Ready? We've an ambush to spring.
String.Dest: Ready? We've an ambush to spring.

String.Source: I'll meet you in Varsel.
String.Dest: I'll meet you in Varsel.

String.Source: That depends, walker. Do you ask of the myth or the object itself? This one will answer both.
String.Dest: That depends, walker. Do you ask of the myth or the object itself? This one will answer both.

String.Source: In the old myths, Lorkhaj, last of Fadomai's children, was born in the depths of the Void. Thus, the Great Darkness filled Lorkhaj at birth.
String.Dest: In the old myths, Lorkhaj, last of Fadomai's children, was born in the depths of the Void. Thus, the Great Darkness filled Lorkhaj at birth.

String.Source: This allowed the Darkness to know itself, and Namiira was born. When Lorkhaj's Heart was torn out, the Darkness of Namiira took its place.
String.Dest: This allowed the Darkness to know itself, and Namiira was born. When Lorkhaj's Heart was torn out, the Darkness of Namiira took its place.

String.Source: This new Darkness - the empty space where his Heart once rested - became the Dark Heart and made Lorkhaj the first dro-m'Athra.
String.Dest: This new Darkness - the empty space where his Heart once rested - became the Dark Heart and made Lorkhaj the first dro-m'Athra.

String.Source: Much happened, but the ending of the story is this: Azurah tore the Dark Heart from Lorkhaj and threw it back into the Void, freeing Lorkhaj.
String.Dest: Much happened, but the ending of the story is this: Azurah tore the Dark Heart from Lorkhaj and threw it back into the Void, freeing Lorkhaj.

String.Source: But just as Lorkhaj's place in the Void made him vulnerable to the Dark Heart, so too are all Khajiit susceptible to the Bent Dance.
String.Dest: But just as Lorkhaj's place in the Void made him vulnerable to the Dark Heart, so too are all Khajiit susceptible to the Bent Dance.

String.Source: Ah, yes. This one became distracted by storytelling.
String.Dest: Ah, yes. This one became distracted by storytelling.

String.Source: The Dark Heart itself was a Daedric Artifact of Namiira, buried deep below Skyrim.
String.Dest: The Dark Heart itself was a Daedric Artifact of Namiira, buried deep below Skyrim.

String.Source: In the Second Era, an evil army called the Gray Host tried to awaken it by sacrificing all souls in the Reach.
String.Dest: In the Second Era, an evil army called the Gray Host tried to awaken it by sacrificing all souls in the Reach.

String.Source: They failed, of course, and the Dark Heart disappeared. But whispers of its power still fill the Reach.
String.Dest: They failed, of course, and the Dark Heart disappeared. But whispers of its power still fill the Reach.

String.Source: That is why this place is both valuable and dangerous to Khajiit. The echoes of the Great Darkness let us grow closer to Lorkhaj, but...
String.Dest: That is why this place is both valuable and dangerous to Khajiit. The echoes of the Great Darkness let us grow closer to Lorkhaj, but...

String.Source: We must be cautious not to begin to dance to those echoes, or our souls will pass by Lorkhaj and fall instead to Namiira.
String.Dest: We must be cautious not to begin to dance to those echoes, or our souls will pass by Lorkhaj and fall instead to Namiira.

String.Source: Which one? We've got a lot going on.
String.Dest: Which one? We've got a lot going on.

String.Source: Yeah. I definitely feel stronger.
String.Dest: Yeah. I definitely feel stronger.

String.Source: Ah, Rootwatch. Yes, I know of it.
String.Dest: Ah, Rootwatch. Yes, I know of it.

String.Source: It was once a xanmeer, but a visiting scholar took it as a home. They lived there many years.
String.Dest: It was once a xanmeer, but a visiting scholar took it as a home. They lived there many years.

String.Source: Before they departed, they assured us that any evil had been purged from Rootwatch, and it was safe for any to live in.
String.Dest: Before they departed, they assured us that any evil had been purged from Rootwatch, and it was safe for any to live in.

String.Source: Most Saxhleel have no desire to live in a stone nest, however. Even I would not want one as a home.
String.Dest: Most Saxhleel have no desire to live in a stone nest, however. Even I would not want one as a home.

String.Source: And so it was left abandoned. The door was kept locked to ensure no monsters could enter... though some Voriplasms may have gone in.
String.Dest: And so it was left abandoned. The door was kept locked to ensure no monsters could enter... though some Voriplasms may have gone in.

String.Source: If it wishes to explore, I have the key. But I will need some time to find where I put it...
String.Dest: If it wishes to explore, I have the key. But I will need some time to find where I put it...

String.Source: While it waits, perhaps it could help me?
String.Dest: While it waits, perhaps it could help me?

String.Source: There is a strange idol in the depths of the Haj-Taeed xanmeer. The drowned flock to it.
String.Dest: There is a strange idol in the depths of the Haj-Taeed xanmeer. The drowned flock to it.

String.Source: Normally, I would study it, but if it draws the drowned, it is too dangerous.
String.Dest: Normally, I would study it, but if it draws the drowned, it is too dangerous.

String.Source: I ask that it destroy the idol.
String.Dest: I ask that it destroy the idol.

String.Source: Damnit, nothing's hurting her!
String.Dest: Damnit, nothing's hurting her!

String.Source: We need to regroup! Head for that hole in the wall!
String.Dest: We need to regroup! Head for that hole in the wall!

String.Source: You... You fiend! You lied!
String.Dest: You... You fiend! You lied!

String.Source: You swore! You swore you'd not prevent us from serving the Hist!
String.Dest: You swore! You swore you'd not prevent us from serving the Hist!

String.Source: I told no lie. You will serve the Hist... as fertilizer.
String.Dest: I told no lie. You will serve the Hist... as fertilizer.

String.Source: Agk...
String.Dest: Agk...

String.Source: Many times, in the past. People seeking power, curious scholars, those devoted to the worship of the Blood... but none succeeded.
String.Dest: Many times, in the past. People seeking power, curious scholars, those devoted to the worship of the Blood... but none succeeded.

String.Source: All perished or disappeared before the fifth bell could ring.
String.Dest: All perished or disappeared before the fifth bell could ring.

String.Source: It's part of the protective spell. All five must ring within the same short period of time.
String.Dest: It's part of the protective spell. All five must ring within the same short period of time.

String.Source: I confess I don't know exactly how long may pass before the spell, for lack of a better word, "resets." Only that a limit exists.
String.Dest: I confess I don't know exactly how long may pass before the spell, for lack of a better word, "resets." Only that a limit exists.

String.Source: I heard it. You have rung the first bell!
String.Dest: I heard it. You have rung the first bell!

String.Source: Two bells rung. Please, you must hurry and find the third. We're all counting on you.
String.Dest: Two bells rung. Please, you must hurry and find the third. We're all counting on you.

String.Source: I heard the ringing. Dare I hope? Have you done all three?
String.Dest: I heard the ringing. Dare I hope? Have you done all three?

String.Source: Bloodstains... None of the miners seemed injured, did they?
String.Dest: Bloodstains... None of the miners seemed injured, did they?

String.Source: Maybe this dripped off the Meat as the thief carried it off...
String.Dest: Maybe this dripped off the Meat as the thief carried it off...

String.Source: Following a blood trail into a spooky cave. You do know how to have fun.
String.Dest: Following a blood trail into a spooky cave. You do know how to have fun.

String.Source: Xuth! Another beast released from below the xanmeers, no doubt.
String.Dest: Xuth! Another beast released from below the xanmeers, no doubt.

String.Source: We're already short on Meat. We can't keep losing it like this.
String.Dest: We're already short on Meat. We can't keep losing it like this.

String.Source: Khh. It did what it could. Here's its pay, as promised.
String.Dest: Khh. It did what it could. Here's its pay, as promised.

String.Source: What the- how did we end up back here?
String.Dest: What the- how did we end up back here?

String.Source: Well... That was the last bell. The barrier around the Palace should be down now.
String.Dest: Well... That was the last bell. The barrier around the Palace should be down now.

String.Source: Excellent! Which did you bring?
String.Dest: Excellent! Which did you bring?

String.Source: Marvelous. Thank you, friend. These will be very helpful.
String.Dest: Marvelous. Thank you, friend. These will be very helpful.

String.Source: Thank you, friend. With your help, the village may yet survive.
String.Dest: Thank you, friend. With your help, the village may yet survive.

String.Source: Why would you have? They're even more distant from Nirn than most of the daedra are.
String.Dest: Why would you have? They're even more distant from Nirn than most of the daedra are.

String.Source: You don't hear about the Void Spirits for the same reason you don't hear about Magna-Ge politics or tax policies in the Adjacent Place.
String.Dest: You don't hear about the Void Spirits for the same reason you don't hear about Magna-Ge politics or tax policies in the Adjacent Place.

String.Source: Even the spirits like Kalarix that do take an interest in Nirn can only interact with it through special planes like the Old Lands.
String.Dest: Even the spirits like Kalarix that do take an interest in Nirn can only interact with it through special planes like the Old Lands.

String.Source: Hm?! These are...
String.Dest: Hm?! These are...

String.Source: My friend, this is astonishing! A long-forgotten outpost of the Cronvangr, dating back to ancient times!
String.Dest: My friend, this is astonishing! A long-forgotten outpost of the Cronvangr, dating back to ancient times!

String.Source: I will have these copied and preserved at once. You may keep the originals - as thanks for helping recover our heritage.
String.Dest: I will have these copied and preserved at once. You may keep the originals - as thanks for helping recover our heritage.

String.Source: These... these are writings from our ancient past!
String.Dest: These... these are writings from our ancient past!

String.Source: It seems to be missing some pages, though... If you can find all the pages, I will have them preserved for the future.
String.Dest: It seems to be missing some pages, though... If you can find all the pages, I will have them preserved for the future.

String.Source: We need to locate that stolen scepter - meaning we need to locate Kheereth-Lah.
String.Dest: We need to locate that stolen scepter - meaning we need to locate Kheereth-Lah.

String.Source: Ask around the Meat Mines. One of the miners must have seen him.
String.Dest: Ask around the Meat Mines. One of the miners must have seen him.

String.Source: I need to do more research - find a way to seal the scepter's power once you recover it.
String.Dest: I need to do more research - find a way to seal the scepter's power once you recover it.

String.Source: More than you might expect, walker. Within the village, everything is bartered, but we have lots of trade with Skyrim.
String.Dest: More than you might expect, walker. Within the village, everything is bartered, but we have lots of trade with Skyrim.

String.Source: Many of the trading caravans have special deals with this one. Supplies we can't get here in return for the special materials native to this land.
String.Dest: Many of the trading caravans have special deals with this one. Supplies we can't get here in return for the special materials native to this land.

String.Source: There may not be many who know of us, but those who do take full advantage. This one is never short of supplies.
String.Dest: There may not be many who know of us, but those who do take full advantage. This one is never short of supplies.

String.Source: Traders from Skyrim, mainly. Sometimes a traveling mage.
String.Dest: Traders from Skyrim, mainly. Sometimes a traveling mage.

String.Source: Everyone in this realm has their own home already. The villagers may gather here in the evenings to socialize, but they have no use for an inn.
String.Dest: Everyone in this realm has their own home already. The villagers may gather here in the evenings to socialize, but they have no use for an inn.

String.Source: And the village is too dry for the miners' comfort, so they rarely spend the night. So this one rarely rents rooms.
String.Dest: And the village is too dry for the miners' comfort, so they rarely spend the night. So this one rarely rents rooms.

String.Source: Not much, no. The Church lacks the influence it once had.
String.Dest: Not much, no. The Church lacks the influence it once had.

String.Source: In decades past, the Church could be said to rule this land. But now? If not for the Church's Blood supply, most would have abandoned it already.
String.Dest: In decades past, the Church could be said to rule this land. But now? If not for the Church's Blood supply, most would have abandoned it already.

String.Source: This one has various items. Perhaps some will be of interest.
String.Dest: This one has various items. Perhaps some will be of interest.

String.Source: This one has many wares. Something will surely be of interest.
String.Dest: This one has many wares. Something will surely be of interest.

String.Source: Hm. This one is not certain how to answer that.
String.Dest: Hm. This one is not certain how to answer that.

String.Source: There is little affection between the groups, but little hostility either. Both groups generally keep to themselves.
String.Dest: There is little affection between the groups, but little hostility either. Both groups generally keep to themselves.

String.Source: It may as well be a Daedric cult... except the ones running it are as fooled as the rest of its victims.
String.Dest: It may as well be a Daedric cult... except the ones running it are as fooled as the rest of its victims.

String.Source: It plays on the beliefs of other cultures, mixing warped versions of Reachfolk and Khajiit superstitions - among others - to control its adherents.
String.Dest: It plays on the beliefs of other cultures, mixing warped versions of Reachfolk and Khajiit superstitions - among others - to control its adherents.

String.Source: Normally, Vigil procedure would be to simply eliminate the leadership, but in this case, that would be ill-advised.
String.Dest: Normally, Vigil procedure would be to simply eliminate the leadership, but in this case, that would be ill-advised.

String.Source: It's a self-sustaining machine. Until we can safely cure the locals of their reliance on the Old Blood, we need the Church to keep them alive.
String.Dest: It's a self-sustaining machine. Until we can safely cure the locals of their reliance on the Old Blood, we need the Church to keep them alive.

String.Source: It's the primary source of the Old Blood, so those of us in the village have no choice but to rely on the Priestess.
String.Dest: It's the primary source of the Old Blood, so those of us in the village have no choice but to rely on the Priestess.

String.Source: With the Blood drying up, though... I fear she's given in to paranoia. She suspects us all of plotting to steal her stockpiled Blood.
String.Dest: With the Blood drying up, though... I fear she's given in to paranoia. She suspects us all of plotting to steal her stockpiled Blood.

String.Source: I fear what may happen if the situation escalates.
String.Dest: I fear what may happen if the situation escalates.

String.Source: The Church is in disarray, but we lack an alternative. Hopefully, the new Priestess can manage things better than her predecessor...
String.Dest: The Church is in disarray, but we lack an alternative. Hopefully, the new Priestess can manage things better than her predecessor...

String.Source: It's good that the Priestess opened some of her stockpiles now that the Meat shortage is resolved, but it's only a temporary measure.
String.Dest: It's good that the Priestess opened some of her stockpiles now that the Meat shortage is resolved, but it's only a temporary measure.

String.Source: Still, if a new source of Blood isn't found - or the current reliance on the Blood isn't resolved - tensions will inevitably arise again.
String.Dest: Still, if a new source of Blood isn't found - or the current reliance on the Blood isn't resolved - tensions will inevitably arise again.

String.Source: With the Hist dead, the Church will naturally fade in time.
String.Dest: With the Hist dead, the Church will naturally fade in time.

String.Source: The stockpiled "Blood" remaining will help keep the villagers from succumbing to madness until everyone can be treated for Hist sap addiction.
String.Dest: The stockpiled "Blood" remaining will help keep the villagers from succumbing to madness until everyone can be treated for Hist sap addiction.

String.Source: Stay moist.
String.Dest: Stay moist.

String.Source: May friendly branches shade its path.
String.Dest: May friendly branches shade its path.

String.Source: May the Roots embrace it.
String.Dest: May the Roots embrace it.

String.Source: I raise the hand of farewell.
String.Dest: I raise the hand of farewell.

String.Source: May its scales keep their shine.
String.Dest: May its scales keep their shine.

String.Source: Go well along the river.
String.Dest: Go well along the river.

String.Source: Mines be open to it.
String.Dest: Mines be open to it.

String.Source: Mmhmm.
String.Dest: Mmhmm.

String.Source: Stay safe. Outsiders can make neither tails nor scales of these mines.
String.Dest: Stay safe. Outsiders can make neither tails nor scales of these mines.

String.Source: This is the head of a Voskrona. The living statues that guard the xanmeers.
String.Dest: This is the head of a Voskrona. The living statues that guard the xanmeers.

String.Source: I do much of my work on high cliffs. Sometimes I fall. The helmet helps protect me.
String.Dest: I do much of my work on high cliffs. Sometimes I fall. The helmet helps protect me.

String.Source: It is important to protect my head. That is where I store my jokes!
String.Dest: It is important to protect my head. That is where I store my jokes!

String.Source: Aside from helping Anagach?
String.Dest: Aside from helping Anagach?

String.Source: I buy and sell rare minerals.
String.Dest: I buy and sell rare minerals.

String.Source: I was born to the Deep-Hill Clan. The traditions of that clan place great value on stones.
String.Dest: I was born to the Deep-Hill Clan. The traditions of that clan place great value on stones.

String.Source: All who grow up among the Deep-Hill people are taught the mysteries of the stones. To identify minerals - and how to put them to use.
String.Dest: All who grow up among the Deep-Hill people are taught the mysteries of the stones. To identify minerals - and how to put them to use.

String.Source: I came to the Old Lands after marrying Anagach. The ores of this realm are unlike any you could find on Nirn.
String.Dest: I came to the Old Lands after marrying Anagach. The ores of this realm are unlike any you could find on Nirn.

String.Source: I buy and sell rare minerals.
String.Dest: I buy and sell rare minerals.

String.Source: Let me know if anything strikes your fancy. I've got things for sale you won't find elsewhere.
String.Dest: Let me know if anything strikes your fancy. I've got things for sale you won't find elsewhere.

String.Source: The traditions of the Reach tell us that life is hard and unforgiving, but that surviving the suffering teaches and uplifts us.
String.Dest: The traditions of the Reach tell us that life is hard and unforgiving, but that surviving the suffering teaches and uplifts us.

String.Source: The Old Lands are a fitting reflection of that. We face monsters and demons. We become reliant on the Old Blood and risk the Dryblood curse.
String.Dest: The Old Lands are a fitting reflection of that. We face monsters and demons. We become reliant on the Old Blood and risk the Dryblood curse.

String.Source: But, in turn, we receive the blessings of ancient magic and rare materials. As a daughter of the Reach, I find this a fitting life.
String.Dest: But, in turn, we receive the blessings of ancient magic and rare materials. As a daughter of the Reach, I find this a fitting life.

String.Source: The land isn't made of natural materials, the way Nirn is. The fact that the Argonians can dig Meat from the swamp is proof enough of that.
String.Dest: The land isn't made of natural materials, the way Nirn is. The fact that the Argonians can dig Meat from the swamp is proof enough of that.

String.Source: The Old Lands are something between Nirn and an Oblivion plane. That affects the ores and minerals found here as well.
String.Dest: The Old Lands are something between Nirn and an Oblivion plane. That affects the ores and minerals found here as well.

String.Source: Along with being useful for smithing, the nature of the ore makes it valuable to mages. I sell many gems to the College of Winterhold.
String.Dest: Along with being useful for smithing, the nature of the ore makes it valuable to mages. I sell many gems to the College of Winterhold.

String.Source: Ha! Saving my husband's life not enough heroics for you?
String.Dest: Ha! Saving my husband's life not enough heroics for you?

String.Source: I knew I liked you, friend. I won't turn down an offer of help.
String.Dest: I knew I liked you, friend. I won't turn down an offer of help.

String.Source: There's a special day coming up - the twentieth anniversary of the day Anagach and I were wed.
String.Dest: There's a special day coming up - the twentieth anniversary of the day Anagach and I were wed.

String.Source: I'd like to prepare a special gift for him. A ring made in the style of his clan, the Cloud-Hawks.
String.Dest: I'd like to prepare a special gift for him. A ring made in the style of his clan, the Cloud-Hawks.

String.Source: I have most of what I need, but I'm short one piece - the ore itself.
String.Dest: I have most of what I need, but I'm short one piece - the ore itself.

String.Source: There's a very special type of dried Old Blood that's suitable for jewelry, but it's hard to get - and what we have is reserved for customers.
String.Dest: There's a very special type of dried Old Blood that's suitable for jewelry, but it's hard to get - and what we have is reserved for customers.

String.Source: There's a cave to the south of the village - Varnauch Mine. It's one of the few places you can reliably find the ore.
String.Dest: There's a cave to the south of the village - Varnauch Mine. It's one of the few places you can reliably find the ore.

String.Source: Ah, you could tell from my expression?
String.Dest: Ah, you could tell from my expression?

String.Source: Well, I can't deny that I'm troubled.
String.Dest: Well, I can't deny that I'm troubled.

String.Source: We may have dealt with the Quarra and Cronvangr, but the threat of the Vampyrum Order lingers... and now another problem has arisen.
String.Dest: We may have dealt with the Quarra and Cronvangr, but the threat of the Vampyrum Order lingers... and now another problem has arisen.

String.Source: We're already busy with the vampire threat, and now we have another matter to deal with.
String.Dest: We're already busy with the vampire threat, and now we have another matter to deal with.

String.Source: I've received a report from an undercover Vigilant requesting help, and I think you're the best candidate for the task.
String.Dest: I've received a report from an undercover Vigilant requesting help, and I think you're the best candidate for the task.

String.Source: It involves a potential threat we've been monitoring since we learned of it almost a century ago.
String.Dest: It involves a potential threat we've been monitoring since we learned of it almost a century ago.

String.Source: The details are generally restricted to Keepers, but the situation seems to have taken a worrying turn.
String.Dest: The details are generally restricted to Keepers, but the situation seems to have taken a worrying turn.

String.Source: Our agent can explain the situation better than I can. Head to Twisted Root Cave, at the base of Karthspire.
String.Dest: Our agent can explain the situation better than I can. Head to Twisted Root Cave, at the base of Karthspire.

String.Source: You'll understand the situation when you get through the cave.
String.Dest: You'll understand the situation when you get through the cave.

String.Source: I'm not your servant, so no.
String.Dest: I'm not your servant, so no.

String.Source: Sure, whatcha got?
String.Dest: Sure, whatcha got?

String.Source: Anything you need, my love.
String.Dest: Anything you need, my love.

String.Source: Ah, excellent. I'll read it now.
String.Dest: Ah, excellent. I'll read it now.

String.Source: Oh!
String.Dest: Oh!

String.Source: Marvelous! You are truly amazing, my friend.
String.Dest: Marvelous! You are truly amazing, my friend.

String.Source: The details of what you've done may never be revealed to the public, but you and I will always know. You've averted a potential disaster.
String.Dest: The details of what you've done may never be revealed to the public, but you and I will always know. You've averted a potential disaster.

String.Source: Skyrim is lucky to have you. As am I.
String.Dest: Skyrim is lucky to have you. As am I.

String.Source: My business here will likely last another decade at least. I must help cure those addicted to the sap and stop the Old Blood cult from reviving.
String.Dest: My business here will likely last another decade at least. I must help cure those addicted to the sap and stop the Old Blood cult from reviving.

String.Source: But, for now, there is only one thing left for you to do: reporting this matter to Ciirta!
String.Dest: But, for now, there is only one thing left for you to do: reporting this matter to Ciirta!

String.Source: I've written up a report on everything that happened here. I imagine Ciirta will want to reward you personally.
String.Dest: I've written up a report on everything that happened here. I imagine Ciirta will want to reward you personally.

String.Source: What's this? A mortal?
String.Dest: What's this? A mortal?

String.Source: Well, mortal... step forward. The Writhing Mother would speak to you.
String.Dest: Well, mortal... step forward. The Writhing Mother would speak to you.

String.Source: It's been quite some time since a mortal's visited my shrine.
String.Dest: It's been quite some time since a mortal's visited my shrine.

String.Source: You may approach, mortal.
String.Dest: You may approach, mortal.

String.Source: Welcome back, mortal.
String.Dest: Welcome back, mortal.

String.Source: I am Kalarix Brood, Lord of All Parasites.
String.Dest: I am Kalarix Brood, Lord of All Parasites.

String.Source: I serve no one, mortal.
String.Dest: I serve no one, mortal.

String.Source: Namira and I merely have... similar tastes.
String.Dest: Namira and I merely have... similar tastes.

String.Source: She appreciates my adorable children.
String.Dest: She appreciates my adorable children.

String.Source: You have such... limited imagination. There are more realms than merely Oblivion and Aetherius.
String.Dest: You have such... limited imagination. There are more realms than merely Oblivion and Aetherius.

String.Source: I am a daughter of the Void.
String.Dest: I am a daughter of the Void.

String.Source: Sadly, I cannot manifest in the Aurbis in my true form. It's only thanks to Namira that I can pass through the barriers at all.
String.Dest: Sadly, I cannot manifest in the Aurbis in my true form. It's only thanks to Namira that I can pass through the barriers at all.

String.Source: Did I not say already?
String.Dest: Did I not say already?

String.Source: I am the mother of all that writhes within flesh. The source of all parasites.
String.Dest: I am the mother of all that writhes within flesh. The source of all parasites.

String.Source: Namira has graciously provided me space within her realm to serve as a breeding ground for my children.
String.Dest: Namira has graciously provided me space within her realm to serve as a breeding ground for my children.

String.Source: Even so... My children cannot stay with me forever. They must find their own homes.
String.Dest: Even so... My children cannot stay with me forever. They must find their own homes.

String.Source: Thus, my task for you.
String.Dest: Thus, my task for you.

String.Source: Take these eggs. Infiltrate the finest kitchens and pantries in Skyrim. Hide the eggs within the jarls' meals. Let them host my children.
String.Dest: Take these eggs. Infiltrate the finest kitchens and pantries in Skyrim. Hide the eggs within the jarls' meals. Let them host my children.

String.Source: Do this, and you shall be rewarded.
String.Dest: Do this, and you shall be rewarded.

String.Source: Murder? Do you make a habit of burning down your home, mortal?
String.Dest: Murder? Do you make a habit of burning down your home, mortal?

String.Source: My children will not kill their hosts. Merely... feed a bit.
String.Dest: My children will not kill their hosts. Merely... feed a bit.

String.Source: There may be some... illnesses, but nothing fatal.
String.Dest: There may be some... illnesses, but nothing fatal.

String.Source: Besides. If you refuse... you will host my children instead.
String.Dest: Besides. If you refuse... you will host my children instead.

String.Source: Of course you will. Return here once the task is done, and I will grant you my boon.
String.Dest: Of course you will. Return here once the task is done, and I will grant you my boon.

String.Source: Do you now? Quite unwise, mortal.
String.Dest: Do you now? Quite unwise, mortal.

String.Source: Very well, then. I will permit you to keep the eggs... I have an endless supply.
String.Dest: Very well, then. I will permit you to keep the eggs... I have an endless supply.

String.Source: When you come to your senses, use the eggs to perform the task.
String.Dest: When you come to your senses, use the eggs to perform the task.

String.Source: Do so and you will be rewarded. Until then... Be cautious what you ingest, lest my children make you suffer for your disobedience.
String.Dest: Do so and you will be rewarded. Until then... Be cautious what you ingest, lest my children make you suffer for your disobedience.

String.Source: The Old Blood alone can't sustain us. Its magic is too powerful - it would destroy the mind of someone who consumed too much.
String.Dest: The Old Blood alone can't sustain us. Its magic is too powerful - it would destroy the mind of someone who consumed too much.

String.Source: To tide us over between ministrations, we rely on the Meat. Sacred flesh dug up from the ruins below the swamp.
String.Dest: To tide us over between ministrations, we rely on the Meat. Sacred flesh dug up from the ruins below the swamp.

String.Source: The Bloodroots have run through those ruins for eons. The Meat has been soaked in the Blood, so eating it acts as a weaker substitute.
String.Dest: The Bloodroots have run through those ruins for eons. The Meat has been soaked in the Blood, so eating it acts as a weaker substitute.

String.Source: With the Bloodroots drying up, we're forced to rely even more on the Meat.
String.Dest: With the Bloodroots drying up, we're forced to rely even more on the Meat.

String.Source: The caretakers of the Old Blood. They're in charge of making sure everyone has plenty and ensuring it's administered properly.
String.Dest: The caretakers of the Old Blood. They're in charge of making sure everyone has plenty and ensuring it's administered properly.

String.Source: Of course, with the Blood drying out, they're quickly losing their purpose.
String.Dest: Of course, with the Blood drying out, they're quickly losing their purpose.

String.Source: Long ago, a Khajiit cult came here from Elsweyr. They thought the Old Blood would help elevate them to their "true forms," whatever that meant.
String.Dest: Long ago, a Khajiit cult came here from Elsweyr. They thought the Old Blood would help elevate them to their "true forms," whatever that meant.

String.Source: Instead, most of them became dro-m'Athra - a kind of Khajiit daedra. Their city fell to ruins, and the survivors fled to the village.
String.Dest: Instead, most of them became dro-m'Athra - a kind of Khajiit daedra. Their city fell to ruins, and the survivors fled to the village.

String.Source: Most of the Khajiit who live in the village now are descended from that ancient cult, though some newcomers still arrive from Elsweyr.
String.Dest: Most of the Khajiit who live in the village now are descended from that ancient cult, though some newcomers still arrive from Elsweyr.

String.Source: Very little. Nobody in the village dares venture in.
String.Dest: Very little. Nobody in the village dares venture in.

String.Source: It's haunted. Monsters from the Void, undead beasts, all manner of things.
String.Dest: It's haunted. Monsters from the Void, undead beasts, all manner of things.

String.Source: Most come from the Hollow Palace, but smaller Ayleid ruins are scattered throughout the forest. The monsters come from those as well.
String.Dest: Most come from the Hollow Palace, but smaller Ayleid ruins are scattered throughout the forest. The monsters come from those as well.

String.Source: Before we leave, we should probably make sure we tell Thorntaker about the Hist so he knows how to treat the villagers.
String.Dest: Before we leave, we should probably make sure we tell Thorntaker about the Hist so he knows how to treat the villagers.

String.Source: Might want to tell the lady at the Church and the Mines overseer, too.
String.Dest: Might want to tell the lady at the Church and the Mines overseer, too.

String.Source: Before we leave, we should probably make sure we tell the village healer about the Hist so he knows how to treat the villagers.
String.Dest: Before we leave, we should probably make sure we tell the village healer about the Hist so he knows how to treat the villagers.

String.Source: Might want to tell the lady at the Church and the Mines overseer, too.
String.Dest: Might want to tell the lady at the Church and the Mines overseer, too.

String.Source: This is the garb worn by the dro-m'Athra. This one took it from them as trophies of battle.
String.Dest: This is the garb worn by the dro-m'Athra. This one took it from them as trophies of battle.

String.Source: And this one wears it much more nicely than those Bent Cats, no?
String.Dest: And this one wears it much more nicely than those Bent Cats, no?

String.Source: Yeah, I definitely feel stronger.
String.Dest: Yeah, I definitely feel stronger.

String.Source: Many of these portals date back to the Merethic Era. And, unfortunately, most of them are impossible to close.
String.Dest: Many of these portals date back to the Merethic Era. And, unfortunately, most of them are impossible to close.

String.Source: Martin Septim's sacrifice strengthened the barriers, but there are exceptions. Existing portals were often unaffected.
String.Dest: Martin Septim's sacrifice strengthened the barriers, but there are exceptions. Existing portals were often unaffected.

String.Source: Moreover, most of these portals are currently inactive. If we try to seal them, we risk stirring the ire of those on the other sides.
String.Dest: Moreover, most of these portals are currently inactive. If we try to seal them, we risk stirring the ire of those on the other sides.

String.Source: Think of it like the situation at Red Scar Cavern - with no way to close the portals, all we can do is guard the exits.
String.Dest: Think of it like the situation at Red Scar Cavern - with no way to close the portals, all we can do is guard the exits.

String.Source: Thankfully, most of the known portals haven't stirred in centuries, and the older tribes keep a close watch on them as well.
String.Dest: Thankfully, most of the known portals haven't stirred in centuries, and the older tribes keep a close watch on them as well.

String.Source: The Old Lands themselves only became a true threat recently, with the rising numbers of Drybloods and monsters.
String.Dest: The Old Lands themselves only became a true threat recently, with the rising numbers of Drybloods and monsters.

String.Source: Unless the realms on the other side of those portals pose an imminent danger - as the Old Lands do - it's better to leave them be.
String.Dest: Unless the realms on the other side of those portals pose an imminent danger - as the Old Lands do - it's better to leave them be.

String.Source: Indeed, we didn't consider the Old Lands an imminent threat until recently, either. But with the rise in Drybloods, not to mention other monsters...
String.Dest: Indeed, we didn't consider the Old Lands an imminent threat until recently, either. But with the rise in Drybloods, not to mention other monsters...

String.Source: Well, you see the result. The situation in the Old Lands warranted intervention.
String.Dest: Well, you see the result. The situation in the Old Lands warranted intervention.

String.Source: You thought you could sneak in and steal the Blood?
String.Dest: You thought you could sneak in and steal the Blood?

String.Source: Tch... Fine. This one will not blame you for their laziness.
String.Dest: Tch... Fine. This one will not blame you for their laziness.

String.Source: Here. Ring the bell and begone.
String.Dest: Here. Ring the bell and begone.

String.Source: And that excuses your attempt to break in?! You are no better than those lizards.
String.Dest: And that excuses your attempt to break in?! You are no better than those lizards.

String.Source: This one will not be threatened!
String.Dest: This one will not be threatened!

String.Source: Once you die, those failures from the mines are next!
String.Dest: Once you die, those failures from the mines are next!

String.Source: Zenkali-Dra became convinced the miners were going to attack the church... She barricaded us inside.
String.Dest: Zenkali-Dra became convinced the miners were going to attack the church... She barricaded us inside.

String.Source: When I tried to talk her out of it, she threw me into my room and locked the door.
String.Dest: When I tried to talk her out of it, she threw me into my room and locked the door.

String.Source: Her paranoia... She was turning dryblood, wasn't she?
String.Dest: Her paranoia... She was turning dryblood, wasn't she?

String.Source: I know. I don't blame you. It... It was a mercy.
String.Dest: I know. I don't blame you. It... It was a mercy.

String.Source: Thank you. I'll... see what I can do. If she's still reasonable, it might not be too late.
String.Dest: Thank you. I'll... see what I can do. If she's still reasonable, it might not be too late.

String.Source: Khh... I walk all the way here, and that church harlot locks the door when she sees me!
String.Dest: Khh... I walk all the way here, and that church harlot locks the door when she sees me!

String.Source: Ore, gems, all the gifts of the earth.
String.Dest: Ore, gems, all the gifts of the earth.

String.Source: It's a family craft. Kelsrah may have been born in Tamriel, but I was born and raised here in the Old Lands, just as my forefathers were.
String.Dest: It's a family craft. Kelsrah may have been born in Tamriel, but I was born and raised here in the Old Lands, just as my forefathers were.

String.Source: My family has been sculpting the Old Blood for generations. One day, fate willing, Kelsrah and I will have a child to inherit that tradition.
String.Dest: My family has been sculpting the Old Blood for generations. One day, fate willing, Kelsrah and I will have a child to inherit that tradition.

String.Source: Weapons and armor, as well as some ores. If you want more, talk to Kelsrah inside.
String.Dest: Weapons and armor, as well as some ores. If you want more, talk to Kelsrah inside.

String.Source: Weapons and armor, as well as some ores.
String.Dest: Weapons and armor, as well as some ores.

String.Source: Enough to keep you alive.
String.Dest: Enough to keep you alive.

String.Source: It's rare to meet someone so eager to help strangers. You're certain it wouldn't be a bother?
String.Dest: It's rare to meet someone so eager to help strangers. You're certain it wouldn't be a bother?

String.Source: Well, if you're truly interested in some sellsword work, I'll take you up on the offer.
String.Dest: Well, if you're truly interested in some sellsword work, I'll take you up on the offer.

String.Source: When I was first learning Blood-Sculpting, I'd often hear stories of my ancestor, Hrolgarn Rockshaper.
String.Dest: When I was first learning Blood-Sculpting, I'd often hear stories of my ancestor, Hrolgarn Rockshaper.

String.Source: They say he was the first Blood-Sculptor, in service to the Hollow Princess herself. The smithing secrets passed down in my family started with him.
String.Dest: They say he was the first Blood-Sculptor, in service to the Hollow Princess herself. The smithing secrets passed down in my family started with him.

String.Source: When he died, he was buried in the cave called Blood-Pilgrim's Rest. In the old days, it was a place for travelers to stop and rest.
String.Dest: When he died, he was buried in the cave called Blood-Pilgrim's Rest. In the old days, it was a place for travelers to stop and rest.

String.Source: But these days, the whole place is abandoned and overrun with Drybloods. It pains me to think of my ancestor's grave being so dishonored.
String.Dest: But these days, the whole place is abandoned and overrun with Drybloods. It pains me to think of my ancestor's grave being so dishonored.

String.Source: Can't say I've ever lived anywhere else.
String.Dest: Can't say I've ever lived anywhere else.

String.Source: Life here is hard but rewarding. Our people are raised to accept difficulties because that is how Lorkh uplifts us.
String.Dest: Life here is hard but rewarding. Our people are raised to accept difficulties because that is how Lorkh uplifts us.

String.Source: I will say, though... It has been sad to see the decline of the village.
String.Dest: I will say, though... It has been sad to see the decline of the village.

String.Source: Since the Blood started to dry, we've lost many people to the Dryblood curse.
String.Dest: Since the Blood started to dry, we've lost many people to the Dryblood curse.

String.Source: Seeing the people I grew up alongside go mad and vanish into the desert... I can only hope we don't lose too many more.
String.Dest: Seeing the people I grew up alongside go mad and vanish into the desert... I can only hope we don't lose too many more.

String.Source: I'm captain of the guard. I do my best to defend the villagers from all the threats of this land.
String.Dest: I'm captain of the guard. I do my best to defend the villagers from all the threats of this land.

String.Source: I was part of the group that helped dig you out of Twisted Root Cave when the entrance collapsed. You got very lucky.
String.Dest: I was part of the group that helped dig you out of Twisted Root Cave when the entrance collapsed. You got very lucky.

String.Source: Say, speaking of. You don't seem to be a trader... Might you be a sellsword? The guards could use some extra help, if you're open to work.
String.Dest: Say, speaking of. You don't seem to be a trader... Might you be a sellsword? The guards could use some extra help, if you're open to work.

String.Source: This one hunts the dro-m'Athra. It is a lonely job, but necessary.
String.Dest: This one hunts the dro-m'Athra. It is a lonely job, but necessary.

String.Source: This one hunts the dro-m'Athra with his brother Ma'Jaka. We ensure the Bent Cats can cause no further harm.
String.Dest: This one hunts the dro-m'Athra with his brother Ma'Jaka. We ensure the Bent Cats can cause no further harm.

String.Source: Perhaps. Are you a hunter?
String.Dest: Perhaps. Are you a hunter?

String.Source: If so, this one could use your aid. There are three especially powerful dro-m'Athra that this one has spent several months tracking.
String.Dest: If so, this one could use your aid. There are three especially powerful dro-m'Athra that this one has spent several months tracking.

String.Source: But they always manage to escape before this one can ambush them. This one suspects they have learned his scent.
String.Dest: But they always manage to escape before this one can ambush them. This one suspects they have learned his scent.

String.Source: They have not yet learned yours. This one will mark where he last saw them. Kill them, and this one will reward you.
String.Dest: They have not yet learned yours. This one will mark where he last saw them. Kill them, and this one will reward you.

String.Source: You are a strong warrior. Let this one know whenever you seek his aid, and he will follow.
String.Dest: You are a strong warrior. Let this one know whenever you seek his aid, and he will follow.

String.Source: The Bent Cats. Khajiit twisted by Namiira, the Great Darkness.
String.Dest: The Bent Cats. Khajiit twisted by Namiira, the Great Darkness.

String.Source: They can never be truly killed. Namiira will always resurrect them eventually. But killing their mortal forms keeps the village safe for a time.
String.Dest: They can never be truly killed. Namiira will always resurrect them eventually. But killing their mortal forms keeps the village safe for a time.

String.Source: It is a trophy of battle. Taken from slain dro-m'Athra.
String.Dest: It is a trophy of battle. Taken from slain dro-m'Athra.

String.Source: Of course. We work together well.
String.Dest: Of course. We work together well.

String.Source: This one handles the fighting, and Ma'Jaka handles the talking. This is as it should be.
String.Dest: This one handles the fighting, and Ma'Jaka handles the talking. This is as it should be.

String.Source: Only the most important part of our lives.
String.Dest: Only the most important part of our lives.

String.Source: The Church is in charge of making sure everyone gets their share of Blood. Without them, we'd all be Drybloods.
String.Dest: The Church is in charge of making sure everyone gets their share of Blood. Without them, we'd all be Drybloods.

String.Source: I wonder that myself these days... There was a time we all had pure faith in the Old Blood and the Church.
String.Dest: I wonder that myself these days... There was a time we all had pure faith in the Old Blood and the Church.

String.Source: Now... I suppose we'll have to wait and see.
String.Dest: Now... I suppose we'll have to wait and see.

String.Source: No matter what happens, we still owe the Church for keeping us from becoming Drybloods when the Old Blood ran out.
String.Dest: No matter what happens, we still owe the Church for keeping us from becoming Drybloods when the Old Blood ran out.

String.Source: The Meat is the Meat. The Church doesn't teach us to question the gifts of Lorkh.
String.Dest: The Meat is the Meat. The Church doesn't teach us to question the gifts of Lorkh.

String.Source: The Old Blood flows through the Roots below the Mines and thus transforms the Meat into a substitute for the Blood.
String.Dest: The Old Blood flows through the Roots below the Mines and thus transforms the Meat into a substitute for the Blood.

String.Source: In the absence of Blood, the Meat helps stave off the Dryblood madness.
String.Dest: In the absence of Blood, the Meat helps stave off the Dryblood madness.

String.Source: I wonder that myself now. If the Blood was a lie, then what was the Meat? Was it too a trick by some dark spirit?
String.Dest: I wonder that myself now. If the Blood was a lie, then what was the Meat? Was it too a trick by some dark spirit?

String.Source: We'll need to re-examine everything we've taken as truth.
String.Dest: We'll need to re-examine everything we've taken as truth.

String.Source: Not sure. That area isn't prone to quakes.
String.Dest: Not sure. That area isn't prone to quakes.

String.Source: That cave was always filled with Bloodroots. My guess is a lot of them died all at once. Must have weakened the floor of the cave.
String.Dest: That cave was always filled with Bloodroots. My guess is a lot of them died all at once. Must have weakened the floor of the cave.

String.Source: Thankfully, we managed to clear out the rubble. But if the cave were to fully collapse, we'd be cut off from Tamriel entirely.
String.Dest: Thankfully, we managed to clear out the rubble. But if the cave were to fully collapse, we'd be cut off from Tamriel entirely.

String.Source: I'm planning to send in some guards to reinforce the cave. Set up support pillars and the like. Assuming we ever have time...
String.Dest: I'm planning to send in some guards to reinforce the cave. Set up support pillars and the like. Assuming we ever have time...

String.Source: Hm. That's concerning.
String.Dest: Hm. That's concerning.

String.Source: Did it look like the scepter was removed recently?
String.Dest: Did it look like the scepter was removed recently?

String.Source: As I feared. The recent increase in the monsters must have spurred one of their cultists to act.
String.Dest: As I feared. The recent increase in the monsters must have spurred one of their cultists to act.

String.Source: We need to narrow down the suspects... Ask the guard by the forest gate if anyone's passed by there recently.
String.Dest: We need to narrow down the suspects... Ask the guard by the forest gate if anyone's passed by there recently.

String.Source: While you do that, I'll do some research into what the missing scepter might be.
String.Dest: While you do that, I'll do some research into what the missing scepter might be.

String.Source: It seems we have our suspect, then.
String.Dest: It seems we have our suspect, then.

String.Source: We will need to act quickly - I believe I have identified the scepter, and if I am correct...
String.Dest: We will need to act quickly - I believe I have identified the scepter, and if I am correct...

String.Source: Have you heard of the Void Spirits?
String.Dest: Have you heard of the Void Spirits?

String.Source: Properly describing them is impossible, as they are definitionally beyond the bounds of reality, but in simple terms...
String.Dest: Properly describing them is impossible, as they are definitionally beyond the bounds of reality, but in simple terms...

String.Source: The Void is the chaotic Nothing that exists outside the Aurbis. The alien energies beyond even Oblivion.
String.Dest: The Void is the chaotic Nothing that exists outside the Aurbis. The alien energies beyond even Oblivion.

String.Source: Many of the entities within it would cow even a Daedric Prince, were they to enter our reality.
String.Dest: Many of the entities within it would cow even a Daedric Prince, were they to enter our reality.

String.Source: Thankfully, most entities within the Void seem unaware of our reality, and, of those that are aware, few seem to have any interest.
String.Dest: Thankfully, most entities within the Void seem unaware of our reality, and, of those that are aware, few seem to have any interest.

String.Source: There are, however, a few exceptions.
String.Dest: There are, however, a few exceptions.

String.Source: Know that what I tell you is known to very few - most orders, including the Church of Stendarr, believe that even knowing this much is dangerous.
String.Dest: Know that what I tell you is known to very few - most orders, including the Church of Stendarr, believe that even knowing this much is dangerous.

String.Source: The Psijics, the closest there are to experts in these matters, call these exceptions the "Greater Void Spirits."
String.Dest: The Psijics, the closest there are to experts in these matters, call these exceptions the "Greater Void Spirits."

String.Source: They are entities who, through one method or another, have entered the Aurbis - and, often, claimed territories within Oblivion.
String.Dest: They are entities who, through one method or another, have entered the Aurbis - and, often, claimed territories within Oblivion.

String.Source: Of the Greater Spirits, there are a few whose interest in Mundus is especially dangerous.
String.Dest: Of the Greater Spirits, there are a few whose interest in Mundus is especially dangerous.

String.Source: Millamaste the Golden. Tellijih the Silent. Likirani the Radiant. Zelondra Quush, the Corruptor.
String.Dest: Millamaste the Golden. Tellijih the Silent. Likirani the Radiant. Zelondra Quush, the Corruptor.

String.Source: And I believe the stolen scepter is an artifact of Quush.
String.Dest: And I believe the stolen scepter is an artifact of Quush.

String.Source: I'm sworn to secrecy on the details, but suffice to say I am acquainted with a member of the Psijic Order.
String.Dest: I'm sworn to secrecy on the details, but suffice to say I am acquainted with a member of the Psijic Order.

String.Source: In my youth, I made a grave mistake while investigating the older ruins in the Reach. If not for my friend in the Order, my whole clan would be dead.
String.Dest: In my youth, I made a grave mistake while investigating the older ruins in the Reach. If not for my friend in the Order, my whole clan would be dead.

String.Source: The Psijics value their secrets - and my friend believes that speaking too much of the Void grants the entities further access to Nirn.
String.Dest: The Psijics value their secrets - and my friend believes that speaking too much of the Void grants the entities further access to Nirn.

String.Source: As such, I must ask that you trust the information I've found and understand why I cannot share more.
String.Dest: As such, I must ask that you trust the information I've found and understand why I cannot share more.

String.Source: What matters now is that this scepter poses a threat. We must stop Kheereth-Lah before he can use it.
String.Dest: What matters now is that this scepter poses a threat. We must stop Kheereth-Lah before he can use it.

String.Source: Thank the Eight. Who knows what he might have unleashed had you not intervened.
String.Dest: Thank the Eight. Who knows what he might have unleashed had you not intervened.

String.Source: But we are left with one problem: how to dispose of the scepter.
String.Dest: But we are left with one problem: how to dispose of the scepter.

String.Source: I've found a ritual that may be able to banish it back to the Void, at least for a time, but if the ritual fails, we risk reprisal.
String.Dest: I've found a ritual that may be able to banish it back to the Void, at least for a time, but if the ritual fails, we risk reprisal.

String.Source: We could also seal it back in Angawyll. Whatever spells the Ayleids placed there seem to have kept it contained until now.
String.Dest: We could also seal it back in Angawyll. Whatever spells the Ayleids placed there seem to have kept it contained until now.

String.Source: What do you think? Shall we seal it or destroy it?
String.Dest: What do you think? Shall we seal it or destroy it?

String.Source: That seems safest, I agree. Let us hope the Ayleid wards retain their power.
String.Dest: That seems safest, I agree. Let us hope the Ayleid wards retain their power.

String.Source: Very well. Follow me - I have set up the necessary preparations.
String.Dest: Very well. Follow me - I have set up the necessary preparations.

String.Source: I don't think that's wise. The scepter has a powerful influence - prolonged exposure risks corrupting you as well.
String.Dest: I don't think that's wise. The scepter has a powerful influence - prolonged exposure risks corrupting you as well.

String.Source: A wise decision. Let us hope the Ayleid wards can still contain it.
String.Dest: A wise decision. Let us hope the Ayleid wards can still contain it.

String.Source: Aim, and... hup!
String.Dest: Aim, and... hup!

String.Source: And there it is. In we go!
String.Dest: And there it is. In we go!

String.Source: You got it.
String.Dest: You got it.

String.Source: Farewell for now, mortal. I will be watching you with great interest.
String.Dest: Farewell for now, mortal. I will be watching you with great interest.

String.Source: Foolish Vessel! Did you think I wouldn't sense your betrayal? I created you!
String.Dest: Foolish Vessel! Did you think I wouldn't sense your betrayal? I created you!

String.Source: You sure did. How's that working out for you?
String.Dest: You sure did. How's that working out for you?

String.Source: Riften is such a wonderful place. The stagnant canal is a perfect home for my children.
String.Dest: Riften is such a wonderful place. The stagnant canal is a perfect home for my children.

String.Source: The Nords of Windhelm are quite hardy... they can host a great many young.
String.Dest: The Nords of Windhelm are quite hardy... they can host a great many young.

String.Source: Winterhold is far too cold... my children will need to be strong to survive here.
String.Dest: Winterhold is far too cold... my children will need to be strong to survive here.

String.Source: Ah, Markarth... Namira's city already hums with the energy of the Void. My children will thrive here.
String.Dest: Ah, Markarth... Namira's city already hums with the energy of the Void. My children will thrive here.

String.Source: Falkreath, town of the dead... Yes, my children will like it here. Much flesh to infest.
String.Dest: Falkreath, town of the dead... Yes, my children will like it here. Much flesh to infest.

String.Source: I sense the influence of another power here... If it seeks to interfere with my children, I will take action.
String.Dest: I sense the influence of another power here... If it seeks to interfere with my children, I will take action.

String.Source: Behind the door...? Heh, you needn't worry. Our goals are in alignment, Web-Spinner.
String.Dest: Behind the door...? Heh, you needn't worry. Our goals are in alignment, Web-Spinner.

String.Source: I sense... Ah, the Mad Prince. My elder sister is quite fond of you... Perhaps I'll visit the Isles myself.
String.Dest: I sense... Ah, the Mad Prince. My elder sister is quite fond of you... Perhaps I'll visit the Isles myself.

String.Source: Swamps are the ideal home for my children. They will thrive here.
String.Dest: Swamps are the ideal home for my children. They will thrive here.

String.Source: Well done, mortal. That was the last set of eggs. Return to my shrine... I will reward your service.
String.Dest: Well done, mortal. That was the last set of eggs. Return to my shrine... I will reward your service.

String.Source: There is a grove northwest of Whiterun called Greenspring Hollow. Meet me there, and I will free you from this curse.
String.Dest: There is a grove northwest of Whiterun called Greenspring Hollow. Meet me there, and I will free you from this curse.

String.Source: What, forgot already?
String.Dest: What, forgot already?

String.Source: This is Shuna-Jul. The cave of regret.
String.Dest: This is Shuna-Jul. The cave of regret.

String.Source: Or in simple terms: the jail. If you cause trouble, you'll be tossed in here.
String.Dest: Or in simple terms: the jail. If you cause trouble, you'll be tossed in here.

String.Source: And this isn't like Tamriel. No waiting for your sentence to run out. If you want freedom here, you earn it.
String.Dest: And this isn't like Tamriel. No waiting for your sentence to run out. If you want freedom here, you earn it.

String.Source: If you don't want to spend your time mining the Meat in the depths of Shuna-Jul, be on your best behavior.
String.Dest: If you don't want to spend your time mining the Meat in the depths of Shuna-Jul, be on your best behavior.

String.Source: A joke book! I grin in joy. I will study this at once!
String.Dest: A joke book! I grin in joy. I will study this at once!

String.Source: Here. Payment for the book. When I am a master of humor, it will be thanks to its help.
String.Dest: Here. Payment for the book. When I am a master of humor, it will be thanks to its help.

String.Source: Ah, this one was hoping you would ask. He is glad he read you well.
String.Dest: Ah, this one was hoping you would ask. He is glad he read you well.

String.Source: Indeed, this one has many tasks he has thought of that can help him to liberate these ruins from the Bent Cats. And he will pay you for the service!
String.Dest: Indeed, this one has many tasks he has thought of that can help him to liberate these ruins from the Bent Cats. And he will pay you for the service!

String.Source: If you are helpful enough, perhaps this one will even let you in on something special - and with a special payment as well.
String.Dest: If you are helpful enough, perhaps this one will even let you in on something special - and with a special payment as well.

String.Source: But that is for the future. For now, let this one know whenever you wish to help, and this one will select a task from his very large pile.
String.Dest: But that is for the future. For now, let this one know whenever you wish to help, and this one will select a task from his very large pile.

String.Source: Sure, I'll try to land the first hit.
String.Dest: Sure, I'll try to land the first hit.

String.Source: You got it. No attacking unless they hit first.
String.Dest: You got it. No attacking unless they hit first.

String.Source: Indeed you have.
String.Dest: Indeed you have.

String.Source: With luck, my children will find their way into new hosts soon. Skyrim's elite will make fine servants.
String.Dest: With luck, my children will find their way into new hosts soon. Skyrim's elite will make fine servants.

String.Source: You have pleased me, mortal.
String.Dest: You have pleased me, mortal.

String.Source: Know that the Writhing Mother rewards those who earn her favor.
String.Dest: Know that the Writhing Mother rewards those who earn her favor.

String.Source: And so I grant you my blade, Blood-Burrower. You shall find it on a pedestal below this platform.
String.Dest: And so I grant you my blade, Blood-Burrower. You shall find it on a pedestal below this platform.

String.Source: I think I will tell my siblings of the service you've rendered as well... They may find use for you in the future.
String.Dest: I think I will tell my siblings of the service you've rendered as well... They may find use for you in the future.

String.Source: You've made a poor decision, mortal.
String.Dest: You've made a poor decision, mortal.

String.Source: None can escape my children... and that includes you. Best watch what you eat...
String.Dest: None can escape my children... and that includes you. Best watch what you eat...

String.Source: Oh? Did you get cold feet, mortal?
String.Dest: Oh? Did you get cold feet, mortal?

String.Source: To infest some victims, then stop before the task is complete... Such a waste.
String.Dest: To infest some victims, then stop before the task is complete... Such a waste.

String.Source: I'd hoped you'd be more amusing than that. What a disappointment you were, mortal.
String.Dest: I'd hoped you'd be more amusing than that. What a disappointment you were, mortal.

String.Source: What's this? So close to completing my task, only to falter at the end?
String.Dest: What's this? So close to completing my task, only to falter at the end?

String.Source: Did one of my siblings tell you to do this? Are you just teasing me?
String.Dest: Did one of my siblings tell you to do this? Are you just teasing me?

String.Source: Or perhaps you were using my children for your own agenda...
String.Dest: Or perhaps you were using my children for your own agenda...

String.Source: Well, no matter. You've spread a decent amount of the eggs already.
String.Dest: Well, no matter. You've spread a decent amount of the eggs already.

String.Source: You're a strange mortal, but you've served my purposes. I'll be watching you in the future... We will meet again.
String.Dest: You're a strange mortal, but you've served my purposes. I'll be watching you in the future... We will meet again.

String.Source: The swamp has always been a place to dispose of the dead. Sometimes, these dead return.
String.Dest: The swamp has always been a place to dispose of the dead. Sometimes, these dead return.

String.Source: I ask it to slay the drowned corpses that walk once more.
String.Dest: I ask it to slay the drowned corpses that walk once more.

String.Source: Several of the miners were attacked by undead. Will it help push the drowned back?
String.Dest: Several of the miners were attacked by undead. Will it help push the drowned back?

String.Source: The guards report several dead animals near a drinking hole. Poison seeps from the ruins.
String.Dest: The guards report several dead animals near a drinking hole. Poison seeps from the ruins.

String.Source: I have purifying potions. Will it use them to cleanse the pools?
String.Dest: I have purifying potions. Will it use them to cleanse the pools?

String.Source: In places where monsters gather, the water turns foul and stagnant. Use these purifying potions to cleanse the worst spots.
String.Dest: In places where monsters gather, the water turns foul and stagnant. Use these purifying potions to cleanse the worst spots.

String.Source: One of the miners has not returned. If we act swiftly, they may yet be saved.
String.Dest: One of the miners has not returned. If we act swiftly, they may yet be saved.

String.Source: Will it investigate the place they were last digging?
String.Dest: Will it investigate the place they were last digging?

String.Source: The miners were attacked by monsters. One has yet to return.
String.Dest: The miners were attacked by monsters. One has yet to return.

String.Source: Will it lead the rescue?
String.Dest: Will it lead the rescue?

String.Source: Lizka-Rosh asks to study a relic from within one of the xanmeers. Will it recover one for her?
String.Dest: Lizka-Rosh asks to study a relic from within one of the xanmeers. Will it recover one for her?

String.Source: A mage from Tamriel offers to purchase xanmeer relics from us. Will it help us gather them?
String.Dest: A mage from Tamriel offers to purchase xanmeer relics from us. Will it help us gather them?

String.Source: A miner reports an interesting relic within one of the xanmeers, but the monsters keep them from collecting it.
String.Dest: A miner reports an interesting relic within one of the xanmeers, but the monsters keep them from collecting it.

String.Source: If the monsters seek to guard the relic, it may hold clues to defeating them. I wish to study it.
String.Dest: If the monsters seek to guard the relic, it may hold clues to defeating them. I wish to study it.

String.Source: A powerful monster emerges from within one of the xanmeers. It must be put down quickly.
String.Dest: A powerful monster emerges from within one of the xanmeers. It must be put down quickly.

String.Source: While scouting one of the xanmeers, I encountered a powerful monster. The other creatures seem to obey its every whim.
String.Dest: While scouting one of the xanmeers, I encountered a powerful monster. The other creatures seem to obey its every whim.

String.Source: This monster must be killed before it can gather a horde.
String.Dest: This monster must be killed before it can gather a horde.

String.Source: "Those who try to lift the mud find it slips through their fingers."
