String.Dest: "Those who try to lift the mud find it slips through their fingers."

String.Source: I have given it one job already. It is not good to overcomplicate things.
String.Dest: I have given it one job already. It is not good to overcomplicate things.

String.Source: So be it. Let us hope it is not too late to find another to do it.
String.Dest: So be it. Let us hope it is not too late to find another to do it.

String.Source: Very well. We are used to being abandoned.
String.Dest: Very well. We are used to being abandoned.

String.Source: The monsters in the woods have a hierarchy. The witch-things called "Voidmothers" seem to be in command of the others.
String.Dest: The monsters in the woods have a hierarchy. The witch-things called "Voidmothers" seem to be in command of the others.

String.Source: Kill a few, and maybe their minions will be more cautious around us.
String.Dest: Kill a few, and maybe their minions will be more cautious around us.

String.Source: Nobody knows what the Voidmothers really are. Some say they're witches who were blessed by Namira; some say they're physical embodiments of the Void.
String.Dest: Nobody knows what the Voidmothers really are. Some say they're witches who were blessed by Namira; some say they're physical embodiments of the Void.

String.Source: Whatever they are, they're powerful and cruel. If we're going to weaken the monsters, we need to kill those Voidmothers.
String.Dest: Whatever they are, they're powerful and cruel. If we're going to weaken the monsters, we need to kill those Voidmothers.

String.Source: It's not just the monsters that stalk the woods. An ancient vampire clan calls that place home, too.
String.Dest: It's not just the monsters that stalk the woods. An ancient vampire clan calls that place home, too.

String.Source: The guards have managed to keep them out so far, but it's only a matter of time before they break through. We need to eliminate their hunters.
String.Dest: The guards have managed to keep them out so far, but it's only a matter of time before they break through. We need to eliminate their hunters.

String.Source: When I was young, I thought the Voidsucker vampires were a myth. Now I know better.
String.Dest: When I was young, I thought the Voidsucker vampires were a myth. Now I know better.

String.Source: Their hunters are getting bolder. If we don't push them back, it's only a matter of time before they assault the village.
String.Dest: Their hunters are getting bolder. If we don't push them back, it's only a matter of time before they assault the village.

String.Source: The biggest souce of the wood's corruption is the Hollow Palace, of course. But it's not the only source.
String.Dest: The biggest souce of the wood's corruption is the Hollow Palace, of course. But it's not the only source.

String.Source: The ancient Ayleids who built the Palace buried some of their foremost mages in the ruins around the forest. Their powers keep the corruption active.
String.Dest: The ancient Ayleids who built the Palace buried some of their foremost mages in the ruins around the forest. Their powers keep the corruption active.

String.Source: If we're going to weaken the powers in the forest, we need to deal with those Ayleid undead.
String.Dest: If we're going to weaken the powers in the forest, we need to deal with those Ayleid undead.

String.Source: Even the guards who are willing to enter the forest refuse to approach the Ayleid ruins.
String.Dest: Even the guards who are willing to enter the forest refuse to approach the Ayleid ruins.

String.Source: Unless the powers in those ruins are dealt with, they'll just keep summoning more monsters. Do you have the courage to brave those ruins?
String.Dest: Unless the powers in those ruins are dealt with, they'll just keep summoning more monsters. Do you have the courage to brave those ruins?

String.Source: There's all sorts of legends about the magic of the Ayleids. There might even be something we can use to help fight the monsters.
String.Dest: There's all sorts of legends about the magic of the Ayleids. There might even be something we can use to help fight the monsters.

String.Source: I want you to check the ruins. See if you can find anything that seems useful.
String.Dest: I want you to check the ruins. See if you can find anything that seems useful.

String.Source: If Ayleid magic is responsible for summoning the monsters, maybe it can be used to expel them, too.
String.Dest: If Ayleid magic is responsible for summoning the monsters, maybe it can be used to expel them, too.

String.Source: I'd like you to search the ruins for any relics that seem magical. Something we can use against the monsters.
String.Dest: I'd like you to search the ruins for any relics that seem magical. Something we can use against the monsters.

String.Source: There's some sort of blight spreading through the woods. Warping the Bloodroots there.
String.Dest: There's some sort of blight spreading through the woods. Warping the Bloodroots there.

String.Source: We can't let that spread. I want you to burn any infected Roots you see.
String.Dest: We can't let that spread. I want you to burn any infected Roots you see.

String.Source: The woods are the last source of healthy Bloodroots. We can't risk those Roots being corrupted by whatever malice is spreading there.
String.Dest: The woods are the last source of healthy Bloodroots. We can't risk those Roots being corrupted by whatever malice is spreading there.

String.Source: I want you to burn any corrupted Roots you can find.
String.Dest: I want you to burn any corrupted Roots you can find.

String.Source: I already gave you a job. If you take on too much at once, you'll get overwhelmed by the things in the woods.
String.Dest: I already gave you a job. If you take on too much at once, you'll get overwhelmed by the things in the woods.

String.Source: I'm sorry to hear that. You're the only one capable of surviving that forest.
String.Dest: I'm sorry to hear that. You're the only one capable of surviving that forest.

String.Source: Disappointing but understandable. That forest has been the death of many.
String.Dest: Disappointing but understandable. That forest has been the death of many.

String.Source: There is no shame in that. Knowing one's limits is important - those who push themselves too much are vulnerable to the Bent Dance.
String.Dest: There is no shame in that. Knowing one's limits is important - those who push themselves too much are vulnerable to the Bent Dance.

String.Source: It is for the best. This one forgot what he asked of you.
String.Dest: It is for the best. This one forgot what he asked of you.

String.Source: This one's cousin once told him "Never quit. Continue forward, no matter what."
String.Dest: This one's cousin once told him "Never quit. Continue forward, no matter what."

String.Source: The last time this one saw him, he was pressing his face into a mountain, demanding it stand aside. That is how this one learned to quit.
String.Dest: The last time this one saw him, he was pressing his face into a mountain, demanding it stand aside. That is how this one learned to quit.

String.Source: Hm, they've got a nice collection of books here.
String.Dest: Hm, they've got a nice collection of books here.

String.Source: "500 Classic Jokes from Elsweyr?"
String.Dest: "500 Classic Jokes from Elsweyr?"

String.Source: "A hyena walks into a bar and says 'I can't see anything, I'll open this one.'"
String.Dest: "A hyena walks into a bar and says 'I can't see anything, I'll open this one.'"

String.Source: ...Maybe it reads better in the original Ta'agra.
String.Dest: ...Maybe it reads better in the original Ta'agra.

String.Source: You've grabbed a few of those Void Gems, right? Those things are stores of Void magic - not much, but enough to be useful.
String.Dest: You've grabbed a few of those Void Gems, right? Those things are stores of Void magic - not much, but enough to be useful.

String.Source: If you're willing to let me have those gems, I can use them to make myself stronger. Though obviously, the process destroys the gems.
String.Dest: If you're willing to let me have those gems, I can use them to make myself stronger. Though obviously, the process destroys the gems.

String.Source: Just keep it in mind, okay?
String.Dest: Just keep it in mind, okay?

String.Source: Great! I'll take all you've got.
String.Dest: Great! I'll take all you've got.

String.Source: It'll destroy them, though. You sure you're okay giving me all of them?
String.Dest: It'll destroy them, though. You sure you're okay giving me all of them?

String.Source: Thanks! Every gem helps.
String.Dest: Thanks! Every gem helps.

String.Source: Thought so.
String.Dest: Thought so.

String.Source: Put the ones you want to keep in a strongbox or something; I'll wait.
String.Dest: Put the ones you want to keep in a strongbox or something; I'll wait.

String.Source: Kheh? Hehehe.
String.Dest: Kheh? Hehehe.

String.Source: Hehehe.
String.Dest: Hehehe.

String.Source: Khh. Grrr.
String.Dest: Khh. Grrr.

String.Source: Taking up the quest, huh? Well, there's definitely something special about you, considering you can see me.
String.Dest: Taking up the quest, huh? Well, there's definitely something special about you, considering you can see me.

String.Source: Hey, who knows? Maybe we really can save the village.
String.Dest: Hey, who knows? Maybe we really can save the village.

String.Source: Okay, let's do this!
String.Dest: Okay, let's do this!

String.Source: Oh, a Voidlight spell? That's a pretty simple one. I can cast it if you don't want to.
String.Dest: Oh, a Voidlight spell? That's a pretty simple one. I can cast it if you don't want to.

String.Source: I'll forgive you... this time.
String.Dest: I'll forgive you... this time.

String.Source: Just don't do that again.
String.Dest: Just don't do that again.

String.Source: This one will sheathe his claws... this time
String.Dest: This one will sheathe his claws... this time

String.Source: This one will sheathe her claws... this time
String.Dest: This one will sheathe her claws... this time

String.Source: This one forgives you. Do not push your luck.
String.Dest: This one forgives you. Do not push your luck.

String.Source: Do not do it again.
String.Dest: Do not do it again.

String.Source: We... we actually did it.
String.Dest: We... we actually did it.

String.Source: I... I'm free. I can actually... decide for myself.
String.Dest: I... I'm free. I can actually... decide for myself.

String.Source: With Rukar's control gone and the power I absorbed, I bet I can even leave the Old Lands.
String.Dest: With Rukar's control gone and the power I absorbed, I bet I can even leave the Old Lands.

String.Source: I can finally explore the world!
String.Dest: I can finally explore the world!

String.Source: You'll come with me, right? Together, we're unstoppable!
String.Dest: You'll come with me, right? Together, we're unstoppable!

String.Source: Heh, perfect. You and me, taking on the world!
String.Dest: Heh, perfect. You and me, taking on the world!

String.Source: Xuth! Will it next ask if the swamp is moist?
String.Dest: Xuth! Will it next ask if the swamp is moist?

String.Source: It is exceedingly dangerous. Monsters stalk the ruins, and the corpses of our predecessors hunt the living! Miners vanish frequently.
String.Dest: It is exceedingly dangerous. Monsters stalk the ruins, and the corpses of our predecessors hunt the living! Miners vanish frequently.

String.Source: We all do what we can to defend our fellows, but we are overwhelmed.
String.Dest: We all do what we can to defend our fellows, but we are overwhelmed.

String.Source: I am grateful. While it does that, I will find the key.
String.Dest: I am grateful. While it does that, I will find the key.

String.Source: Either way, I will seek the key. If it decides to help, it will have my gratitude.
String.Dest: Either way, I will seek the key. If it decides to help, it will have my gratitude.

String.Source: Heh. None are "safe." But I know what it means to ask.
String.Dest: Heh. None are "safe." But I know what it means to ask.

String.Source: It is not a skill that can be taught. More a sense one develops. With a well-honed mind, one can sense the Meat - and the monsters.
String.Dest: It is not a skill that can be taught. More a sense one develops. With a well-honed mind, one can sense the Meat - and the monsters.

String.Source: It becomes instinct, feeling which sites will give us the most Meat for the least danger.
String.Dest: It becomes instinct, feeling which sites will give us the most Meat for the least danger.

String.Source: Tsk. This one suspected something had gone wrong.
String.Dest: Tsk. This one suspected something had gone wrong.

String.Source: It is not the first caravan to have run into danger. The Forsworn have taken to raiding them as well.
String.Dest: It is not the first caravan to have run into danger. The Forsworn have taken to raiding them as well.

String.Source: If this keeps up, the traders may decide it is not worth the risk... And traders are our source of food and clothing.
String.Dest: If this keeps up, the traders may decide it is not worth the risk... And traders are our source of food and clothing.

String.Source: The guards here do what they can to stop more monsters from entering Twisted Root, but as for the Forsworn...
String.Dest: The guards here do what they can to stop more monsters from entering Twisted Root, but as for the Forsworn...

String.Source: This one suspected you would offer.
String.Dest: This one suspected you would offer.

String.Source: From what this one's contacts have told her, there is one specific group of Forsworn that are responsible for most of the raids.
String.Dest: From what this one's contacts have told her, there is one specific group of Forsworn that are responsible for most of the raids.

String.Source: They are called the Darkwalker Clan. They were barred from the Old Lands years ago after they tried to steal the Church's stores of Blood.
String.Dest: They are called the Darkwalker Clan. They were barred from the Old Lands years ago after they tried to steal the Church's stores of Blood.

String.Source: They think the magic of this realm will help them overthrow the Nords of Markarth.
String.Dest: They think the magic of this realm will help them overthrow the Nords of Markarth.

String.Source: Tch. This one does not care for Skyrim politics, but by attacking our traders, they have made themselves our business.
String.Dest: Tch. This one does not care for Skyrim politics, but by attacking our traders, they have made themselves our business.

String.Source: If you wipe out that pride of bandits, this one will reward you.
String.Dest: If you wipe out that pride of bandits, this one will reward you.

String.Source: Not often. Many of the older Reach clans know of the Old Lands, but their superstitions forbid most of them from interfering.
String.Dest: Not often. Many of the older Reach clans know of the Old Lands, but their superstitions forbid most of them from interfering.

String.Source: Very few tribes are both willing to break the taboo and eager to resort to banditry. Sadly, the Darkwalkers are among those who are.
String.Dest: Very few tribes are both willing to break the taboo and eager to resort to banditry. Sadly, the Darkwalkers are among those who are.

String.Source: The xanmeers? Not much more than the miners do.
String.Dest: The xanmeers? Not much more than the miners do.

String.Source: From what I've read, the ancient Argonians built them back in the Merethic Era. Before humans or elves came to Tamriel.
String.Dest: From what I've read, the ancient Argonians built them back in the Merethic Era. Before humans or elves came to Tamriel.

String.Source: They were supposed to be eternal. Outlasting Sithis - who the Argonians see as the embodiment of change.
String.Dest: They were supposed to be eternal. Outlasting Sithis - who the Argonians see as the embodiment of change.

String.Source: That entire civilization vanished during something called Duskfall. None of my books explained what that was.
String.Dest: That entire civilization vanished during something called Duskfall. None of my books explained what that was.

String.Source: But now, most Argonians think of the xanmeers as something cursed. Best left forgotten.
String.Dest: But now, most Argonians think of the xanmeers as something cursed. Best left forgotten.

String.Source: I bet the Argonians in Black Marsh would be horrified about the Meat Mines. Digging up something the ancients tried to bury...
String.Dest: I bet the Argonians in Black Marsh would be horrified about the Meat Mines. Digging up something the ancients tried to bury...

String.Source: Though, I don't know if the xanmeers here are the same as the ones on Nirn. Not like I had an opportunity to compare them.
String.Dest: Though, I don't know if the xanmeers here are the same as the ones on Nirn. Not like I had an opportunity to compare them.

String.Source: It's the terrain of the Scuttling Void - Namira's realm.
String.Dest: It's the terrain of the Scuttling Void - Namira's realm.

String.Source: Namira's the visceral type. Making part of her realm out of "flesh" just adds to that.
String.Dest: Namira's the visceral type. Making part of her realm out of "flesh" just adds to that.

String.Source: That's why I don't recommend mortals eat it. It's probably not poisonous, but who knows what supernatural effects it has...
String.Dest: That's why I don't recommend mortals eat it. It's probably not poisonous, but who knows what supernatural effects it has...

String.Source: Just what I've read. Khajiit souls are more vulnerable to Namira's influence than other races, somehow.
String.Dest: Just what I've read. Khajiit souls are more vulnerable to Namira's influence than other races, somehow.

String.Source: When the Khajiit are corrupted by Namira, they transform into daedra - into dro-m'Athra.
String.Dest: When the Khajiit are corrupted by Namira, they transform into daedra - into dro-m'Athra.

String.Source: It's something to do with their connection to Lorkhan - and to the Dark Heart. It mirrors Lorkhan's corruption when his Heart was removed.
String.Dest: It's something to do with their connection to Lorkhan - and to the Dark Heart. It mirrors Lorkhan's corruption when his Heart was removed.

String.Source: Many of us are descendants of the Order of the False Moon. A cult driven from Elsweyr for heresy.
String.Dest: Many of us are descendants of the Order of the False Moon. A cult driven from Elsweyr for heresy.

String.Source: Khajiit religion is clear: we are created and guarded by Azurah, who defends us from Namiira.
String.Dest: Khajiit religion is clear: we are created and guarded by Azurah, who defends us from Namiira.

String.Source: Namiira is the enemy, the source of all Bent Cats - the dro-m'Athra. The Dark Heart, created when the Void entered Lorkhaj.
String.Dest: Namiira is the enemy, the source of all Bent Cats - the dro-m'Athra. The Dark Heart, created when the Void entered Lorkhaj.

String.Source: The Order of the False Moon defied this. They believed that Azurah was a liar - that Namiira was the true mother of Khajiit.
String.Dest: The Order of the False Moon defied this. They believed that Azurah was a liar - that Namiira was the true mother of Khajiit.

String.Source: They preached that dro-m'Athra were a curse from Azurah, much as how she turned the defiant Chimer into Dunmer. That a true cat embraced the Void.
String.Dest: They preached that dro-m'Athra were a curse from Azurah, much as how she turned the defiant Chimer into Dunmer. That a true cat embraced the Void.

String.Source: They came here countless moons ago, seeking to use the magic of the Old Blood to reconnect with Namiira and purge themselves of Azurah's curse.
String.Dest: They came here countless moons ago, seeking to use the magic of the Old Blood to reconnect with Namiira and purge themselves of Azurah's curse.

String.Source: No. The cultists fell to the Bent Dance of Namiira. They were tricked by her - taken by the evil in the Dark Behind the World.
String.Dest: No. The cultists fell to the Bent Dance of Namiira. They were tricked by her - taken by the evil in the Dark Behind the World.

String.Source: Most of us who remain are their offspring. The Old Blood keeps us here, just as skooma keeps its victims bound to their dealers.
String.Dest: Most of us who remain are their offspring. The Old Blood keeps us here, just as skooma keeps its victims bound to their dealers.

String.Source: Still, there might have been merit to what the cult believed.
String.Dest: Still, there might have been merit to what the cult believed.

String.Source: The most powerful dro-m'Athra call themselves Rajaska - dark singers whose music pulls other Khajiit into the evil Chorus of the Rajaska-z'har.
String.Dest: The most powerful dro-m'Athra call themselves Rajaska - dark singers whose music pulls other Khajiit into the evil Chorus of the Rajaska-z'har.

String.Source: This one is not truly certain if the dro-m'Athra here are real Rajaska or if they simply use the name, but they are dangerous either way.
String.Dest: This one is not truly certain if the dro-m'Athra here are real Rajaska or if they simply use the name, but they are dangerous either way.

String.Source: Either way, dispelling them is sure to weaken the lesser dro-m'Athra. Will you slay the Rajaska this one located?
String.Dest: Either way, dispelling them is sure to weaken the lesser dro-m'Athra. Will you slay the Rajaska this one located?

String.Source: The Bent Cats have built many dark altars around the ruins, using their magic to strengthen Namiira's influence. Do you feel like smashing them?
String.Dest: The Bent Cats have built many dark altars around the ruins, using their magic to strengthen Namiira's influence. Do you feel like smashing them?

String.Source: This one sometimes thinks Merrunz has the right idea - many problems can be solved by breaking things... such as the evil altars of the dro-m'Athra.
String.Dest: This one sometimes thinks Merrunz has the right idea - many problems can be solved by breaking things... such as the evil altars of the dro-m'Athra.

String.Source: What do you say to destroying some yourself?
String.Dest: What do you say to destroying some yourself?

String.Source: The first Khajiit in these lands built shrines to channel the power of Lorkhaj, the Dark Moon. But now those shrines honor Namiira instead.
String.Dest: The first Khajiit in these lands built shrines to channel the power of Lorkhaj, the Dark Moon. But now those shrines honor Namiira instead.

String.Source: If the enchantments of the dro-m'Athra are purged from the shrines, Namiira's influence may be lessened. What say you?
String.Dest: If the enchantments of the dro-m'Athra are purged from the shrines, Namiira's influence may be lessened. What say you?

String.Source: This one has found some ancient moon-shrines. If the influence of the dro-m'Athra can be cleansed from them, the shrines' magic can be used for good.
String.Dest: This one has found some ancient moon-shrines. If the influence of the dro-m'Athra can be cleansed from them, the shrines' magic can be used for good.

String.Source: Will you help to cleanse these shrines?
String.Dest: Will you help to cleanse these shrines?

String.Source: Sadly, the ancient shrines never stay purified for long. The influence of the dro-m'Athra has once again corrupted the shrines.
String.Dest: Sadly, the ancient shrines never stay purified for long. The influence of the dro-m'Athra has once again corrupted the shrines.

String.Source: Will you purify them once more?
String.Dest: Will you purify them once more?

String.Source: Another Rajaska has appeared within the ruins. Will you help send it back to the Dark Behind the World?
String.Dest: Another Rajaska has appeared within the ruins. Will you help send it back to the Dark Behind the World?

String.Source: This one has located the lair of a Rajaska. Will you go destroy it?
String.Dest: This one has located the lair of a Rajaska. Will you go destroy it?

String.Source: This one has noticed that the dro-m'Athra enjoy collecting shiny trinkets. Perhaps they are for evil magic, or perhaps they are simply pretty.
String.Dest: This one has noticed that the dro-m'Athra enjoy collecting shiny trinkets. Perhaps they are for evil magic, or perhaps they are simply pretty.

String.Source: Either way, those gems would be of better use with us; do you not agree? Let us lighten the pockets of the Bent Cats.
String.Dest: Either way, those gems would be of better use with us; do you not agree? Let us lighten the pockets of the Bent Cats.

String.Source: This one has found a stash of jewels collected by the dro-m'Athra. This one would like you to liberate those jewels.
String.Dest: This one has found a stash of jewels collected by the dro-m'Athra. This one would like you to liberate those jewels.

String.Source: There are many valuable relics left over in the ruins. Will you risk the dangers and recover them?
String.Dest: There are many valuable relics left over in the ruins. Will you risk the dangers and recover them?

String.Source: The ruins still hold relics of the False Moon faith. Studying those may give clues to stopping the dro-m'Athra, if you will help recover them.
String.Dest: The ruins still hold relics of the False Moon faith. Studying those may give clues to stopping the dro-m'Athra, if you will help recover them.

String.Source: This one has already given you a task. If you take too many at once, this one will have trouble keeping track.
String.Dest: This one has already given you a task. If you take too many at once, this one will have trouble keeping track.

String.Source: This one understands. Return if you change your mind.
String.Dest: This one understands. Return if you change your mind.

String.Source: Very well. Perhaps the next task will be more to your liking.
String.Dest: Very well. Perhaps the next task will be more to your liking.

String.Source: "Having second thoughts is what allows us the opportunity to continue thinking."
String.Dest: "Having second thoughts is what allows us the opportunity to continue thinking."

String.Source: This one came up with that phrase after consuming a great deal of skooma. He is unsure whether it means anything.
String.Dest: This one came up with that phrase after consuming a great deal of skooma. He is unsure whether it means anything.

String.Source: Hm. Let this one see...
String.Dest: Hm. Let this one see...

String.Source: Not yet, but this one appreciates your enthusiasm. Perhaps soon.
String.Dest: Not yet, but this one appreciates your enthusiasm. Perhaps soon.

String.Source: Indeed. This one thinks it is time to tell you the full story.
String.Dest: Indeed. This one thinks it is time to tell you the full story.

String.Source: We once had a sister. Li'Rakka.
String.Dest: We once had a sister. Li'Rakka.

String.Source: When we fled Elsweyr after angering the Thalmor, all three of us hoped to escape to Skyrim. We planned to join one of the caravans.
String.Dest: When we fled Elsweyr after angering the Thalmor, all three of us hoped to escape to Skyrim. We planned to join one of the caravans.

String.Source: But before we even left Elsweyr, we were attacked. A group of dro-m'Athra... and a Thalmor mage. He had somehow summoned the Bent Cats.
String.Dest: But before we even left Elsweyr, we were attacked. A group of dro-m'Athra... and a Thalmor mage. He had somehow summoned the Bent Cats.

String.Source: Ri'nakkhu and this one escaped, but Li'Rakka was captured.
String.Dest: Ri'nakkhu and this one escaped, but Li'Rakka was captured.

String.Source: Ah, you have done well. This one is impressed.
String.Dest: Ah, you have done well. This one is impressed.

String.Source: Here. Payment for you.
String.Dest: Here. Payment for you.

String.Source: Very good! The evils in these ruins will not stay gone, but every bit helps. Here is your payment.
String.Dest: Very good! The evils in these ruins will not stay gone, but every bit helps. Here is your payment.

String.Source: This one is pleased. You have earned his respect.
String.Dest: This one is pleased. You have earned his respect.

String.Source: And here is your pay. Let us continue working to defeat the Bent Cats together.
String.Dest: And here is your pay. Let us continue working to defeat the Bent Cats together.

String.Source: There are many things. The swamp is filled with danger, and we are ill-equipped to face it.
String.Dest: There are many things. The swamp is filled with danger, and we are ill-equipped to face it.

String.Source: If it helps us to push back the monsters and gain new sources of Meat, I will gladly pay for its aid.
String.Dest: If it helps us to push back the monsters and gain new sources of Meat, I will gladly pay for its aid.

String.Source: Perhaps eventually, enough problems will be solved that I can ask for help with other matters.
String.Dest: Perhaps eventually, enough problems will be solved that I can ask for help with other matters.

String.Source: I erect the spine of gratitude. This helps ease our burdens.
String.Dest: I erect the spine of gratitude. This helps ease our burdens.

String.Source: This is good. It gives us hope for survival.
String.Dest: This is good. It gives us hope for survival.

String.Source: Each task done helps lighten the burden. It has our gratitude.
String.Dest: Each task done helps lighten the burden. It has our gratitude.

String.Source: It wastes my time.
String.Dest: It wastes my time.

String.Source: It has nothing better to do than bother me? Go elsewhere if it will not help.
String.Dest: It has nothing better to do than bother me? Go elsewhere if it will not help.

String.Source: There is too much work to do. I have no time for personal matters.
String.Dest: There is too much work to do. I have no time for personal matters.

String.Source: Hm. Perhaps.
String.Dest: Hm. Perhaps.

String.Source: Legends say that all voriplasms are drippings from a single enormous one. This is likely untrue, but it has a basis in fact.
String.Dest: Legends say that all voriplasms are drippings from a single enormous one. This is likely untrue, but it has a basis in fact.

String.Source: Larger voriplasms do indeed birth smaller ones. By slaying these larger ones, we prevent the birth of new voriplasms.
String.Dest: Larger voriplasms do indeed birth smaller ones. By slaying these larger ones, we prevent the birth of new voriplasms.

String.Source: One such greater voriplasm dwells in the lowest reaches of Reezal-Bak. Many lesser voriplasms flow from it.
String.Dest: One such greater voriplasm dwells in the lowest reaches of Reezal-Bak. Many lesser voriplasms flow from it.

String.Source: If that greater voriplasm is slain, all shall swim in the River of Relief.
String.Dest: If that greater voriplasm is slain, all shall swim in the River of Relief.

String.Source: Here. This Meat has been soaked in a special solution loved by voriplasms. Place it in the lowest chamber of Reezal-Bak to lure out the fiend.
String.Dest: Here. This Meat has been soaked in a special solution loved by voriplasms. Place it in the lowest chamber of Reezal-Bak to lure out the fiend.

String.Source: Let us see...
String.Dest: Let us see...

String.Source: It may not be as glamorous as slaying monsters, but this too will weaken the dro-m'Athra.
String.Dest: It may not be as glamorous as slaying monsters, but this too will weaken the dro-m'Athra.

String.Source: This one appreciates your enthusiasm. If all were so eager, perhaps the ruins could be reclaimed.
String.Dest: This one appreciates your enthusiasm. If all were so eager, perhaps the ruins could be reclaimed.

String.Source: Good. We cannot let the Bent Cats increase their power further.
String.Dest: Good. We cannot let the Bent Cats increase their power further.

String.Source: Ah, you have not lost your inner kitten. Such whimsy is good - it will help you resist the Bent Dance.
String.Dest: Ah, you have not lost your inner kitten. Such whimsy is good - it will help you resist the Bent Dance.

String.Source: This one wishes you good fortune. Be cautious of their magic - it would be a shame for you to fall to the Darkness.
String.Dest: This one wishes you good fortune. Be cautious of their magic - it would be a shame for you to fall to the Darkness.

String.Source: If only it were so easy. Sadly, the Way of Jone is not a permanent solution. With time, they will return.
String.Dest: If only it were so easy. Sadly, the Way of Jone is not a permanent solution. With time, they will return.

String.Source: But, in the present moment, slaying them is still worthwhile.
String.Dest: But, in the present moment, slaying them is still worthwhile.

String.Source: This one looks forward to seeing what you recover.
String.Dest: This one looks forward to seeing what you recover.

String.Source: This one will turn a blind eye if some should disappear, so long as you do the same.
String.Dest: This one will turn a blind eye if some should disappear, so long as you do the same.

String.Source: This one thanks you. Our history should not remain trapped by Namiira.
String.Dest: This one thanks you. Our history should not remain trapped by Namiira.

String.Source: This one is grateful. Studying those relics may help us find a new way to fight the dro-m'Athra.
String.Dest: This one is grateful. Studying those relics may help us find a new way to fight the dro-m'Athra.

String.Source: We went after her, of course. We followed the Thalmor to his den. Under cover of night, we snuck in and slit his throat.
String.Dest: We went after her, of course. We followed the Thalmor to his den. Under cover of night, we snuck in and slit his throat.

String.Source: But when we reached the prison... We found we were too late. Li'Rakka had been corrupted by the Bent Dance. She had become a dro-m'Athra.
String.Dest: But when we reached the prison... We found we were too late. Li'Rakka had been corrupted by the Bent Dance. She had become a dro-m'Athra.

String.Source: Before she vanished, she taunted us. She said that Namiira had summoned her to the Old Lands in preparation for the coming age of darkness.
String.Dest: Before she vanished, she taunted us. She said that Namiira had summoned her to the Old Lands in preparation for the coming age of darkness.

String.Source: That is why we came here. To avenge Li'Rakka. And, perhaps... to grant her a final rest.
String.Dest: That is why we came here. To avenge Li'Rakka. And, perhaps... to grant her a final rest.

String.Source: While you have been keeping the dro-m'Athra busy, this one has been investigating as well. And he has found her.
String.Dest: While you have been keeping the dro-m'Athra busy, this one has been investigating as well. And he has found her.

String.Source: This one asks you to accompany him to Li'Rakka's lair. If we can slay her current form, perhaps her soul can be purified.
String.Dest: This one asks you to accompany him to Li'Rakka's lair. If we can slay her current form, perhaps her soul can be purified.

String.Source: We will meet up within Seribani Sallidadna and make our way into the hidden inner chambers. This one will see you there.
String.Dest: We will meet up within Seribani Sallidadna and make our way into the hidden inner chambers. This one will see you there.

String.Source: Let us put Li'Rakka to rest.
String.Dest: Let us put Li'Rakka to rest.

String.Source: Good. You are here.
String.Dest: Good. You are here.

String.Source: That is good! And it has good timing, as well. I found the key.
String.Dest: That is good! And it has good timing, as well. I found the key.

String.Source: Here. I hope Rootwatch proves a good home for it. Perhaps I will visit later.
String.Dest: Here. I hope Rootwatch proves a good home for it. Perhaps I will visit later.

String.Source: This one was waiting for you, brother! Come, join us in the Bent Dance!
String.Dest: This one was waiting for you, brother! Come, join us in the Bent Dance!

String.Source: There is no escape from Namiira. Come; let us dance together once more!
String.Dest: There is no escape from Namiira. Come; let us dance together once more!

String.Source: You think to save me, brother? There is no undoing Namiira's gift!
String.Dest: You think to save me, brother? There is no undoing Namiira's gift!

String.Source: Come! Join us in the Dark Behind the World!
String.Dest: Come! Join us in the Dark Behind the World!

String.Source: Even if you kill this one, she will return. The dro-m'Athra cannot be stopped!
String.Dest: Even if you kill this one, she will return. The dro-m'Athra cannot be stopped!

String.Source: Li'Rakka makes her den in the deeper parts of this ruin. A hidden chamber. This one has found where it is located.
String.Dest: Li'Rakka makes her den in the deeper parts of this ruin. A hidden chamber. This one has found where it is located.

String.Source: Once we find the chamber, Li'Rakka will be waiting for us. That will be our chance.
String.Dest: Once we find the chamber, Li'Rakka will be waiting for us. That will be our chance.

String.Source: It took much effort and much money, but this one has something that may be able to save Li'Rakka: a pair of Moonclaws.
String.Dest: It took much effort and much money, but this one has something that may be able to save Li'Rakka: a pair of Moonclaws.

String.Source: Relics of an ancient Khajiit order, the Hidden Moon. They fought the dro-m'Athra in the early First Era.
String.Dest: Relics of an ancient Khajiit order, the Hidden Moon. They fought the dro-m'Athra in the early First Era.

String.Source: Their Moonclaws were said to be blessed weapons, made in imitation of Azurah's own Moonlight Blade.
String.Dest: Their Moonclaws were said to be blessed weapons, made in imitation of Azurah's own Moonlight Blade.

String.Source: The details have faded into legend, but... This one has hope. If Li'Rakka's current body can be slain, perhaps...
String.Dest: The details have faded into legend, but... This one has hope. If Li'Rakka's current body can be slain, perhaps...

String.Source: Perhaps the magic in the Moonclaws can be used to purify her soul before it can be drawn back into the Dark Behind the World.
String.Dest: Perhaps the magic in the Moonclaws can be used to purify her soul before it can be drawn back into the Dark Behind the World.

String.Source: This one was never faithful to Azurah. Even now, he doubts her promises. He wonders if the False Moon had some truth in its teachings.
String.Dest: This one was never faithful to Azurah. Even now, he doubts her promises. He wonders if the False Moon had some truth in its teachings.

String.Source: But if faith in Azurah is needed to save his sister, he will believe whatever he must.
String.Dest: But if faith in Azurah is needed to save his sister, he will believe whatever he must.

String.Source: May the Moons light your way, Li'Rakka. May they guide you out of the Darkness.
String.Dest: May the Moons light your way, Li'Rakka. May they guide you out of the Darkness.

String.Source: Light... It has been so long since this one felt the moonlight.
String.Dest: Light... It has been so long since this one felt the moonlight.

String.Source: Ma'Jaka... Thank you.
String.Dest: Ma'Jaka... Thank you.

String.Source: This one will wait for you in the Sands Behind the Stars.
String.Dest: This one will wait for you in the Sands Behind the Stars.

String.Source: It worked. It... It truly worked.
String.Dest: It worked. It... It truly worked.

String.Source: Li'Rakka... She has passed on. She is free of Namiira.
String.Dest: Li'Rakka... She has passed on. She is free of Namiira.

String.Source: This one cannot thank you enough. It would not have been possible without you.
String.Dest: This one cannot thank you enough. It would not have been possible without you.

String.Source: Nothing can repay what you have done... But here. This one will give you the most valuable things he has: the Moonclaws.
String.Dest: Nothing can repay what you have done... But here. This one will give you the most valuable things he has: the Moonclaws.

String.Source: Perhaps they will allow you to save other victims of the dro-m'Athra as you did my sister.
String.Dest: Perhaps they will allow you to save other victims of the dro-m'Athra as you did my sister.

String.Source: For now... This one will return to the village. There are more Bent Cats still to fight and more evils to purge.
String.Dest: For now... This one will return to the village. There are more Bent Cats still to fight and more evils to purge.

String.Source: Yes. Li'Rakka may be free, but the dro-m'Athra still threaten all Khajiit. This one will not leave as long as this land is part of Namiira's schemes.
String.Dest: Yes. Li'Rakka may be free, but the dro-m'Athra still threaten all Khajiit. This one will not leave as long as this land is part of Namiira's schemes.

String.Source: Somewhere below the xanmeers, it seems. The deeper into the ruins we explore, the more they appear.
String.Dest: Somewhere below the xanmeers, it seems. The deeper into the ruins we explore, the more they appear.

String.Source: Perhaps the ancients who built the xanmeers sealed them there - or summoned them as guardians. Or perhaps they have appeared since. Who can say?
String.Dest: Perhaps the ancients who built the xanmeers sealed them there - or summoned them as guardians. Or perhaps they have appeared since. Who can say?

String.Source: All we can do is plan our digs carefully to avoid the monsters as best we can.
String.Dest: All we can do is plan our digs carefully to avoid the monsters as best we can.

String.Source: Nothing here for you, outsider. Best be on your way.
String.Dest: Nothing here for you, outsider. Best be on your way.

String.Source: There is nothing here for it. It should leave with haste.
String.Dest: There is nothing here for it. It should leave with haste.

String.Source: The forest is cursed, outsider. I wouldn't go there if I were you.
String.Dest: The forest is cursed, outsider. I wouldn't go there if I were you.

String.Source: The forest is cursed, outsider. This one suggests staying far away.
String.Dest: The forest is cursed, outsider. This one suggests staying far away.

String.Source: Careful, outsider. You're on your own past the gates.
String.Dest: Careful, outsider. You're on your own past the gates.

String.Source: It must be careful. It is on its own past the gates.
String.Dest: It must be careful. It is on its own past the gates.

String.Source: Cause no trouble.
String.Dest: Cause no trouble.

String.Source: Outsider.
String.Dest: Outsider.

String.Source: Rukar still thinks the village can be saved. I wish I could believe it...
String.Dest: Rukar still thinks the village can be saved. I wish I could believe it...

String.Source: In my grandfather's day, the village could rival Whiterun. All rubble now...
String.Dest: In my grandfather's day, the village could rival Whiterun. All rubble now...

String.Source: Hard to believe this place used to be thriving...
String.Dest: Hard to believe this place used to be thriving...

String.Source: You're the one who fixed up Rootwatch? Seems like a nice place.
String.Dest: You're the one who fixed up Rootwatch? Seems like a nice place.

String.Source: It is the new owner of Rootwatch? It is quite lucky.
String.Dest: It is the new owner of Rootwatch? It is quite lucky.

String.Source: A Hist... truly?
String.Dest: A Hist... truly?

String.Source: The Blood... was it really a lie?
String.Dest: The Blood... was it really a lie?

String.Source: Stay clear of Blood-Pilgrim's Rest. That cave's become a den of drybloods.
String.Dest: Stay clear of Blood-Pilgrim's Rest. That cave's become a den of drybloods.

String.Source: Varnauch Mine used to be the pride of the village. Now it's a monster lair...
String.Dest: Varnauch Mine used to be the pride of the village. Now it's a monster lair...

String.Source: The desert ruins are all deathtraps, but the one called Seribani Sallidadna is the worst...
String.Dest: The desert ruins are all deathtraps, but the one called Seribani Sallidadna is the worst...

String.Source: Stay far away from Nalpa-Kur. That ruin is cursed.
String.Dest: Stay far away from Nalpa-Kur. That ruin is cursed.

String.Source: Swampwatch used to be a guard station. No knowing what lives there now...
String.Dest: Swampwatch used to be a guard station. No knowing what lives there now...

String.Source: Careful in the desert. Drybloods about.
String.Dest: Careful in the desert. Drybloods about.

String.Source: Warm-Wind Pit... Too nice a name for a dro-m'Athra den.
String.Dest: Warm-Wind Pit... Too nice a name for a dro-m'Athra den.

String.Source: Learning Blood-Sculpting? Can make some good weapons with it.
String.Dest: Learning Blood-Sculpting? Can make some good weapons with it.

String.Source: The Blood-Stores used to hold all the surplus Blood. Now it holds nothing but dust...
String.Dest: The Blood-Stores used to hold all the surplus Blood. Now it holds nothing but dust...

String.Source: Need Meat soon... Can feel the Blood drying...
String.Dest: Need Meat soon... Can feel the Blood drying...

String.Source: Darkclaw Den's aptly named. Full of vicious beasts.
String.Dest: Darkclaw Den's aptly named. Full of vicious beasts.

String.Source: We're watching you, outsider.
String.Dest: We're watching you, outsider.

String.Source: It convinced that Church hag to share the Blood? It performs the impossible.
String.Dest: It convinced that Church hag to share the Blood? It performs the impossible.

String.Source: None miss that Church hag. We hope the new Priestess is better.
String.Dest: None miss that Church hag. We hope the new Priestess is better.

String.Source: If you're looking for work, Ma'Jaka is hiring sellswords.
String.Dest: If you're looking for work, Ma'Jaka is hiring sellswords.

String.Source: Ma'Jaka hires sellswords to fight the dro-m'Athra. If it has a strong sword arm, the task may suit it.
String.Dest: Ma'Jaka hires sellswords to fight the dro-m'Athra. If it has a strong sword arm, the task may suit it.

String.Source: Captain Glynach is looking for sellswords to help explore the forest. Sounds like suicide to me.
String.Dest: Captain Glynach is looking for sellswords to help explore the forest. Sounds like suicide to me.

String.Source: Glynach seeks sellswords to explore the forest. Any who accept swim in the River of Foolishness.
String.Dest: Glynach seeks sellswords to explore the forest. Any who accept swim in the River of Foolishness.

String.Source: If you're feeling unwell, you should drop by Thorntaker's.
String.Dest: If you're feeling unwell, you should drop by Thorntaker's.

String.Source: If it feels unwell, it should visit Thorntaker's.
String.Dest: If it feels unwell, it should visit Thorntaker's.

String.Source: Looking to arm yourself? Try the Art of Blood-Sculpting.
String.Dest: Looking to arm yourself? Try the Art of Blood-Sculpting.

String.Source: It needs weapons? It should visit the Art of Blood-Sculpting.
String.Dest: It needs weapons? It should visit the Art of Blood-Sculpting.

String.Source: If you need a place to stay, the owner of Desert Delights has rooms for rent.
String.Dest: If you need a place to stay, the owner of Desert Delights has rooms for rent.

String.Source: If it needs lodgings, it should visit Desert Delights.
String.Dest: If it needs lodgings, it should visit Desert Delights.

String.Source: That's a foul-looking blade you've got there. Careful not to prick someone with it.
String.Dest: That's a foul-looking blade you've got there. Careful not to prick someone with it.

String.Source: I tense my scales in concern... It carries a most sinister blade.
String.Dest: I tense my scales in concern... It carries a most sinister blade.

String.Source: That last quake reopened the old shrine below the village. It's a bad omen... that cursed cave was sealed for a reason.
String.Dest: That last quake reopened the old shrine below the village. It's a bad omen... that cursed cave was sealed for a reason.

String.Source: Don't like the looks of that Glassringer woman. Not unusual for mages to drop by, but there's something strange about her.
String.Dest: Don't like the looks of that Glassringer woman. Not unusual for mages to drop by, but there's something strange about her.

String.Source: Glynach has a special task for it. It should seek him out.
String.Dest: Glynach has a special task for it. It should seek him out.

String.Source: Glynach was looking for you. Something about a special job.
String.Dest: Glynach was looking for you. Something about a special job.

String.Source: You should stop by the Church. Ancheta's been looking for you.
String.Dest: You should stop by the Church. Ancheta's been looking for you.

String.Source: Ancheta asks for it. It should go to her.
String.Dest: Ancheta asks for it. It should go to her.

String.Source: Ma'Jaka was just asking about you. Said he had something to discuss.
String.Dest: Ma'Jaka was just asking about you. Said he had something to discuss.

String.Source: Ma'Jaka wishes to speak with it.
String.Dest: Ma'Jaka wishes to speak with it.

String.Source: Ah-Khajat was just looking for you. Something about a job.
String.Dest: Ah-Khajat was just looking for you. Something about a job.

String.Source: Ah-Khajat has a task for it. It should speak with him.
String.Dest: Ah-Khajat has a task for it. It should speak with him.

String.Source: I hear Ancheta up at the Church has been looking for sellswords. Wonder what changed.
String.Dest: I hear Ancheta up at the Church has been looking for sellswords. Wonder what changed.

String.Source: Ancheta seeks to hire sellswords. But who will accept the job?
String.Dest: Ancheta seeks to hire sellswords. But who will accept the job?

String.Source: Cause any trouble and you'll be laboring in Shuna-Jul.
String.Dest: Cause any trouble and you'll be laboring in Shuna-Jul.

String.Source: It causes trouble, it finds itself laboring in Shuna-Jul.
String.Dest: It causes trouble, it finds itself laboring in Shuna-Jul.

String.Source: That terrible storm... It's gone! The Hollow Palace is silent!
String.Dest: That terrible storm... It's gone! The Hollow Palace is silent!

String.Source: Ancheta asked all the guards to find you. Sounds like she needs help with something important.
String.Dest: Ancheta asked all the guards to find you. Sounds like she needs help with something important.

String.Source: Ancheta asks all guards to find it. She has an urgent task for it.
String.Dest: Ancheta asks all guards to find it. She has an urgent task for it.

String.Source: This cave is cursed.
String.Dest: This cave is cursed.

String.Source: The ancient founders built a shrine to some evil power here. Even the greatest mages couldn't destroy it.
String.Dest: The ancient founders built a shrine to some evil power here. Even the greatest mages couldn't destroy it.

String.Source: Ah, you're a wonder.
String.Dest: Ah, you're a wonder.

String.Source: I can make some lovely jewelry with this. It will be a wonderful gift for Anagach.
String.Dest: I can make some lovely jewelry with this. It will be a wonderful gift for Anagach.

String.Source: Thank you again. Here's your pay.
String.Dest: Thank you again. Here's your pay.

String.Source: Being in the Volkihar feels like a fantasy. I still can't believe a girl from a tiny Reach clan would be allowed into Skyrim's oldest clan.
String.Dest: Being in the Volkihar feels like a fantasy. I still can't believe a girl from a tiny Reach clan would be allowed into Skyrim's oldest clan.

String.Source: I'll do whatever I can to help us win this feud. It's the least I can do for the clan that took me in.
String.Dest: I'll do whatever I can to help us win this feud. It's the least I can do for the clan that took me in.

String.Source: I don't dislike spiders, but it'll take some time getting used to living with them on purpose...
String.Dest: I don't dislike spiders, but it'll take some time getting used to living with them on purpose...

String.Source: The clans of the Reach are all taught to fear Dwemer ruins. They're evil places to be avoided at all costs.
String.Dest: The clans of the Reach are all taught to fear Dwemer ruins. They're evil places to be avoided at all costs.

String.Source: So living in one intentionally is a little...
String.Dest: So living in one intentionally is a little...

String.Source: It will take some getting used to.
String.Dest: It will take some getting used to.

String.Source: I get to be in one of Skyrim's strongest clans. The victor of the clan feud. How could I not be thrilled?
String.Dest: I get to be in one of Skyrim's strongest clans. The victor of the clan feud. How could I not be thrilled?

String.Source: I'm so used to sleeping in an actual bed. Sleeping in a coffin will be an adjustment...
String.Dest: I'm so used to sleeping in an actual bed. Sleeping in a coffin will be an adjustment...

String.Source: Energetic as a kitten, but bold as a Senche. Ri'nakkhu and this one were often at the mercy of her playful whims.
String.Dest: Energetic as a kitten, but bold as a Senche. Ri'nakkhu and this one were often at the mercy of her playful whims.

String.Source: The Thalmor's oppression of our people stoked a fire in her soul. She led us in many strikes against them. Many Khajiit owe their lives to her.
String.Dest: The Thalmor's oppression of our people stoked a fire in her soul. She led us in many strikes against them. Many Khajiit owe their lives to her.

String.Source: To become a dro-m'Athra... it is the worst fate any could imagine for her. We must free her soul from Namiira's curse.
String.Dest: To become a dro-m'Athra... it is the worst fate any could imagine for her. We must free her soul from Namiira's curse.

String.Source: Hey, are you alright? Come on, don't die on me after we've gotten this far!
String.Dest: Hey, are you alright? Come on, don't die on me after we've gotten this far!

String.Source: Oh, good, you're alive. Are you okay?
String.Dest: Oh, good, you're alive. Are you okay?

String.Source: Well, we killed that Hist alright. Too bad it was load-bearing.
String.Dest: Well, we killed that Hist alright. Too bad it was load-bearing.

String.Source: The whole cavern collapsed. I barely managed to pull you out after you took a rock to the head.
String.Dest: The whole cavern collapsed. I barely managed to pull you out after you took a rock to the head.

String.Source: Still... I think we did it. Last I saw of the Princess, it looked like she was being sucked back into the Void.
String.Dest: Still... I think we did it. Last I saw of the Princess, it looked like she was being sucked back into the Void.

String.Source: Hey, um...
String.Dest: Hey, um...

String.Source: Look. I know we already did what we came for, but... There's something you should know.
String.Dest: Look. I know we already did what we came for, but... There's something you should know.

String.Source: If you don't mind indulging an old man, might I take a bit more of your time?
String.Dest: If you don't mind indulging an old man, might I take a bit more of your time?

String.Source: Uh... Shadows, more than ghosts, I guess. They're very insubstantial.
String.Dest: Uh... Shadows, more than ghosts, I guess. They're very insubstantial.

String.Source: But yeah, I can sense them. They're indistinct, though. And terrible conversationalists. Just repeating the same words over and over.
String.Dest: But yeah, I can sense them. They're indistinct, though. And terrible conversationalists. Just repeating the same words over and over.

String.Source: Not worth trying to understand them. They're just echoes.
String.Dest: Not worth trying to understand them. They're just echoes.

String.Source: Woah... That's the Hist?!
String.Dest: Woah... That's the Hist?!

String.Source: The Blood is... Hist Sap?
String.Dest: The Blood is... Hist Sap?

String.Source: Huh. It actually makes sense when you think of it. That would explain the Roots...
String.Dest: Huh. It actually makes sense when you think of it. That would explain the Roots...

String.Source: It's kinda scary to think how long-term the daedra's plans are.
String.Dest: It's kinda scary to think how long-term the daedra's plans are.

String.Source: Namira got the Hist moved here in the Merethic Era, knowing it would take until the Fourth Era to fully absorb the needed power?
String.Dest: Namira got the Hist moved here in the Merethic Era, knowing it would take until the Fourth Era to fully absorb the needed power?

String.Source: I can't imagine that kind of patience...
String.Dest: I can't imagine that kind of patience...

String.Source: You know that Vix doll you gave the kids? I keep spotting it in weird places...
String.Dest: You know that Vix doll you gave the kids? I keep spotting it in weird places...

String.Source: The Bloodroots stretch all through this land. Especially so in the forest and swamp.
String.Dest: The Bloodroots stretch all through this land. Especially so in the forest and swamp.

String.Source: That is why the xanmeers are a source of Meat. The Blood flows through them, and the Meat collects it.
String.Dest: That is why the xanmeers are a source of Meat. The Blood flows through them, and the Meat collects it.

String.Source: The others try to find sources by examining where the surface Roots are. But I can hear the voices of the Roots themselves. It is a gift.
String.Dest: The others try to find sources by examining where the surface Roots are. But I can hear the voices of the Roots themselves. It is a gift.

String.Source: No! I will not be stopped! More power... Grant me more power!
String.Dest: No! I will not be stopped! More power... Grant me more power!

String.Source: Oh, do shut up already.
String.Dest: Oh, do shut up already.

String.Source: Even if I remembered my name, it would mean nothing to you.
String.Dest: Even if I remembered my name, it would mean nothing to you.

String.Source: The ones who sealed me here called me the Drowned Queen. It is a sufficient name.
String.Dest: The ones who sealed me here called me the Drowned Queen. It is a sufficient name.

String.Source: He wasn't wrong. I was a master of the Corruptor's magic. If he'd managed to free me, I could certainly have summoned her.
String.Dest: He wasn't wrong. I was a master of the Corruptor's magic. If he'd managed to free me, I could certainly have summoned her.

String.Source: My corpse is sealed in the chambers deep below. The ancient Argonians wished to ensure I could never escape.
String.Dest: My corpse is sealed in the chambers deep below. The ancient Argonians wished to ensure I could never escape.

String.Source: Not that I blame them. I did quite enjoy slaughtering them.
String.Dest: Not that I blame them. I did quite enjoy slaughtering them.

String.Source: It was obvious enough he wouldn't succeed.
String.Dest: It was obvious enough he wouldn't succeed.

String.Source: It would take a team of miners decades to dig deep enough to reach my tomb. A lone madman would never manage it.
String.Dest: It would take a team of miners decades to dig deep enough to reach my tomb. A lone madman would never manage it.

String.Source: Besides, you'd already thoroughly beaten him. All he was doing was disturbing my slumber by waving that staff around.
String.Dest: Besides, you'd already thoroughly beaten him. All he was doing was disturbing my slumber by waving that staff around.

String.Source: The dead are blessed with great patience.
String.Dest: The dead are blessed with great patience.

String.Source: Eventually, someone with sufficient power will liberate me, and I will spread darkness and death once more.
String.Dest: Eventually, someone with sufficient power will liberate me, and I will spread darkness and death once more.

String.Source: Perhaps it will take a millennium. Perhaps ten. It matters not. I am content to slumber until then.
String.Dest: Perhaps it will take a millennium. Perhaps ten. It matters not. I am content to slumber until then.

String.Source: You need not be concerned about me. I pose you no threat.
String.Dest: You need not be concerned about me. I pose you no threat.

String.Source: Take the madman's staff and do as you will. I shall return to my rest.
String.Dest: Take the madman's staff and do as you will. I shall return to my rest.

String.Source: Where are you...
String.Dest: Where are you...

String.Source: I know you're there...
String.Dest: I know you're there...

String.Source: The darkness can't hide you...
String.Dest: The darkness can't hide you...

String.Source: It worked! The Princess is vulnerable! Come on, let's get her!
String.Dest: It worked! The Princess is vulnerable! Come on, let's get her!

String.Source: There! She's weakening!
String.Dest: There! She's weakening!

String.Source: Hit her hard! Don't let her heal the Hist again!
String.Dest: Hit her hard! Don't let her heal the Hist again!

String.Source: Damn it, the Hist is shielding her again! Destroy the eyes, quick!
String.Dest: Damn it, the Hist is shielding her again! Destroy the eyes, quick!

String.Source: One more time, we can do this! Destroy those eyes!
String.Dest: One more time, we can do this! Destroy those eyes!

String.Source: ...This is kinda weird, isn't it?
String.Dest: ...This is kinda weird, isn't it?

String.Source: Is this what it's like to discover a long-lost sibling?
String.Dest: Is this what it's like to discover a long-lost sibling?

String.Source: Well, um... Thanks for the help.
String.Dest: Well, um... Thanks for the help.

String.Source: Gggk.
String.Dest: Gggk.

String.Source: Do you have a name?
String.Dest: Do you have a name?

String.Source: Hhhgkk.
String.Dest: Hhhgkk.

String.Source: Vix... Huh, okay.
String.Dest: Vix... Huh, okay.

String.Source: Well, she helped kill Rukar, and she's not doing anything to us.
String.Dest: Well, she helped kill Rukar, and she's not doing anything to us.

String.Source: Maybe we should take her with us? I'd feel kinda bad leaving her here.
String.Dest: Maybe we should take her with us? I'd feel kinda bad leaving her here.

String.Source: This one cannot rent the same room twice. Perhaps you should go sleep.
String.Dest: This one cannot rent the same room twice. Perhaps you should go sleep.

String.Source: This one does not get much demand for beds, but this one still cannot give them away for free.
String.Dest: This one does not get much demand for beds, but this one still cannot give them away for free.

String.Source: Of course, walker. It's yours for the night.
String.Dest: Of course, walker. It's yours for the night.

String.Source: Forgive me. My words carry more meaning than they should.
String.Dest: Forgive me. My words carry more meaning than they should.

String.Source: Pay me no mind.
String.Dest: Pay me no mind.

String.Source: Such an odd question. Do you also ask the nature of the sun or the purpose of a mirror?
String.Dest: Such an odd question. Do you also ask the nature of the sun or the purpose of a mirror?

String.Source: I am a Glassringer. What more explanation is needed?
String.Dest: I am a Glassringer. What more explanation is needed?

String.Source: If you believe the Nords of Markarth, all Reachfolk are Forsworn now. But the clans of the Reach are as varied as any other peoples.
String.Dest: If you believe the Nords of Markarth, all Reachfolk are Forsworn now. But the clans of the Reach are as varied as any other peoples.

String.Source: Many support the Forsworn, but many others see them as madmen. To reclaim our ancestral homeland, they are willing to betray our history.
String.Dest: Many support the Forsworn, but many others see them as madmen. To reclaim our ancestral homeland, they are willing to betray our history.

String.Source: The Forsworn invoke dark spirits, long-forgotten evils from the depths of the Reach. Even if they drive out the Nords, the Reach will be lost to us.
String.Dest: The Forsworn invoke dark spirits, long-forgotten evils from the depths of the Reach. Even if they drive out the Nords, the Reach will be lost to us.

String.Source: The Old Blood is the Blood of Lorkh, the essence of creation itself.
String.Dest: The Old Blood is the Blood of Lorkh, the essence of creation itself.

String.Source: By taking it into ourselves, we become closer to the ancient spirits. The Church is in charge of ensuring we all have enough Blood.
String.Dest: By taking it into ourselves, we become closer to the ancient spirits. The Church is in charge of ensuring we all have enough Blood.

String.Source: Are you mocking us? Ancheta says you're the one who discovered what the Blood really was.
String.Dest: Are you mocking us? Ancheta says you're the one who discovered what the Blood really was.

String.Source: To think we've been manipulated by some mutant tree for thousands of years... It sickens me.
String.Dest: To think we've been manipulated by some mutant tree for thousands of years... It sickens me.

String.Source: I don't know what we'll do now. The Blood was everything to us.
String.Dest: I don't know what we'll do now. The Blood was everything to us.

String.Source: When someone has taken enough of the Old Blood into themselves, they become reliant on it. If they stop taking it after that...
String.Dest: When someone has taken enough of the Old Blood into themselves, they become reliant on it. If they stop taking it after that...

String.Source: They go mad. It's said the Blood they've already ingested solidifies in their veins, turning them into maddened fiends.
String.Dest: They go mad. It's said the Blood they've already ingested solidifies in their veins, turning them into maddened fiends.

String.Source: There's no cure. Drybloods are worse than vampires. Nothing but crazed monsters.
String.Dest: There's no cure. Drybloods are worse than vampires. Nothing but crazed monsters.

String.Source: Meat from the mines helps stave off the effects for a while, but only continuing to ingest the Blood can truly prevent it.
String.Dest: Meat from the mines helps stave off the effects for a while, but only continuing to ingest the Blood can truly prevent it.

String.Source: We all have problems with the guards. It's Carries-the-Meat who deals with it the most.
String.Dest: We all have problems with the guards. It's Carries-the-Meat who deals with it the most.

String.Source: But he's too polite to complain, so I do it for him. But if it wants to help, have him tell the details. I have work to do.
String.Dest: But he's too polite to complain, so I do it for him. But if it wants to help, have him tell the details. I have work to do.

String.Source: Monsters? What did they look like?
String.Dest: Monsters? What did they look like?

String.Source: Hm. Those sound like the Shades we see in the forest sometimes, but I've never seen them anywhere else.
String.Dest: Hm. Those sound like the Shades we see in the forest sometimes, but I've never seen them anywhere else.

String.Source: And they managed to reach Twisted Root without anyone seeing it? That doesn't seem possible... Could there be another entrance?
String.Dest: And they managed to reach Twisted Root without anyone seeing it? That doesn't seem possible... Could there be another entrance?

String.Source: Thank you for telling me. I'll need to investigate this further.
String.Dest: Thank you for telling me. I'll need to investigate this further.

String.Source: Ha! I'm sure she did. That harlot won't be satisfied until she squeezes every drop of life from us!
String.Dest: Ha! I'm sure she did. That harlot won't be satisfied until she squeezes every drop of life from us!

String.Source: I mean that we already give the village all the Meat we can! There are barely enough scraps left over for us to stave off becoming Drybloods!
String.Dest: I mean that we already give the village all the Meat we can! There are barely enough scraps left over for us to stave off becoming Drybloods!

String.Source: The Priestess thinks she can simply demand more from us and have it magically appear at her doorstep. Our suffering means nothing to her.
String.Dest: The Priestess thinks she can simply demand more from us and have it magically appear at her doorstep. Our suffering means nothing to her.

String.Source: We dig the Meat from the xanmeers throughout the swamp. This is a dangerous task already - there is always the threat of traps and tunnel collapses.
String.Dest: We dig the Meat from the xanmeers throughout the swamp. This is a dangerous task already - there is always the threat of traps and tunnel collapses.

String.Source: But now monsters have appeared within the xanmeers as well. Many good miners have died. We cannot dig in these conditions.
String.Dest: But now monsters have appeared within the xanmeers as well. Many good miners have died. We cannot dig in these conditions.

String.Source: If it thinks itself capable, certainly. None of the guards that attempted it survived.
String.Dest: If it thinks itself capable, certainly. None of the guards that attempted it survived.

String.Source: This key will unlock the main entrance to the Mines. We sealed it to keep the monsters contained.
String.Dest: This key will unlock the main entrance to the Mines. We sealed it to keep the monsters contained.

String.Source: If it dies, try to do it somewhere where we can salvage that key from its corpse.
String.Dest: If it dies, try to do it somewhere where we can salvage that key from its corpse.

String.Source: The ancient ones who first came to this land. The Saxhleel have dwelled in this realm since before the coming of the Hollow Princess.
String.Dest: The ancient ones who first came to this land. The Saxhleel have dwelled in this realm since before the coming of the Hollow Princess.

String.Source: We do not often think of history, but Lizka-Rosh may be able to tell it more.
String.Dest: We do not often think of history, but Lizka-Rosh may be able to tell it more.

String.Source: Truly? This is wondrous news.
String.Dest: Truly? This is wondrous news.

String.Source: I will send the miners to confirm this immediately. I erect the spine of gratitude.
String.Dest: I will send the miners to confirm this immediately. I erect the spine of gratitude.

String.Source: There is still a problem, however.
String.Dest: There is still a problem, however.

String.Source: Simply removing the monsters does not mean we will immediately have enough Meat. It will take some time to dig enough.
String.Dest: Simply removing the monsters does not mean we will immediately have enough Meat. It will take some time to dig enough.

String.Source: It can tell the Priestess that we will deliver more once we've mined enough, but she will not accept this. She will want it now.
String.Dest: It can tell the Priestess that we will deliver more once we've mined enough, but she will not accept this. She will want it now.

String.Source: We would have to give it almost the entirety of our stores.
String.Dest: We would have to give it almost the entirety of our stores.

String.Source: It would not doom us outright now that more Meat can be collected, but we would still suffer. The weaker among us would surely become Drybloods.
String.Dest: It would not doom us outright now that more Meat can be collected, but we would still suffer. The weaker among us would surely become Drybloods.

String.Source: I offer an alternative. I will send a messenger to the Church promising that more Meat will arrive soon. With luck, the Priestess will accept it.
String.Dest: I offer an alternative. I will send a messenger to the Church promising that more Meat will arrive soon. With luck, the Priestess will accept it.

String.Source: But since she surely will not consider that worth letting it into the Church, I will show it an alternate way in.
String.Dest: But since she surely will not consider that worth letting it into the Church, I will show it an alternate way in.

String.Source: We know of one. We have not used it yet.
String.Dest: We know of one. We have not used it yet.

String.Source: In truth, we considered raiding the Church and stealing the Blood if she continued to ignore our pleas for help against the monsters.
String.Dest: In truth, we considered raiding the Church and stealing the Blood if she continued to ignore our pleas for help against the monsters.

String.Source: But now that the monsters have been stopped, we have no need for it.
String.Dest: But now that the monsters have been stopped, we have no need for it.

String.Source: What does it say? Let us keep our stores of Meat, and sneak into the Church?
String.Dest: What does it say? Let us keep our stores of Meat, and sneak into the Church?

String.Source: It is a relief to hear this decision.
String.Dest: It is a relief to hear this decision.

String.Source: Here. This key will unlock all doors in the Church. Do not ask how I obtained it.
String.Dest: Here. This key will unlock all doors in the Church. Do not ask how I obtained it.

String.Source: Go to the old Blood-Stores. There is a disused door there leading to the cellar. It can reach the belltower from there.
String.Dest: Go to the old Blood-Stores. There is a disused door there leading to the cellar. It can reach the belltower from there.

String.Source: What does it think to offer us? We cannot give what we do not have, and the monsters keep us from mining more.
String.Dest: What does it think to offer us? We cannot give what we do not have, and the monsters keep us from mining more.

String.Source: Keh. I will not refuse after what it does for us. I only hope it understands the consequences of its decision.
String.Dest: Keh. I will not refuse after what it does for us. I only hope it understands the consequences of its decision.

String.Source: Fine. Tell that harlot the Meat arrives shortly. I hope she chokes on it.
String.Dest: Fine. Tell that harlot the Meat arrives shortly. I hope she chokes on it.

String.Source: Very well. I hope it makes the right choice.
String.Dest: Very well. I hope it makes the right choice.

String.Source: You're continuing Duraeg's work in his memory? Quite noble of you.
String.Dest: You're continuing Duraeg's work in his memory? Quite noble of you.

String.Source: Duraeg was a good man. His death was a true loss to the village.
String.Dest: Duraeg was a good man. His death was a true loss to the village.

String.Source: I hope he and Lailani can reunite in the next life.
String.Dest: I hope he and Lailani can reunite in the next life.

String.Source: Duraeg's daughter. The poor child was slain by Drybloods last year.
String.Dest: Duraeg's daughter. The poor child was slain by Drybloods last year.

String.Source: That's her grave outside the entrance to Duraeg's home. I try to pay my respects whenever I'm able.
String.Dest: That's her grave outside the entrance to Duraeg's home. I try to pay my respects whenever I'm able.

String.Source: Now I'll be paying my respects to Duraeg as well. Too many good souls have perished of late...
String.Dest: Now I'll be paying my respects to Duraeg as well. Too many good souls have perished of late...

String.Source: Thank you for bringing this to me, friend. It should prove most interesting to study.
String.Dest: Thank you for bringing this to me, friend. It should prove most interesting to study.

String.Source: And thank you for honoring my late friend's wishes. Duraeg had a hard life, especially after the tragic death of his daughter Lailani.
String.Dest: And thank you for honoring my late friend's wishes. Duraeg had a hard life, especially after the tragic death of his daughter Lailani.

String.Source: I hope his spirit will rest more peacefully now.
String.Dest: I hope his spirit will rest more peacefully now.

String.Source: Ah, she involves others in our troubles now? Well, it is true.
String.Dest: Ah, she involves others in our troubles now? Well, it is true.

String.Source: It is one of the guards who monitors the border between the swamp and desert. They refuse to allow us to pass without a bribe of Meat.
String.Dest: It is one of the guards who monitors the border between the swamp and desert. They refuse to allow us to pass without a bribe of Meat.

String.Source: This escalates tensions with the village. Now the small amount of Meat we can supply them is even less.
String.Dest: This escalates tensions with the village. Now the small amount of Meat we can supply them is even less.

String.Source: If we resist, the guards will stop protecting us. There is nothing we can do. But it is an outsider - perhaps its words will be more persuasive.
String.Dest: If we resist, the guards will stop protecting us. There is nothing we can do. But it is an outsider - perhaps its words will be more persuasive.

String.Source: Thank you, walker. This one appreciates your time.
String.Dest: Thank you, walker. This one appreciates your time.

String.Source: The dried Roots offer little blood, but this one can stew them to make the most of it.
String.Dest: The dried Roots offer little blood, but this one can stew them to make the most of it.

String.Source: Hah! They're asking outsiders for pity now?
String.Dest: Hah! They're asking outsiders for pity now?

String.Source: We risk our lives to defend them from the Drybloods, and they can't even give us enough Meat to keep ourselves from going Dryblood, too!
String.Dest: We risk our lives to defend them from the Drybloods, and they can't even give us enough Meat to keep ourselves from going Dryblood, too!

String.Source: If those lazy lizards would just put in the same work that the rest of us do, we wouldn't have any trouble.
String.Dest: If those lazy lizards would just put in the same work that the rest of us do, we wouldn't have any trouble.

String.Source: All I'm doing is making sure I get enough to keep myself going. So you go back and tell those lizards to stop complaining.
String.Dest: All I'm doing is making sure I get enough to keep myself going. So you go back and tell those lizards to stop complaining.

String.Source: Not to alarm you, but the door just disappeared.
String.Dest: Not to alarm you, but the door just disappeared.

String.Source: The only source of tension is the Blood shortage. The miners demand more Blood rations from the Church, and the Church demands more Meat.
String.Dest: The only source of tension is the Blood shortage. The miners demand more Blood rations from the Church, and the Church demands more Meat.

String.Source: Unless an agreement can be reached, the miners and Church may come to blows. In that case, the villagers would likely side with the Church.
String.Dest: Unless an agreement can be reached, the miners and Church may come to blows. In that case, the villagers would likely side with the Church.

String.Source: Let us hope the issue is resolved before that happens.
String.Dest: Let us hope the issue is resolved before that happens.

String.Source: With the shortage of Meat resolved, hopefully matters will not escalate further.
String.Dest: With the shortage of Meat resolved, hopefully matters will not escalate further.

String.Source: Ancheta has always been more sympathetic to the miners than her predecessor. This one hopes that she will improve relations now.
String.Dest: Ancheta has always been more sympathetic to the miners than her predecessor. This one hopes that she will improve relations now.

String.Source: It is hard to imagine a hopeful future. I will try.
String.Dest: It is hard to imagine a hopeful future. I will try.
