String.Source: I hope it proves worth the danger.
String.Dest: I hope it proves worth the danger.

String.Source: Slowly going insane.
String.Dest: Slowly going insane.

String.Source: I joke, but... that is how it felt. Imagine nobody else acknowledges your existence, no matter what you do.
String.Dest: I joke, but... that is how it felt. Imagine nobody else acknowledges your existence, no matter what you do.

String.Source: I tried everything at first. Moving objects, casting spells, outright grabbing people. It was like their minds just... edited me out.
String.Dest: I tried everything at first. Moving objects, casting spells, outright grabbing people. It was like their minds just... edited me out.

String.Source: After the second year I gave up. I just... watched. Pretended everything was a show and I was the audience.
String.Dest: After the second year I gave up. I just... watched. Pretended everything was a show and I was the audience.

String.Source: Imagine my shock when you actually responded to my commentary.
String.Dest: Imagine my shock when you actually responded to my commentary.

String.Source: I tried, but... I can't.
String.Dest: I tried, but... I can't.

String.Source: I can't seem to leave the Old Lands. I'm... tied to it somehow.
String.Dest: I can't seem to leave the Old Lands. I'm... tied to it somehow.

String.Source: Maybe if I get stronger - get more magic or something - I'll be able to leave. I'll definitely keep trying.
String.Dest: Maybe if I get stronger - get more magic or something - I'll be able to leave. I'll definitely keep trying.

String.Source: Yes. There's a breach in reality here.
String.Dest: Yes. There's a breach in reality here.

String.Source: I can sense another location overlapping with this one. Should I move us there?
String.Dest: I can sense another location overlapping with this one. Should I move us there?

String.Source: Okay. Let me know when you're ready.
String.Dest: Okay. Let me know when you're ready.

String.Source: Okay. Brace yourself... Hah!
String.Dest: Okay. Brace yourself... Hah!

String.Source: Okay. Brace yourself... Hah!
String.Dest: Okay. Brace yourself... Hah!

String.Source: Good. They will not stay dead forever, but each death still pains them.
String.Dest: Good. They will not stay dead forever, but each death still pains them.

String.Source: You are a skilled hunter. If you plan to continue fighting the Bent Cats, this one would like to accompany you.
String.Dest: You are a skilled hunter. If you plan to continue fighting the Bent Cats, this one would like to accompany you.

String.Source: You could put it that way.
String.Dest: You could put it that way.

String.Source: People who've adapted to the Blood don't need food in the way other mortals do. Blood and Meat are enough to stay alive.
String.Dest: People who've adapted to the Blood don't need food in the way other mortals do. Blood and Meat are enough to stay alive.

String.Source: But folks still want variety and flavor. When they get the craving for real food, they come to me.
String.Dest: But folks still want variety and flavor. When they get the craving for real food, they come to me.

String.Source: Believe it or not, I used to work in Markarth. I was a chef at the Silver-Blood Inn.
String.Dest: Believe it or not, I used to work in Markarth. I was a chef at the Silver-Blood Inn.

String.Source: Then the situation there started to escalate. I had to choose between my city and my people.
String.Dest: Then the situation there started to escalate. I had to choose between my city and my people.

String.Source: Considered joining the Forsworn, but I couldn't agree with their methods. Our ancestors wouldn't want that sort of slaughter.
String.Dest: Considered joining the Forsworn, but I couldn't agree with their methods. Our ancestors wouldn't want that sort of slaughter.

String.Source: Happened to run across a Khajiit caravan on their way to trade with the Old Lands. I offered my services in exchange for transport and ended up here.
String.Dest: Happened to run across a Khajiit caravan on their way to trade with the Old Lands. I offered my services in exchange for transport and ended up here.

String.Source: Azzah-Ko is decent at getting things we need from traders. Usually, at least.
String.Dest: Azzah-Ko is decent at getting things we need from traders. Usually, at least.

String.Source: Of course, the Khajiit caravans overcharge us. They know they're our only suppliers.
String.Dest: Of course, the Khajiit caravans overcharge us. They know they're our only suppliers.

String.Source: Oh! Forgive me, friend. I didn't realize we were investigating the same matter.
String.Dest: Oh! Forgive me, friend. I didn't realize we were investigating the same matter.

String.Source: Permit me to repeat my introduction, then. Capiton Esdrescus, loyal scout for the Cyrodiil Vampyrum Order, at your service.
String.Dest: Permit me to repeat my introduction, then. Capiton Esdrescus, loyal scout for the Cyrodiil Vampyrum Order, at your service.

String.Source: Nothing nefarious, I assure you. We simply seek to ensure that Skyrim's vampire clans are in a stable position.
String.Dest: Nothing nefarious, I assure you. We simply seek to ensure that Skyrim's vampire clans are in a stable position.

String.Source: With matters as they are - and I regret that I cannot elaborate further - Tamriel's vampires must be strong.
String.Dest: With matters as they are - and I regret that I cannot elaborate further - Tamriel's vampires must be strong.

String.Source: There is no room for interclan wars. Nor for rampaging bloodfiends attracting the attention of the hunters.
String.Dest: There is no room for interclan wars. Nor for rampaging bloodfiends attracting the attention of the hunters.

String.Source: My purpose in investigating the local vampires - the Voidsuckers - was to ensure that they cannot threaten the stability of Skyrim's clans.
String.Dest: My purpose in investigating the local vampires - the Voidsuckers - was to ensure that they cannot threaten the stability of Skyrim's clans.

String.Source: Not at all! You represent one of the primary stabilizing factors in Skyrim at present. Threats to you threaten our goals as well.
String.Dest: Not at all! You represent one of the primary stabilizing factors in Skyrim at present. Threats to you threaten our goals as well.

String.Source: In fact, your presence here is most welcome. Would you be willing to assist me in completing my mission here?
String.Dest: In fact, your presence here is most welcome. Would you be willing to assist me in completing my mission here?

String.Source: We can ensure that the Voidsuckers will never endanger your position - and give the Vigilants a black eye in the process.
String.Dest: We can ensure that the Voidsuckers will never endanger your position - and give the Vigilants a black eye in the process.

String.Source: Excellent! Just let me know whenever you're ready, and we can begin.
String.Dest: Excellent! Just let me know whenever you're ready, and we can begin.

String.Source: Ah. My apologies, friend.
String.Dest: Ah. My apologies, friend.

String.Source: I'm sure my words mean little, but please rest assured that no malice is intended - by myself or my mistress.
String.Dest: I'm sure my words mean little, but please rest assured that no malice is intended - by myself or my mistress.

String.Source: Manipulation is the lifeblood of our clan - perhaps more so than actual blood!
String.Dest: Manipulation is the lifeblood of our clan - perhaps more so than actual blood!

String.Source: Please, do not take it personally. The Order means no harm to you - your continued success benefits us as well.
String.Dest: Please, do not take it personally. The Order means no harm to you - your continued success benefits us as well.

String.Source: If you're still willing to assist me, it would be appreciated - but I fully understand if you have no desire to help.
String.Dest: If you're still willing to assist me, it would be appreciated - but I fully understand if you have no desire to help.

String.Source: Of course, I understand. I will continue my mission myself then.
String.Dest: Of course, I understand. I will continue my mission myself then.

String.Source: If you change your mind, please let me know. I'll gladly compensate you for your efforts.
String.Dest: If you change your mind, please let me know. I'll gladly compensate you for your efforts.

String.Source: My! You killed that mutant tree, then?
String.Dest: My! You killed that mutant tree, then?

String.Source: Well, that's certainly unexpected, but I'm pleased to hear it. Without the Hist, this realm poses no threat to anyone.
String.Dest: Well, that's certainly unexpected, but I'm pleased to hear it. Without the Hist, this realm poses no threat to anyone.

String.Source: I suppose I'd better complete my research here quickly, before the sap is entirely gone.
String.Dest: I suppose I'd better complete my research here quickly, before the sap is entirely gone.

String.Source: Interesting. Perhaps they sense a larger supply of "Blood" below there?
String.Dest: Interesting. Perhaps they sense a larger supply of "Blood" below there?

String.Source: Well, this presents us an opportunity. If we find a way in first, we can lure the clan's hunters there and ambush them.
String.Dest: Well, this presents us an opportunity. If we find a way in first, we can lure the clan's hunters there and ambush them.

String.Source: With the hunters dealt with, we can assault the Voidsuckers' lair with impunity.
String.Dest: With the hunters dealt with, we can assault the Voidsuckers' lair with impunity.

String.Source: So... we're working for a Void Spirit. This can't end well.
String.Dest: So... we're working for a Void Spirit. This can't end well.

String.Source: I've never spoken with her personally, if that's what you mean.
String.Dest: I've never spoken with her personally, if that's what you mean.

String.Source: But I've heard of her. She's what's called a "Greater Void Spirit" - one of the Void entities powerful enough to enter reality.
String.Dest: But I've heard of her. She's what's called a "Greater Void Spirit" - one of the Void entities powerful enough to enter reality.

String.Source: Though "Greater" might not be the right word. The really powerful Void entities wouldn't enter reality - they'd unmake it just by noticing it.
String.Dest: Though "Greater" might not be the right word. The really powerful Void entities wouldn't enter reality - they'd unmake it just by noticing it.

String.Source: Hm. Kinda, I guess.
String.Dest: Hm. Kinda, I guess.

String.Source: The Void Spirits aren't daedra per se. Oblivion, alien as it is to mortals, is still part of the overall Aurbis - part of reality. The Void... isn't.
String.Dest: The Void Spirits aren't daedra per se. Oblivion, alien as it is to mortals, is still part of the overall Aurbis - part of reality. The Void... isn't.

String.Source: But most of the Void entities that manage to enter the Aurbis either end up serving a Daedric Prince - those are the Lesser Void Spirits, or they...
String.Dest: But most of the Void entities that manage to enter the Aurbis either end up serving a Daedric Prince - those are the Lesser Void Spirits, or they...

String.Source: Well, or they're like Kalarix Brood. Strong enough to claim a plane of Oblivion for themselves. So more of a Daedric Lord than a Daedric Prince.
String.Dest: Well, or they're like Kalarix Brood. Strong enough to claim a plane of Oblivion for themselves. So more of a Daedric Lord than a Daedric Prince.

String.Source: All Princes are Lords, but not all Lords are Princes, I guess?
String.Dest: All Princes are Lords, but not all Lords are Princes, I guess?

String.Source: If you want an overly simplified view of it, you could say Lords are the rank below Princes.
String.Dest: If you want an overly simplified view of it, you could say Lords are the rank below Princes.

String.Source: They've still got their own planes of Oblivion, their own artifacts, stuff like that. But they don't have the influence the Princes do.
String.Dest: They've still got their own planes of Oblivion, their own artifacts, stuff like that. But they don't have the influence the Princes do.

String.Source: For example, Hircine rules over everything involving the Hunt, but he also delegates some fish-related stuff to the Lord of Fishing.
String.Dest: For example, Hircine rules over everything involving the Hunt, but he also delegates some fish-related stuff to the Lord of Fishing.

String.Source: So while you've only got a few Princes, there's room for tons of Lords. Hollowjack, Fa-Nuit-Hen, Zaltakh-Fen, et cetera.
String.Dest: So while you've only got a few Princes, there's room for tons of Lords. Hollowjack, Fa-Nuit-Hen, Zaltakh-Fen, et cetera.

String.Source: Since she claimed a plane of Oblivion for herself after entering the Aurbis, you could consider Kalarix Brood an honorary Lord.
String.Dest: Since she claimed a plane of Oblivion for herself after entering the Aurbis, you could consider Kalarix Brood an honorary Lord.

String.Source: Oh, Gods, no.
String.Dest: Oh, Gods, no.

String.Source: I've heard of at least eleven, and there's probably way more. But, for all we know, there could be more Daedric Princes, too, right?
String.Dest: I've heard of at least eleven, and there's probably way more. But, for all we know, there could be more Daedric Princes, too, right?

String.Source: It's one of those topics that isn't really safe to discuss; you know? No way to know what's listening.
String.Dest: It's one of those topics that isn't really safe to discuss; you know? No way to know what's listening.

String.Source: Certainly. Usually I would conceal my true allegiance. However, the note contains a coded message from my mistress.
String.Dest: Certainly. Usually I would conceal my true allegiance. However, the note contains a coded message from my mistress.

String.Source: It instructs me to be honest with you about my position in the Order. And, as a loyal servant, I will do as ordered.
String.Dest: It instructs me to be honest with you about my position in the Order. And, as a loyal servant, I will do as ordered.

String.Source: The only real "clan" you'll find in the Old Lands. But they're all utterly insane - they even try to feed on other vampires!
String.Dest: The only real "clan" you'll find in the Old Lands. But they're all utterly insane - they even try to feed on other vampires!

String.Source: Their lair is somewhere in the forest. They're one of the reasons we can't search for new Blood sources there - as if the monsters weren't enough.
String.Dest: Their lair is somewhere in the forest. They're one of the reasons we can't search for new Blood sources there - as if the monsters weren't enough.

String.Source: I don't know much else about them. They claim they come from some ancient clan called the Nighthollow, but I can't say I ever heard of that clan.
String.Dest: I don't know much else about them. They claim they come from some ancient clan called the Nighthollow, but I can't say I ever heard of that clan.

String.Source: Better to just avoid them. They see everyone as prey, nothing more.
String.Dest: Better to just avoid them. They see everyone as prey, nothing more.

String.Source: It is. The Blood of a God can take many forms.
String.Dest: It is. The Blood of a God can take many forms.

String.Source: The Old Blood is Lorkh's Blood in the purest sense - the Blood He shed at the moment he created the world in the space Namira gave him.
String.Dest: The Old Blood is Lorkh's Blood in the purest sense - the Blood He shed at the moment he created the world in the space Namira gave him.

String.Source: Ebony is tainted Blood. It's the Blood left over after his Heart was torn out.
String.Dest: Ebony is tainted Blood. It's the Blood left over after his Heart was torn out.

String.Source: Both have their uses, of course. But only the Old Blood can help us to ascend.
String.Dest: Both have their uses, of course. But only the Old Blood can help us to ascend.

String.Source: She did. And I... I'm not sure.
String.Dest: She did. And I... I'm not sure.

String.Source: It's a shocking thing to realize. That everything you ever believed was all the trick of some evil spirits.
String.Dest: It's a shocking thing to realize. That everything you ever believed was all the trick of some evil spirits.

String.Source: It will take time to accept. And even longer to figure out what to do next.
String.Dest: It will take time to accept. And even longer to figure out what to do next.

String.Source: But Thorntaker says he can help cure us of the Dryblood curse now that he knows the cause. At least there is hope there.
String.Dest: But Thorntaker says he can help cure us of the Dryblood curse now that he knows the cause. At least there is hope there.

String.Source: After that... I suppose we'll see.
String.Dest: After that... I suppose we'll see.

String.Source: The full details are a little confusing, so I'll just tell you the basics for now. I can explain the rest later.
String.Dest: The full details are a little confusing, so I'll just tell you the basics for now. I can explain the rest later.

String.Source: As you can probably guess, I'm not a natural being. I - or at least this body - was created by a mage. My purpose is to be a "Vessel" for the Void.
String.Dest: As you can probably guess, I'm not a natural being. I - or at least this body - was created by a mage. My purpose is to be a "Vessel" for the Void.

String.Source: When I was created, the mage gave me an instruction: to find a way to reach the source of the Old Blood, destroy it, and absorb its power.
String.Dest: When I was created, the mage gave me an instruction: to find a way to reach the source of the Old Blood, destroy it, and absorb its power.

String.Source: He also ordered me to not speak of my purpose. If I tried to tell you anything, his spell would prevent it.
String.Dest: He also ordered me to not speak of my purpose. If I tried to tell you anything, his spell would prevent it.

String.Source: His plan was probably what you'd expect: use me to collect the energy of the Dark Heart, then use that power to conquer the world.
String.Dest: His plan was probably what you'd expect: use me to collect the energy of the Dark Heart, then use that power to conquer the world.

String.Source: It's a bit more complex than that, really. But the details aren't what matters. The point is this: he made one mistake.
String.Dest: It's a bit more complex than that, really. But the details aren't what matters. The point is this: he made one mistake.

String.Source: Well, two. The first is, he didn't realize that absorbing that mutant Hist's power would make me strong enough to defy his command.
String.Dest: Well, two. The first is, he didn't realize that absorbing that mutant Hist's power would make me strong enough to defy his command.

String.Source: The other... Well, I guess he didn't expect that I'd enjoy traveling with you.
String.Dest: The other... Well, I guess he didn't expect that I'd enjoy traveling with you.

String.Source: Too bad for him. If I'm going to hold onto this power, I'd rather you get access to it instead of a self-obsessed lunatic.
String.Dest: Too bad for him. If I'm going to hold onto this power, I'd rather you get access to it instead of a self-obsessed lunatic.

String.Source: His plan was probably what you'd expect: use me to collect the energy of the Dark Heart, then use that power to conquer the world.
String.Dest: His plan was probably what you'd expect: use me to collect the energy of the Dark Heart, then use that power to conquer the world.

String.Source: It's a bit more complex than that, really. But the details aren't what matters. The point is this: he made one mistake.
String.Dest: It's a bit more complex than that, really. But the details aren't what matters. The point is this: he made one mistake.

String.Source: He didn't realize that absorbing that mutant Hist's power would make me strong enough to defy his command.
String.Dest: He didn't realize that absorbing that mutant Hist's power would make me strong enough to defy his command.

String.Source: Too bad for him. He doesn't deserve that power any more than the Hollow Princess did.
String.Dest: Too bad for him. He doesn't deserve that power any more than the Hollow Princess did.

String.Source: We've been through a lot already, but... Can I ask you for this last favor?
String.Dest: We've been through a lot already, but... Can I ask you for this last favor?

String.Source: Please. Help me defeat my creator. I finally have the power to seek my own path... and someone I want to travel with.
String.Dest: Please. Help me defeat my creator. I finally have the power to seek my own path... and someone I want to travel with.

String.Source: If we don't... He'll probably come after you anyway. He'll see you as a threat to his plans.
String.Dest: If we don't... He'll probably come after you anyway. He'll see you as a threat to his plans.

String.Source: I'm sure you're eager to be done with this, but I won't be satisfied until he's dead... and I'm free.
String.Dest: I'm sure you're eager to be done with this, but I won't be satisfied until he's dead... and I'm free.

String.Source: But I can't fully resist him. I still need your help to kill him.
String.Dest: But I can't fully resist him. I still need your help to kill him.

String.Source: If we don't... He'll probably come after you anyway. He'll see you as a threat to his plans.
String.Dest: If we don't... He'll probably come after you anyway. He'll see you as a threat to his plans.

String.Source: The problem is... I can't just leave. I might be able to resist his commands for now, but once he realizes I'm not returning, he'll react.
String.Dest: The problem is... I can't just leave. I might be able to resist his commands for now, but once he realizes I'm not returning, he'll react.

String.Source: He could very well find a way to regain control over me. Barring that, he could send his minions after me.
String.Dest: He could very well find a way to regain control over me. Barring that, he could send his minions after me.

String.Source: Hehe. Thank you.
String.Dest: Hehe. Thank you.

String.Source: Let's put an end to this. Once I'm free, we can travel together for real.
String.Dest: Let's put an end to this. Once I'm free, we can travel together for real.

String.Source: Heh... No, I suppose not.
String.Dest: Heh... No, I suppose not.

String.Source: Well... Once this is over, we can go our separate ways. If that's what you want.
String.Dest: Well... Once this is over, we can go our separate ways. If that's what you want.

String.Source: Heheh. Good guess, but nope.
String.Dest: Heheh. Good guess, but nope.

String.Source: But before that... Truth is, the mage is someone you've met. And trust me, being unable to call him out was painful.
String.Dest: But before that... Truth is, the mage is someone you've met. And trust me, being unable to call him out was painful.

String.Source: Any guess who it is?
String.Dest: Any guess who it is?

String.Source: Well, I'll tell you either way. I'm just curious if you noticed already.
String.Dest: Well, I'll tell you either way. I'm just curious if you noticed already.

String.Source: Heh. I should have known you'd already realized.
String.Dest: Heh. I should have known you'd already realized.

String.Source: He was trying a bit too hard to sell you on the idea that this was the only way to save everyone, huh?
String.Dest: He was trying a bit too hard to sell you on the idea that this was the only way to save everyone, huh?

String.Source: Well, I appreciate you playing along. It gives us the chance to surprise him.
String.Dest: Well, I appreciate you playing along. It gives us the chance to surprise him.

String.Source: Shall we return to the village? With luck, we can catch him off guard.
String.Dest: Shall we return to the village? With luck, we can catch him off guard.

String.Source: Of course, we need to get out of here first. Let's see...
String.Dest: Of course, we need to get out of here first. Let's see...

String.Source: This will be a good test of the magic I absorbed.
String.Dest: This will be a good test of the magic I absorbed.

String.Source: I should be able to make a portal back to the village. Let's give it a try...
String.Dest: I should be able to make a portal back to the village. Let's give it a try...

String.Source: What? No. Who the heck even is-?
String.Dest: What? No. Who the heck even is-?

String.Source: Oh. Oh, I get it. You're messing with me.
String.Dest: Oh. Oh, I get it. You're messing with me.

String.Source: Well, I'm glad you still have your sense of humor after taking a rock to the skull.
String.Dest: Well, I'm glad you still have your sense of humor after taking a rock to the skull.

String.Source: It's Rukar. The so-called "old hunter." Or, as he actually calls himself, the Void Mage.
String.Dest: It's Rukar. The so-called "old hunter." Or, as he actually calls himself, the Void Mage.

String.Source: His real goal has nothing to do with helping the villagers. All he wants is power.
String.Dest: His real goal has nothing to do with helping the villagers. All he wants is power.

String.Source: He thinks he can use the magic I've absorbed in a ritual to make himself a god. And I'm not too eager to see him do that.
String.Dest: He thinks he can use the magic I've absorbed in a ritual to make himself a god. And I'm not too eager to see him do that.

String.Source: Well, if we're going to stop him, we should get back to the village. Let's see...
String.Dest: Well, if we're going to stop him, we should get back to the village. Let's see...

String.Source: Right. This... might take a while. Do you want the full story now?
String.Dest: Right. This... might take a while. Do you want the full story now?

String.Source: Thought so. We've got more important things to deal with.
String.Dest: Thought so. We've got more important things to deal with.

String.Source: Alright, I'll do my best to make this make sense. Bear with me; okay?
String.Dest: Alright, I'll do my best to make this make sense. Bear with me; okay?

String.Source: Rukar's whole plan is based on the idea of Numidium. The Brass Tower of the Dwemer - the mechanical god powered by the Heart of Lorkhan.
String.Dest: Rukar's whole plan is based on the idea of Numidium. The Brass Tower of the Dwemer - the mechanical god powered by the Heart of Lorkhan.

String.Source: It was said that Numidium was powerful enough that its very voice could reshape reality.
String.Dest: It was said that Numidium was powerful enough that its very voice could reshape reality.

String.Source: Imagine yelling "No" so forcefully that whatever you yell it at ceases to exist. If you believe the story, that was the power of Numidium.
String.Dest: Imagine yelling "No" so forcefully that whatever you yell it at ceases to exist. If you believe the story, that was the power of Numidium.

String.Source: But Rukar figured that there was a flaw in Numidium - the reason the Dwemer disappeared. The issue was the power source.
String.Dest: But Rukar figured that there was a flaw in Numidium - the reason the Dwemer disappeared. The issue was the power source.

String.Source: The Heart of Lorkhan was the power of creation. Of "Maybe." But the Dwemer were inherently nihilistic. Rukar figured there was a mismatch there.
String.Dest: The Heart of Lorkhan was the power of creation. Of "Maybe." But the Dwemer were inherently nihilistic. Rukar figured there was a mismatch there.

String.Source: His idea was that the Dark Heart - the Void left behind when the Heart of Lorkhan was removed - was a better power source.
String.Dest: His idea was that the Dark Heart - the Void left behind when the Heart of Lorkhan was removed - was a better power source.

String.Source: Of course, even if he got the Dark Heart's power, there's the issue that Numidium itself is gone. It disappeared after the Warp in the West.
String.Dest: Of course, even if he got the Dark Heart's power, there's the issue that Numidium itself is gone. It disappeared after the Warp in the West.

String.Source: So Rukar came up with another idea: Mantling.
String.Dest: So Rukar came up with another idea: Mantling.

String.Source: It's an esoteric theory. The concept is "Walk like them until they walk like you."
String.Dest: It's an esoteric theory. The concept is "Walk like them until they walk like you."

String.Source: Basically, the idea is if you become a close enough imitation of something - a god, usually - you can "trick" reality into thinking you're it.
String.Dest: Basically, the idea is if you become a close enough imitation of something - a god, usually - you can "trick" reality into thinking you're it.

String.Source: He didn't want to become Numidium, though. He wanted to control one. So... he made me.
String.Dest: He didn't want to become Numidium, though. He wanted to control one. So... he made me.

String.Source: I have no idea what magical processes were involved, but his goal was that I would Mantle Numidium.
String.Dest: I have no idea what magical processes were involved, but his goal was that I would Mantle Numidium.

String.Source: I don't get the metaphysics of what made him think a doll and a brass god were close enough, but he certainly seemed confident.
String.Dest: I don't get the metaphysics of what made him think a doll and a brass god were close enough, but he certainly seemed confident.

String.Source: So, that's what he was after. His own Numidium, powered by the Dark Heart, bound to his will. Reshaping reality as he commands.
String.Dest: So, that's what he was after. His own Numidium, powered by the Dark Heart, bound to his will. Reshaping reality as he commands.

String.Source: I doubt it. I certainly don't feel like a Numidium. Whatever that feels like.
String.Dest: I doubt it. I certainly don't feel like a Numidium. Whatever that feels like.

String.Source: But who knows. Maybe the plan was to do some additional adjustments to me once I got the Dark Heart's power.
String.Dest: But who knows. Maybe the plan was to do some additional adjustments to me once I got the Dark Heart's power.

String.Source: Either way, he'd at least have had enough power to make sure a lot of people suffered and died. That's bad enough.
String.Dest: Either way, he'd at least have had enough power to make sure a lot of people suffered and died. That's bad enough.

String.Source: Well, that's the gist of his plan. Hopefully it made some sense.
String.Dest: Well, that's the gist of his plan. Hopefully it made some sense.

String.Source: To be perfectly honest, I'm not sure.
String.Dest: To be perfectly honest, I'm not sure.

String.Source: But my best guess is, by making this body as a vessel for the Dark Heart, Rukar made it a good host for other things from the Void as well.
String.Dest: But my best guess is, by making this body as a vessel for the Dark Heart, Rukar made it a good host for other things from the Void as well.

String.Source: Because of that, some sort of Void spirit possessed this body and merged with it.
String.Dest: Because of that, some sort of Void spirit possessed this body and merged with it.

String.Source: I can't be sure, though. I already existed like this when my memories began. Whatever spirit I used to be, I've lost any memory of it.
String.Dest: I can't be sure, though. I already existed like this when my memories began. Whatever spirit I used to be, I've lost any memory of it.

String.Source: And, honestly, I'd... prefer not to think about it. There are things in the Void that are far worse than anything in Oblivion.
String.Dest: And, honestly, I'd... prefer not to think about it. There are things in the Void that are far worse than anything in Oblivion.

String.Source: Things that could unmake reality with their gaze... and worse.
String.Dest: Things that could unmake reality with their gaze... and worse.

String.Source: Obviously, whatever I might be, I'm not anything like that. But I'm worried that if I think too hard about the Void, I might... reach something.
String.Dest: Obviously, whatever I might be, I'm not anything like that. But I'm worried that if I think too hard about the Void, I might... reach something.

String.Source: I'm sure it's not a rational fear, but the idea of accidentally drawing the attention of a more powerful Void entity terrifies me.
String.Dest: I'm sure it's not a rational fear, but the idea of accidentally drawing the attention of a more powerful Void entity terrifies me.

String.Source: So let's just say I'm Audrey and leave it at that. Okay?
String.Dest: So let's just say I'm Audrey and leave it at that. Okay?

String.Source: Frosted spiderweb... ensnare my icy heart and rip it free... Please... the pain!
String.Dest: Frosted spiderweb... ensnare my icy heart and rip it free... Please... the pain!

String.Source: Tellijih... We beg you, restore our time...
String.Dest: Tellijih... We beg you, restore our time...

String.Source: By Shade and swell, dread Sondra Drel did send us Light deserving... Embrace of sun and ice combined to trap us in our yearning...
String.Dest: By Shade and swell, dread Sondra Drel did send us Light deserving... Embrace of sun and ice combined to trap us in our yearning...

String.Source: Icy threads at the seams of my mind... Pull them free, O Radiant Likirani... I am already undone...
String.Dest: Icy threads at the seams of my mind... Pull them free, O Radiant Likirani... I am already undone...

String.Source: Yes, I'm sure you have places to be.
String.Dest: Yes, I'm sure you have places to be.

String.Source: I won't keep you.
String.Dest: I won't keep you.

String.Source: Another time.
String.Dest: Another time.

String.Source: Mmhmm.
String.Dest: Mmhmm.

String.Source: Till next time.
String.Dest: Till next time.

String.Source: If you see Anagach, tell him to check the inventory, would you?
String.Dest: If you see Anagach, tell him to check the inventory, would you?

String.Source: You know where to find us again.
String.Dest: You know where to find us again.

String.Source: Aye. Got ores to tend to.
String.Dest: Aye. Got ores to tend to.

String.Source: Old Blood see you well.
String.Dest: Old Blood see you well.

String.Source: I hope to see you again at The Art.
String.Dest: I hope to see you again at The Art.

String.Source: Walk in safety. I shall be here if you do not.
String.Dest: Walk in safety. I shall be here if you do not.

String.Source: Time heals all. In its absence, call on me again.
String.Dest: Time heals all. In its absence, call on me again.

String.Source: Gods guide you.
String.Dest: Gods guide you.

String.Source: Taste's still in my throat... Agh...
String.Dest: Taste's still in my throat... Agh...

String.Source: Safe travels. I don't want to be cleaning any blood off the floors again.
String.Dest: Safe travels. I don't want to be cleaning any blood off the floors again.

String.Source: Oh, you should know we just recently replaced our pillow stuffing. Any neck pains will be gone in a trice!
String.Dest: Oh, you should know we just recently replaced our pillow stuffing. Any neck pains will be gone in a trice!

String.Source: Suppose... the taste of the Old Blood is always in your throat too...?
String.Dest: Suppose... the taste of the Old Blood is always in your throat too...?

String.Source: No free samples.
String.Dest: No free samples.

String.Source: Aye. Stove needs tendin'.
String.Dest: Aye. Stove needs tendin'.

String.Source: This one shall leave you now.
String.Dest: This one shall leave you now.

String.Source: This one's ears remain open.
String.Dest: This one's ears remain open.

String.Source: Walk on warm sands.
String.Dest: Walk on warm sands.

String.Source: This one thanks you.
String.Dest: This one thanks you.

String.Source: A good parting, five-claw.
String.Dest: A good parting, five-claw.

String.Source: Blood guard ye where I may not.
String.Dest: Blood guard ye where I may not.

String.Source: Veins flow for ye.
String.Dest: Veins flow for ye.

String.Source: Watch yourself on the roads. Drybloods in corners you wouldn't expect.
String.Dest: Watch yourself on the roads. Drybloods in corners you wouldn't expect.

String.Source: Keep safe. Don't let any Drybloods follow you back here either.
String.Dest: Keep safe. Don't let any Drybloods follow you back here either.

String.Source: If it's a fight you want...
String.Dest: If it's a fight you want...

String.Source: Teach you to mess with me!
String.Dest: Teach you to mess with me!

String.Source: This one never falls without a fight!
String.Dest: This one never falls without a fight!

String.Source: This one gives worse than it takes!
String.Dest: This one gives worse than it takes!

String.Source: Enough is enough...
String.Dest: Enough is enough...

String.Source: Glad that's over with.
String.Dest: Glad that's over with.

String.Source: Fool...
String.Dest: Fool...

String.Source: Waste of my time.
String.Dest: Waste of my time.

String.Source: This one was barely beginning...
String.Dest: This one was barely beginning...

String.Source: Thought you could hide?
String.Dest: Thought you could hide?

String.Source: No more sneaking around!
String.Dest: No more sneaking around!

String.Source: I've about had it with you!
String.Dest: I've about had it with you!

String.Source: This one has had it with you!
String.Dest: This one has had it with you!

String.Source: Someone's here...
String.Dest: Someone's here...

String.Source: At least try and hit me!
String.Dest: At least try and hit me!

String.Source: You left me no other choice!
String.Dest: You left me no other choice!

String.Source: As if I'd let a reeker touch me!
String.Dest: As if I'd let a reeker touch me!

String.Source: Your kin must be so disappointed...
String.Dest: Your kin must be so disappointed...

String.Source: This one always wins!
String.Dest: This one always wins!

String.Source: The Blood shall not run! No more!
String.Dest: The Blood shall not run! No more!

String.Source: Crack... Crack... Break you all...
String.Dest: Crack... Crack... Break you all...

String.Source: The Blood burns!
String.Dest: The Blood burns!

String.Source: Spill... Tear... Feast...
String.Dest: Spill... Tear... Feast...

String.Source: Blood! Blood!
String.Dest: Blood! Blood!

String.Source: Mother of Hunger - she brings a feast!
String.Dest: Mother of Hunger - she brings a feast!

String.Source: Decay... Decry... Destroy...
String.Dest: Decay... Decry... Destroy...

String.Source: Mother provides... Her feast...
String.Dest: Mother provides... Her feast...

String.Source: The Blood boils anew!
String.Dest: The Blood boils anew!

String.Source: The mountain screams!
String.Dest: The mountain screams!

String.Source: My Blood roars!
String.Dest: My Blood roars!

String.Source: I smell... rot...
String.Dest: I smell... rot...

String.Source: (Sniffing)
String.Dest: (Sniffing)

String.Source: Breath and Blood... Near...
String.Dest: Breath and Blood... Near...

String.Source: The mountain weeps... Shall it bleed?
String.Dest: The mountain weeps... Shall it bleed?

String.Source: Mother... Maggot... What approaches?
String.Dest: Mother... Maggot... What approaches?

String.Source: Beast... or Blood?
String.Dest: Beast... or Blood?

String.Source: In the shadows... a feast?
String.Dest: In the shadows... a feast?

String.Source: The Root... cracks... creaks... What does it send me now?
String.Dest: The Root... cracks... creaks... What does it send me now?

String.Source: The Root is... hollow... Hounding... Hello... I smell you...
String.Dest: The Root is... hollow... Hounding... Hello... I smell you...

String.Source: Suck - bite - Blood!
String.Dest: Suck - bite - Blood!

String.Source: Yeaaarrrghh!
String.Dest: Yeaaarrrghh!

String.Source: Fresh prey... at last!
String.Dest: Fresh prey... at last!

String.Source: Pitiful whelp, your end is come!
String.Dest: Pitiful whelp, your end is come!

String.Source: Pray swiftly, little rat! Your gods have no power here!
String.Dest: Pray swiftly, little rat! Your gods have no power here!

String.Source: Too late to run, little beast!
String.Dest: Too late to run, little beast!

String.Source: Yes... Yes, come toward your death, little kill...
String.Dest: Yes... Yes, come toward your death, little kill...

String.Source: How swift your death shall be...
String.Dest: How swift your death shall be...

String.Source: Prey comes to the hunter!
String.Dest: Prey comes to the hunter!

String.Source: Listen... A little mouse wanders toward the cat...
String.Dest: Listen... A little mouse wanders toward the cat...

String.Source: Blood beats on the wind... Prey...
String.Dest: Blood beats on the wind... Prey...

String.Source: I smell... flesh...
String.Dest: I smell... flesh...

String.Source: I taste fear... Glorious...
String.Dest: I taste fear... Glorious...

String.Source: Something comes... Someone...
String.Dest: Something comes... Someone...

String.Source: Another foolish mortal? Good...
String.Dest: Another foolish mortal? Good...

String.Source: Running cannot save you... I can already taste your insides...
String.Dest: Running cannot save you... I can already taste your insides...

String.Source: A lost little beast is nigh... Do let me toy with you a little.
String.Dest: A lost little beast is nigh... Do let me toy with you a little.

String.Source: A shame... They taste so much better still beating.
String.Dest: A shame... They taste so much better still beating.

String.Source: Such fine flesh...
String.Dest: Such fine flesh...

String.Source: The hunter strikes true...
String.Dest: The hunter strikes true...

String.Source: Pathetic prey...
String.Dest: Pathetic prey...

String.Source: I like it better when they scream...
String.Dest: I like it better when they scream...

String.Source: Your gods abandoned you... as expected.
String.Dest: Your gods abandoned you... as expected.

String.Source: And that ends it... Pitiful.
String.Dest: And that ends it... Pitiful.

String.Source: Not even fit for the soil you'll rot in...
String.Dest: Not even fit for the soil you'll rot in...

String.Source: And so you learn the power of the night...
String.Dest: And so you learn the power of the night...

String.Source: You cannot run - even the gods cannot!
String.Dest: You cannot run - even the gods cannot!

String.Source: I will find you!
String.Dest: I will find you!

String.Source: Run... Fear me... You'll taste so much sweeter...
String.Dest: Run... Fear me... You'll taste so much sweeter...

String.Source: Oh, little mouse, little mouse... I can make it so very painless...
String.Dest: Oh, little mouse, little mouse... I can make it so very painless...

String.Source: The faster you run, the louder your blood calls for me!
String.Dest: The faster you run, the louder your blood calls for me!

String.Source: You bleed beautifully!
String.Dest: You bleed beautifully!

String.Source: Bleed for me!
String.Dest: Bleed for me!

String.Source: The more I cut you, the more I hunger!
String.Dest: The more I cut you, the more I hunger!

String.Source: I will feast!
String.Dest: I will feast!

String.Source: No match!
String.Dest: No match!

String.Source: The Blood calls... It sings!
String.Dest: The Blood calls... It sings!

String.Source: You will sate me! Give up!
String.Dest: You will sate me! Give up!

String.Source: I will have your blood!
String.Dest: I will have your blood!

String.Source: You dare defy me?!
String.Dest: You dare defy me?!

String.Source: Take this, thinblood!
String.Dest: Take this, thinblood!

String.Source: Hssss!
String.Dest: Hssss!

String.Source: You dare?!
String.Dest: You dare?!

String.Source: Prey with teeth - how brave!
String.Dest: Prey with teeth - how brave!

String.Source: None touch me and live!
String.Dest: None touch me and live!

String.Source: I'll bleed you for that!
String.Dest: I'll bleed you for that!

String.Source: Hargh!
String.Dest: Hargh!

String.Source: No... Not from you!
String.Dest: No... Not from you!

String.Source: Argh... ah...
String.Dest: Argh... ah...

String.Source: Touch me again and my blade shall skewer your heart!
String.Dest: Touch me again and my blade shall skewer your heart!

String.Source: Filthy vermin!
String.Dest: Filthy vermin!

String.Source: You little beast!
String.Dest: You little beast!

String.Source: No! My blood is strong!
String.Dest: No! My blood is strong!

String.Source: You'll never hit me again!
String.Dest: You'll never hit me again!

String.Source: No... Not like this...
String.Dest: No... Not like this...

String.Source: Huuhhhhh....
String.Dest: Huuhhhhh....

String.Source: Nuuhhh...
String.Dest: Nuuhhh...

String.Source: Not... by prey!
String.Dest: Not... by prey!

String.Source: Mother... It's cold...
String.Dest: Mother... It's cold...

String.Source: The mountain... weeps...
String.Dest: The mountain... weeps...

String.Source: Lady of Maggots...
String.Dest: Lady of Maggots...

String.Source: Feast... on me...
String.Dest: Feast... on me...

String.Source: My Blood... burns...
String.Dest: My Blood... burns...

String.Source: Nuhhh...
String.Dest: Nuhhh...

String.Source: Break... bend...
String.Dest: Break... bend...

String.Source: Raargh!
String.Dest: Raargh!

String.Source: Hnuugh!
String.Dest: Hnuugh!

String.Source: Blood - Blood!
String.Dest: Blood - Blood!

String.Source: Away - away!
String.Dest: Away - away!

String.Source: Mother, I bleed! I bleed!
String.Dest: Mother, I bleed! I bleed!

String.Source: Shadow take you!
String.Dest: Shadow take you!

String.Source: Rot claim ye!
String.Dest: Rot claim ye!

String.Source: Pain... always pain!
String.Dest: Pain... always pain!

String.Source: Are you trying to miss me, little beast?
String.Dest: Are you trying to miss me, little beast?

String.Source: If the gods wanted you to live, they wouldn't have made me.
String.Dest: If the gods wanted you to live, they wouldn't have made me.

String.Source: Do you remember how to beg for mercy, mouse?
String.Dest: Do you remember how to beg for mercy, mouse?

String.Source: I'll skin you first... Keep your heart beating, veins pounding to be drunk...
String.Dest: I'll skin you first... Keep your heart beating, veins pounding to be drunk...

String.Source: So this is why mother never let me have pets... All you do is die!
String.Dest: So this is why mother never let me have pets... All you do is die!

String.Source: None will even remember your name!
String.Dest: None will even remember your name!

String.Source: You call this a fight, little rat? How prey always cling to survival...
String.Dest: You call this a fight, little rat? How prey always cling to survival...

String.Source: I see your blood radiating... How it longs to be freed from your skin...
String.Dest: I see your blood radiating... How it longs to be freed from your skin...

String.Source: Damned thinblood!
String.Dest: Damned thinblood!

String.Source: You dare defy us? We are the heirs of the Nighthollow!
String.Dest: You dare defy us? We are the heirs of the Nighthollow!

String.Source: Oh, dulcet flesh... You'll soon be rent from those bones...
String.Dest: Oh, dulcet flesh... You'll soon be rent from those bones...

String.Source: Deaaaath!
String.Dest: Deaaaath!

String.Source: I will feed!
String.Dest: I will feed!

String.Source: Raaaarrrgh!
String.Dest: Raaaarrrgh!

String.Source: Yaaarrrrgh!
String.Dest: Yaaarrrrgh!

String.Source: Hngh!
String.Dest: Hngh!

String.Source: Ha ha ha...
String.Dest: Ha ha ha...

String.Source: Fool! You cannot best me!
String.Dest: Fool! You cannot best me!

String.Source: That's your best? I'm insulted...
String.Dest: That's your best? I'm insulted...

String.Source: Easily blocked, beastie...
String.Dest: Easily blocked, beastie...

String.Source: You'll have to try harder, little mouse!
String.Dest: You'll have to try harder, little mouse!

String.Source: Come on - come on!
String.Dest: Come on - come on!

String.Source: I knew I heard you!
String.Dest: I knew I heard you!

String.Source: Pitiful whelp, your end is come!
String.Dest: Pitiful whelp, your end is come!

String.Source: Pray swiftly, little rat! Your gods have no power here!
String.Dest: Pray swiftly, little rat! Your gods have no power here!

String.Source: Too late to run, little beast!
String.Dest: Too late to run, little beast!

String.Source: Should've run while you had the chance!
String.Dest: Should've run while you had the chance!

String.Source: I never lose a mark...
String.Dest: I never lose a mark...

String.Source: How hungry your hiding's made me!
String.Dest: How hungry your hiding's made me!

String.Source: No... Never! I am... above the gods!
String.Dest: No... Never! I am... above the gods!

String.Source: I'm not... going to give you... the satisfaction!
String.Dest: I'm not... going to give you... the satisfaction!

String.Source: I will not fall to vermin!
String.Dest: I will not fall to vermin!

String.Source: How long since a fresh hunt... A thrilling hunt...
String.Dest: How long since a fresh hunt... A thrilling hunt...

String.Source: Dreams in red... Always red... Beautiful...
String.Dest: Dreams in red... Always red... Beautiful...

String.Source: Mind's never quiet... Quiet now... Hush, little beasts... You'll die eventually...
String.Dest: Mind's never quiet... Quiet now... Hush, little beasts... You'll die eventually...

String.Source: Why fear the sun? It should run from us...
String.Dest: Why fear the sun? It should run from us...

String.Source: A thirst to be sated... With what? With who? Oh, I hope they try to run...
String.Dest: A thirst to be sated... With what? With who? Oh, I hope they try to run...

String.Source: It will all be ours... Ours...
String.Dest: It will all be ours... Ours...

String.Source: I could take up a thrall, perhaps... But why put off a meal till it turns all sad and gamey? Oh, perhaps to break its heart?
String.Dest: I could take up a thrall, perhaps... But why put off a meal till it turns all sad and gamey? Oh, perhaps to break its heart?

String.Source: The night eternal awaits. I shall send many stars to its frigid embrace.
String.Dest: The night eternal awaits. I shall send many stars to its frigid embrace.

String.Source: Hargh!
String.Dest: Hargh!

String.Source: Garrgh!
String.Dest: Garrgh!

String.Source: Guhh!
String.Dest: Guhh!

String.Source: Another?!
String.Dest: Another?!

String.Source: Is this what it takes?!
String.Dest: Is this what it takes?!

String.Source: Hithin guide these hands!
String.Dest: Hithin guide these hands!

String.Source: Alrabeg guides!
String.Dest: Alrabeg guides!

String.Source: Hunter, I am your Spear!
String.Dest: Hunter, I am your Spear!

String.Source: I'm going to put you down!
String.Dest: I'm going to put you down!

String.Source: I have the Hunter's fury on my side!
String.Dest: I have the Hunter's fury on my side!

String.Source: This one takes no prisoners!
String.Dest: This one takes no prisoners!

String.Source: The Hungry Cat guides these claws!
String.Dest: The Hungry Cat guides these claws!

String.Source: Khenarthi blow you down!
String.Dest: Khenarthi blow you down!

String.Source: Fusozay var dar!
String.Dest: Fusozay var dar!

String.Source: This one shall not hesitate!
String.Dest: This one shall not hesitate!

String.Source: Hey! Careful!
String.Dest: Hey! Careful!

String.Source: Last warning, knock it off!
String.Dest: Last warning, knock it off!

String.Source: Gaargh!
String.Dest: Gaargh!

String.Source: Aargh!
String.Dest: Aargh!

String.Source: Naghh!
String.Dest: Naghh!

String.Source: Couldn't even cut parchment!
String.Dest: Couldn't even cut parchment!

String.Source: Agh! Enough!
String.Dest: Agh! Enough!

String.Source: That your best?!
String.Dest: That your best?!

String.Source: Arghh... Bastard!
String.Dest: Arghh... Bastard!

String.Source: I won't be killed by the likes of you!
String.Dest: I won't be killed by the likes of you!

String.Source: I'll see you dead!
String.Dest: I'll see you dead!

String.Source: Hssss!
String.Dest: Hssss!

String.Source: This one has suffered fleas more painful!
String.Dest: This one has suffered fleas more painful!

String.Source: This one curses you!
String.Dest: This one curses you!

String.Source: Die, dull-claw!
String.Dest: Die, dull-claw!

String.Source: Ziss'vo!
String.Dest: Ziss'vo!

String.Source: Nuhhh...
String.Dest: Nuhhh...

String.Source: Guuhhhh...
String.Dest: Guuhhhh...

String.Source: Gods... No...
String.Dest: Gods... No...

String.Source: Enough! Please!
String.Dest: Enough! Please!

String.Source: Feast... at last...
String.Dest: Feast... at last...

String.Source: The mountain shakes... for us...
String.Dest: The mountain shakes... for us...

String.Source: Crack... crack... cracked...
String.Dest: Crack... crack... cracked...

String.Source: To dust... to death... to despair... Delicious...
String.Dest: To dust... to death... to despair... Delicious...

String.Source: Feed... Yes... Feeeeeed...
String.Dest: Feed... Yes... Feeeeeed...

String.Source: Mother mine... how you bless me...
String.Dest: Mother mine... how you bless me...

String.Source: Bones... skin... sinew... slain!
String.Dest: Bones... skin... sinew... slain!

String.Source: The Root... The Root...
String.Dest: The Root... The Root...

String.Source: As captain of the guard, my duty is to defend the village from the monsters. But it's a losing battle.
String.Dest: As captain of the guard, my duty is to defend the village from the monsters. But it's a losing battle.

String.Source: The spirits coming from the woods are endless, and none of my guards are willing to undertake any missions there.
String.Dest: The spirits coming from the woods are endless, and none of my guards are willing to undertake any missions there.

String.Source: If you're willing to take on some scouting missions, I can set aside some wages for you.
String.Dest: If you're willing to take on some scouting missions, I can set aside some wages for you.

String.Source: Might even have a bigger job for you if we can get these fiends pushed back a bit.
String.Dest: Might even have a bigger job for you if we can get these fiends pushed back a bit.

String.Source: That one too hard for you? Well, let's see...
String.Dest: That one too hard for you? Well, let's see...

String.Source: Good. It's good to have someone here who isn't afraid of the woods.
String.Dest: Good. It's good to have someone here who isn't afraid of the woods.

String.Source: I used to think we'd never have a chance of conquering the forest. Now I'm not so sure.
String.Dest: I used to think we'd never have a chance of conquering the forest. Now I'm not so sure.

String.Source: If only we'd had someone like you decades ago.
String.Dest: If only we'd had someone like you decades ago.

String.Source: You're certainly earning your pay. Keep it up - there's plenty to do.
String.Dest: You're certainly earning your pay. Keep it up - there's plenty to do.

String.Source: Not yet. We need to push back some of those forest demons before we can focus on a counterattack.
String.Dest: Not yet. We need to push back some of those forest demons before we can focus on a counterattack.

String.Source: Good timing. With the work you've been doing to push back the monsters, you gave me time to do some investigating as well.
String.Dest: Good timing. With the work you've been doing to push back the monsters, you gave me time to do some investigating as well.

String.Source: I've been trying to figure out how those monsters made it to Twisted Root Cave, and I think I have a lead.
String.Dest: I've been trying to figure out how those monsters made it to Twisted Root Cave, and I think I have a lead.

String.Source: I found traces of a collapsed tunnel. I think that's how the monsters got here.
String.Dest: I found traces of a collapsed tunnel. I think that's how the monsters got here.

String.Source: I didn't want to risk crawling too deep, but I got far enough to notice it was wet. I suspect the other end of that tunnel is underwater.
String.Dest: I didn't want to risk crawling too deep, but I got far enough to notice it was wet. I suspect the other end of that tunnel is underwater.

String.Source: There's a lake in the forest - I bet there's an underwater cave there. I need you to investigate. If you find the monsters' lair, destroy them.
String.Dest: There's a lake in the forest - I bet there's an underwater cave there. I need you to investigate. If you find the monsters' lair, destroy them.

String.Source: I call it a blessing from the spirits.
String.Dest: I call it a blessing from the spirits.

String.Source: I was born and raised here, but Kelsrah grew up in the mountains of Skyrim. A child of the Reach.
String.Dest: I was born and raised here, but Kelsrah grew up in the mountains of Skyrim. A child of the Reach.

String.Source: But her love of rare ores led her to discover a sample of dried Old Blood. She was immediately taken with it, of course.
String.Dest: But her love of rare ores led her to discover a sample of dried Old Blood. She was immediately taken with it, of course.

String.Source: She searched for more of it and discovered the Old Lands.
String.Dest: She searched for more of it and discovered the Old Lands.

String.Source: And, as fate would have it, she exited Twisted Root right when I was helping the guards expand the entrance.
String.Dest: And, as fate would have it, she exited Twisted Root right when I was helping the guards expand the entrance.

String.Source: You could say it was love at first sight - for me, at least. She wasn't interested until I proved I could match her passion for ore!
String.Dest: You could say it was love at first sight - for me, at least. She wasn't interested until I proved I could match her passion for ore!

String.Source: Here. If you can fight past the Drybloods and leave this grave offering, it would mean a great deal to me.
String.Dest: Here. If you can fight past the Drybloods and leave this grave offering, it would mean a great deal to me.

String.Source: Oh? Let me see...
String.Dest: Oh? Let me see...

String.Source: D- do you realize what these are? These predate any known writings of the clan!
String.Dest: D- do you realize what these are? These predate any known writings of the clan!

String.Source: This is an incredible discovery! I'll have these copied at once - you deserve to keep the originals.
String.Dest: This is an incredible discovery! I'll have these copied at once - you deserve to keep the originals.

String.Source: You never cease to amaze. The clan truly is blessed to have you.
String.Dest: You never cease to amaze. The clan truly is blessed to have you.

String.Source: Hm? These... These seem to be journals of an ancient Cronvangr leader!
String.Dest: Hm? These... These seem to be journals of an ancient Cronvangr leader!

String.Source: Please, can you see if you can recover the rest? I'll make preparations to have them copied and preserved for posterity.
String.Dest: Please, can you see if you can recover the rest? I'll make preparations to have them copied and preserved for posterity.

String.Source: I remember somewhere... Dark. Very dark.
String.Dest: I remember somewhere... Dark. Very dark.

String.Source: No light at all, except some glowing fungus.
String.Dest: No light at all, except some glowing fungus.

String.Source: Reality felt... weak, there. Like the Void was leaking through.
String.Dest: Reality felt... weak, there. Like the Void was leaking through.

String.Source: Looks like the ruins of a Dwemer laboratory... Maybe part of the old Arkthzand library?
String.Dest: Looks like the ruins of a Dwemer laboratory... Maybe part of the old Arkthzand library?

String.Source: Guess we should look around.
String.Dest: Guess we should look around.

String.Source: I'm... not sure. I think I absorbed more power...
String.Dest: I'm... not sure. I think I absorbed more power...

String.Source: It must be because of how close to the Void we are.
String.Dest: It must be because of how close to the Void we are.

String.Source: Well, I guess I shouldn't complain about getting stronger.
String.Dest: Well, I guess I shouldn't complain about getting stronger.

String.Source: This...
String.Dest: This...

String.Source: The worst part of this news is how much sense it makes.
String.Dest: The worst part of this news is how much sense it makes.

String.Source: No wonder we Saxhleel have always been part of this realm. No wonder the "Blood" came through Roots.
String.Dest: No wonder we Saxhleel have always been part of this realm. No wonder the "Blood" came through Roots.

String.Source: Xuth! Why did none of us even contemplate this idea before? Did the Hist warp our thoughts against us?
String.Dest: Xuth! Why did none of us even contemplate this idea before? Did the Hist warp our thoughts against us?

String.Source: It is good it comes to me first. I will find a way to tell all the others.
String.Dest: It is good it comes to me first. I will find a way to tell all the others.

String.Source: And then we will need to decide the course of our people.
String.Dest: And then we will need to decide the course of our people.

String.Source: Well, that is something we need to decide amongst ourselves. Its job here is complete.
String.Dest: Well, that is something we need to decide amongst ourselves. Its job here is complete.

String.Source: I erect the spine of gratitude for telling me, as unwelcome as this knowledge may be.
String.Dest: I erect the spine of gratitude for telling me, as unwelcome as this knowledge may be.

String.Source: Ah! Pardon me! Might I trouble you to release me?
String.Dest: Ah! Pardon me! Might I trouble you to release me?

String.Source: I may have made some suggestions that the clan elders disagreed with.
String.Dest: I may have made some suggestions that the clan elders disagreed with.

String.Source: That was enough for them to deem me "prey." They're waiting for me to go feral so they can eat me.
String.Dest: That was enough for them to deem me "prey." They're waiting for me to go feral so they can eat me.

String.Source: I'd like to avoid that, so if you don't mind...
String.Dest: I'd like to avoid that, so if you don't mind...

String.Source: Oh! Where are my manners?
String.Dest: Oh! Where are my manners?

String.Source: I am Kalsesh Darkbiter. Formerly of the Voidsucker Clan, until the elders decided I'd make better prey than hunter.
String.Dest: I am Kalsesh Darkbiter. Formerly of the Voidsucker Clan, until the elders decided I'd make better prey than hunter.

String.Source: I'd be happy to speak more, but might you release me from this cage first?
String.Dest: I'd be happy to speak more, but might you release me from this cage first?

String.Source: Woah. That's... not what I was expecting.
String.Dest: Woah. That's... not what I was expecting.

String.Source: Not much. Nobody dares to go there other than occasional scouting missions right by the entrance.
String.Dest: Not much. Nobody dares to go there other than occasional scouting missions right by the entrance.

String.Source: That forest is cursed by the magic flowing out of the Hollow Palace. Filled with monsters from the Void.
String.Dest: That forest is cursed by the magic flowing out of the Hollow Palace. Filled with monsters from the Void.

String.Source: And then there's the Ayleid ruins... No telling what those mad elves buried in there.
String.Dest: And then there's the Ayleid ruins... No telling what those mad elves buried in there.

String.Source: Say. If you happen to have any Moon Sugar, I'll buy it. Even above market price, it'll be cheaper than what the caravans charge us here.
String.Dest: Say. If you happen to have any Moon Sugar, I'll buy it. Even above market price, it'll be cheaper than what the caravans charge us here.

String.Source: Well, it is what it is. Can't exactly set up a reliable supply chain to us, and the land isn't suited for crops. Good food's a luxury.
String.Dest: Well, it is what it is. Can't exactly set up a reliable supply chain to us, and the land isn't suited for crops. Good food's a luxury.

String.Source: The lorekeepers of the Reach. They preserve the history of the land through their songs and stories.
String.Dest: The lorekeepers of the Reach. They preserve the history of the land through their songs and stories.

String.Source: They also perform many sacred rituals and serve as diplomats between clans. All Reachfolk hold them in high esteem.
String.Dest: They also perform many sacred rituals and serve as diplomats between clans. All Reachfolk hold them in high esteem.

String.Source: I suggest it keep its wits about. The ruins do not need more corpses.
String.Dest: I suggest it keep its wits about. The ruins do not need more corpses.

String.Source: Pride brought down the old xanmeer civilization. Do not let it be your downfall as well.
String.Dest: Pride brought down the old xanmeer civilization. Do not let it be your downfall as well.

String.Source: All are claimed by the swamp. It simply hastens the process.
String.Dest: All are claimed by the swamp. It simply hastens the process.

String.Source: If only it were so easy. The rot-waters always carry the drowned back to us.
String.Dest: If only it were so easy. The rot-waters always carry the drowned back to us.

String.Source: Whatever the ancient Saxhleel's sin, it leaves this land deeply ill. This is a small step towards healing it.
String.Dest: Whatever the ancient Saxhleel's sin, it leaves this land deeply ill. This is a small step towards healing it.

String.Source: I hope it is not too late. We cannot let the Roots sicken.
String.Dest: I hope it is not too late. We cannot let the Roots sicken.

String.Source: Let us hope its words are true. We cannot allow more to die.
String.Dest: Let us hope its words are true. We cannot allow more to die.

String.Source: If only the guards had its strength. Perhaps then we would not be in this position.
String.Dest: If only the guards had its strength. Perhaps then we would not be in this position.

String.Source: Well, I'm still the Vessel for it. All the power that Hist absorbed since the Merethic Era is inside me now.
String.Dest: Well, I'm still the Vessel for it. All the power that Hist absorbed since the Merethic Era is inside me now.

String.Source: No idea how to access it, though. For now, I'm more of a container keeping it sealed.
String.Dest: No idea how to access it, though. For now, I'm more of a container keeping it sealed.

String.Source: I'm not sure if I really want to learn to harness it, honestly. It might be better to just keep it contained.
String.Dest: I'm not sure if I really want to learn to harness it, honestly. It might be better to just keep it contained.

String.Source: You don't need to worry, though. Even if something were to happen to me, the magic wouldn't pour out or anything. It would just fade away.
String.Dest: You don't need to worry, though. Even if something were to happen to me, the magic wouldn't pour out or anything. It would just fade away.

String.Source: Well... now that I can visit Tamriel, there's something I was hoping to do.
String.Dest: Well... now that I can visit Tamriel, there's something I was hoping to do.

String.Source: See, Rukar did a lot of research across Skyrim before he made me. I was hoping to maybe retrace his steps - see what we find.
String.Dest: See, Rukar did a lot of research across Skyrim before he made me. I was hoping to maybe retrace his steps - see what we find.

String.Source: I'm not really sure what I'm expecting to find, honestly. I've just got these vague memories of places around Skyrim.
String.Dest: I'm not really sure what I'm expecting to find, honestly. I've just got these vague memories of places around Skyrim.

String.Source: If you're up for it, just let me know. I'll tell you what I can remember.
String.Dest: If you're up for it, just let me know. I'll tell you what I can remember.

String.Source: Ah, overseer! I have a fresh joke for you!
String.Dest: Ah, overseer! I have a fresh joke for you!

String.Source: Xuth...
String.Dest: Xuth...

String.Source: How does one know when it is time to replace ones bedding?
String.Dest: How does one know when it is time to replace ones bedding?

String.Source: When I throw it into the mud for its irritations. Jokes do not dig up more Meat.
String.Dest: When I throw it into the mud for its irritations. Jokes do not dig up more Meat.

String.Source: Overseer! There you are!
String.Dest: Overseer! There you are!

String.Source: Hm? Something troubles you, Roots?
String.Dest: Hm? Something troubles you, Roots?

String.Source: Absolutely not. Return it to the mine before it eats our homes.
String.Dest: Absolutely not. Return it to the mine before it eats our homes.

String.Source: The cutest voriplasm follows me back from the mines. I wonder if-
String.Dest: The cutest voriplasm follows me back from the mines. I wonder if-

String.Source: It pains me to ask more of it, but does it find any new Meat sources?
String.Dest: It pains me to ask more of it, but does it find any new Meat sources?

String.Source: I twitch my tail in irritation. All xanmeers are filled with monsters
String.Dest: I twitch my tail in irritation. All xanmeers are filled with monsters

String.Source: But the search continues. I do not give up.
String.Dest: But the search continues. I do not give up.

String.Source: Ah-Khajat! Is today the day you join me in exploring a xanmeer?
String.Dest: Ah-Khajat! Is today the day you join me in exploring a xanmeer?

String.Source: Tch. You lack a sense of adventure.
String.Dest: Tch. You lack a sense of adventure.

String.Source: I take no joy in searching the xanmeers. I am poor company for an adventure.
String.Dest: I take no joy in searching the xanmeers. I am poor company for an adventure.

String.Source: Can I ask you a favor, Aeodgam?
String.Dest: Can I ask you a favor, Aeodgam?

String.Source: My anniversary's coming up. I was hoping to surprise Kelsrah with some traditional Reach food.
String.Dest: My anniversary's coming up. I was hoping to surprise Kelsrah with some traditional Reach food.

String.Source: I appreciate it, Aeodgam.
String.Dest: I appreciate it, Aeodgam.

String.Source: Depends what it is.
String.Dest: Depends what it is.

String.Source: Hm. I'd have to check. Each clan's got its own way of cooking.
String.Dest: Hm. I'd have to check. Each clan's got its own way of cooking.

String.Source: Aeodgam, has the shipment of Moon Sugar arrived?
String.Dest: Aeodgam, has the shipment of Moon Sugar arrived?

String.Source: Not yet. Seems the caravan's delayed.
String.Dest: Not yet. Seems the caravan's delayed.

String.Source: Tsk. This one craves her sweets...
String.Dest: Tsk. This one craves her sweets...

String.Source: Ah, Anagach. I heard you were attacked by the dro-m'Athra. Are you hurt?
String.Dest: Ah, Anagach. I heard you were attacked by the dro-m'Athra. Are you hurt?

String.Source: Nothing more than some bruises. The Spirits must be watching out for me.
String.Dest: Nothing more than some bruises. The Spirits must be watching out for me.

String.Source: Reality is weak here... Another plane is overlapping.
String.Dest: Reality is weak here... Another plane is overlapping.

String.Source: Woah. It's like... a shadowy version of the real world.
String.Dest: Woah. It's like... a shadowy version of the real world.

String.Source: Another breach. Let's take care of it.
String.Dest: Another breach. Let's take care of it.

String.Source: I see you, little worms. Crawling through my home.
String.Dest: I see you, little worms. Crawling through my home.

String.Source: I know what you seek. Countless others have tried before you.
String.Dest: I know what you seek. Countless others have tried before you.

String.Source: Come then. I will drag your souls into the Void as I have all before you.
String.Dest: Come then. I will drag your souls into the Void as I have all before you.

String.Source: You are most amusing... for mere insects.
String.Dest: You are most amusing... for mere insects.

String.Source: You have my congratulations for managing to drag yourselves all the way here. It has been some time since I've crushed such spirited worms.
String.Dest: You have my congratulations for managing to drag yourselves all the way here. It has been some time since I've crushed such spirited worms.

String.Source: But matters are now at an end. I am Hana the Hollow Princess, Chosen Champion of Namira, and you will fall before me!
String.Dest: But matters are now at an end. I am Hana the Hollow Princess, Chosen Champion of Namira, and you will fall before me!

String.Source: This grows tedious. Perhaps you do not yet understand the truth.
String.Dest: This grows tedious. Perhaps you do not yet understand the truth.

String.Source: Do you think I am like those shades you've faced? That my physical form can be slain like theirs?
String.Dest: Do you think I am like those shades you've faced? That my physical form can be slain like theirs?

String.Source: I am beyond such things. I am the Void. Destroy this body. Burn it in Dragonfire; crush it below the earth. It will accomplish nothing.
String.Dest: I am beyond such things. I am the Void. Destroy this body. Burn it in Dragonfire; crush it below the earth. It will accomplish nothing.

String.Source: I am the Hollow Princess. My essence is tied to the Heart of this world. Namira's power flows eternally into me.
String.Dest: I am the Hollow Princess. My essence is tied to the Heart of this world. Namira's power flows eternally into me.

String.Source: Slay as many shades as you wish. It will not hurt me.
String.Dest: Slay as many shades as you wish. It will not hurt me.

String.Source: But I tire of this diversion. Allow me to show you my true power.
String.Dest: But I tire of this diversion. Allow me to show you my true power.

String.Source: Yeah. And my mind feels... Clearer. I guess that means we've visited all the places I remember?
String.Dest: Yeah. And my mind feels... Clearer. I guess that means we've visited all the places I remember?

String.Source: Well, I'm glad we investigated that. Those breaches could have caused a lot of problems if we'd left them.
String.Dest: Well, I'm glad we investigated that. Those breaches could have caused a lot of problems if we'd left them.

String.Source: Thanks again. I wouldn't be able to do this without you.
String.Dest: Thanks again. I wouldn't be able to do this without you.

String.Source: Very well. We do as it suggests.
String.Dest: Very well. We do as it suggests.

String.Source: The clan elders and I had a... disagreement.
String.Dest: The clan elders and I had a... disagreement.

String.Source: I suggested that, in the light of the recent withering of the Bloodroots, we should be looking for a way to cure our reliance on the Old Blood.
String.Dest: I suggested that, in the light of the recent withering of the Bloodroots, we should be looking for a way to cure our reliance on the Old Blood.

String.Source: In turn, they suggested I should be locked up until the hunger drove me feral, at which point they would eat me.
String.Dest: In turn, they suggested I should be locked up until the hunger drove me feral, at which point they would eat me.

String.Source: Might you be willing to release me from here? The switch should be nearby.
String.Dest: Might you be willing to release me from here? The switch should be nearby.

String.Source: Ah, thank you!
String.Dest: Ah, thank you!

String.Source: Please, finish off the clan elders. I can't escape until they're dead.
String.Dest: Please, finish off the clan elders. I can't escape until they're dead.

String.Source: Is it done?
String.Dest: Is it done?

String.Source: Not to worry, I'm right behind you.
String.Dest: Not to worry, I'm right behind you.

String.Source: Ah, home sweet home.
String.Dest: Ah, home sweet home.

String.Source: Delightful to see you.
String.Dest: Delightful to see you.

String.Source: I'm afraid not. We can only feed on mortals that have already fallen to the Old Blood.
String.Dest: I'm afraid not. We can only feed on mortals that have already fallen to the Old Blood.

String.Source: Well, in a pinch, we can drink the Old Blood itself, but it tastes absolutely vile.
String.Dest: Well, in a pinch, we can drink the Old Blood itself, but it tastes absolutely vile.

String.Source: In better times, we'd get our cattle drunk on the Old Blood and feast on them. But those days are long gone.
String.Dest: In better times, we'd get our cattle drunk on the Old Blood and feast on them. But those days are long gone.

String.Source: Most of the clan is already half feral. They see me as the mad one for retaining my sanity.
String.Dest: Most of the clan is already half feral. They see me as the mad one for retaining my sanity.

String.Source: My hope is to find a way to cure my reliance on the Old Blood. But it will be difficult as long as the clan elders are after me.
String.Dest: My hope is to find a way to cure my reliance on the Old Blood. But it will be difficult as long as the clan elders are after me.

String.Source: You seem quite brave - you must be to venture here. Would you care to help me make good on my escape? Namely, by ending the clan elders?
String.Dest: You seem quite brave - you must be to venture here. Would you care to help me make good on my escape? Namely, by ending the clan elders?

String.Source: Oh good. I knew I liked you!
String.Dest: Oh good. I knew I liked you!

String.Source: I'll wait here. Wouldn't want to disrupt the slaughter!
String.Dest: I'll wait here. Wouldn't want to disrupt the slaughter!

String.Source: Come get me when the deed is done.
String.Dest: Come get me when the deed is done.

String.Source: Your heroism is appreciated.
String.Dest: Your heroism is appreciated.

String.Source: I'll wait here. Come get me once the deed is done.
String.Dest: I'll wait here. Come get me once the deed is done.

String.Source: Ah. That is... unfortunate.
String.Dest: Ah. That is... unfortunate.

String.Source: Am I to take that as a threat?
String.Dest: Am I to take that as a threat?

String.Source: I'll use you to sate my hunger, then slaughter the elders myself!
String.Dest: I'll use you to sate my hunger, then slaughter the elders myself!

String.Source: Hm. I suppose I can work with that. Assuming I can find a cure, there's plenty of bandits out there.
String.Dest: Hm. I suppose I can work with that. Assuming I can find a cure, there's plenty of bandits out there.

String.Source: Very well. You have a deal.
String.Dest: Very well. You have a deal.

String.Source: Well, I'll be here. Can't make a proper escape as long as the elders are on guard.
String.Dest: Well, I'll be here. Can't make a proper escape as long as the elders are on guard.

String.Source: If you decide to help, come see me once the deed is done.
String.Dest: If you decide to help, come see me once the deed is done.

String.Source: Hopefully, I'll still be alive by then.
String.Dest: Hopefully, I'll still be alive by then.

String.Source: Your presence honors us. The Void-Worship of Varladimath is legendary - we did not expect you would find us worth your notice.
String.Dest: Your presence honors us. The Void-Worship of Varladimath is legendary - we did not expect you would find us worth your notice.

String.Source: Of course. Namira calls, and I obey.
String.Dest: Of course. Namira calls, and I obey.

String.Source: She instructed me to... assist your people in fulfilling her will.
