String.Dest: She instructed me to... assist your people in fulfilling her will.

String.Source: Ah. I understand. Follow, then. I will show you Namira's creation.
String.Dest: Ah. I understand. Follow, then. I will show you Namira's creation.

String.Source: Planting a Hist sapling directly above where the Dark Heart slept, allowing the sapling to feed on the Heart's energies... Quite clever.
String.Dest: Planting a Hist sapling directly above where the Dark Heart slept, allowing the sapling to feed on the Heart's energies... Quite clever.

String.Source: What inspired your ancestors to do this?
String.Dest: What inspired your ancestors to do this?

String.Source: Most Saxhleel fear Sithis. They see him as an avatar of death and destruction.
String.Dest: Most Saxhleel fear Sithis. They see him as an avatar of death and destruction.

String.Source: Our tribe is more enlightened. We listen to the Hist, and we hear the truth. Emptiness allows for new creation.
String.Dest: Our tribe is more enlightened. We listen to the Hist, and we hear the truth. Emptiness allows for new creation.

String.Source: But as the rest of kronka-thatith rejects that truth, the Hist could never shape the lands into a true paradise.
String.Dest: But as the rest of kronka-thatith rejects that truth, the Hist could never shape the lands into a true paradise.

String.Source: And so the Hist communes with the Void, seeking a new place for us to nest.
String.Dest: And so the Hist communes with the Void, seeking a new place for us to nest.

String.Source: Perhaps your Hist should have been more patient. Argonians have revered Sithis as a benevolent avatar of change ever since Duskfall.
String.Dest: Perhaps your Hist should have been more patient. Argonians have revered Sithis as a benevolent avatar of change ever since Duskfall.

String.Source: Duskfall? I do not know this word.
String.Dest: Duskfall? I do not know this word.

String.Source: It may explain after I finish my answer.
String.Dest: It may explain after I finish my answer.

String.Source: When the Hist speaks with the Void, Namira answers. She promises a place where we will grow.
String.Dest: When the Hist speaks with the Void, Namira answers. She promises a place where we will grow.

String.Source: But another tribe discovers our allegiance to Sithis. They attack us, and in the chaos, our Hist burns.
String.Dest: But another tribe discovers our allegiance to Sithis. They attack us, and in the chaos, our Hist burns.

String.Source: With failing life, the Hist grants us its sole sapling and tells us to flee to Skyrim. To plant the sapling in the Reach, where the Void feeds it.
String.Dest: With failing life, the Hist grants us its sole sapling and tells us to flee to Skyrim. To plant the sapling in the Reach, where the Void feeds it.

String.Source: And in time, the young Hist used the power it had absorbed to turn the lands where it grew into its own demi-plane. I see.
String.Dest: And in time, the young Hist used the power it had absorbed to turn the lands where it grew into its own demi-plane. I see.

String.Source: Hist are indeed quite attuned to the Void... and are not subject to the laws of the Divines.
String.Dest: Hist are indeed quite attuned to the Void... and are not subject to the laws of the Divines.

String.Source: Heh. So that was Namira's plan. To use the Hist as a permanent link between Mundus and Namira's realm, even if the Dark Heart were to be lost.
String.Dest: Heh. So that was Namira's plan. To use the Hist as a permanent link between Mundus and Namira's realm, even if the Dark Heart were to be lost.

String.Source: Indeed. And we nurture the Hist. Even without a physical link to the Heart, it continues to feed and grow. As Namira desires.
String.Dest: Indeed. And we nurture the Hist. Even without a physical link to the Heart, it continues to feed and grow. As Namira desires.

String.Source: And it say Namira bids it come here as well?
String.Dest: And it say Namira bids it come here as well?

String.Source: Indeed. My kingdom has long studied both Oblivion and the Void beyond.
String.Dest: Indeed. My kingdom has long studied both Oblivion and the Void beyond.

String.Source: Namira feels we can... help you to nurture your Hist.
String.Dest: Namira feels we can... help you to nurture your Hist.

String.Source: Fascinating. Namira's corruption has warped the Hist's appearance quite dramatically.
String.Dest: Fascinating. Namira's corruption has warped the Hist's appearance quite dramatically.

String.Source: If I didn't already know this was Hist sap, I would believe it was blood. The appearance and scent are a perfect imitation.
String.Dest: If I didn't already know this was Hist sap, I would believe it was blood. The appearance and scent are a perfect imitation.

String.Source: Hm. I had been wondering what story I'd tell our followers once they arrive.
String.Dest: Hm. I had been wondering what story I'd tell our followers once they arrive.

String.Source: After all, we can't have them knowing of the Hist. They may try to claim it for themselves.
String.Dest: After all, we can't have them knowing of the Hist. They may try to claim it for themselves.

String.Source: "Blood" may be the perfect lie to tell... Heheh.
String.Dest: "Blood" may be the perfect lie to tell... Heheh.

String.Source: Though... We'll first need to ensure none of the local lizards remain to contradict my story.
String.Dest: Though... We'll first need to ensure none of the local lizards remain to contradict my story.

String.Source: Round them up. We'll dispose of them all at once.
String.Dest: Round them up. We'll dispose of them all at once.

String.Source: If that tree decides it still needs some lizards to trim its roots, we can always bring in some slaves from Black Marsh.
String.Dest: If that tree decides it still needs some lizards to trim its roots, we can always bring in some slaves from Black Marsh.

String.Source: I was wondering that myself.
String.Dest: I was wondering that myself.

String.Source: When the world shook, I was concerned that more monsters might be coming from the forest. I wanted to ask his advice, but...
String.Dest: When the world shook, I was concerned that more monsters might be coming from the forest. I wanted to ask his advice, but...

String.Source: The entire world seemed to tremble. What happened?
String.Dest: The entire world seemed to tremble. What happened?

String.Source: This is... No, I cannot question you now. I assume you learned this in your search for the source of the Blood.
String.Dest: This is... No, I cannot question you now. I assume you learned this in your search for the source of the Blood.

String.Source: We can discuss more later. For now, go search Rukar's house. I will speak with the guards and see if they saw anything unusual.
String.Dest: We can discuss more later. For now, go search Rukar's house. I will speak with the guards and see if they saw anything unusual.

String.Source: Hmm. No offense, but that won't be enough. It's no good if I can't use it for multiple meals.
String.Dest: Hmm. No offense, but that won't be enough. It's no good if I can't use it for multiple meals.

String.Source: Easier for me to buy it in batches of five.
String.Dest: Easier for me to buy it in batches of five.

String.Source: For five bowls, I'll pay you 400 Gold. Sound good?
String.Dest: For five bowls, I'll pay you 400 Gold. Sound good?

String.Source: Pleasure doing business.
String.Dest: Pleasure doing business.

String.Source: Don't keep me waiting too long. I've got things to cook.
String.Dest: Don't keep me waiting too long. I've got things to cook.

String.Source: The eyes! Destroy the eyes!
String.Dest: The eyes! Destroy the eyes!

String.Source: I've gotten reports of Forsworn agents hiding in the desert. I sympathize with the clans of the Reach, but we can't tolerate the Forsworn's violence.
String.Dest: I've gotten reports of Forsworn agents hiding in the desert. I sympathize with the clans of the Reach, but we can't tolerate the Forsworn's violence.

String.Source: Please, drive them out before they strike us again.
String.Dest: Please, drive them out before they strike us again.

String.Source: The Forsworn think the Old Blood will help them overthrow the Nords. They see us as their enemies for not sharing the Blood with them.
String.Dest: The Forsworn think the Old Blood will help them overthrow the Nords. They see us as their enemies for not sharing the Blood with them.

String.Source: Sadly, negotiation is impossible. They've started attacking our people. Can I ask you to fend them off?
String.Dest: Sadly, negotiation is impossible. They've started attacking our people. Can I ask you to fend them off?

String.Source: Many of our people came here to escape the conflicts of Tamriel. But the Forsworn want to bring their conflicts here.
String.Dest: Many of our people came here to escape the conflicts of Tamriel. But the Forsworn want to bring their conflicts here.

String.Source: I need you to push back the Forsworn spies before they can act against us.
String.Dest: I need you to push back the Forsworn spies before they can act against us.

String.Source: It saddens me to think of all the people who have become Drybloods. To die alone, forgotten, gripped by madness...
String.Dest: It saddens me to think of all the people who have become Drybloods. To die alone, forgotten, gripped by madness...

String.Source: I'd like to honor their memories. Can I ask you to recover the possessions of fallen villagers? I'll store them in a place of honor.
String.Dest: I'd like to honor their memories. Can I ask you to recover the possessions of fallen villagers? I'll store them in a place of honor.

String.Source: Several guards were slain by Drybloods. Can you recover their possessions? I'd like to use them in a memorial.
String.Dest: Several guards were slain by Drybloods. Can you recover their possessions? I'd like to use them in a memorial.

String.Source: The ranks of Drybloods are continuing to swell as more villagers succumb to madness. If this keeps up, we'll be overrun.
String.Dest: The ranks of Drybloods are continuing to swell as more villagers succumb to madness. If this keeps up, we'll be overrun.

String.Source: I need you to thin the numbers of Drybloods before the problem grows out of control.
String.Dest: I need you to thin the numbers of Drybloods before the problem grows out of control.

String.Source: The Dryblood attacks are growing worse. If we don't push them back, we'll be overrun. Can you help?
String.Dest: The Dryblood attacks are growing worse. If we don't push them back, we'll be overrun. Can you help?

String.Source: Several of the guards were injured in a recent Dryblood attack. Can I ask you to deliver some medicine?
String.Dest: Several of the guards were injured in a recent Dryblood attack. Can I ask you to deliver some medicine?

String.Source: I've heard that a number of guards were injured recently. Can you deliver some medicine to them?
String.Dest: I've heard that a number of guards were injured recently. Can you deliver some medicine to them?

String.Source: We need a cure for the Dryblood madness - a way to reduce our dependency on the Old Blood.
String.Dest: We need a cure for the Dryblood madness - a way to reduce our dependency on the Old Blood.

String.Source: Can I ask you to take samples of some of the Bloodroots around the desert? Studying them may prove helpful.
String.Dest: Can I ask you to take samples of some of the Bloodroots around the desert? Studying them may prove helpful.

String.Source: I'd like you to collect some samples from the Bloodroots around the Old Lands.
String.Dest: I'd like you to collect some samples from the Bloodroots around the Old Lands.

String.Source: The better we understand the roots, the better our chances of finding a cure.
String.Dest: The better we understand the roots, the better our chances of finding a cure.

String.Source: I'm concerned what may happen to the Bloodroots now that the Hist is dead.
String.Dest: I'm concerned what may happen to the Bloodroots now that the Hist is dead.

String.Source: If the remaining sap begins to rot, we'll have even less time to find a cure for our addiction to it. Can you collect some samples from the Roots?
String.Dest: If the remaining sap begins to rot, we'll have even less time to find a cure for our addiction to it. Can you collect some samples from the Roots?

String.Source: With the Hist dead, the Bloodroots will soon decay.
String.Dest: With the Hist dead, the Bloodroots will soon decay.

String.Source: Considering how the Roots stretch through the entire land, I'm concerned that this will destabilize the entirety of the Old Lands.
String.Dest: Considering how the Roots stretch through the entire land, I'm concerned that this will destabilize the entirety of the Old Lands.

String.Source: Can I ask you to take some samples of the Bloodroots? We need to gain an understanding of what's happening now.
String.Dest: Can I ask you to take some samples of the Bloodroots? We need to gain an understanding of what's happening now.

String.Source: Ah... I appreciate the interest, but I've already given you one job.
String.Dest: Ah... I appreciate the interest, but I've already given you one job.

String.Source: Marvelous! Thank you, friend!
String.Dest: Marvelous! Thank you, friend!

String.Source: There is still much to do, but we're finally making strong progress.
String.Dest: There is still much to do, but we're finally making strong progress.

String.Source: Your aid is much appreciated. Thank you.
String.Dest: Your aid is much appreciated. Thank you.

String.Source: It's such a relief to see things improving. I hope you can continue to help.
String.Dest: It's such a relief to see things improving. I hope you can continue to help.

String.Source: I see... That is unfortunate.
String.Dest: I see... That is unfortunate.

String.Source: I hope you are able to help in the future.
String.Dest: I hope you are able to help in the future.

String.Source: I'm sorry to hear that. Skilled allies are in short supply.
String.Dest: I'm sorry to hear that. Skilled allies are in short supply.

String.Source: I think so. Let me see...
String.Dest: I think so. Let me see...

String.Source: Not at the moment. There's so much else to do that I barely have time to think.
String.Dest: Not at the moment. There's so much else to do that I barely have time to think.

String.Source: Well... Yes, but it's more of a personal matter. You're sure you wouldn't mind?
String.Dest: Well... Yes, but it's more of a personal matter. You're sure you wouldn't mind?

String.Source: I've been thinking lately... about the Reach. I've never been there - never so much as seen it from afar. I've never left the Old Lands.
String.Dest: I've been thinking lately... about the Reach. I've never been there - never so much as seen it from afar. I've never left the Old Lands.

String.Source: But despite all that, I'm still a daughter of the Reach. I still feel a close connection to the tribes of that land.
String.Dest: But despite all that, I'm still a daughter of the Reach. I still feel a close connection to the tribes of that land.

String.Source: It's a strange feeling, to be homesick for a land you've never seen, but... The more I think on it, the more my soul aches.
String.Dest: It's a strange feeling, to be homesick for a land you've never seen, but... The more I think on it, the more my soul aches.

String.Source: I don't know if I'll ever be able to leave the Old Lands, but perhaps I can have a piece of the Reach here with me... if you're willing to help.
String.Dest: I don't know if I'll ever be able to leave the Old Lands, but perhaps I can have a piece of the Reach here with me... if you're willing to help.

String.Source: Oh. That is... disappointing. I hope you reconsider.
String.Dest: Oh. That is... disappointing. I hope you reconsider.

String.Source: I... I see. Let me know if you change your mind.
String.Dest: I... I see. Let me know if you change your mind.

String.Source: Excellent! Serves the old fools right.
String.Dest: Excellent! Serves the old fools right.

String.Source: It should be safe to leave now. Might you escort me? Surely a brave warrior wouldn't abandon the lost maiden.
String.Dest: It should be safe to leave now. Might you escort me? Surely a brave warrior wouldn't abandon the lost maiden.

String.Source: Indeed. This will be a good place to shelter for now.
String.Dest: Indeed. This will be a good place to shelter for now.

String.Source: Now, as for the reward I promised you.
String.Dest: Now, as for the reward I promised you.

String.Source: I stashed some jewelry behind that cupboard over there. Help yourself.
String.Dest: I stashed some jewelry behind that cupboard over there. Help yourself.

String.Source: Before you leave, I'd like to ask you one last favor. I was communicating with a mage regarding a potential cure for my reliance on the Old Blood.
String.Dest: Before you leave, I'd like to ask you one last favor. I was communicating with a mage regarding a potential cure for my reliance on the Old Blood.

String.Source: For now, I intend to remain here while I make arrangements for the future.
String.Dest: For now, I intend to remain here while I make arrangements for the future.

String.Source: I have a number of items from my time with the Voidsuckers that I no longer need, so I'll make do by selling them off.
String.Dest: I have a number of items from my time with the Voidsuckers that I no longer need, so I'll make do by selling them off.

String.Source: Hm. That is an appealing prospect, but I'm afraid I can't go far from the Old Blood as long as I'm reliant on it.
String.Dest: Hm. That is an appealing prospect, but I'm afraid I can't go far from the Old Blood as long as I'm reliant on it.

String.Source: Though... Should my attempts to cure myself of this reliance succeed, I'll be sure to alert you.
String.Dest: Though... Should my attempts to cure myself of this reliance succeed, I'll be sure to alert you.

String.Source: That sounds delightful. Let me know whenever you wish to travel.
String.Dest: That sounds delightful. Let me know whenever you wish to travel.

String.Source: Heh. I can tell you have a specific one in mind.
String.Dest: Heh. I can tell you have a specific one in mind.

String.Source: However, I'm afraid I'll have to decline. After a few centuries with the Voidsuckers, I'd prefer to be unshackled for now. Perhaps in the future.
String.Dest: However, I'm afraid I'll have to decline. After a few centuries with the Voidsuckers, I'd prefer to be unshackled for now. Perhaps in the future.

String.Source: I'm sure you'll find something appealing.
String.Dest: I'm sure you'll find something appealing.

String.Source: Ah, thank you. Perhaps it means nothing to the spirits, but it is meaningful to those of us who still live, wouldn't you say?
String.Dest: Ah, thank you. Perhaps it means nothing to the spirits, but it is meaningful to those of us who still live, wouldn't you say?

String.Source: I'm sorry to hear that. Perhaps the years of neglect led my ancestor to feel he had been forgotten.
String.Dest: I'm sorry to hear that. Perhaps the years of neglect led my ancestor to feel he had been forgotten.

String.Source: I am glad you're unharmed. Hopefully my ancestor's spirit has been appeased now and will not attack others in the future...
String.Dest: I am glad you're unharmed. Hopefully my ancestor's spirit has been appeased now and will not attack others in the future...

String.Source: I hope so. Honoring our ancestors is important to the people of the Reach.
String.Dest: I hope so. Honoring our ancestors is important to the people of the Reach.

String.Source: Well, here is your pay. You have my thanks for indulging my request, friend. Please let me know if you ever require my aid.
String.Dest: Well, here is your pay. You have my thanks for indulging my request, friend. Please let me know if you ever require my aid.

String.Source: Seeing your efforts made me think. We've... stagnated. The Church is losing everything, and we're just waiting for it to fix itself.
String.Dest: Seeing your efforts made me think. We've... stagnated. The Church is losing everything, and we're just waiting for it to fix itself.

String.Source: I was always too afraid to do anything without Zenkali-Dra telling me to, even if I knew something was needed.
String.Dest: I was always too afraid to do anything without Zenkali-Dra telling me to, even if I knew something was needed.

String.Source: But you, a total stranger - you're taking action. Trying to help. That convinced me... I can't let myself be afraid to do what's right.
String.Dest: But you, a total stranger - you're taking action. Trying to help. That convinced me... I can't let myself be afraid to do what's right.

String.Source: I've been thinking of ways to help repair what's been done to our people. Simple tasks to help the Church.
String.Dest: I've been thinking of ways to help repair what's been done to our people. Simple tasks to help the Church.

String.Source: If you're willing to help out, I'll pay you whatever I can spare.
String.Dest: If you're willing to help out, I'll pay you whatever I can spare.

String.Source: Pardon me. Might I ask you for your help?
String.Dest: Pardon me. Might I ask you for your help?

String.Source: Do you have a moment? It's rather important.
String.Dest: Do you have a moment? It's rather important.

String.Source: Urg...
String.Dest: Urg...

String.Source: Ah... This will help. Thank you.
String.Dest: Ah... This will help. Thank you.

String.Source: Bless you, friend.
String.Dest: Bless you, friend.

String.Source: You're not going to let this go, are you?
String.Dest: You're not going to let this go, are you?

String.Source: Ugh. Fine. I'll leave the lizards alone, but they'd better start picking up the pace of Meat production, or we'll all have problems.
String.Dest: Ugh. Fine. I'll leave the lizards alone, but they'd better start picking up the pace of Meat production, or we'll all have problems.

String.Source: Well then, maybe they should work harder, hm? I'm not risking my life defending a bunch of incompetents without getting something for it.
String.Dest: Well then, maybe they should work harder, hm? I'm not risking my life defending a bunch of incompetents without getting something for it.

String.Source: You... You're serious, aren't you?
String.Dest: You... You're serious, aren't you?

String.Source: Damnit, fine. I'll leave the damn lizards alone. Happy now?
String.Dest: Damnit, fine. I'll leave the damn lizards alone. Happy now?

String.Source: Threatening me was your last mistake, outsider. And once I'm done with you, I'll teach those lizards what happens to complainers!
String.Dest: Threatening me was your last mistake, outsider. And once I'm done with you, I'll teach those lizards what happens to complainers!

String.Source: A deal's a deal. The miners won't have any more trouble.
String.Dest: A deal's a deal. The miners won't have any more trouble.

String.Source: I don't think we have anything left to discuss, outsider.
String.Dest: I don't think we have anything left to discuss, outsider.

String.Source: Fine! I was looking for a chance to let loose anyway!
String.Dest: Fine! I was looking for a chance to let loose anyway!

String.Source: Sure. You can make sure I have enough Meat of my own so I don't have to take it from their couriers.
String.Dest: Sure. You can make sure I have enough Meat of my own so I don't have to take it from their couriers.

String.Source: Tell you what. There's a nice supply of Meat down in Shuna-Jul... where we send all the malcontents.
String.Dest: Tell you what. There's a nice supply of Meat down in Shuna-Jul... where we send all the malcontents.

String.Source: Let's make a deal. I'll toss you in there - make up something about catching you pickpocketing.
String.Dest: Let's make a deal. I'll toss you in there - make up something about catching you pickpocketing.

String.Source: And while you're doing your labor there, you'll also dig up some Meat for me. You bring me that, and I'll never bother the miners again.
String.Dest: And while you're doing your labor there, you'll also dig up some Meat for me. You bring me that, and I'll never bother the miners again.

String.Source: Glad to hear it. Time for your "arrest" then. And don't worry... I'll let you keep your stuff this time.
String.Dest: Glad to hear it. Time for your "arrest" then. And don't worry... I'll let you keep your stuff this time.

String.Source: Then I guess we're done here, outsider.
String.Dest: Then I guess we're done here, outsider.

String.Source: I admit, I didn't think you'd actually do it, outsider.
String.Dest: I admit, I didn't think you'd actually do it, outsider.

String.Source: A deal's a deal. I won't bother those miners anymore.
String.Dest: A deal's a deal. I won't bother those miners anymore.

String.Source: Hopefully this shortage can be sorted out soon. I've seen enough good folk turn Dryblood already.
String.Dest: Hopefully this shortage can be sorted out soon. I've seen enough good folk turn Dryblood already.

String.Source: If true, it has my thanks. We have enough struggles already without the guards turning on us.
String.Dest: If true, it has my thanks. We have enough struggles already without the guards turning on us.

String.Source: I am sorry it has to get involved, but it is good that the problem is resolved.
String.Dest: I am sorry it has to get involved, but it is good that the problem is resolved.

String.Source: I will not keep it longer. May its scales stay moist, friend.
String.Dest: I will not keep it longer. May its scales stay moist, friend.

String.Source: Xuth! Is it trying to get the guards to turn on us?!
String.Dest: Xuth! Is it trying to get the guards to turn on us?!

String.Source: Leave quickly, while it is not discovered! And pray that the blame for that death falls on the Drybloods, not us!
String.Dest: Leave quickly, while it is not discovered! And pray that the blame for that death falls on the Drybloods, not us!

String.Source: I shake my head in sorrow. This is not a result I desire.
String.Dest: I shake my head in sorrow. This is not a result I desire.

String.Source: Perhaps my job is easier now, but the loss of a life is not to be praised.
String.Dest: Perhaps my job is easier now, but the loss of a life is not to be praised.

String.Source: This one will follow you into battle.
String.Dest: This one will follow you into battle.

String.Source: Our enemies shall fear our claws.
String.Dest: Our enemies shall fear our claws.

String.Source: We return to the fight.
String.Dest: We return to the fight.

String.Source: This one was growing tired of waiting.
String.Dest: This one was growing tired of waiting.

String.Source: This one does not work well in groups. Return when you do not have others with you.
String.Dest: This one does not work well in groups. Return when you do not have others with you.

String.Source: Do not keep this one waiting long.
String.Dest: Do not keep this one waiting long.

String.Source: This one will return to the village then.
String.Dest: This one will return to the village then.

String.Source: Then this one will return home, my love.
String.Dest: Then this one will return home, my love.

String.Source: This one will share your burdens.
String.Dest: This one will share your burdens.

String.Source: Then this one will carry them for you.
String.Dest: Then this one will carry them for you.

String.Source: Alright prisoner, pay attention.
String.Dest: Alright prisoner, pay attention.

String.Source: Welcome to Shuna-Jul. This isn't like Skyrim. No comfy cell for you to wait out your sentence here.
String.Dest: Welcome to Shuna-Jul. This isn't like Skyrim. No comfy cell for you to wait out your sentence here.

String.Source: If you want your freedom, you'll have to earn it.
String.Dest: If you want your freedom, you'll have to earn it.

String.Source: Well, well, well. Back again, prisoner?
String.Dest: Well, well, well. Back again, prisoner?

String.Source: Well, if you can't stay out of trouble, we'll have to find a better use for you. Time to earn your freedom or die trying.
String.Dest: Well, if you can't stay out of trouble, we'll have to find a better use for you. Time to earn your freedom or die trying.

String.Source: No need for me to give you the explanation, hm? Let's get right to it.
String.Dest: No need for me to give you the explanation, hm? Let's get right to it.

String.Source: Either you're mad or there's something you're after.
String.Dest: Either you're mad or there's something you're after.

String.Source: Either way, you know how this works. Do your labor without complaining, and you'll see the outside again.
String.Dest: Either way, you know how this works. Do your labor without complaining, and you'll see the outside again.

String.Source: You're doing this on purpose, aren't you? If you just need work, there's easier ways to get a job.
String.Dest: You're doing this on purpose, aren't you? If you just need work, there's easier ways to get a job.

String.Source: Well, let's get on with it.
String.Dest: Well, let's get on with it.

String.Source: Since you're so familiar with this place by now, I've got a special one for you.
String.Dest: Since you're so familiar with this place by now, I've got a special one for you.

String.Source: There's a specific voriplasm that's been causing us a lot of trouble. We even sent down a group of guards... None of them came back.
String.Dest: There's a specific voriplasm that's been causing us a lot of trouble. We even sent down a group of guards... None of them came back.

String.Source: You kill that thing, and you'll have your freedom.
String.Dest: You kill that thing, and you'll have your freedom.

String.Source: Some of the prisoners tried to tunnel out. Fools didn't realize we're underneath the other xanmeers... Ended up releasing a swarm of voriplasms.
String.Dest: Some of the prisoners tried to tunnel out. Fools didn't realize we're underneath the other xanmeers... Ended up releasing a swarm of voriplasms.

String.Source: Problem is, we can't afford to waste supplies. Get down there and recover their tools.
String.Dest: Problem is, we can't afford to waste supplies. Get down there and recover their tools.

String.Source: Some of your fellow prisoners got crushed by a rockslide. It's too late for them, but we can't leave their tools to rust. Go get them back.
String.Dest: Some of your fellow prisoners got crushed by a rockslide. It's too late for them, but we can't leave their tools to rust. Go get them back.

String.Source: A swarm of voriplasms was spotted in the lower levels. We can't get any mining done while those things are there - clear them out.
String.Dest: A swarm of voriplasms was spotted in the lower levels. We can't get any mining done while those things are there - clear them out.

String.Source: That big voriplasm may be gone, but we still have to deal with the smaller ones. I want you to clear out a nest of them.
String.Dest: That big voriplasm may be gone, but we still have to deal with the smaller ones. I want you to clear out a nest of them.

String.Source: I'd hoped killing that big voriplasm would stop the smaller ones from coming, but no luck. Guess you'll have to keep clearing them out, prisoner.
String.Dest: I'd hoped killing that big voriplasm would stop the smaller ones from coming, but no luck. Guess you'll have to keep clearing them out, prisoner.

String.Source: Someone opened a tunnel into a nest of voriplasms. If they're not dealt with, they'll eat all the ore. Wipe them out.
String.Dest: Someone opened a tunnel into a nest of voriplasms. If they're not dealt with, they'll eat all the ore. Wipe them out.

String.Source: I'll give you an easy one. We're behind our ore quota - bring me fifteen samples of Dried Blood Ore and you can go.
String.Dest: I'll give you an easy one. We're behind our ore quota - bring me fifteen samples of Dried Blood Ore and you can go.

String.Source: One of the prisoners dug up... something. Dunno what it is, but now we've got a swarm of monsters around it.
String.Dest: One of the prisoners dug up... something. Dunno what it is, but now we've got a swarm of monsters around it.

String.Source: Whatever that thing is, it needs to be destroyed.
String.Dest: Whatever that thing is, it needs to be destroyed.

String.Source: And try not to die, prisoner. You don't want to know what those things did to the other corpses.
String.Dest: And try not to die, prisoner. You don't want to know what those things did to the other corpses.

String.Source: No matter how many this one kills, there will always be more.
String.Dest: No matter how many this one kills, there will always be more.

String.Source: This one and his brother work hard to push them back. This one kills them himself, and Ma'Jaka offers pay to those who will help in the fight.
String.Dest: This one and his brother work hard to push them back. This one kills them himself, and Ma'Jaka offers pay to those who will help in the fight.

String.Source: Best get to work, prisoner. Until the job's done, you're not leaving.
String.Dest: Best get to work, prisoner. Until the job's done, you're not leaving.

String.Source: Try not to cause any trouble in the future.
String.Dest: Try not to cause any trouble in the future.

String.Source: So you do.
String.Dest: So you do.

String.Source: Good work, prisoner. I'll take those off your hands, and you're free to go.
String.Dest: Good work, prisoner. I'll take those off your hands, and you're free to go.

String.Source: Huh! I didn't really think you'd be able to do it.
String.Dest: Huh! I didn't really think you'd be able to do it.

String.Source: You know what, prisoner? You've earned a bonus.
String.Dest: You know what, prisoner? You've earned a bonus.

String.Source: Hopefully, this will keep you from feeling the need to cause trouble in the future.
String.Dest: Hopefully, this will keep you from feeling the need to cause trouble in the future.

String.Source: For now, at least. Those damn things are relentless.
String.Dest: For now, at least. Those damn things are relentless.

String.Source: Well, the job is done. You've earned your freedom.
String.Dest: Well, the job is done. You've earned your freedom.

String.Source: Good. Damn thing just felt wrong. Unnatural.
String.Dest: Good. Damn thing just felt wrong. Unnatural.

String.Source: Can't help but feel like it might reappear, though. Things like that don't go away easily.
String.Dest: Can't help but feel like it might reappear, though. Things like that don't go away easily.

String.Source: Maybe it's just this place. Darkness plays tricks on the mind. Either way, the job is done. You've earned your freedom.
String.Dest: Maybe it's just this place. Darkness plays tricks on the mind. Either way, the job is done. You've earned your freedom.

String.Source: Hm. Not in the best shape, are they?
String.Dest: Hm. Not in the best shape, are they?

String.Source: Well, they'll do the job for now. You're free to go, prisoner.
String.Dest: Well, they'll do the job for now. You're free to go, prisoner.

String.Source: Most kind of you to offer. However, I've already completed the majority of my research tasks myself. All that remains is some final analysis.
String.Dest: Most kind of you to offer. However, I've already completed the majority of my research tasks myself. All that remains is some final analysis.

String.Source: I doubt you'd find much of interest in helping me compare the hundreds of results of alchemical reagents on these Blood samples.
String.Dest: I doubt you'd find much of interest in helping me compare the hundreds of results of alchemical reagents on these Blood samples.

String.Source: Though, if you have the time to spare regardless, perhaps you could help me indulge my personal curiosity about this realm.
String.Dest: Though, if you have the time to spare regardless, perhaps you could help me indulge my personal curiosity about this realm.

String.Source: You see, I'm quite fascinated by Ayleid ruins. There are such variations amongst them - each Ayleid kingdom had its own unique culture.
String.Dest: You see, I'm quite fascinated by Ayleid ruins. There are such variations amongst them - each Ayleid kingdom had its own unique culture.

String.Source: My mistress has recently taken an interest in Ayleid ruins, you see.
String.Dest: My mistress has recently taken an interest in Ayleid ruins, you see.

String.Source: Well, one ruin in particular, really - but the ruins here in the Old Lands seem to originate from the same culture as the Ayleids of Varladimath.
String.Dest: Well, one ruin in particular, really - but the ruins here in the Old Lands seem to originate from the same culture as the Ayleids of Varladimath.

String.Source: If you'd be willing to indulge my curiosity, I wish to study several of the ruins here in a bit more depth.
String.Dest: If you'd be willing to indulge my curiosity, I wish to study several of the ruins here in a bit more depth.

String.Source: There are two that interest me at present - Varloria Kemet, and Goria Autaracu.
String.Dest: There are two that interest me at present - Varloria Kemet, and Goria Autaracu.

String.Source: Each ruin should have a "throne room" of sorts - a place where things of importance would be displayed.
String.Dest: Each ruin should have a "throne room" of sorts - a place where things of importance would be displayed.

String.Source: If you can recover any Ayleid writings stored in those chambers, I would be most eager to study them.
String.Dest: If you can recover any Ayleid writings stored in those chambers, I would be most eager to study them.

String.Source: I'm pleased to hear it, but perhaps that should wait until we're back in my hideout. Now's not the best time.
String.Dest: I'm pleased to hear it, but perhaps that should wait until we're back in my hideout. Now's not the best time.

String.Source: Ah, excellent! I'm rather fluent in Ayleidoon, so this should be a decently speedy translation. Bear with me a moment.
String.Dest: Ah, excellent! I'm rather fluent in Ayleidoon, so this should be a decently speedy translation. Bear with me a moment.

String.Source: Hm, interesting.
String.Dest: Hm, interesting.

String.Source: The notes from Goria Autaracu are written in a rather odd dialect, but the keeper of Varloria Kemet seems to have kept marvelously detailed notes.
String.Dest: The notes from Goria Autaracu are written in a rather odd dialect, but the keeper of Varloria Kemet seems to have kept marvelously detailed notes.

String.Source: It appears the various ruins throughout the forest were designed as sites for magical rituals.
String.Dest: It appears the various ruins throughout the forest were designed as sites for magical rituals.

String.Source: The rituals themselves are rather vague... Mostly religious babbling about "Hollowing our souls" and the like. But this... hm.
String.Dest: The rituals themselves are rather vague... Mostly religious babbling about "Hollowing our souls" and the like. But this... hm.

String.Source: It seems their Hollow Princess provided each of her vassals with a large collection of varla stones for use in their rituals.
String.Dest: It seems their Hollow Princess provided each of her vassals with a large collection of varla stones for use in their rituals.

String.Source: According to the Varloria Kemet tablet, excess varla stones were kept in a ruin known as "Sunnandhame."
String.Dest: According to the Varloria Kemet tablet, excess varla stones were kept in a ruin known as "Sunnandhame."

String.Source: Heh. Imagine having such a surplus of magical relics that you needed to construct a special site to hold them!
String.Dest: Heh. Imagine having such a surplus of magical relics that you needed to construct a special site to hold them!

String.Source: I would very much like to learn more about this Sunnandhame. If we assume it is in a place that each of the Ayleid settlements could access...
String.Dest: I would very much like to learn more about this Sunnandhame. If we assume it is in a place that each of the Ayleid settlements could access...

String.Source: Here. I've marked a spot on your map that seems promising. I suspect you'll find what remains of Sunnandhame in that general area.
String.Dest: Here. I've marked a spot on your map that seems promising. I suspect you'll find what remains of Sunnandhame in that general area.

String.Source: Do let me know if you find anything there.
String.Dest: Do let me know if you find anything there.

String.Source: I'm pleased to hear it, but perhaps that should wait until we're back in my hideout. Now's not the best time.
String.Dest: I'm pleased to hear it, but perhaps that should wait until we're back in my hideout. Now's not the best time.

String.Source: Ah, fascinating! Please, let me see the tablet.
String.Dest: Ah, fascinating! Please, let me see the tablet.

String.Source: Heh, I can see the concern in your eyes. Don't worry, I won't claim any of those varla stones for myself!
String.Dest: Heh, I can see the concern in your eyes. Don't worry, I won't claim any of those varla stones for myself!

String.Source: Hm. This is a more archaic dialect of Ayleidoon than I'm accustomed to. It may take some time to translate this one.
String.Dest: Hm. This is a more archaic dialect of Ayleidoon than I'm accustomed to. It may take some time to translate this one.

String.Source: Well, I find translation work rather pleasant, so that isn't an issue. But I won't ask you to stand here for the weeks that work may take!
String.Dest: Well, I find translation work rather pleasant, so that isn't an issue. But I won't ask you to stand here for the weeks that work may take!

String.Source: Here. I hope you find this appropriate compensation for your assistance.
String.Dest: Here. I hope you find this appropriate compensation for your assistance.

String.Source: Thank you again for indulging my whims. If I discover anything interesting in my translation of these tablets, I'll be sure to let you know.
String.Dest: Thank you again for indulging my whims. If I discover anything interesting in my translation of these tablets, I'll be sure to let you know.

String.Source: Hahaha! Did you think you were the only Vessel?
String.Dest: Hahaha! Did you think you were the only Vessel?

String.Source: I'll simply destroy you and use the new Vessel in my conquest!
String.Dest: I'll simply destroy you and use the new Vessel in my conquest!

String.Source: Kehehehe.
String.Dest: Kehehehe.

String.Source: Destroy them, my servant!
String.Dest: Destroy them, my servant!

String.Source: Ghhk?
String.Dest: Ghhk?

String.Source: Don't just stand there, you fool! Kill th-
String.Dest: Don't just stand there, you fool! Kill th-

String.Source: RRRRAAAAGGGGHHHH!
String.Dest: RRRRAAAAGGGGHHHH!

String.Source: So be it! I'll destroy you all myself!
String.Dest: So be it! I'll destroy you all myself!

String.Source: You cannot stop me! This world is mine to rule!
String.Dest: You cannot stop me! This world is mine to rule!

String.Source: Worthless, disobedient Vessels! I'll destroy you!
String.Dest: Worthless, disobedient Vessels! I'll destroy you!

String.Source: This world exists for me! You are nothing!
String.Dest: This world exists for me! You are nothing!

String.Source: I am the worm!
String.Dest: I am the worm!

String.Source: Namira! Bless your chosen one!
String.Dest: Namira! Bless your chosen one!

String.Source: The Aurbis is mine to rule!
String.Dest: The Aurbis is mine to rule!

String.Source: Bow down, and I'll make your death swift!
String.Dest: Bow down, and I'll make your death swift!

String.Source: No... Not... possible....
String.Dest: No... Not... possible....

String.Source: Aghk-
String.Dest: Aghk-

String.Source: It has our thanks. Perhaps the waters ahead are less troubled now.
String.Dest: It has our thanks. Perhaps the waters ahead are less troubled now.

String.Source: Woah. Never seen that happen before.
String.Dest: Woah. Never seen that happen before.

String.Source: There really is something unique about your soul, isn't there?
String.Dest: There really is something unique about your soul, isn't there?

String.Source: The Vampyrum Order... I thought they were a myth!
String.Dest: The Vampyrum Order... I thought they were a myth!

String.Source: The Vampyrum Order... Ciirta mentioned them in her last message.
String.Dest: The Vampyrum Order... Ciirta mentioned them in her last message.

String.Source: Their presence here is concerning. Thank you for alerting me.
String.Dest: Their presence here is concerning. Thank you for alerting me.

String.Source: Where was the vampire hiding?
String.Dest: Where was the vampire hiding?

String.Source: Ah, interesting...
String.Dest: Ah, interesting...

String.Source: Well, I will handle investigating the vampire's lair. You've done us a great service already.
String.Dest: Well, I will handle investigating the vampire's lair. You've done us a great service already.

String.Source: Hehehe!
String.Dest: Hehehe!

String.Source: Kyne's blessings upon you.
String.Dest: Kyne's blessings upon you.

String.Source: The Gildergreen is revived! This is surely a sign from Kynareth. Peace will return to Skyrim.
String.Dest: The Gildergreen is revived! This is surely a sign from Kynareth. Peace will return to Skyrim.

String.Source: Let us pray that the Eldergleam's sapling grows to be as grand as its parent.
String.Dest: Let us pray that the Eldergleam's sapling grows to be as grand as its parent.

String.Source: Greetings. Are you here for healing? If so, I'm afraid we've no spare beds.
String.Dest: Greetings. Are you here for healing? If so, I'm afraid we've no spare beds.

String.Source: By the Gods... Such a foul aura. Those are not of this world.
String.Dest: By the Gods... Such a foul aura. Those are not of this world.

String.Source: You made a wise choice to come here. I can sense a powerful curse upon these... Any attempt to be rid of them through normal means would be futile.
String.Dest: You made a wise choice to come here. I can sense a powerful curse upon these... Any attempt to be rid of them through normal means would be futile.

String.Source: I believe I can perform a ritual to rid you of them, but it will take me a bit to prepare... and we cannot do it here.
String.Dest: I believe I can perform a ritual to rid you of them, but it will take me a bit to prepare... and we cannot do it here.

String.Source: Place the eggs on the altar I've prepared. And pray that my spell works.
String.Dest: Place the eggs on the altar I've prepared. And pray that my spell works.

String.Source: Oh Blessed Mother Kynareth, Patron of Nature, we beseech your aid.
String.Dest: Oh Blessed Mother Kynareth, Patron of Nature, we beseech your aid.

String.Source: Purge the influence of this dark being. Destroy these cursed eggs before they can bring harm to your children.
String.Dest: Purge the influence of this dark being. Destroy these cursed eggs before they can bring harm to your children.

String.Source: I... I believe so.
String.Dest: I... I believe so.

String.Source: That horrid voice... Was that the spirit that inflicted that curse on you?
String.Dest: That horrid voice... Was that the spirit that inflicted that curse on you?

String.Source: Just the sound of it makes me feel ill. There is something truly foul about that spirit... More than even I'd expect from a daedra.
String.Dest: Just the sound of it makes me feel ill. There is something truly foul about that spirit... More than even I'd expect from a daedra.

String.Source: Be cautious, my friend. Such a being will not soon lose interest in you.
String.Dest: Be cautious, my friend. Such a being will not soon lose interest in you.

String.Source: Still... At least those foul eggs are destroyed. Be proud of that - you made the right choice.
String.Dest: Still... At least those foul eggs are destroyed. Be proud of that - you made the right choice.

String.Source: Wh- Why would you do that?!
String.Dest: Wh- Why would you do that?!

String.Source: Are you trying to earn points with Kalarix or something?! Trust me, that will not end well.
String.Dest: Are you trying to earn points with Kalarix or something?! Trust me, that will not end well.

String.Source: An Amulet of Mara? Can't say I expected to see you wearing that.
String.Dest: An Amulet of Mara? Can't say I expected to see you wearing that.

String.Source: What's your desire?
String.Dest: What's your desire?

String.Source: Shall we?
String.Dest: Shall we?

String.Source: What shall we do now?
String.Dest: What shall we do now?

String.Source: I thought you'd never ask.
String.Dest: I thought you'd never ask.

String.Source: Of course you need me. You don't need to tell me that.
String.Dest: Of course you need me. You don't need to tell me that.

String.Source: Back to it then.
String.Dest: Back to it then.

String.Source: I was starting to get bored.
String.Dest: I was starting to get bored.

String.Source: A bit too many people, wouldn't you say? I might just mistake the others for food.
String.Dest: A bit too many people, wouldn't you say? I might just mistake the others for food.

String.Source: You'll be missing me before long.
String.Dest: You'll be missing me before long.

String.Source: Let's not be apart too long, hm?
String.Dest: Let's not be apart too long, hm?

String.Source: Hm. If you insist.
String.Dest: Hm. If you insist.

String.Source: If I must.
String.Dest: If I must.

String.Source: Don't keep me waiting too long.
String.Dest: Don't keep me waiting too long.

String.Source: Certainly. I might even let you have them back later.
String.Dest: Certainly. I might even let you have them back later.

String.Source: In you? Most certainly. But not in marriage.
String.Dest: In you? Most certainly. But not in marriage.

String.Source: Terribly sorry, but someone like me wouldn't do well in a temple.
String.Dest: Terribly sorry, but someone like me wouldn't do well in a temple.

String.Source: Crow, little crow, little watcher of skies, crow from the heart and ye never shall die.
String.Dest: Crow, little crow, little watcher of skies, crow from the heart and ye never shall die.

String.Source: Winged of heel and hale of wing, for the mighty mountain all feathers shall sing.
String.Dest: Winged of heel and hale of wing, for the mighty mountain all feathers shall sing.

String.Source: Oh, there once was a hero who... something s-something... lah lah lah la la... Agh, kill me...
String.Dest: Oh, there once was a hero who... something s-something... lah lah lah la la... Agh, kill me...

String.Source: My, you are serious; aren't you?
String.Dest: My, you are serious; aren't you?

String.Source: Hm. I suppose I could be persuaded to give it a try... if you're certain.
String.Dest: Hm. I suppose I could be persuaded to give it a try... if you're certain.

String.Source: Well, how could I refuse passion like that?
String.Dest: Well, how could I refuse passion like that?

String.Source: Very well. Let's give Skyrim a wedding it will never forget, hm?
String.Dest: Very well. Let's give Skyrim a wedding it will never forget, hm?

String.Source: Indeed. Why change a good thing?
String.Dest: Indeed. Why change a good thing?

String.Source: We've got a fine enough relationship already, wouldn't you say? No need to change anything.
String.Dest: We've got a fine enough relationship already, wouldn't you say? No need to change anything.

String.Source: For the Cronvangr!
String.Dest: For the Cronvangr!

String.Source: Feel the bite of the spiders!
String.Dest: Feel the bite of the spiders!

String.Source: For the Quarra!
String.Dest: For the Quarra!

String.Source: For Volrina!
String.Dest: For Volrina!

String.Source: Face the power of the Volkihar!
String.Dest: Face the power of the Volkihar!

String.Source: The Volkihar rule the night!
String.Dest: The Volkihar rule the night!

String.Source: Mhm.
String.Dest: Mhm.

String.Source: You return alive. Was your journey successful?
String.Dest: You return alive. Was your journey successful?

String.Source: That... is that not the Bloodfire Amulet? To think it still exists...
String.Dest: That... is that not the Bloodfire Amulet? To think it still exists...

String.Source: A fellow Snow Elf! I had thought Ysgramor's people wiped us from Mundus!
String.Dest: A fellow Snow Elf! I had thought Ysgramor's people wiped us from Mundus!

String.Source: You still live, I see. Let us hope that stays true.
String.Dest: You still live, I see. Let us hope that stays true.

String.Source: None are spared the curse.
String.Dest: None are spared the curse.

String.Source: A... A Hist?
String.Dest: A... A Hist?

String.Source: We... We've been worshipping a tree?!
String.Dest: We... We've been worshipping a tree?!

String.Source: Heh... Heheh...
String.Dest: Heh... Heheh...

String.Source: I suppose we owe the Argonians in the swamp an apology. Have their efforts been sustaining this land for us?
String.Dest: I suppose we owe the Argonians in the swamp an apology. Have their efforts been sustaining this land for us?

String.Source: I'm sorry. I'll... Need some time to think.
String.Dest: I'm sorry. I'll... Need some time to think.

String.Source: Yes. It's quite important.
String.Dest: Yes. It's quite important.

String.Source: I'm sure you're well aware that the Church and the miners haven't been on the best of terms for quite some time.
String.Dest: I'm sure you're well aware that the Church and the miners haven't been on the best of terms for quite some time.

String.Source: I think it's high time we put an end to that. The Blood is finished - if we don't band together, we'll all become Drybloods before we cure ourselves.
String.Dest: I think it's high time we put an end to that. The Blood is finished - if we don't band together, we'll all become Drybloods before we cure ourselves.

String.Source: We need a new start - an end to the bickering.
String.Dest: We need a new start - an end to the bickering.

String.Source: I'm... not sure. She said something about being inspired by your determination.
String.Dest: I'm... not sure. She said something about being inspired by your determination.

String.Source: I believe she's gone on a pilgrimage. Until she chooses to return, I will do my best as overseer of the Church.
String.Dest: I believe she's gone on a pilgrimage. Until she chooses to return, I will do my best as overseer of the Church.

String.Source: Ah, this one is pleased.
String.Dest: Ah, this one is pleased.

String.Source: Very well. This one will hold to her end of the bargain.
String.Dest: Very well. This one will hold to her end of the bargain.

String.Source: Take this key. It will unlock the attic. You can reach the belltower through there.
String.Dest: Take this key. It will unlock the attic. You can reach the belltower through there.

String.Source: Perhaps you will even survive this foolish mission. This one doubts it, though.
String.Dest: Perhaps you will even survive this foolish mission. This one doubts it, though.

String.Source: Already served my sentence... How was I to know I couldn't pocket some Meat on the way out?
String.Dest: Already served my sentence... How was I to know I couldn't pocket some Meat on the way out?

String.Source: Watch your step. Easy to miss a chasm in this darkness.
String.Dest: Watch your step. Easy to miss a chasm in this darkness.

String.Source: If you hear a voice coming from the darkness... Don't answer. Pretend it's the wind.
String.Dest: If you hear a voice coming from the darkness... Don't answer. Pretend it's the wind.

String.Source: Damn... Leg still hurts...
String.Dest: Damn... Leg still hurts...

String.Source: How long since I've had my share of Blood... Meat's not enough, damnit...
String.Dest: How long since I've had my share of Blood... Meat's not enough, damnit...

String.Source: This one is in a foul mood. Do not speak to him.
String.Dest: This one is in a foul mood. Do not speak to him.

String.Source: If you die, this one will take your things. It is only fair.
String.Dest: If you die, this one will take your things. It is only fair.

String.Source: As soon as this one is released, he will make that merchant suffer.
String.Dest: As soon as this one is released, he will make that merchant suffer.

String.Source: The Drybloods are vicious. This one is worse.
String.Dest: The Drybloods are vicious. This one is worse.

String.Source: This one is not sure what the voriplasms are, but this one does not want to see any more of them.
String.Dest: This one is not sure what the voriplasms are, but this one does not want to see any more of them.

String.Source: This one came here as part of a caravan. This one regrets that.
String.Dest: This one came here as part of a caravan. This one regrets that.

String.Source: Many of the ones arrested are nearly Dryblood already. They never last long.
String.Dest: Many of the ones arrested are nearly Dryblood already. They never last long.

String.Source: This one once saw a maggot the size of a Senche. This one was not pleased.
String.Dest: This one once saw a maggot the size of a Senche. This one was not pleased.

String.Source: This one hears voices from the depths when she sleeps. She pretends they are dreams.
String.Dest: This one hears voices from the depths when she sleeps. She pretends they are dreams.

String.Source: Damn all of you... You betray by staying here.
String.Dest: Damn all of you... You betray by staying here.

String.Source: Locking me up won't stop the Forsworn. This land's magic will be ours.
String.Dest: Locking me up won't stop the Forsworn. This land's magic will be ours.

String.Source: I've been in Cidnha Mine. This is nothing.
String.Dest: I've been in Cidnha Mine. This is nothing.

String.Source: The Dark Spirits support the Forsworn. Those who oppose us are doomed.
String.Dest: The Dark Spirits support the Forsworn. Those who oppose us are doomed.

String.Source: Do you hear the whispers? The Spirits answer my prayers even here.
String.Dest: Do you hear the whispers? The Spirits answer my prayers even here.

String.Source: The woods are pretty damp, but be careful. I hate to think what would happen if a forest fire broke out.
String.Dest: The woods are pretty damp, but be careful. I hate to think what would happen if a forest fire broke out.

String.Source: The blight affecting the Roots is new. I hate to imagine what might have changed...
String.Dest: The blight affecting the Roots is new. I hate to imagine what might have changed...

String.Source: Be careful. Those ancient elves weren't the type to rest peacefully.
String.Dest: Be careful. Those ancient elves weren't the type to rest peacefully.

String.Source: Good luck. You'll need it.
String.Dest: Good luck. You'll need it.

String.Source: Be cautious. Don't want you grabbing any cursed relics.
String.Dest: Be cautious. Don't want you grabbing any cursed relics.

String.Source: Doubt you'll have to worry about that. Those ruins are better defended than most castles.
String.Dest: Doubt you'll have to worry about that. Those ruins are better defended than most castles.

String.Source: Make sure to stay on your guard.
String.Dest: Make sure to stay on your guard.

String.Source: I'm sorry to hear that. If you can't handle it, the guards certainly won't be able to.
String.Dest: I'm sorry to hear that. If you can't handle it, the guards certainly won't be able to.

String.Source: Well, come see me if you change your mind.
String.Dest: Well, come see me if you change your mind.

String.Source: You seem... oddly eager for that.
String.Dest: You seem... oddly eager for that.

String.Source: Well... I'll leave you to it then.
String.Dest: Well... I'll leave you to it then.

String.Source: You seem quite confident. Hope you can back it up.
String.Dest: You seem quite confident. Hope you can back it up.

String.Source: Uh... Sure. Just don't get bitten, okay?
String.Dest: Uh... Sure. Just don't get bitten, okay?

String.Source: Good luck. Watch out for their bites - don't need them spreading their influence to you.
String.Dest: Good luck. Watch out for their bites - don't need them spreading their influence to you.

String.Source: Let's hope they stay there this time.
String.Dest: Let's hope they stay there this time.

String.Source: (Bark!)
String.Dest: (Bark!)

String.Source: As I promised when we began this endeavor, we shall strike against the Voidsuckers... and give the Vigilants of Stendarr a black eye in the process.
String.Dest: As I promised when we began this endeavor, we shall strike against the Voidsuckers... and give the Vigilants of Stendarr a black eye in the process.

String.Source: If you were not yet aware, the Vigil has an undercover agent here in the Old Lands. One that sadly lacks our own sense of secrecy.
String.Dest: If you were not yet aware, the Vigil has an undercover agent here in the Old Lands. One that sadly lacks our own sense of secrecy.

String.Source: I speak of Ahodsil Thorntaker, the village healer. He has been working to help the Vigilants defeat the Daedric powers in this land.
String.Dest: I speak of Ahodsil Thorntaker, the village healer. He has been working to help the Vigilants defeat the Daedric powers in this land.

String.Source: Follow the flow of the water to victory.
String.Dest: Follow the flow of the water to victory.

String.Source: You see that too, right? That breach in reality?
String.Dest: You see that too, right? That breach in reality?

String.Source: Huh. Rukar was looking into the Ayleids? I wonder how an Ayleid got connected with a Nord vampire clan...
String.Dest: Huh. Rukar was looking into the Ayleids? I wonder how an Ayleid got connected with a Nord vampire clan...

String.Source: Hm. He must have been looking for something in these ruins, but I'm not sure what.
String.Dest: Hm. He must have been looking for something in these ruins, but I'm not sure what.

String.Source: Let's keep our eyes out for any clues.
String.Dest: Let's keep our eyes out for any clues.

String.Source: I can feel Namira's influence here. No wonder Rukar was interested in these ruins.
String.Dest: I can feel Namira's influence here. No wonder Rukar was interested in these ruins.

String.Source: I think I read about this place. The ancient Reachfolk thought Namira herself lived in the caverns below here.
String.Dest: I think I read about this place. The ancient Reachfolk thought Namira herself lived in the caverns below here.

String.Source: Another Void Breach. Who knows what damage it could do if left unattended...
String.Dest: Another Void Breach. Who knows what damage it could do if left unattended...

String.Source: Whatever Rukar was after here, I hope he didn't find it. Nothing good comes of Dwemer technology.
String.Dest: Whatever Rukar was after here, I hope he didn't find it. Nothing good comes of Dwemer technology.

String.Source: How many breaches did Rukar open? What was he even trying to do?
String.Dest: How many breaches did Rukar open? What was he even trying to do?

String.Source: Then at least one curse has been broken.
String.Dest: Then at least one curse has been broken.

String.Source: Our curse may yet remain, but it pleases me to know that no future victims will be drawn here by that foul false Blood.
String.Dest: Our curse may yet remain, but it pleases me to know that no future victims will be drawn here by that foul false Blood.

String.Source: And while it does no good to wish suffering on another...
String.Dest: And while it does no good to wish suffering on another...

String.Source: I must confess some satisfaction in the knowledge that the Hollow Princess must now be facing the wrath of her Daedric master.
String.Dest: I must confess some satisfaction in the knowledge that the Hollow Princess must now be facing the wrath of her Daedric master.

String.Source: Namira will not soon forgive her servant for allowing her plot to fail.
String.Dest: Namira will not soon forgive her servant for allowing her plot to fail.

String.Source: I have spent the last few millennia with little to do but ponder. But with no way to leave the Academy, I could not act upon my conclusions.
String.Dest: I have spent the last few millennia with little to do but ponder. But with no way to leave the Academy, I could not act upon my conclusions.

String.Source: You have my gratitude for doing what I could not.
String.Dest: You have my gratitude for doing what I could not.

String.Source: Now, you should depart from here. This is no place for the living, and our curse is ours to suffer. You have more adventures yet before you.
String.Dest: Now, you should depart from here. This is no place for the living, and our curse is ours to suffer. You have more adventures yet before you.

String.Source: I've arranged a meeting with Overseer Dokazeek. As an outsider who was drawn into the feud, I'd like you there as a neutral third party.
String.Dest: I've arranged a meeting with Overseer Dokazeek. As an outsider who was drawn into the feud, I'd like you there as a neutral third party.

String.Source: Should matters become heated, your outside opinion will help.
String.Dest: Should matters become heated, your outside opinion will help.

String.Source: Additionally... Well, I'm a bit worried about the Drybloods attacking me on the way there. I'd appreciate a bodyguard.
String.Dest: Additionally... Well, I'm a bit worried about the Drybloods attacking me on the way there. I'd appreciate a bodyguard.

String.Source: In better times, we were in charge of matters of the Old Blood. We stockpiled and distributed it.
String.Dest: In better times, we were in charge of matters of the Old Blood. We stockpiled and distributed it.

String.Source: Losing access to the Blood once one becomes reliant on it results in the Dryblood madness, but an overdose is just as dangerous.
String.Dest: Losing access to the Blood once one becomes reliant on it results in the Dryblood madness, but an overdose is just as dangerous.

String.Source: So the Church was in charge of ensuring everyone had enough. Not too much, not too little. It was a vital duty.
String.Dest: So the Church was in charge of ensuring everyone had enough. Not too much, not too little. It was a vital duty.

String.Source: Do you lack eyes? This one is the Priestess of the Old Blood!
String.Dest: Do you lack eyes? This one is the Priestess of the Old Blood!

String.Source: It is this one's duty to ensure all have sufficient Blood and Meat... but now we have neither!
String.Dest: It is this one's duty to ensure all have sufficient Blood and Meat... but now we have neither!

String.Source: This one must focus on her prayers if this is to be resolved. This one has no time for foolish questions!
String.Dest: This one must focus on her prayers if this is to be resolved. This one has no time for foolish questions!

String.Source: Ah... She is...
String.Dest: Ah... She is...

String.Source: Harsh... but I cannot blame her. The current state of the Old Lands... the shortage first of Blood and now of Meat as well...
String.Dest: Harsh... but I cannot blame her. The current state of the Old Lands... the shortage first of Blood and now of Meat as well...

String.Source: She is under immense strain.
String.Dest: She is under immense strain.

String.Source: I'm merely an acolyte. I cook and clean, and sometimes I aid in Blood rituals. But Zenkali-Dra is the one you want if you need anything.
String.Dest: I'm merely an acolyte. I cook and clean, and sometimes I aid in Blood rituals. But Zenkali-Dra is the one you want if you need anything.

String.Source: I suppose... I'm the Priestess of the Old Blood now. The administration of the entire Church falls to me.
String.Dest: I suppose... I'm the Priestess of the Old Blood now. The administration of the entire Church falls to me.

String.Source: I will... do my best.
String.Dest: I will... do my best.

String.Source: Hm? I sense something...
String.Dest: Hm? I sense something...

String.Source: Is something there?
String.Dest: Is something there?

String.Source: Oh? What was that?
String.Dest: Oh? What was that?

String.Source: Ah, there you are...
String.Dest: Ah, there you are...

String.Source: To battle, then.
String.Dest: To battle, then.

String.Source: Ah... How unfortunate.
String.Dest: Ah... How unfortunate.

String.Source: Thy sacrifice shall not be in vain.
String.Dest: Thy sacrifice shall not be in vain.

String.Source: Oh? A fight, hm?
String.Dest: Oh? A fight, hm?

String.Source: Trying to sneak up on me?
String.Dest: Trying to sneak up on me?

String.Source: As we were, then.
String.Dest: As we were, then.

String.Source: Shatter.
String.Dest: Shatter.

String.Source: To thy doom.
String.Dest: To thy doom.

String.Source: Thy death awaits.
String.Dest: Thy death awaits.

String.Source: Face my magic.
String.Dest: Face my magic.

String.Source: I've faced far worse than you.
String.Dest: I've faced far worse than you.

String.Source: I'll end thy existence.
String.Dest: I'll end thy existence.

String.Source: None hear my bell and live.
String.Dest: None hear my bell and live.

String.Source: The Glass chimes for thee.
String.Dest: The Glass chimes for thee.

String.Source: 'Tis far too late to flee.
String.Dest: 'Tis far too late to flee.

String.Source: Thou wer't doomed the instant I saw thee.
String.Dest: Thou wer't doomed the instant I saw thee.

String.Source: I'll... need a moment...
String.Dest: I'll... need a moment...

String.Source: Oh? You've mastered the Voice?
String.Dest: Oh? You've mastered the Voice?

String.Source: Ah, the Thu'um. It follows similar principles to mine own bells.
String.Dest: Ah, the Thu'um. It follows similar principles to mine own bells.

String.Source: The Ayleids created some works of true majesty, no?
String.Dest: The Ayleids created some works of true majesty, no?

String.Source: Be cautious. The Ayleids were masters of curses.
String.Dest: Be cautious. The Ayleids were masters of curses.

String.Source: Keep an eye out for Varla Stones. They're exceptionally valuable.
String.Dest: Keep an eye out for Varla Stones. They're exceptionally valuable.

String.Source: Be wary of traps.
String.Dest: Be wary of traps.

String.Source: Few cultures mastered curses the way the Ayleids did. Their aura still fills these stones...
String.Dest: Few cultures mastered curses the way the Ayleids did. Their aura still fills these stones...

String.Source: Hm... I admit, I don't see the appeal of xanmeers.
String.Dest: Hm... I admit, I don't see the appeal of xanmeers.

String.Source: The ancient Argonians were truly lacking in elegance.
String.Dest: The ancient Argonians were truly lacking in elegance.

String.Source: Do you sense them? Eyes in the darkness...
String.Dest: Do you sense them? Eyes in the darkness...

String.Source: It's quite dark here. Shall I light the way?
String.Dest: It's quite dark here. Shall I light the way?

String.Source: The aura of the Glass here is almost dizzying, no?
String.Dest: The aura of the Glass here is almost dizzying, no?

String.Source: Be wary... the Coldlight shines strongly here.
String.Dest: Be wary... the Coldlight shines strongly here.

String.Source: Let us shatter all in our way. 'Tis a mercy killing.
String.Dest: Let us shatter all in our way. 'Tis a mercy killing.

String.Source: Let me know if time seems to stop for thee. 'Tis an early sign of the affliction.
String.Dest: Let me know if time seems to stop for thee. 'Tis an early sign of the affliction.

String.Source: I doubt anything can release these trapped souls. They're part of the Glass now...
String.Dest: I doubt anything can release these trapped souls. They're part of the Glass now...

String.Source: Caves are rather dull, no?
String.Dest: Caves are rather dull, no?

String.Source: Watch thy step. Loose stones are everywhere.
String.Dest: Watch thy step. Loose stones are everywhere.

String.Source: Tch. Falmer are truly foul creatures.
String.Dest: Tch. Falmer are truly foul creatures.

String.Source: Be on guard.
String.Dest: Be on guard.

String.Source: Watch for enemies.
String.Dest: Watch for enemies.

String.Source: ...Ah, pardon. I was lost in childhood memories...
String.Dest: ...Ah, pardon. I was lost in childhood memories...

String.Source: Dragur, zombies, liches... Whatever the cause, the undead are a plague on the living.
String.Dest: Dragur, zombies, liches... Whatever the cause, the undead are a plague on the living.

String.Source: Tch. Bandits are a plague on all right-mannered souls. Let us end them.
String.Dest: Tch. Bandits are a plague on all right-mannered souls. Let us end them.

String.Source: Bandits often attack patients on their way to the Asylum. Let us repay their cruelty tenfold.
String.Dest: Bandits often attack patients on their way to the Asylum. Let us repay their cruelty tenfold.

String.Source: One doesn't see many Dwemer ruins in Cyrodiil. They're quite fascinating, no?
String.Dest: One doesn't see many Dwemer ruins in Cyrodiil. They're quite fascinating, no?

String.Source: The Tonal Architecture of the Dwemer is not too different from the Thu'um... or from mine own bell.
String.Dest: The Tonal Architecture of the Dwemer is not too different from the Thu'um... or from mine own bell.

String.Source: I wonder if the souls powering these automatons retain any intelligence...
String.Dest: I wonder if the souls powering these automatons retain any intelligence...

String.Source: Hast thou ever seen a wailway? Some ruined tracks still run 'cross Cyrodiil...
String.Dest: Hast thou ever seen a wailway? Some ruined tracks still run 'cross Cyrodiil...

String.Source: Does my lack of concern here seem strange? In truth, I'm immune to vampirism. I'll ask thee not to inquire further, though.
String.Dest: Does my lack of concern here seem strange? In truth, I'm immune to vampirism. I'll ask thee not to inquire further, though.

String.Source: I do so enjoy these excursions.
String.Dest: I do so enjoy these excursions.

String.Source: Exploration is always stimulating.
String.Dest: Exploration is always stimulating.

String.Source: Heh. Barely worth my notice.
String.Dest: Heh. Barely worth my notice.

String.Source: Good attempt. Perhaps next time you'll even hit me.
String.Dest: Good attempt. Perhaps next time you'll even hit me.

String.Source: Was that thy blade? I took it for a gnat.
String.Dest: Was that thy blade? I took it for a gnat.

String.Source: Gh... 'tis nothing.
String.Dest: Gh... 'tis nothing.

String.Source: Hah! Is that thy best?
String.Dest: Hah! Is that thy best?

String.Source: I've taken worse hits than that!
String.Dest: I've taken worse hits than that!

String.Source: Rgg!
String.Dest: Rgg!

String.Source: Ah... hah...
String.Dest: Ah... hah...

String.Source: Gh!
String.Dest: Gh!

String.Source: Hm. The only way it could have ended.
String.Dest: Hm. The only way it could have ended.

String.Source: Back to work, then.
String.Dest: Back to work, then.

String.Source: And that's that.
String.Dest: And that's that.

String.Source: Heh. Quite satisfying.
String.Dest: Heh. Quite satisfying.

String.Source: Oh? Trying to flee?
String.Dest: Oh? Trying to flee?

String.Source: None can hide from my bell.
String.Dest: None can hide from my bell.

String.Source: Heh, no match for us.
String.Dest: Heh, no match for us.

String.Source: And that's that dealt with.
String.Dest: And that's that dealt with.

String.Source: So much for that.
String.Dest: So much for that.

String.Source: Phew.
String.Dest: Phew.

String.Source: Victory!
String.Dest: Victory!

String.Source: Another battle won.
String.Dest: Another battle won.

String.Source: Heh, we're a good team.
String.Dest: Heh, we're a good team.

String.Source: Hm... I no longer sense anyone.
String.Dest: Hm... I no longer sense anyone.

String.Source: It appears they've fled.
String.Dest: It appears they've fled.

String.Source: There you are, little morsel!
String.Dest: There you are, little morsel!

String.Source: Ha! Should have fled while you could, meat!
String.Dest: Ha! Should have fled while you could, meat!

String.Source: Life here is difficult and dangerous. Humor is the antidote to that suffering.
String.Dest: Life here is difficult and dangerous. Humor is the antidote to that suffering.

String.Source: Whenever traders from Tamriel come, I purchase any joke books they have for sale. I hope to eventually swim fully in the River of Comedy.
String.Dest: Whenever traders from Tamriel come, I purchase any joke books they have for sale. I hope to eventually swim fully in the River of Comedy.

String.Source: It is from Tamriel, yes? Perhaps it can help me practice my jokes.
String.Dest: It is from Tamriel, yes? Perhaps it can help me practice my jokes.

String.Source: Certainly! The book I read says this is a classic of Nordic humor.
String.Dest: Certainly! The book I read says this is a classic of Nordic humor.

String.Source: "What do you get if you cross a Snow Troll with a Falmer?"
String.Dest: "What do you get if you cross a Snow Troll with a Falmer?"

String.Source: It is not laughing. Perhaps I should memorize the second half of that joke as well.
String.Dest: It is not laughing. Perhaps I should memorize the second half of that joke as well.

String.Source: This is apparently a classic in Alinor.
String.Dest: This is apparently a classic in Alinor.

String.Source: "One day, a Sload decides to invade Alinor. He rallies his armies of the undead and attacks."
String.Dest: "One day, a Sload decides to invade Alinor. He rallies his armies of the undead and attacks."

String.Source: "Of course, he fails. No foolish Sload can withstand the might of the Thalmor. Now laugh, or we will throw you in the dungeon."
String.Dest: "Of course, he fails. No foolish Sload can withstand the might of the Thalmor. Now laugh, or we will throw you in the dungeon."

String.Source: ...Perhaps that would be funnier if I knew what a Sload is. Or a Thalmor.
String.Dest: ...Perhaps that would be funnier if I knew what a Sload is. Or a Thalmor.

String.Source: This comes from a book of Black Marsh classics. A joke from my own homeland!
String.Dest: This comes from a book of Black Marsh classics. A joke from my own homeland!

String.Source: "One morning, a Haj Mota enters a bar carrying three ajum and a depassa cutting. The reel-ka on guard asks him where he gets them from."
String.Dest: "One morning, a Haj Mota enters a bar carrying three ajum and a depassa cutting. The reel-ka on guard asks him where he gets them from."

String.Source: "The Haj Mota replies..."
String.Dest: "The Haj Mota replies..."

String.Source: Hm. I seem to forget the rest, but I assure you, it is quite funny.
String.Dest: Hm. I seem to forget the rest, but I assure you, it is quite funny.

String.Source: Ma'Jaka teaches me this one!
String.Dest: Ma'Jaka teaches me this one!

String.Source: "An Alfiq once asked a Nord, 'why is drinking milk shameful?'"
String.Dest: "An Alfiq once asked a Nord, 'why is drinking milk shameful?'"

String.Source: "The Nord replied, 'By Shor! A talking cat!' and jumped out a window."
String.Dest: "The Nord replied, 'By Shor! A talking cat!' and jumped out a window."

String.Source: By the way, what is an Alfiq?
String.Dest: By the way, what is an Alfiq?

String.Source: This is a classic joke from Morrowind.
String.Dest: This is a classic joke from Morrowind.

String.Source: "What is the difference between a Netch calf and a Nord?"
String.Dest: "What is the difference between a Netch calf and a Nord?"
