String.Source: Unfortunately, my copy of the book is missing the next page. I am sure it is humorous.
String.Dest: Unfortunately, my copy of the book is missing the next page. I am sure it is humorous.

String.Source: This is a joke from High Rock. Ahem.
String.Dest: This is a joke from High Rock. Ahem.

String.Source: "What is the difference between an orc and a century-old wheel of cheese?"
String.Dest: "What is the difference between an orc and a century-old wheel of cheese?"

String.Source: "The cheese smells better."
String.Dest: "The cheese smells better."

String.Source: Hm. That is quite insulting, isn't it? I do not see the humor there.
String.Dest: Hm. That is quite insulting, isn't it? I do not see the humor there.

String.Source: I hear this is quite popular in Valenwood.
String.Dest: I hear this is quite popular in Valenwood.

String.Source: "Why does the monkey fall out of the tree?"
String.Dest: "Why does the monkey fall out of the tree?"

String.Source: "Because it is dead."
String.Dest: "Because it is dead."

String.Source: Hm. I feel sorry for the monkey.
String.Dest: Hm. I feel sorry for the monkey.

String.Source: The book assures me that this never fails to amuse.
String.Dest: The book assures me that this never fails to amuse.

String.Source: "How does a Nord know when he has had enough to drink?"
String.Dest: "How does a Nord know when he has had enough to drink?"

String.Source: "When he wakes up in bed with a mammoth."
String.Dest: "When he wakes up in bed with a mammoth."

String.Source: ...Hm, I am not sure I understand that one. How does a mammoth fit in the bed?
String.Dest: ...Hm, I am not sure I understand that one. How does a mammoth fit in the bed?

String.Source: Let us immerse ourselves in the River of Comedy.
String.Dest: Let us immerse ourselves in the River of Comedy.

String.Source: "What does the Breton say to his wife when she finds him with her sister?"
String.Dest: "What does the Breton say to his wife when she finds him with her sister?"

String.Source: "I thought she was your mother!"
String.Dest: "I thought she was your mother!"

String.Source: ...What does that even mean? This joke is as murky as the swamp.
String.Dest: ...What does that even mean? This joke is as murky as the swamp.

String.Source: Dokazeek tells me this joke. It is a surprise, as he does not often swim in the river of humor.
String.Dest: Dokazeek tells me this joke. It is a surprise, as he does not often swim in the river of humor.

String.Source: "What is the difference between a mosquito and the Church?"
String.Dest: "What is the difference between a mosquito and the Church?"

String.Source: "One drains us of every drop we have, and the other is an insect."
String.Dest: "One drains us of every drop we have, and the other is an insect."

String.Source: ...Hm, does he say the Church is an insect? I hear of winged buildings in other lands, but the Church seems wooden to me.
String.Dest: ...Hm, does he say the Church is an insect? I hear of winged buildings in other lands, but the Church seems wooden to me.

String.Source: Ah, this news moistens my scales.
String.Dest: Ah, this news moistens my scales.

String.Source: Perhaps now the number of voriplasms will decrease. This will help to keep our miners safe.
String.Dest: Perhaps now the number of voriplasms will decrease. This will help to keep our miners safe.

String.Source: The Vigilants serve a useful purpose. They cull the thinblooded vampires, and their presence gives the other mortals a false sense of security.
String.Dest: The Vigilants serve a useful purpose. They cull the thinblooded vampires, and their presence gives the other mortals a false sense of security.

String.Source: Besides, the Vigilants are just the latest incarnation of an eternal trend. There will always be an organization of impotent vampire hunters.
String.Dest: Besides, the Vigilants are just the latest incarnation of an eternal trend. There will always be an organization of impotent vampire hunters.

String.Source: Rather than waste time fighting a group that doesn't pose a threat, it's better to use them for our own purposes.
String.Dest: Rather than waste time fighting a group that doesn't pose a threat, it's better to use them for our own purposes.

String.Source: You and I don't have the time or inclination to spend fully wiping out the Voidsuckers. But the Vigilants...
String.Dest: You and I don't have the time or inclination to spend fully wiping out the Voidsuckers. But the Vigilants...

String.Source: Well, we can force them to waste time and resources eliminating the Voidsuckers for us.
String.Dest: Well, we can force them to waste time and resources eliminating the Voidsuckers for us.

String.Source: A simple sleight of hand. Planted evidence.
String.Dest: A simple sleight of hand. Planted evidence.

String.Source: First, I'll need you to sneak into Thorntaker's home. He seems to trust you, the fool. Find his Amulet of Stendarr and steal it.
String.Dest: First, I'll need you to sneak into Thorntaker's home. He seems to trust you, the fool. Find his Amulet of Stendarr and steal it.

String.Source: Then go to the Voidsucker's lair. Slay their clanlord... and place the Amulet of Stendarr somewhere obvious.
String.Dest: Then go to the Voidsucker's lair. Slay their clanlord... and place the Amulet of Stendarr somewhere obvious.

String.Source: The Voidsuckers will assume the Vigilants were responsible for the attack and retaliate.
String.Dest: The Voidsuckers will assume the Vigilants were responsible for the attack and retaliate.

String.Source: In the meantime, I will make arrangements to ensure that Thorntaker believes a Voidsucker agent was responsible for the theft.
String.Dest: In the meantime, I will make arrangements to ensure that Thorntaker believes a Voidsucker agent was responsible for the theft.

String.Source: That should ensure both the Voidsuckers and Thorntaker cease to be a hindrance to any of our activities.
String.Dest: That should ensure both the Voidsuckers and Thorntaker cease to be a hindrance to any of our activities.

String.Source: I cannot speak for the Order as a whole. The most I can assure you is that our current goal is stability.
String.Dest: I cannot speak for the Order as a whole. The most I can assure you is that our current goal is stability.

String.Source: Mistress Caerellia in particular has a great interest in ensuring that Skyrim's vampires are united.
String.Dest: Mistress Caerellia in particular has a great interest in ensuring that Skyrim's vampires are united.

String.Source: At present, supporting you is the best way to ensure that goal is achieved. As long as that remains the case, you have our support.
String.Dest: At present, supporting you is the best way to ensure that goal is achieved. As long as that remains the case, you have our support.

String.Source: Heh. I'm afraid not.
String.Dest: Heh. I'm afraid not.

String.Source: Even if I desired to do so, she takes steps to ensure her underlings cannot betray her. Of course, I have no such desire.
String.Dest: Even if I desired to do so, she takes steps to ensure her underlings cannot betray her. Of course, I have no such desire.

String.Source: If she has taken an interest in you, I'm sure she'll make contact herself. Especially if you intend to one day visit Cyrodiil.
String.Dest: If she has taken an interest in you, I'm sure she'll make contact herself. Especially if you intend to one day visit Cyrodiil.

String.Source: I'm looking forward to wiping out those traitors. They deserve death for abandoning me.
String.Dest: I'm looking forward to wiping out those traitors. They deserve death for abandoning me.

String.Source: I'll gladly help to ensure I'm the last Voidsucker.
String.Dest: I'll gladly help to ensure I'm the last Voidsucker.

String.Source: I admit, I never actually believed the Vampyrum Order existed.
String.Dest: I admit, I never actually believed the Vampyrum Order existed.

String.Source: So you're the one who's been meddling with our plans! I'll make you suffer for your defiance!
String.Dest: So you're the one who's been meddling with our plans! I'll make you suffer for your defiance!

String.Source: Kalsesh! You traitor, I should have known you were allied with this meddler!
String.Dest: Kalsesh! You traitor, I should have known you were allied with this meddler!

String.Source: Hahah! Marvelous!
String.Dest: Hahah! Marvelous!

String.Source: I've left some evidence in the village to ensure Thorntaker believes the Voidsuckers have learned his identity.
String.Dest: I've left some evidence in the village to ensure Thorntaker believes the Voidsuckers have learned his identity.

String.Source: This should ensure that the Vigilants eliminate the remaining Voidsuckers... while remaining blind to our presence here.
String.Dest: This should ensure that the Vigilants eliminate the remaining Voidsuckers... while remaining blind to our presence here.

String.Source: This concludes my duties in the Old Lands as well. My study of the Old Blood is done, and the Voidsuckers and Drybloods will soon be contained.
String.Dest: This concludes my duties in the Old Lands as well. My study of the Old Blood is done, and the Voidsuckers and Drybloods will soon be contained.

String.Source: Here is your pay. I'll inform Mistress Caerellia of your aid... Though I suspect she's already fully aware.
String.Dest: Here is your pay. I'll inform Mistress Caerellia of your aid... Though I suspect she's already fully aware.

String.Source: Perhaps we'll have the opportunity to work together again.
String.Dest: Perhaps we'll have the opportunity to work together again.

String.Source: Ah, you're back. I assume it went well?
String.Dest: Ah, you're back. I assume it went well?

String.Source: An Amulet of Mara? This one is surprised that one like you lacks a mate.
String.Dest: An Amulet of Mara? This one is surprised that one like you lacks a mate.

String.Source: This one hopes you will continue to offer your help.
String.Dest: This one hopes you will continue to offer your help.

String.Source: If nothing else, we must try. Let us go to Li'Rakka's lair. When you fell her shadowy form, this one will strike.
String.Dest: If nothing else, we must try. Let us go to Li'Rakka's lair. When you fell her shadowy form, this one will strike.

String.Source: Here. This staff has great value to the Meat-Seekers. It has earned this reward.
String.Dest: Here. This staff has great value to the Meat-Seekers. It has earned this reward.

String.Source: Good, good. My men reported similar success on our end - the tunnel in Twisted Root Cave has been buried.
String.Dest: Good, good. My men reported similar success on our end - the tunnel in Twisted Root Cave has been buried.

String.Source: Let us hope no other tunnels appear... But for now, this was a success. Traders from Skyrim no longer need fear the monsters.
String.Dest: Let us hope no other tunnels appear... But for now, this was a success. Traders from Skyrim no longer need fear the monsters.

String.Source: Here. This blade has served me well in my time as captain of the guard. I hope it serves you as well.
String.Dest: Here. This blade has served me well in my time as captain of the guard. I hope it serves you as well.

String.Source: Thank you, friend. Words cannot express how much this means to me.
String.Dest: Thank you, friend. Words cannot express how much this means to me.

String.Source: Perhaps I will never be able to visit my homeland, but... with this, I can feel some connection to it.
String.Dest: Perhaps I will never be able to visit my homeland, but... with this, I can feel some connection to it.

String.Source: Here. This weapon once served as a symbol of those who guarded the Church. I can think of nobody more fitting to wield it than you.
String.Dest: Here. This weapon once served as a symbol of those who guarded the Church. I can think of nobody more fitting to wield it than you.

String.Source: With luck... and assuming you survive... I will have the bell here repaired by the time you succeed.
String.Dest: With luck... and assuming you survive... I will have the bell here repaired by the time you succeed.

String.Source: I doubt anyone can truly answer that. It's a part of the realm - not like something you'd find on Nirn.
String.Dest: I doubt anyone can truly answer that. It's a part of the realm - not like something you'd find on Nirn.

String.Source: Myths call it the Flesh of Lorkhan, or the corpses of forgotten gods. Less fantastical theories say it's a native fungus or something similar.
String.Dest: Myths call it the Flesh of Lorkhan, or the corpses of forgotten gods. Less fantastical theories say it's a native fungus or something similar.

String.Source: It's not my position to speculate on what it is. All I know is that we rely on it to avoid becoming Drybloods.
String.Dest: It's not my position to speculate on what it is. All I know is that we rely on it to avoid becoming Drybloods.

String.Source: Locked, huh? Figures... Nothing's ever simple.
String.Dest: Locked, huh? Figures... Nothing's ever simple.

String.Source: Well, I doubt the dro-m'Athra would have let anyone steal the key, so it must still be in this general area.
String.Dest: Well, I doubt the dro-m'Athra would have let anyone steal the key, so it must still be in this general area.

String.Source: Guess we should check the nearby ruins.
String.Dest: Guess we should check the nearby ruins.

String.Source: Locked, huh? Good thing we've already got the key!
String.Dest: Locked, huh? Good thing we've already got the key!

String.Source: Ah, I do apologize, friend. I'm afraid whatever my mistress is doing in Cyrodiil is beyond my purview.
String.Dest: Ah, I do apologize, friend. I'm afraid whatever my mistress is doing in Cyrodiil is beyond my purview.

String.Source: If you continue to draw her interest, I'm sure you'll learn the details in due time.
String.Dest: If you continue to draw her interest, I'm sure you'll learn the details in due time.

String.Source: It's come to meet its end!
String.Dest: It's come to meet its end!

String.Source: Ruheeva u xul-vahat!
String.Dest: Ruheeva u xul-vahat!

String.Source: It's dead meat!
String.Dest: It's dead meat!

String.Source: The Mines swallow it whole!
String.Dest: The Mines swallow it whole!

String.Source: Nowhere to run! It's all flesh here!
String.Dest: Nowhere to run! It's all flesh here!

String.Source: Tzilnech!
String.Dest: Tzilnech!

String.Source: It thinks it can harm me? It knows nothing of pain...
String.Dest: It thinks it can harm me? It knows nothing of pain...

String.Source: The currents drown you!
String.Dest: The currents drown you!

String.Source: Church shatter like eggshells!
String.Dest: Church shatter like eggshells!

String.Source: It doesn't want to see my pick crush real meat!
String.Dest: It doesn't want to see my pick crush real meat!

String.Source: Has it lost its senses?! Stop that!
String.Dest: Has it lost its senses?! Stop that!

String.Source: I will not warn again!
String.Dest: I will not warn again!

String.Source: Xhuth!
String.Dest: Xhuth!

String.Source: Graargh!
String.Dest: Graargh!

String.Source: Our scales scorch with anger!
String.Dest: Our scales scorch with anger!

String.Source: I will not join the drowned!
String.Dest: I will not join the drowned!

String.Source: Gaah! Mammal-licker!
String.Dest: Gaah! Mammal-licker!

String.Source: Sap-scrounger!
String.Dest: Sap-scrounger!

String.Source: It will regret that, dryskin!
String.Dest: It will regret that, dryskin!

String.Source: Gaargh!
String.Dest: Gaargh!

String.Source: Aargh!
String.Dest: Aargh!

String.Source: The Hist aid me!
String.Dest: The Hist aid me!

String.Source: Bleed, egg-sac!
String.Dest: Bleed, egg-sac!

String.Source: It's in murky waters now!
String.Dest: It's in murky waters now!

String.Source: Our blood runs with poison!
String.Dest: Our blood runs with poison!

String.Source: I will end its breaths!
String.Dest: I will end its breaths!

String.Source: By the egg, it will not survive!
String.Dest: By the egg, it will not survive!

String.Source: I carve it like Meat!
String.Dest: I carve it like Meat!

String.Source: Dryskin savage!
String.Dest: Dryskin savage!

String.Source: It wishes it has scales to protect from us!
String.Dest: It wishes it has scales to protect from us!

String.Source: I'll peel its scales one by one!
String.Dest: I'll peel its scales one by one!

String.Source: Raaargh!
String.Dest: Raaargh!

String.Source: Grraaargh!
String.Dest: Grraaargh!

String.Source: Yeearrgh!
String.Dest: Yeearrgh!

String.Source: The Church will pay for abandoning us!
String.Dest: The Church will pay for abandoning us!

String.Source: Waxhuthi!
String.Dest: Waxhuthi!

String.Source: Our claws are ready!
String.Dest: Our claws are ready!

String.Source: What harm does it bring to us?!
String.Dest: What harm does it bring to us?!

String.Source: By the Hist, it won't survive!
String.Dest: By the Hist, it won't survive!

String.Source: It thinks it can defeat us?
String.Dest: It thinks it can defeat us?

String.Source: Hsss!
String.Dest: Hsss!

String.Source: Look out! A fight!
String.Dest: Look out! A fight!

String.Source: Over here, egg-brothers!
String.Dest: Over here, egg-brothers!

String.Source: Teach it to mess with us...
String.Dest: Teach it to mess with us...

String.Source: The river comes to calm waters again...
String.Dest: The river comes to calm waters again...

String.Source: No more. Good.
String.Dest: No more. Good.

String.Source: Our tail whips with irritation...
String.Dest: Our tail whips with irritation...

String.Source: That is all that it has?
String.Dest: That is all that it has?

String.Source: I shake my head in disbelief. A wasted fight.
String.Dest: I shake my head in disbelief. A wasted fight.

String.Source: The sweat of combat... like rain on our scales... Ah...
String.Dest: The sweat of combat... like rain on our scales... Ah...

String.Source: No xul-vaat is needed here.
String.Dest: No xul-vaat is needed here.

String.Source: What rapture... what Light...
String.Dest: What rapture... what Light...

String.Source: Likirani... your glow... how alive...
String.Dest: Likirani... your glow... how alive...

String.Source: Oh, heart... soul... core... Cold... Cold... Cooooold...
String.Dest: Oh, heart... soul... core... Cold... Cold... Cooooold...

String.Source: Oh, great aegis of calamity... How should Light be our despair?
String.Dest: Oh, great aegis of calamity... How should Light be our despair?

String.Source: Glass Star... fractal fiend and heart of ice... why do you reflect us thus?
String.Dest: Glass Star... fractal fiend and heart of ice... why do you reflect us thus?

String.Source: Light... Light... Light... Light... Light... Light...
String.Dest: Light... Light... Light... Light... Light... Light...

String.Source: Blessed cold... Ice that binds in piety! Fealty! Forever! Ever and ever and ever and ever and ever yours, my Star of Glass!
String.Dest: Blessed cold... Ice that binds in piety! Fealty! Forever! Ever and ever and ever and ever and ever yours, my Star of Glass!

String.Source: Forsake me... Break me... Shatter me... Consume me... Use me, Tellijih... Melt and mould me to your will; only lift this Cold from in my skin...
String.Dest: Forsake me... Break me... Shatter me... Consume me... Use me, Tellijih... Melt and mould me to your will; only lift this Cold from in my skin...

String.Source: It's so... Cold... Mother? I can't... I can't feel you... I'm scared... M- Mother, please!
String.Dest: It's so... Cold... Mother? I can't... I can't feel you... I'm scared... M- Mother, please!

String.Source: The Academy will preserve... it w- will... preserve us all...
String.Dest: The Academy will preserve... it w- will... preserve us all...

String.Source: Tellijih... please... please!
String.Dest: Tellijih... please... please!

String.Source: The pain... the pain... O, Glass Star, rip it from my bones... I beg...
String.Dest: The pain... the pain... O, Glass Star, rip it from my bones... I beg...

String.Source: Suffering... is absolute... Radiance... will follow...
String.Dest: Suffering... is absolute... Radiance... will follow...

String.Source: Please, forgive our defiance. Purge it all, sweet Princess... Make us hollow too...
String.Dest: Please, forgive our defiance. Purge it all, sweet Princess... Make us hollow too...

String.Source: Endure it... She swore... she swore...
String.Dest: Endure it... She swore... she swore...

String.Source: (Agonized moans)
String.Dest: (Agonized moans)

String.Source: Please... Freedom... I'll do anything...
String.Dest: Please... Freedom... I'll do anything...

String.Source: Likirani, mentor of the Star! The Coldlight shines with your radiance!
String.Dest: Likirani, mentor of the Star! The Coldlight shines with your radiance!

String.Source: Sondra Drel, show us the truth... Share the wisdom that you taught the Glass Star!
String.Dest: Sondra Drel, show us the truth... Share the wisdom that you taught the Glass Star!

String.Source: Tellijih... The shimmer of the Glass Star echoes thy silence.
String.Dest: Tellijih... The shimmer of the Glass Star echoes thy silence.

String.Source: Let us swim through the Coldlight. Climb to the heavens!
String.Dest: Let us swim through the Coldlight. Climb to the heavens!

String.Source: Mind the way!
String.Dest: Mind the way!

String.Source: Is it drunk? Move!
String.Dest: Is it drunk? Move!

String.Source: Xuth - watch it!
String.Dest: Xuth - watch it!

String.Source: Witness my Light!
String.Dest: Witness my Light!

String.Source: The Cold! It burns!
String.Dest: The Cold! It burns!

String.Source: The Light will blind you all!
String.Dest: The Light will blind you all!

String.Source: I am resplendent!
String.Dest: I am resplendent!

String.Source: The Cold consumes us! It cannot be stopped! Please!
String.Dest: The Cold consumes us! It cannot be stopped! Please!

String.Source: You will be undone, Blood-bearer!
String.Dest: You will be undone, Blood-bearer!

String.Source: Destroy me! Fracture me! I cannot feel release!
String.Dest: Destroy me! Fracture me! I cannot feel release!

String.Source: The Cold comes for us all!
String.Dest: The Cold comes for us all!

String.Source: You cannot hide from the Light!
String.Dest: You cannot hide from the Light!

String.Source: Raargh!
String.Dest: Raargh!

String.Source: Daargh!
String.Dest: Daargh!

String.Source: Feel it! Feel the crystal coursing through your skin!
String.Dest: Feel it! Feel the crystal coursing through your skin!

String.Source: Taste death! The Cold awaits...
String.Dest: Taste death! The Cold awaits...

String.Source: Fear the Void! Fear it!
String.Dest: Fear the Void! Fear it!

String.Source: I smell you!
String.Dest: I smell you!

String.Source: Gaargh!
String.Dest: Gaargh!

String.Source: Again! Splinter me! Destroy all trace! Do it!
String.Dest: Again! Splinter me! Destroy all trace! Do it!

String.Source: The Light burns! She is... angry!
String.Dest: The Light burns! She is... angry!

String.Source: The heat... Blood! Ahh!
String.Dest: The heat... Blood! Ahh!

String.Source: Cut me down; the Glass Star only shines brighter!
String.Dest: Cut me down; the Glass Star only shines brighter!

String.Source: Yes! Yes! The pain!
String.Dest: Yes! Yes! The pain!

String.Source: Bleed me! Let all see my love!
String.Dest: Bleed me! Let all see my love!

String.Source: Gore me to the bone! Every fracture a blessing! A cure!
String.Dest: Gore me to the bone! Every fracture a blessing! A cure!

String.Source: Arghh - the pain! Mother, what's happening?!
String.Dest: Arghh - the pain! Mother, what's happening?!

String.Source: I just wanted to be pure! My son - my... son!
String.Dest: I just wanted to be pure! My son - my... son!

String.Source: T- There was a cure! She promised us!
String.Dest: T- There was a cure! She promised us!

String.Source: Endure any pain... for the Maiden... for the cure!
String.Dest: Endure any pain... for the Maiden... for the cure!

String.Source: Curse the Blood! It doomed us all!
String.Dest: Curse the Blood! It doomed us all!

String.Source: Ouugh!
String.Dest: Ouugh!

String.Source: Yaargh!
String.Dest: Yaargh!

String.Source: Kill meeee!
String.Dest: Kill meeee!

String.Source: Raaarrrghh!
String.Dest: Raaarrrghh!

String.Source: May the Glass Star shatter your soul!
String.Dest: May the Glass Star shatter your soul!

String.Source: Likirani! May your Radiance shine on me!
String.Dest: Likirani! May your Radiance shine on me!

String.Source: Destruction! Pain!
String.Dest: Destruction! Pain!

String.Source: How I longed for the heat of battle! The Cold cannot claim me now!
String.Dest: How I longed for the heat of battle! The Cold cannot claim me now!

String.Source: The Glass Star will illuminate your Blood like a cathedral of despair!
String.Dest: The Glass Star will illuminate your Blood like a cathedral of despair!

String.Source: Likirani, light my path to transcendence!
String.Dest: Likirani, light my path to transcendence!

String.Source: You know nothing of pain... yet!
String.Dest: You know nothing of pain... yet!

String.Source: You want suffering? You want suffering?!
String.Dest: You want suffering? You want suffering?!

String.Source: There is no salvation! Hope hides in the light and deceives us all! Only the Cold can cleanse us; cast us out like snowfall!
String.Dest: There is no salvation! Hope hides in the light and deceives us all! Only the Cold can cleanse us; cast us out like snowfall!

String.Source: You can still bleed... I wish I could...
String.Dest: You can still bleed... I wish I could...

String.Source: By Sondra Drel, I'll have your head... Spill it out like refuse from the Void...
String.Dest: By Sondra Drel, I'll have your head... Spill it out like refuse from the Void...

String.Source: Aaeeouugghh... Haaaaarrrghh!
String.Dest: Aaeeouugghh... Haaaaarrrghh!

String.Source: Every... second is torture! I... hate you!
String.Dest: Every... second is torture! I... hate you!

String.Source: You will be cleansed! Void and shadow have no place but the Coldlight!
String.Dest: You will be cleansed! Void and shadow have no place but the Coldlight!

String.Source: I'll rip the Old Blood from every pore of you! Pure... clean... cured... just like we should have been!
String.Dest: I'll rip the Old Blood from every pore of you! Pure... clean... cured... just like we should have been!

String.Source: No more... light...
String.Dest: No more... light...

String.Source: It's so... warm...
String.Dest: It's so... warm...

String.Source: Blessed Coldlight... I tried...
String.Dest: Blessed Coldlight... I tried...

String.Source: Nuuhh...
String.Dest: Nuuhh...

String.Source: Free...
String.Dest: Free...

String.Source: It's dark... at last...
String.Dest: It's dark... at last...

String.Source: Thank... you...
String.Dest: Thank... you...

String.Source: Like hope drawn to the Void...
String.Dest: Like hope drawn to the Void...

String.Source: Soon you will know our agony!
String.Dest: Soon you will know our agony!

String.Source: Intruder! Fool!
String.Dest: Intruder! Fool!

String.Source: Neither can live... so let us end each other!
String.Dest: Neither can live... so let us end each other!

String.Source: This is no place for you, fleshwalker! Die, now!
String.Dest: This is no place for you, fleshwalker! Die, now!

String.Source: I see your breath... and shall end it.
String.Dest: I see your breath... and shall end it.

String.Source: Please, kill me - kill me!
String.Dest: Please, kill me - kill me!

String.Source: Blood approaches! Fiend!
String.Dest: Blood approaches! Fiend!

String.Source: The Glass Star shall shine upon you!
String.Dest: The Glass Star shall shine upon you!

String.Source: See how I serve you, sweet maiden of silence? Blessings... blessings...
String.Dest: See how I serve you, sweet maiden of silence? Blessings... blessings...

String.Source: Why does the pain not stop...? Please...
String.Dest: Why does the pain not stop...? Please...

String.Source: To the Cold... to the rot... to that where I cannot follow...
String.Dest: To the Cold... to the rot... to that where I cannot follow...

String.Source: Oh, to bleed... to die...
String.Dest: Oh, to bleed... to die...

String.Source: Aaargh... ahh... The body burns!
String.Dest: Aaargh... ahh... The body burns!

String.Source: Raargh!
String.Dest: Raargh!

String.Source: Guhh!
String.Dest: Guhh!

String.Source: Rah!
String.Dest: Rah!

String.Source: Ouggh!
String.Dest: Ouggh!

String.Source: A sting, only!
String.Dest: A sting, only!

String.Source: A misstep in our dance... that we will not allow again!
String.Dest: A misstep in our dance... that we will not allow again!

String.Source: Gahh! This one shall drag you to the Darks!
String.Dest: Gahh! This one shall drag you to the Darks!

String.Source: Like the bite of a maggot!
String.Dest: Like the bite of a maggot!

String.Source: Raargh! Her rot will repay that tenfold!
String.Dest: Raargh! Her rot will repay that tenfold!

String.Source: Moon-swine!
String.Dest: Moon-swine!

String.Source: Runt! We will get you for that!
String.Dest: Runt! We will get you for that!

String.Source: Strike us down! The Bent Cats shall return again!
String.Dest: Strike us down! The Bent Cats shall return again!

String.Source: We fear no death... More lives than nine Namiira ties to us, yes...
String.Dest: We fear no death... More lives than nine Namiira ties to us, yes...

String.Source: Ha! Again!
String.Dest: Ha! Again!

String.Source: Argh! Strike us again! We thirst for Blood - even our own!
String.Dest: Argh! Strike us again! We thirst for Blood - even our own!

String.Source: Nuuhh...
String.Dest: Nuuhh...

String.Source: We will... return...
String.Dest: We will... return...

String.Source: The others... will kill you...
String.Dest: The others... will kill you...

String.Source: A good... dance...
String.Dest: A good... dance...

String.Source: The Darkness... calls...
String.Dest: The Darkness... calls...

String.Source: Namiira!
String.Dest: Namiira!

String.Source: Dance! Dance! Daaance!
String.Dest: Dance! Dance! Daaance!

String.Source: Yeeaargh!
String.Dest: Yeeaargh!

String.Source: Raaaarggh!
String.Dest: Raaaarggh!

String.Source: The Darkness always hears! You cannot hide!
String.Dest: The Darkness always hears! You cannot hide!

String.Source: Let us dance! Come toward your end!
String.Dest: Let us dance! Come toward your end!

String.Source: A fine dance, indeed!
String.Dest: A fine dance, indeed!

String.Source: Show us how your blood dances on our blade!
String.Dest: Show us how your blood dances on our blade!

String.Source: Your suffering will be exquisite!
String.Dest: Your suffering will be exquisite!

String.Source: Quarry approaches... Delicious!
String.Dest: Quarry approaches... Delicious!

String.Source: Your skin shall be ours!
String.Dest: Your skin shall be ours!

String.Source: Souls for Namiira! Blood for the blades!
String.Dest: Souls for Namiira! Blood for the blades!

String.Source: Her embrace approaches! Death! Dance! Despair!
String.Dest: Her embrace approaches! Death! Dance! Despair!

String.Source: A waste of such flesh... But just a little taste?
String.Dest: A waste of such flesh... But just a little taste?

String.Source: Namiira, your feast.
String.Dest: Namiira, your feast.

String.Source: No fun. They never survive the dance.
String.Dest: No fun. They never survive the dance.

String.Source: Dance... dance... dance... dead...
String.Dest: Dance... dance... dance... dead...

String.Source: Pitiful. Barely enough to bristle this one's whiskers...
String.Dest: Pitiful. Barely enough to bristle this one's whiskers...

String.Source: The end of that. Namiira, feast well...
String.Dest: The end of that. Namiira, feast well...

String.Source: The Darkness will never be bested. Never.
String.Dest: The Darkness will never be bested. Never.

String.Source: Watch where you're going!
String.Dest: Watch where you're going!

String.Source: Mind yourself!
String.Dest: Mind yourself!

String.Source: Not even going to apologize?
String.Dest: Not even going to apologize?

String.Source: Some people...
String.Dest: Some people...

String.Source: Ouch - hey!
String.Dest: Ouch - hey!

String.Source: The Old Blood is a terror... but the Coldlight is worse. Do not linger long.
String.Dest: The Old Blood is a terror... but the Coldlight is worse. Do not linger long.

String.Source: The Divines worshipped on Nirn are dead as well. Does that stop them from shaping the world?
String.Dest: The Divines worshipped on Nirn are dead as well. Does that stop them from shaping the world?

String.Source: Death means nothing to a god. You would do well to remember that, walker. Do not anger the Hollow Princess.
String.Dest: Death means nothing to a god. You would do well to remember that, walker. Do not anger the Hollow Princess.

String.Source: That is why this problem cannot be solved by mortals. Sending more clawless sellswords to seek the source will only increase her anger.
String.Dest: That is why this problem cannot be solved by mortals. Sending more clawless sellswords to seek the source will only increase her anger.

String.Source: If we desire salvation, it must be through her. We must pray that she restores our flow of Blood.
String.Dest: If we desire salvation, it must be through her. We must pray that she restores our flow of Blood.

String.Source: If you can help avenge me - and recover my clothes - I'll make sure you're rewarded. Won't be needing my wealth in Sovngarde, after all.
String.Dest: If you can help avenge me - and recover my clothes - I'll make sure you're rewarded. Won't be needing my wealth in Sovngarde, after all.

String.Source: I suggest you start your search there. Should you find the key, it will be time to ambush the Voidsuckers.
String.Dest: I suggest you start your search there. Should you find the key, it will be time to ambush the Voidsuckers.

String.Source: And if not, we'll try a different tack.
String.Dest: And if not, we'll try a different tack.

String.Source: Perhaps now we can request more guards for the storehouse...
String.Dest: Perhaps now we can request more guards for the storehouse...

String.Source: Er... yes. If you say so. No need for excess violence, really.
String.Dest: Er... yes. If you say so. No need for excess violence, really.

String.Source: You have my gratitude. With all the threats already facing us, we can't risk the Forsworn taking organized action against us as well.
String.Dest: You have my gratitude. With all the threats already facing us, we can't risk the Forsworn taking organized action against us as well.

String.Source: To the Forsworn, theirs is a struggle for the continued existence of the Reachfolk. Clans that refuse to fight the Nords are seen as collaborators.
String.Dest: To the Forsworn, theirs is a struggle for the continued existence of the Reachfolk. Clans that refuse to fight the Nords are seen as collaborators.

String.Source: But to the people who have lived here for generations, the affairs of Skyrim are not our concern.
String.Dest: But to the people who have lived here for generations, the affairs of Skyrim are not our concern.

String.Source: And those who are newly arrived came here to escape the conflicts in the Reach. Either way, few of us wish to be involved.
String.Dest: And those who are newly arrived came here to escape the conflicts in the Reach. Either way, few of us wish to be involved.

String.Source: But the Forsworn won't accept that answer. They believe the magic of this land is the key to overthrowing the Nords.
String.Dest: But the Forsworn won't accept that answer. They believe the magic of this land is the key to overthrowing the Nords.

String.Source: And so they view our refusal to help the same as if we were actively aiding their oppressors and treat us as enemies.
String.Dest: And so they view our refusal to help the same as if we were actively aiding their oppressors and treat us as enemies.

String.Source: Much appreciated, friend. More knowledge can only benefit us.
String.Dest: Much appreciated, friend. More knowledge can only benefit us.

String.Source: Be careful. The Roots aren't hard to find, but Drybloods often congregate around them.
String.Dest: Be careful. The Roots aren't hard to find, but Drybloods often congregate around them.

String.Source: There is no glory in their deaths... All were once good people. This is a mercy killing, nothing more.
String.Dest: There is no glory in their deaths... All were once good people. This is a mercy killing, nothing more.

String.Source: Even a small reprieve from their attacks would be greatly appreciated. Thank you.
String.Dest: Even a small reprieve from their attacks would be greatly appreciated. Thank you.

String.Source: Thank you, my friend. We must all do what we can to lighten the burdens of others.
String.Dest: Thank you, my friend. We must all do what we can to lighten the burdens of others.

String.Source: I wish I could deliver it myself, but there's simply so many other tasks I need to handle at the moment. Your help is greatly appreciated.
String.Dest: I wish I could deliver it myself, but there's simply so many other tasks I need to handle at the moment. Your help is greatly appreciated.

String.Source: I wish we could give them a proper funeral. With their possessions returned, I can at least prepare a memorial.
String.Dest: I wish we could give them a proper funeral. With their possessions returned, I can at least prepare a memorial.

String.Source: Of course. That is all I ask.
String.Dest: Of course. That is all I ask.

String.Source: Now, I suppose all we do is try to help stave off the Dryblood madness... as best we can.
String.Dest: Now, I suppose all we do is try to help stave off the Dryblood madness... as best we can.

String.Source: Now our purpose will be to help reverse the harm we've done. To try to cure the people of the addiction to the... mutant sap we foolishly worshipped.
String.Dest: Now our purpose will be to help reverse the harm we've done. To try to cure the people of the addiction to the... mutant sap we foolishly worshipped.

String.Source: It's still so hard to believe...
String.Dest: It's still so hard to believe...

String.Source: It will be difficult. To learn everything you've believe your entire life... everything your ancestors believed... was a Daedric lie?
String.Dest: It will be difficult. To learn everything you've believe your entire life... everything your ancestors believed... was a Daedric lie?

String.Source: But we have no choice. If I cannot convince them, we will all go mad from this sap addiction. The truth is the first step to a cure.
String.Dest: But we have no choice. If I cannot convince them, we will all go mad from this sap addiction. The truth is the first step to a cure.

String.Source: I've asked the guards to explore the Hollow Palace and find proof of this Hist... and its demise.
String.Dest: I've asked the guards to explore the Hollow Palace and find proof of this Hist... and its demise.

String.Source: The storm over the Palace has faded for the first time since the founding of the Old Lands. That has convinced many the Princess is gone for good.
String.Dest: The storm over the Palace has faded for the first time since the founding of the Old Lands. That has convinced many the Princess is gone for good.

String.Source: Thankfully, that means the guards are now willing to properly investigate... and since you've rung all the bells, an investigation is possible.
String.Dest: Thankfully, that means the guards are now willing to properly investigate... and since you've rung all the bells, an investigation is possible.

String.Source: If they can bring physical evidence of the Hist, the others will have to believe.
String.Dest: If they can bring physical evidence of the Hist, the others will have to believe.

String.Source: When I sensed your betrayal, I planned to hunt you down. I appreciate you saving me the effort!
String.Dest: When I sensed your betrayal, I planned to hunt you down. I appreciate you saving me the effort!

String.Source: These subjects may have failed as Vessels... but they'll serve to kill you!
String.Dest: These subjects may have failed as Vessels... but they'll serve to kill you!

String.Source: She is a skilled miner and a more skilled warrior. Both traits are needed to survive the Mines.
String.Dest: She is a skilled miner and a more skilled warrior. Both traits are needed to survive the Mines.

String.Source: She was the first to encounter the monsters and survive. If it wishes to know more of them, she is the one to ask.
String.Dest: She was the first to encounter the monsters and survive. If it wishes to know more of them, she is the one to ask.

String.Source: His egg must have been dropped too many times. He thinks he swims in the River of Humor rather than the waters of the Mines.
String.Dest: His egg must have been dropped too many times. He thinks he swims in the River of Humor rather than the waters of the Mines.

String.Source: As long as it ignores what he says, he is good at his job. He mines quickly and effectively.
String.Dest: As long as it ignores what he says, he is good at his job. He mines quickly and effectively.

String.Source: If he were not so good at his job, the others would gag him to stop his jokes.
String.Dest: If he were not so good at his job, the others would gag him to stop his jokes.

String.Source: She is an odd one. The Saxhleel put no value on the past or future, but she finds such things fascinating.
String.Dest: She is an odd one. The Saxhleel put no value on the past or future, but she finds such things fascinating.

String.Source: If there is such a thing as a scholar of the xanmeers, she is among them. If it has any curiosity about the ruins, she is the one to ask.
String.Dest: If there is such a thing as a scholar of the xanmeers, she is among them. If it has any curiosity about the ruins, she is the one to ask.

String.Source: She is either mad or a genius. It is hard to tell.
String.Dest: She is either mad or a genius. It is hard to tell.

String.Source: She claims she hears the voices of the Bloodroots - that they direct her exactly where to mine.
String.Dest: She claims she hears the voices of the Bloodroots - that they direct her exactly where to mine.

String.Source: Strange as that may sound, her pick always locates the best sources of Meat.
String.Dest: Strange as that may sound, her pick always locates the best sources of Meat.

String.Source: His may be the most important role here. He is the Meat-Finder.
String.Dest: His may be the most important role here. He is the Meat-Finder.

String.Source: His job is to study the caves and ruins to determine where we can find more Veins of Meat... without unleashing more monsters.
String.Dest: His job is to study the caves and ruins to determine where we can find more Veins of Meat... without unleashing more monsters.

String.Source: He also works to keep us safe. In many ways, I think he is more suited to be Overseer, but he does not want the task.
String.Dest: He also works to keep us safe. In many ways, I think he is more suited to be Overseer, but he does not want the task.

String.Source: She is one of our strongest miners. I once saw her carry a pile of Meat twice her height.
String.Dest: She is one of our strongest miners. I once saw her carry a pile of Meat twice her height.

String.Source: She talks little, but when she does speak, all listen. She swims in the River of Experience, and her words can carry much knowledge.
String.Dest: She talks little, but when she does speak, all listen. She swims in the River of Experience, and her words can carry much knowledge.

String.Source: He is young but determined. He has not lost his enthusiasm for his duty.
String.Dest: He is young but determined. He has not lost his enthusiasm for his duty.

String.Source: But he is not ready to enter the Mines. His task is to take the Meat the other miners dig and deliver it to the village.
String.Dest: But he is not ready to enter the Mines. His task is to take the Meat the other miners dig and deliver it to the village.

String.Source: It is a harder task than it sounds. The Drybloods stalk the roads. Thankfully, he has the swiftness of youth.
String.Dest: It is a harder task than it sounds. The Drybloods stalk the roads. Thankfully, he has the swiftness of youth.

String.Source: Very well. Does it need anything else?
String.Dest: Very well. Does it need anything else?

String.Source: Might I ask you to deliver this letter for me the next time you're in Skyrim? There's a spot in Markarth's Silver-Blood Inn where you can leave it.
String.Dest: Might I ask you to deliver this letter for me the next time you're in Skyrim? There's a spot in Markarth's Silver-Blood Inn where you can leave it.

String.Source: I follow. The River of Freedom awaits.
String.Dest: I follow. The River of Freedom awaits.

String.Source: I grimace in pain... Is it here to help us?
String.Dest: I grimace in pain... Is it here to help us?

String.Source: I erect the spine of gratitude. It does not need to guide me further.
String.Dest: I erect the spine of gratitude. It does not need to guide me further.

String.Source: It has my thanks. Will it guide us to the exit?
String.Dest: It has my thanks. Will it guide us to the exit?

String.Source: Be careful if you go there. The mine hasn't been active in a while - no telling what's moved in.
String.Dest: Be careful if you go there. The mine hasn't been active in a while - no telling what's moved in.

String.Source: You'll pay!
String.Dest: You'll pay!

String.Source: This one will avenge you.
String.Dest: This one will avenge you.

String.Source: Keep running, coward!
String.Dest: Keep running, coward!

String.Source: Tch. Flee, then!
String.Dest: Tch. Flee, then!

String.Source: Back for more? I'll make you regret that!
String.Dest: Back for more? I'll make you regret that!

String.Source: Should have stayed hidden!
String.Dest: Should have stayed hidden!

String.Source: Good, you are here. This one has a special task for you.
String.Dest: Good, you are here. This one has a special task for you.

String.Source: Hm? What do you want?
String.Dest: Hm? What do you want?

String.Source: Aghk...
String.Dest: Aghk...

String.Source: Excellent! Then it's time for our ambush.
String.Dest: Excellent! Then it's time for our ambush.

String.Source: You've been handling matters yourself thus far - would you prefer to keep it that way?
String.Dest: You've been handling matters yourself thus far - would you prefer to keep it that way?

String.Source: I'd rather enjoy accompanying you on this, but not if I'd be an inconvenience.
String.Dest: I'd rather enjoy accompanying you on this, but not if I'd be an inconvenience.

String.Source: Indeed. We should push our advantage before they realize what's happened.
String.Dest: Indeed. We should push our advantage before they realize what's happened.

String.Source: You keep your hand... this time. Next time you may not be so lucky.
String.Dest: You keep your hand... this time. Next time you may not be so lucky.

String.Source: Rajhin was a great thief. You are no Rajhin.
String.Dest: Rajhin was a great thief. You are no Rajhin.

String.Source: This one sees you. Do not try that again.
String.Dest: This one sees you. Do not try that again.

String.Source: Keep your hands to yourself!
String.Dest: Keep your hands to yourself!

String.Source: How dare you?!
String.Dest: How dare you?!

String.Source: I saw that!
String.Dest: I saw that!

String.Source: I raise my arms in greeting. Its attention is needed.
String.Dest: I raise my arms in greeting. Its attention is needed.

String.Source: Got a minute? I need your help with something.
String.Dest: Got a minute? I need your help with something.

String.Source: If you're able to recover it, I'll grant you a special reward. Either way, I hope to see you back in the village.
String.Dest: If you're able to recover it, I'll grant you a special reward. Either way, I hope to see you back in the village.

String.Source: Then, use my smelter here to melt them into an ingot of Old Blood. Once you've done that, I will train you in the art of Blood-Sculpting.
String.Dest: Then, use my smelter here to melt them into an ingot of Old Blood. Once you've done that, I will train you in the art of Blood-Sculpting.

String.Source: Give it some practice. You'll get it once you've done it a few times. And if you run out of materials, my wife and I both sell what you need.
String.Dest: Give it some practice. You'll get it once you've done it a few times. And if you run out of materials, my wife and I both sell what you need.

String.Source: Get down from there, you fool.
String.Dest: Get down from there, you fool.

String.Source: If you break anything, you're paying for it.
String.Dest: If you break anything, you're paying for it.

String.Source: You are not a kitten. Take care not to break things.
String.Dest: You are not a kitten. Take care not to break things.

String.Source: What in Oblivion are you doing?!
String.Dest: What in Oblivion are you doing?!

String.Source: Watch yourself with that thing!
String.Dest: Watch yourself with that thing!

String.Source: Put that away, you fool!
String.Dest: Put that away, you fool!

String.Source: Must you?!
String.Dest: Must you?!

String.Source: Be careful! Somebody could get hurt!
String.Dest: Be careful! Somebody could get hurt!

String.Source: Seems they give blades to any idiot these days...
String.Dest: Seems they give blades to any idiot these days...

String.Source: Don't go causing trouble with that thing, you got it?
String.Dest: Don't go causing trouble with that thing, you got it?

String.Source: Hss - watch yourself!
String.Dest: Hss - watch yourself!

String.Source: This one dodges swift, but do not test us...
String.Dest: This one dodges swift, but do not test us...

String.Source: Guards! Help - help!
String.Dest: Guards! Help - help!

String.Source: Murderer! Stay back!
String.Dest: Murderer! Stay back!

String.Source: What're you doing?! Gods, no!
String.Dest: What're you doing?! Gods, no!

String.Source: Hunter's Hilt, you killed them!
String.Dest: Hunter's Hilt, you killed them!

String.Source: By S'rendarr, stay back!
String.Dest: By S'rendarr, stay back!

String.Source: Wha - no!
String.Dest: Wha - no!

String.Source: Wha - don't you dare!
String.Dest: Wha - don't you dare!

String.Source: Agh! Why did you do that?!
String.Dest: Agh! Why did you do that?!

String.Source: That sound... It's deafening!
String.Dest: That sound... It's deafening!

String.Source: Incredible... Like the roar of Hircine's hunt!
String.Dest: Incredible... Like the roar of Hircine's hunt!

String.Source: Such a Shout... like the roar of the Mane!
String.Dest: Such a Shout... like the roar of the Mane!

String.Source: Don't touch that!
String.Dest: Don't touch that!

String.Source: Why you...!
String.Dest: Why you...!

String.Source: Put that back, and we won't have any trouble.
String.Dest: Put that back, and we won't have any trouble.

String.Source: This one does not tolerate thieves!
String.Dest: This one does not tolerate thieves!

String.Source: Hss! Hands off!
String.Dest: Hss! Hands off!

String.Source: By Hircine, what a beast!
String.Dest: By Hircine, what a beast!

String.Source: I'll not be hunted today!
String.Dest: I'll not be hunted today!

String.Source: A Skinchanger? Here?
String.Dest: A Skinchanger? Here?

String.Source: Hunt-Father, be proud!
String.Dest: Hunt-Father, be proud!

String.Source: This one always hated dogs!
String.Dest: This one always hated dogs!

String.Source: Khajiit fears no hound!
String.Dest: Khajiit fears no hound!

String.Source: This one's fur is far better, beast!
String.Dest: This one's fur is far better, beast!

String.Source: Delightful!
String.Dest: Delightful!

String.Source: I'll need a bit of time to prepare. Go on ahead - I'll meet you inside Varsel.
String.Dest: I'll need a bit of time to prepare. Go on ahead - I'll meet you inside Varsel.

String.Source: A pity, but understandable. I shall remain here and await the good news, then.
String.Dest: A pity, but understandable. I shall remain here and await the good news, then.

String.Source: Certainly! Give me some time to gather my things and I'll meet you in Varsel.
String.Dest: Certainly! Give me some time to gather my things and I'll meet you in Varsel.

String.Source: It should keep its hands to itself.
String.Dest: It should keep its hands to itself.

String.Source: It thinks the whole world is its nest-egg?!
String.Dest: It thinks the whole world is its nest-egg?!

String.Source: It has no business with that!
String.Dest: It has no business with that!

String.Source: It never learned not to steal?!
String.Dest: It never learned not to steal?!

String.Source: It will regret that theft!
String.Dest: It will regret that theft!

String.Source: Stealing from us when we have so little?!
String.Dest: Stealing from us when we have so little?!

String.Source: It should watch where it swings that!
String.Dest: It should watch where it swings that!

String.Source: Xuth! Be careful with that!
String.Dest: Xuth! Be careful with that!

String.Source: Was its egg cracked before hatching?! Be careful!
String.Dest: Was its egg cracked before hatching?! Be careful!

String.Source: Strike me and it will feel my pickaxe swing...
String.Dest: Strike me and it will feel my pickaxe swing...

String.Source: By the marsh, keep it under control...
String.Dest: By the marsh, keep it under control...

String.Source: The dryskins and their blades...
String.Dest: The dryskins and their blades...

String.Source: I hear something...
String.Dest: I hear something...

String.Source: Something approaches...
String.Dest: Something approaches...

String.Source: What disturbs the waters?
String.Dest: What disturbs the waters?

String.Source: What sneaks around...?
String.Dest: What sneaks around...?

String.Source: Hm. It has left...
String.Dest: Hm. It has left...

String.Source: Perhaps it is just my imagination.
String.Dest: Perhaps it is just my imagination.

String.Source: Hm... Perhaps it was nothing.
String.Dest: Hm... Perhaps it was nothing.

String.Source: Must have imagined it...
String.Dest: Must have imagined it...

String.Source: It will suffer for that!
String.Dest: It will suffer for that!

String.Source: If it wants a fight, it has one!
String.Dest: If it wants a fight, it has one!

String.Source: Hmph. It should keep fleeing.
String.Dest: Hmph. It should keep fleeing.

String.Source: It had best not return.
String.Dest: It had best not return.

String.Source: Does it flee?
String.Dest: Does it flee?

String.Source: It makes a grave mistake!
String.Dest: It makes a grave mistake!

String.Source: Ah, it returns!
String.Dest: Ah, it returns!

String.Source: By the marsh, what thunder!
String.Dest: By the marsh, what thunder!

String.Source: Great sap!
String.Dest: Great sap!

String.Source: By the Hist, it shakes the whole mine!
String.Dest: By the Hist, it shakes the whole mine!

String.Source: What is it doing?!
String.Dest: What is it doing?!

String.Source: Is it mad?!
String.Dest: Is it mad?!

String.Source: It had best get down before it breaks something!
String.Dest: It had best get down before it breaks something!

String.Source: What does it do now...
String.Dest: What does it do now...

String.Source: I rejoin... the roots...
String.Dest: I rejoin... the roots...

String.Source: By the Hist! Help - help!
String.Dest: By the Hist! Help - help!

String.Source: Sithis' shadow, you killed them!
String.Dest: Sithis' shadow, you killed them!

String.Source: Great Sap, a murder!
String.Dest: Great Sap, a murder!

String.Source: Very little. They appear from the darkness without warning.
String.Dest: Very little. They appear from the darkness without warning.

String.Source: They ambush the miners and drag off the ones they kill. The bodies are never found.
String.Dest: They ambush the miners and drag off the ones they kill. The bodies are never found.

String.Source: We do our best to repel them. We are fortunate they still bleed like other creatures.
String.Dest: We do our best to repel them. We are fortunate they still bleed like other creatures.

String.Source: But there is no end to them, and each attack costs us miners.
String.Dest: But there is no end to them, and each attack costs us miners.

String.Source: Our name for them in Jel translates to "Death-Mud." It is an accurate name.
String.Dest: Our name for them in Jel translates to "Death-Mud." It is an accurate name.

String.Source: They devour all they encounter. Unwary miners turn to bone.
String.Dest: They devour all they encounter. Unwary miners turn to bone.

String.Source: It must not underestimate them. They are more vicious than they seem.
String.Dest: It must not underestimate them. They are more vicious than they seem.

String.Source: The dead fill the depths of the swamp, but they do not sleep peacefully.
String.Dest: The dead fill the depths of the swamp, but they do not sleep peacefully.

String.Source: The drowned are corpses puppeted by the swamp. They seek to drag others down into the depths with them.
String.Dest: The drowned are corpses puppeted by the swamp. They seek to drag others down into the depths with them.

String.Source: The last time I fought them, my shield was lost. Facing the monsters will be harder now, but I cannot return to Haj-Taeed just for a shield.
String.Dest: The last time I fought them, my shield was lost. Facing the monsters will be harder now, but I cannot return to Haj-Taeed just for a shield.

String.Source: But only a fool swims against the river. We must continue to push forward, no matter the difficulty.
String.Dest: But only a fool swims against the river. We must continue to push forward, no matter the difficulty.

String.Source: Great Spirits of the Reach! Guardians of Lorkh's realm!
String.Dest: Great Spirits of the Reach! Guardians of Lorkh's realm!

String.Source: Hear my prayer! Bless us with your protection! Push out the rot that infests your world!
String.Dest: Hear my prayer! Bless us with your protection! Push out the rot that infests your world!

String.Source: May Stuhn's might join with yours! Exile this corruption back to the Void!
String.Dest: May Stuhn's might join with yours! Exile this corruption back to the Void!

String.Source: It seems... it seems to have worked.
String.Dest: It seems... it seems to have worked.

String.Source: Let us hope that foul relic does not return to Mundus for many ages.
String.Dest: Let us hope that foul relic does not return to Mundus for many ages.

String.Source: Thank you, my friend. You've been most helpful.
String.Dest: Thank you, my friend. You've been most helpful.

String.Source: Agh! No!
String.Dest: Agh! No!

String.Source: Wh... Why...?
String.Dest: Wh... Why...?

String.Source: Kyne protects me!
String.Dest: Kyne protects me!

String.Source: A Nord never flees from a fight!
String.Dest: A Nord never flees from a fight!

String.Source: I can... still fight!
String.Dest: I can... still fight!

String.Source: There's an abandoned old shack in the forest where I stashed some valuables. If you can escort me there, I'll give you your reward.
String.Dest: There's an abandoned old shack in the forest where I stashed some valuables. If you can escort me there, I'll give you your reward.

String.Source: Ah, a cave. I do love caves.
String.Dest: Ah, a cave. I do love caves.

String.Source: Let's not spend too long here. Vampires and temples don't mix.
String.Dest: Let's not spend too long here. Vampires and temples don't mix.

String.Source: What a lovely shop. Are you planning to buy me something?
String.Dest: What a lovely shop. Are you planning to buy me something?

String.Source: Falmer are quite vile, aren't they? Let's just slaughter them all.
String.Dest: Falmer are quite vile, aren't they? Let's just slaughter them all.

String.Source: Caves are such wonderful places. So many hiding spots to ambush the unwary...
String.Dest: Caves are such wonderful places. So many hiding spots to ambush the unwary...

String.Source: Dwarven ruins are so dull. Nothing to feed on here.
String.Dest: Dwarven ruins are so dull. Nothing to feed on here.

String.Source: Bandit camps are delightful. All the blood you can eat.
String.Dest: Bandit camps are delightful. All the blood you can eat.

String.Source: I never thought I'd see an actual dragon lair...
String.Dest: I never thought I'd see an actual dragon lair...

String.Source: Must we stay in this frozen pit? I'm not exactly dressed for the cold.
String.Dest: Must we stay in this frozen pit? I'm not exactly dressed for the cold.

String.Source: Forsworn, Silver-Bloods... they're all just meat.
String.Dest: Forsworn, Silver-Bloods... they're all just meat.

String.Source: I remember the Wolf Queen. Quite an entertaining woman.
String.Dest: I remember the Wolf Queen. Quite an entertaining woman.

String.Source: Hm. So this is Castle Volkihar, is it? A bit underwhelming...
String.Dest: Hm. So this is Castle Volkihar, is it? A bit underwhelming...

String.Source: I do miss having a proper lair.
String.Dest: I do miss having a proper lair.

String.Source: Hm. Do you think the jailors here would notice if one of the prisoners were to vanish?
String.Dest: Hm. Do you think the jailors here would notice if one of the prisoners were to vanish?

String.Source: I always wanted to explore a xanmeer. There's such a delightfully dark aura about them.
String.Dest: I always wanted to explore a xanmeer. There's such a delightfully dark aura about them.

String.Source: Quite damp in here... I'll need to replace my shoes once we're done.
String.Dest: Quite damp in here... I'll need to replace my shoes once we're done.

String.Source: I used to know some Ayleids. Their Flesh Gardens were quite a delight.
String.Dest: I used to know some Ayleids. Their Flesh Gardens were quite a delight.

String.Source: I can't say I care for these Nord ruins. Draugr are such a nuisance.
String.Dest: I can't say I care for these Nord ruins. Draugr are such a nuisance.

String.Source: You know, harvesting Void energy from Blackreach was one of my ideas for replacing the Old Blood.
String.Dest: You know, harvesting Void energy from Blackreach was one of my ideas for replacing the Old Blood.

String.Source: You know, this is actually where I was born. It went by a different name back then, of course.
String.Dest: You know, this is actually where I was born. It went by a different name back then, of course.

String.Source: Let's be glad the "Silver-Bloods" don't have actual silver in their veins. If they did, we couldn't prey on them.
String.Dest: Let's be glad the "Silver-Bloods" don't have actual silver in their veins. If they did, we couldn't prey on them.

String.Source: I'm not as sensitive to the sun as the thinbloods, but I'd still rather be indoors...
String.Dest: I'm not as sensitive to the sun as the thinbloods, but I'd still rather be indoors...

String.Source: Hss. You cannot flee for long...
String.Dest: Hss. You cannot flee for long...

String.Source: Run all you like. You cannot escape the Darkness.
String.Dest: Run all you like. You cannot escape the Darkness.

String.Source: Yes! Come, join the dance!
String.Dest: Yes! Come, join the dance!

String.Source: There you are, mortal!
String.Dest: There you are, mortal!

String.Source: Come! Feed the Darkness!
String.Dest: Come! Feed the Darkness!

String.Source: Be devoured by the Great Darkness!
String.Dest: Be devoured by the Great Darkness!

String.Source: What skitters nearby?
String.Dest: What skitters nearby?

String.Source: Hmm? Does another join the Dance?
String.Dest: Hmm? Does another join the Dance?

String.Source: You cannot hide...
String.Dest: You cannot hide...

String.Source: Hm. Merely the wind...
String.Dest: Hm. Merely the wind...

String.Source: The Dance continues...
String.Dest: The Dance continues...

String.Source: Death cannot hold us. We all return in time!
String.Dest: Death cannot hold us. We all return in time!

String.Source: Each strike against us will be repaid a thousandfold.
String.Dest: Each strike against us will be repaid a thousandfold.

String.Source: Indeed. The Sunnandhame tablet was written in the same dialect as the one from Goria Autaracu.
String.Dest: Indeed. The Sunnandhame tablet was written in the same dialect as the one from Goria Autaracu.

String.Source: So once I noticed the patterns, it was child's play to translate.
String.Dest: So once I noticed the patterns, it was child's play to translate.

String.Source: Well, much of it would only be of interest to historians. Local rituals and the like. But there was one thing I expect you'll find noteworthy.
String.Dest: Well, much of it would only be of interest to historians. Local rituals and the like. But there was one thing I expect you'll find noteworthy.

String.Source: The "Hollowing" ritual. It seems to be a method for attuning one's soul to the Void. Making them a hollow vessel for Namira's magic.
String.Dest: The "Hollowing" ritual. It seems to be a method for attuning one's soul to the Void. Making them a hollow vessel for Namira's magic.

String.Source: The Sunnandhame tablet mentions that this ritual was performed in a secret chamber of the Hollow Palace... and notes how to enter the chamber.
String.Dest: The Sunnandhame tablet mentions that this ritual was performed in a secret chamber of the Hollow Palace... and notes how to enter the chamber.

String.Source: Should you have a way to enter the Palace, I suspect the contents of that chamber may interest you. I've noted down my translation.
String.Dest: Should you have a way to enter the Palace, I suspect the contents of that chamber may interest you. I've noted down my translation.

String.Source: Ah, you return. What did you find?
String.Dest: Ah, you return. What did you find?

String.Source: Ah, a pity you weren't able to obtain a sample. But probably for the best.
String.Dest: Ah, a pity you weren't able to obtain a sample. But probably for the best.

String.Source: Unattended rituals like that can leak all sorts of catastrophic magic, after all.
String.Dest: Unattended rituals like that can leak all sorts of catastrophic magic, after all.

String.Source: Well, I hope you found something valuable in your search, at least. You've certainly provided me with interesting study materials.
String.Dest: Well, I hope you found something valuable in your search, at least. You've certainly provided me with interesting study materials.

String.Source: Here, a bit of compensation for your time.
String.Dest: Here, a bit of compensation for your time.

String.Source: I think so. Thanks to your help, no further monsters from the woods should be able to enter.
String.Dest: I think so. Thanks to your help, no further monsters from the woods should be able to enter.

String.Source: We'll need to remain vigilant, though. The guards will need to patrol the cave more often.
String.Dest: We'll need to remain vigilant, though. The guards will need to patrol the cave more often.

String.Source: Thank... you...
String.Dest: Thank... you...

String.Source: Free...
String.Dest: Free...

String.Source: Uhhh...
String.Dest: Uhhh...

String.Source: Let me... die...
String.Dest: Let me... die...

String.Source: Release... me...
String.Dest: Release... me...

String.Source: The Maggot provides!
String.Dest: The Maggot provides!

String.Source: A feast from the mountain!
String.Dest: A feast from the mountain!

String.Source: It's a minor task, but yes.
String.Dest: It's a minor task, but yes.

String.Source: With the Hist dead, the Bloodroots are beginning to die as well.
String.Dest: With the Hist dead, the Bloodroots are beginning to die as well.

String.Source: The process is slow, meaning we've mostly managed to clear out the rotting Roots as they die.
String.Dest: The process is slow, meaning we've mostly managed to clear out the rotting Roots as they die.

String.Source: But in the less-traveled areas, some of the rotten Roots have begun attracting monsters. I wish to ensure that the monsters don't attack us.
String.Dest: But in the less-traveled areas, some of the rotten Roots have begun attracting monsters. I wish to ensure that the monsters don't attack us.

String.Source: I've marked where the rotten Roots are known to be. If you can clear the monsters from those areas and burn the dead Roots, I'd be most grateful.
String.Dest: I've marked where the rotten Roots are known to be. If you can clear the monsters from those areas and burn the dead Roots, I'd be most grateful.

String.Source: Ah, thank you. Working on a cure for the corrupted sap addiction is taking most of my attention, so I appreciate your helping with this matter.
String.Dest: Ah, thank you. Working on a cure for the corrupted sap addiction is taking most of my attention, so I appreciate your helping with this matter.

String.Source: Here. I hope this helps.
String.Dest: Here. I hope this helps.

String.Source: Truly? You've truly done it?
String.Dest: Truly? You've truly done it?

String.Source: I dared not allow myself to hope. This is wondrous! We may have hope for our survival after all.
String.Dest: I dared not allow myself to hope. This is wondrous! We may have hope for our survival after all.

String.Source: It seems fate truly favors us. I've just finished repairs on the village's bell as well!
String.Dest: It seems fate truly favors us. I've just finished repairs on the village's bell as well!

String.Source: You should do the honors, friend. Please, ring it.
String.Dest: You should do the honors, friend. Please, ring it.

String.Source: It's as the legends say! The four bells have opened the way to the final one!
String.Dest: It's as the legends say! The four bells have opened the way to the final one!

String.Source: Please, hurry into the tunnel! The final bell awaits, and with it, the village's salvation!
String.Dest: Please, hurry into the tunnel! The final bell awaits, and with it, the village's salvation!

String.Source: Words cannot express my gratitude, friend. Now I can stand before Shor's Throne with pride!
String.Dest: Words cannot express my gratitude, friend. Now I can stand before Shor's Throne with pride!

String.Source: The entrance has been sealed for centuries, but foul creatures still escape sometimes. I'm here to make sure they don't get to the village.
String.Dest: The entrance has been sealed for centuries, but foul creatures still escape sometimes. I'm here to make sure they don't get to the village.

String.Source: The entrance has been sealed for centuries, but foul creatures still escape sometimes. This one is here to make sure they don't get to the village.
String.Dest: The entrance has been sealed for centuries, but foul creatures still escape sometimes. This one is here to make sure they don't get to the village.

String.Source: My ancestors came from a nomadic clan known as the Deathwing Clan. The walls of Understone Keep still bear the markings of the clan's artists.
String.Dest: My ancestors came from a nomadic clan known as the Deathwing Clan. The walls of Understone Keep still bear the markings of the clan's artists.

String.Source: I heard from a trader that an idol crafted by the clan is still there, in the Dwemer Museum... being used as a paperweight.
String.Dest: I heard from a trader that an idol crafted by the clan is still there, in the Dwemer Museum... being used as a paperweight.

String.Source: I hate the thought of it sitting there, holding down research notes or mining ledgers. I want to put it in a place of honor.
String.Dest: I hate the thought of it sitting there, holding down research notes or mining ledgers. I want to put it in a place of honor.

String.Source: It underestimates us!
String.Dest: It underestimates us!

String.Source: A swing like that is useless in the mines!
String.Dest: A swing like that is useless in the mines!

String.Source: We cannot best it!
String.Dest: We cannot best it!

String.Source: Its strength is too much!
String.Dest: Its strength is too much!

String.Source: I lower the claw of aggression... for now.
String.Dest: I lower the claw of aggression... for now.

String.Source: It survives... this time.
String.Dest: It survives... this time.

String.Source: May you be blessed.
String.Dest: May you be blessed.

String.Source: Walk with the Spirits.
String.Dest: Walk with the Spirits.

String.Source: Let the Blood hear your prayers.
String.Dest: Let the Blood hear your prayers.

String.Source: May the Blood flow through you.
String.Dest: May the Blood flow through you.

String.Source: If you return to Skyrim, please recover that idol for me. Help me connect with my ancestors.
String.Dest: If you return to Skyrim, please recover that idol for me. Help me connect with my ancestors.

String.Source: The meeting site is the guardhouse at the border with the swamp. Can I ask you to escort me there?
String.Dest: The meeting site is the guardhouse at the border with the swamp. Can I ask you to escort me there?

String.Source: Greetings, Overseer. Thank you for agreeing to meet me.
String.Dest: Greetings, Overseer. Thank you for agreeing to meet me.

String.Source: Kcha. The riverbed is dry of pleasantries. What does it want?
String.Dest: Kcha. The riverbed is dry of pleasantries. What does it want?

String.Source: Of course. I'll get to the point.
String.Dest: Of course. I'll get to the point.

String.Source: I believe we've all suffered enough. Too many good people have become Drybloods.
String.Dest: I believe we've all suffered enough. Too many good people have become Drybloods.

String.Source: And now we've learned the truth of this realm. We've all been puppets of the dark spirits.
String.Dest: And now we've learned the truth of this realm. We've all been puppets of the dark spirits.

String.Source: The "Blood" will soon be gone forever. We must all band together if we are to survive.
String.Dest: The "Blood" will soon be gone forever. We must all band together if we are to survive.

String.Source: Thorntaker says the sap addiction is treatable, but until we can be cured, we need enough Meat to keep ourselves going.
String.Dest: Thorntaker says the sap addiction is treatable, but until we can be cured, we need enough Meat to keep ourselves going.

String.Source: I'd like us to come to an arrangement. Support from the village, in return for ensuring we all have enough Meat.
String.Dest: I'd like us to come to an arrangement. Support from the village, in return for ensuring we all have enough Meat.

String.Source: Ha! The flow of the river is unchanged by the new leadership, I see.
String.Dest: Ha! The flow of the river is unchanged by the new leadership, I see.

String.Source: The Church makes demands of us as it always does, and expects us to do as we are ordered.
String.Dest: The Church makes demands of us as it always does, and expects us to do as we are ordered.

String.Source: The facts do not change. There is not enough Meat! We can give no more than we already have!
String.Dest: The facts do not change. There is not enough Meat! We can give no more than we already have!

String.Source: I do not deny your suffering. I am well aware of the burden we have placed on your people. It was more than we had the right to ask.
String.Dest: I do not deny your suffering. I am well aware of the burden we have placed on your people. It was more than we had the right to ask.

String.Source: But Zenkali-Dra is not the priestess now. I am, and I wish to ensure we all survive this ordeal.
String.Dest: But Zenkali-Dra is not the priestess now. I am, and I wish to ensure we all survive this ordeal.

String.Source: I am willing to open what meager Blood stores remain. In small doses, it should help stave off madness without furthering the addiction.
String.Dest: I am willing to open what meager Blood stores remain. In small doses, it should help stave off madness without furthering the addiction.

String.Source: Hm. A good start, but it misses the root cause.
String.Dest: Hm. A good start, but it misses the root cause.

String.Source: The hole the monsters crawl from is closed, but many monsters remain in the mines. Miners still die.
String.Dest: The hole the monsters crawl from is closed, but many monsters remain in the mines. Miners still die.

String.Source: The Church does not need so many guards. We do. Send us more protection, and we can dig more Meat.
String.Dest: The Church does not need so many guards. We do. Send us more protection, and we can dig more Meat.

String.Source: You ask more than I can provide. I am not unsympathetic, but we are already short on guards -
String.Dest: You ask more than I can provide. I am not unsympathetic, but we are already short on guards -

String.Source: What does it expect?! It asks sacrifice from us, but offers none itself!
String.Dest: What does it expect?! It asks sacrifice from us, but offers none itself!

String.Source: Either offer us the guards we need, or be content with the river's flow as it is.
String.Dest: Either offer us the guards we need, or be content with the river's flow as it is.

String.Source: Hm. What say you, friend?
String.Dest: Hm. What say you, friend?

String.Source: You accuse us of being callous?! We may have asked much of you, but at least we are not murderers!
String.Dest: You accuse us of being callous?! We may have asked much of you, but at least we are not murderers!

String.Source: Whatever your intention may have been, it was your attempt to rob the Church that led to Zenkali-Dra's death. Do not try to deny that!
String.Dest: Whatever your intention may have been, it was your attempt to rob the Church that led to Zenkali-Dra's death. Do not try to deny that!

String.Source: I cannot seek vengeance for her, but I will not permit you to act as though you are the only one here with a grievance!
String.Dest: I cannot seek vengeance for her, but I will not permit you to act as though you are the only one here with a grievance!

String.Source: My goal is to ensure we all overcome this, but if you are not willing to work together-
String.Dest: My goal is to ensure we all overcome this, but if you are not willing to work together-

String.Source: Enough! I understand its point.
String.Dest: Enough! I understand its point.

String.Source: It speaks truth. My decision shapes the waters that lead to death.
String.Dest: It speaks truth. My decision shapes the waters that lead to death.

String.Source: I do not apologize for trying to help my people, but I raise the hand of submission now.
String.Dest: I do not apologize for trying to help my people, but I raise the hand of submission now.

String.Source: We will give the villagers a larger share of what Meat we recover from the mines.
String.Dest: We will give the villagers a larger share of what Meat we recover from the mines.

String.Source: That is not sufficient. We do not have enough Meat to keep everyone sane.
String.Dest: That is not sufficient. We do not have enough Meat to keep everyone sane.

String.Source: The Meat Mines have reopened, no? Surely you can offer us some Meat from your stores, now that you need not fear being able to replenish them.
String.Dest: The Meat Mines have reopened, no? Surely you can offer us some Meat from your stores, now that you need not fear being able to replenish them.

String.Source: Xuth... It is a heavy demand, but...
String.Dest: Xuth... It is a heavy demand, but...

String.Source: I defer to the one responsible for the reopening of our mines. What does it think?
