String.Dest: I defer to the one responsible for the reopening of our mines. What does it think?

String.Source: Very well. I think we can both be satisfied with this, Overseer?
String.Dest: Very well. I think we can both be satisfied with this, Overseer?

String.Source: For now. We shall see how the water flows.
String.Dest: For now. We shall see how the water flows.

String.Source: Thank you, my friend. I apologize for putting an additional burden on you.
String.Dest: Thank you, my friend. I apologize for putting an additional burden on you.

String.Source: Here. I hope this is sufficient compensation for your time.
String.Dest: Here. I hope this is sufficient compensation for your time.

String.Source: Perhaps now, the people of this land can truly begin to move forward...
String.Dest: Perhaps now, the people of this land can truly begin to move forward...

String.Source: Roly-Poly, Ja'bal the Cat, kitten born of the red moon, he is old since birth. Roly-Poly, he laughs and laughs.
String.Dest: Roly-Poly, Ja'bal the Cat, kitten born of the red moon, he is old since birth. Roly-Poly, he laughs and laughs.

String.Source: Roly-Poly, Ja'bal the Cat! The more he jumps, the more he is chased. Even when the king of Anequina beheads him, Roly-Poly, he laughs and laughs.
String.Dest: Roly-Poly, Ja'bal the Cat! The more he jumps, the more he is chased. Even when the king of Anequina beheads him, Roly-Poly, he laughs and laughs.

String.Source: Roly-Poly, Ja'bal the Cat, the Red Stone in the rift of Anequina. He is rejuvenated with every moonlit night, Roly-Poly, he laughs and laughs.
String.Dest: Roly-Poly, Ja'bal the Cat, the Red Stone in the rift of Anequina. He is rejuvenated with every moonlit night, Roly-Poly, he laughs and laughs.

String.Source: It was yesterday when Ja'bal was beheaded, and strangling chickens became cruel, and crushing chicks turned slightly cruel.
String.Dest: It was yesterday when Ja'bal was beheaded, and strangling chickens became cruel, and crushing chicks turned slightly cruel.

String.Source: Today, the birds will feast on Ja'bal's corpse, and there will be no more chickens, no more chicks, and no more eggs.
String.Dest: Today, the birds will feast on Ja'bal's corpse, and there will be no more chickens, no more chicks, and no more eggs.

String.Source: Nothing is needed anymore, not chickens, nor chicks nor eggs.
String.Dest: Nothing is needed anymore, not chickens, nor chicks nor eggs.

String.Source: Two kinds of eggs: ones that will be female and ones that will be male. But both are round and roll around, so you cannot tell the difference.
String.Dest: Two kinds of eggs: ones that will be female and ones that will be male. But both are round and roll around, so you cannot tell the difference.

String.Source: So chickens, chicks, and eggs have a limit, too. Perhaps it is like the blue sky.
String.Dest: So chickens, chicks, and eggs have a limit, too. Perhaps it is like the blue sky.

String.Source: You'll... regret that!
String.Dest: You'll... regret that!

String.Source: Should it happen to find the thief, I shall ensure it is rewarded.
String.Dest: Should it happen to find the thief, I shall ensure it is rewarded.

String.Source: Does it also ask for explanations of the air and the waters?
String.Dest: Does it also ask for explanations of the air and the waters?

String.Source: The Meat is the Meat. It is what keeps us sane.
String.Dest: The Meat is the Meat. It is what keeps us sane.

String.Source: They tell me many things. They tell me where to find Meat. They tell me where the monsters cluster, that I may avoid them.
String.Dest: They tell me many things. They tell me where to find Meat. They tell me where the monsters cluster, that I may avoid them.

String.Source: And they weep to me of their suffering.
String.Dest: And they weep to me of their suffering.

String.Source: I do not understand exactly, but it is something I hear as long as I can recall.
String.Dest: I do not understand exactly, but it is something I hear as long as I can recall.

String.Source: Something hurts the Roots. Warps the Blood that flows through them into something different. The other Roots retreat from the pain.
String.Dest: Something hurts the Roots. Warps the Blood that flows through them into something different. The other Roots retreat from the pain.

String.Source: The suffering I sense comes from the Roots within the xanmeer of Reezal-Bak, but all Roots feel the echoes of the pain. All are connected.
String.Dest: The suffering I sense comes from the Roots within the xanmeer of Reezal-Bak, but all Roots feel the echoes of the pain. All are connected.

String.Source: Should it travel to Reezal-Bak, it should be cautious. I sense the suffering for many years, but the cause may be there still.
String.Dest: Should it travel to Reezal-Bak, it should be cautious. I sense the suffering for many years, but the cause may be there still.

String.Source: Xuth! It means to tell us someone experiments on the Roots? What fool would do such a thing?
String.Dest: Xuth! It means to tell us someone experiments on the Roots? What fool would do such a thing?

String.Source: It has our thanks for destroying that. Hopefully, the Roots will heal...
String.Dest: It has our thanks for destroying that. Hopefully, the Roots will heal...

String.Source: Someone experiments on the Roots? Could that be why the Hist withdraws its sap?
String.Dest: Someone experiments on the Roots? Could that be why the Hist withdraws its sap?

String.Source: What a pity... If only the truth is known sooner, many could have been saved.
String.Dest: What a pity... If only the truth is known sooner, many could have been saved.

String.Source: At least the mage can do no further harm. It has our thanks for destroying the remnants of that experiment.
String.Dest: At least the mage can do no further harm. It has our thanks for destroying the remnants of that experiment.

String.Source: The Roots flows through the land. Their passage through the Meat infuses it with the essence of the Blood.
String.Dest: The Roots flows through the land. Their passage through the Meat infuses it with the essence of the Blood.

String.Source: The Roots tell me many things.
String.Dest: The Roots tell me many things.

String.Source: Perhaps if I knew it better, I would tell it what the Roots tell me.
String.Dest: Perhaps if I knew it better, I would tell it what the Roots tell me.

String.Source: They tell me that the Meat is not flesh, nor plant. It is a gift from Sithis.
String.Dest: They tell me that the Meat is not flesh, nor plant. It is a gift from Sithis.

String.Source: The Void. Sithis is where all Roots lead. The source and end of all rivers. Sithis brings change, shaping our forms.
String.Dest: The Void. Sithis is where all Roots lead. The source and end of all rivers. Sithis brings change, shaping our forms.

String.Source: The Roots tell me of Sithis, of his daughter Namira, who gifts us the Meat so that we too may be transformed.
String.Dest: The Roots tell me of Sithis, of his daughter Namira, who gifts us the Meat so that we too may be transformed.

String.Source: Ah, it speaks of the Sithis of the Shadowscales. Indeed, that is also Sithis. But Sithis is more than that.
String.Dest: Ah, it speaks of the Sithis of the Shadowscales. Indeed, that is also Sithis. But Sithis is more than that.

String.Source: Sithis is the Void. Sithis is where all Roots lead. The source and end of all rivers. Sithis brings change, shaping our forms.
String.Dest: Sithis is the Void. Sithis is where all Roots lead. The source and end of all rivers. Sithis brings change, shaping our forms.

String.Source: The Roots tell me of Sithis, of his daughter Namira, who gifts us the Meat so that we too may be transformed.
String.Dest: The Roots tell me of Sithis, of his daughter Namira, who gifts us the Meat so that we too may be transformed.

String.Source: Is there a difference? Many may view different currents in the water, but the stream flows all the same.
String.Dest: Is there a difference? Many may view different currents in the water, but the stream flows all the same.

String.Source: The Khajiit call Namiira the corrupting shadow within Lorkhan. The Reachfolk say Namira and Lorkh are allies. Can both be right?
String.Dest: The Khajiit call Namiira the corrupting shadow within Lorkhan. The Reachfolk say Namira and Lorkh are allies. Can both be right?

String.Source: Lorkhan makes the world, but the world exists because the Void offers potential.
String.Dest: Lorkhan makes the world, but the world exists because the Void offers potential.

String.Source: The Reachfolk understand this - they say Namira grants Lorkhan a place within the Void to make his work.
String.Dest: The Reachfolk understand this - they say Namira grants Lorkhan a place within the Void to make his work.

String.Source: And Lorkh makes the world so that mortals may grow and change. The Meat is a continued gift from his ally Namira, to better shape our growth.
String.Dest: And Lorkh makes the world so that mortals may grow and change. The Meat is a continued gift from his ally Namira, to better shape our growth.

String.Source: This is true. The Church thinks it rules the Blood, even though the Saxhleel are here since the oldest days.
String.Dest: This is true. The Church thinks it rules the Blood, even though the Saxhleel are here since the oldest days.

String.Source: The Church keeps the Blood from us, and it demands much Meat in return for granting us a pittance of Blood. It finds no friends of the Church here.
String.Dest: The Church keeps the Blood from us, and it demands much Meat in return for granting us a pittance of Blood. It finds no friends of the Church here.

String.Source: But there is nothing we can do. None can swim against the current.
String.Dest: But there is nothing we can do. None can swim against the current.

String.Source: It cannot reroute the waters, but perhaps it can help us to see what waits downstream.
String.Dest: It cannot reroute the waters, but perhaps it can help us to see what waits downstream.

String.Source: The Church says the stores are dry. Others say the Church lies.
String.Dest: The Church says the stores are dry. Others say the Church lies.

String.Source: I wait with patience.
String.Dest: I wait with patience.

String.Source: I shake my head in uncertainty. The Church may not lie about this, but their demands still place too great a burden on us.
String.Dest: I shake my head in uncertainty. The Church may not lie about this, but their demands still place too great a burden on us.

String.Source: But this is as I expect. Knowing where the water flows does not let us change that path. All we can do is follow the current.
String.Dest: But this is as I expect. Knowing where the water flows does not let us change that path. All we can do is follow the current.

String.Source: If it wishes to help, I ask it to investigate the Blood-Stores. Are they truly empty, or does the Church lie to us?
String.Dest: If it wishes to help, I ask it to investigate the Blood-Stores. Are they truly empty, or does the Church lie to us?

String.Source: I lower my tail in sorrow. It seems the Blood truly has dried everywhere but the forest.
String.Dest: I lower my tail in sorrow. It seems the Blood truly has dried everywhere but the forest.

String.Source: It delivers sad news, but the truth is sometimes sad. It has our thanks for bringing us this news.
String.Dest: It delivers sad news, but the truth is sometimes sad. It has our thanks for bringing us this news.

String.Source: When the Hist reshape the creatures of the swamp, it is not for the benefit of a single creature, but for the health of the swamp as a whole.
String.Dest: When the Hist reshape the creatures of the swamp, it is not for the benefit of a single creature, but for the health of the swamp as a whole.

String.Source: Namira is Sithis' tool for shaping us toward Lorkhan's plan. Perhaps the method chosen causes us to suffer, but that does not undo the goal.
String.Dest: Namira is Sithis' tool for shaping us toward Lorkhan's plan. Perhaps the method chosen causes us to suffer, but that does not undo the goal.

String.Source: If the Hist's efforts failed - if it led to the Hist's corruption - that does not mean all should be abandoned.
String.Dest: If the Hist's efforts failed - if it led to the Hist's corruption - that does not mean all should be abandoned.

String.Source: We remain in this realm, and Namira continues Sithis' plan. The flow of the river continues onward, and the river shapes us as it carries us.
String.Dest: We remain in this realm, and Namira continues Sithis' plan. The flow of the river continues onward, and the river shapes us as it carries us.

String.Source: It may not understand, but the Saxhleel are used to being shaped. We must have faith in the shapes to come.
String.Dest: It may not understand, but the Saxhleel are used to being shaped. We must have faith in the shapes to come.

String.Source: As a fellow Saxhleel, it should understand. We may not understand why the Hist shape us, but we trust that the shapes to come will serve a purpose.
String.Dest: As a fellow Saxhleel, it should understand. We may not understand why the Hist shape us, but we trust that the shapes to come will serve a purpose.

String.Source: Lingering here is ill-advised. I am not the only being sealed here... nor the cruelest.
String.Dest: Lingering here is ill-advised. I am not the only being sealed here... nor the cruelest.

String.Source: It asks the question we all wish answered.
String.Dest: It asks the question we all wish answered.

String.Source: As far as any know, the drowned are present from the very oldest days.
String.Dest: As far as any know, the drowned are present from the very oldest days.

String.Source: Lizka-Rosh suspects they are raised by powers within the xanmeers. Others believe it is a power within the water itself. But none know the truth.
String.Dest: Lizka-Rosh suspects they are raised by powers within the xanmeers. Others believe it is a power within the water itself. But none know the truth.

String.Source: Perhaps they are raised by magic from the xanmeers. Perhaps the land itself raises them. We can only speculate, for the truth is murky as the swamp.
String.Dest: Perhaps they are raised by magic from the xanmeers. Perhaps the land itself raises them. We can only speculate, for the truth is murky as the swamp.

String.Source: I believe questioning is futile. We seek a single answer, but a pond is not made from a single stream.
String.Dest: I believe questioning is futile. We seek a single answer, but a pond is not made from a single stream.

String.Source: All are linked. The xanmeers and the creatures that spring from them are as much a part of the swamp as the mud and water.
String.Dest: All are linked. The xanmeers and the creatures that spring from them are as much a part of the swamp as the mud and water.

String.Source: The drowned are another part of the swamp. That is why we can never truly defeat them.
String.Dest: The drowned are another part of the swamp. That is why we can never truly defeat them.

String.Source: Truly? I already ordered a replacement.
String.Dest: Truly? I already ordered a replacement.

String.Source: Well, it is still good to have this back. There is no harm in extra defense.
String.Dest: Well, it is still good to have this back. There is no harm in extra defense.

String.Source: Here. Some payment for its trouble.
String.Dest: Here. Some payment for its trouble.

String.Source: Ah, I wish. There aren't enough materials for that, nor enough time!
String.Dest: Ah, I wish. There aren't enough materials for that, nor enough time!

String.Source: In my ancestors' days, we had many Blood-Sculptors and apprentices, and plenty of ore to work from.
String.Dest: In my ancestors' days, we had many Blood-Sculptors and apprentices, and plenty of ore to work from.

String.Source: But these days, we have to make do with whatever we have to hand.
String.Dest: But these days, we have to make do with whatever we have to hand.

String.Source: Most of the armor the guards wear is purchased from the Khajiit caravans - things they salvage from battlefields in Skyrim. All I do is patch it up.
String.Dest: Most of the armor the guards wear is purchased from the Khajiit caravans - things they salvage from battlefields in Skyrim. All I do is patch it up.

String.Source: This has been an amusing chase, but it ends here.
String.Dest: This has been an amusing chase, but it ends here.

String.Source: For countless ages, I have guarded this Hist. Helped it to feed upon the magic of the Void, to tether Tamriel to the infinite darkness of Namira.
String.Dest: For countless ages, I have guarded this Hist. Helped it to feed upon the magic of the Void, to tether Tamriel to the infinite darkness of Namira.

String.Source: The Heart is nearly ready. A few meager decades more, and it will unleash the greatest Harrowstorm in history.
String.Dest: The Heart is nearly ready. A few meager decades more, and it will unleash the greatest Harrowstorm in history.

String.Source: The souls of every living creature in Mundus shall be ripped from their bodies and fed to the Dark Heart.
String.Dest: The souls of every living creature in Mundus shall be ripped from their bodies and fed to the Dark Heart.

String.Source: Mundus shall be reforged into a realm fitting Namira, and I shall rule it as her loyal steward.
String.Dest: Mundus shall be reforged into a realm fitting Namira, and I shall rule it as her loyal steward.

String.Source: Namira's victory is close at hand. I will not permit anyone to interfere. Especially mere worms like you!
String.Dest: Namira's victory is close at hand. I will not permit anyone to interfere. Especially mere worms like you!

String.Source: Be honored... your bodies shall rest eternally in the heart of this world!
String.Dest: Be honored... your bodies shall rest eternally in the heart of this world!

String.Source: NOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!
String.Dest: NOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!

String.Source: It sure looks that way. As long as Namira's power is flowing into her, nothing we do can hurt her.
String.Dest: It sure looks that way. As long as Namira's power is flowing into her, nothing we do can hurt her.

String.Source: Well. That could have gone better... Are you alright?
String.Dest: Well. That could have gone better... Are you alright?

String.Source: From those visions we saw, I'm guessing that Hist they talked about is the actual "Heart" of this world. The source of the Blood.
String.Dest: From those visions we saw, I'm guessing that Hist they talked about is the actual "Heart" of this world. The source of the Blood.

String.Source: It makes sense. Hist are godlike beings in their own way, and they already have a connection with the Void. It's the ideal puppet for Namira.
String.Dest: It makes sense. Hist are godlike beings in their own way, and they already have a connection with the Void. It's the ideal puppet for Namira.

String.Source: If we can kill that Hist, I assume it will cut off the flow of Namira's magic - and should send the Princess straight back to the Void.
String.Dest: If we can kill that Hist, I assume it will cut off the flow of Namira's magic - and should send the Princess straight back to the Void.

String.Source: Of course, that's assuming we can kill the Hist. No telling what it's been turned into after millennia of Namira's corruption.
String.Dest: Of course, that's assuming we can kill the Hist. No telling what it's been turned into after millennia of Namira's corruption.

String.Source: Let's be prepared for anything.
String.Dest: Let's be prepared for anything.

String.Source: This one will offer you a deal. Go to the Meat Mines. Force the miners to provide more Meat, and this one will permit you to ring our bell.
String.Dest: This one will offer you a deal. Go to the Meat Mines. Force the miners to provide more Meat, and this one will permit you to ring our bell.

String.Source: This one does not expect you to succeed, but perhaps you will surprise her.
String.Dest: This one does not expect you to succeed, but perhaps you will surprise her.

String.Source: Ancheta! There is still dust in this corner!
String.Dest: Ancheta! There is still dust in this corner!

String.Source: I - I apologize, Priestess.
String.Dest: I - I apologize, Priestess.

String.Source: The world may be decaying, but that does not mean we shirk our duties.
String.Dest: The world may be decaying, but that does not mean we shirk our duties.

String.Source: All must be flawless. We must convince the Princess to forgive us.
String.Dest: All must be flawless. We must convince the Princess to forgive us.

String.Source: Ancheta, did you tell the guards to clear the Drybloods from the Blood-Stores?
String.Dest: Ancheta, did you tell the guards to clear the Drybloods from the Blood-Stores?

String.Source: I did. They say they lack the resources to do anything about it...
String.Dest: I did. They say they lack the resources to do anything about it...

String.Source: Khh. They are all useless. When the Princess forgives us and returns the Blood, where are we supposed to put it?!
String.Dest: Khh. They are all useless. When the Princess forgives us and returns the Blood, where are we supposed to put it?!

String.Source: This one hears that Ancheta is leading the Church now. This one hopes you will help her fulfil her duties.
String.Dest: This one hears that Ancheta is leading the Church now. This one hopes you will help her fulfil her duties.

String.Source: This one is going on a pilgrimage.
String.Dest: This one is going on a pilgrimage.

String.Source: This one spent too long cooped up in the Church. She must reconnect with the Old Lands.
String.Dest: This one spent too long cooped up in the Church. She must reconnect with the Old Lands.

String.Source: And so this one is traveling the realm. Whatever mysteries it hides, she will find them.
String.Dest: And so this one is traveling the realm. Whatever mysteries it hides, she will find them.

String.Source: Sure thing.
String.Dest: Sure thing.

String.Source: You got it.
String.Dest: You got it.

String.Source: Yep!
String.Dest: Yep!

String.Source: Yep, seems that way.
String.Dest: Yep, seems that way.

String.Source: That's another breach closed.
String.Dest: That's another breach closed.

String.Source: If that's what you want.
String.Dest: If that's what you want.

String.Source: Okay, sure.
String.Dest: Okay, sure.

String.Source: It's your call.
String.Dest: It's your call.

String.Source: Hm, I'm sensing a breach here. Let me know if you want me to teleport us.
String.Dest: Hm, I'm sensing a breach here. Let me know if you want me to teleport us.

String.Source: Sure. Should I teleport us now?
String.Dest: Sure. Should I teleport us now?

String.Source: That's another breach dealt with.
String.Dest: That's another breach dealt with.

String.Source: That's dealt with. Should I teleport us back?
String.Dest: That's dealt with. Should I teleport us back?

String.Source: Breach closed. I'm getting good at this!
String.Dest: Breach closed. I'm getting good at this!

String.Source: Alright, that's another breach down.
String.Dest: Alright, that's another breach down.

String.Source: Haha, I can't be sharing all the secrets of my order. My peers are already likely displeased I've left the Asylum to come visit these lands.
String.Dest: Haha, I can't be sharing all the secrets of my order. My peers are already likely displeased I've left the Asylum to come visit these lands.

String.Source: But as always, my instincts guide me well. I sense a stone of Coldlight beyond here.
String.Dest: But as always, my instincts guide me well. I sense a stone of Coldlight beyond here.

String.Source: Ah, I knew you'd come. I'm pleased I read thee well.
String.Dest: Ah, I knew you'd come. I'm pleased I read thee well.

String.Source: Heh. Once more, I fear I put excess meaning into my words. 'Tis of no concern.
String.Dest: Heh. Once more, I fear I put excess meaning into my words. 'Tis of no concern.

String.Source: Shall we be on? The secrets of this place await ahead.
String.Dest: Shall we be on? The secrets of this place await ahead.

String.Source: Know? Very little. 'Tis merely another cursed ruin, to my knowledge.
String.Dest: Know? Very little. 'Tis merely another cursed ruin, to my knowledge.

String.Source: But I've experience in matters of the Glass Curse before. Thus, I can form an understanding of this place.
String.Dest: But I've experience in matters of the Glass Curse before. Thus, I can form an understanding of this place.

String.Source: The Glass is fully embedded here. For all intents and purposes, this structure is no longer part of the Old Lands. 'Tis a plane of the Glass.
String.Dest: The Glass is fully embedded here. For all intents and purposes, this structure is no longer part of the Old Lands. 'Tis a plane of the Glass.

String.Source: There is naught we can do to reverse the Glass once it has reached this state, but there may still be something of value to recover.
String.Dest: There is naught we can do to reverse the Glass once it has reached this state, but there may still be something of value to recover.

String.Source: Indeed. Were I to hazard a guess, I suspect the victims of the curse tried to save themselves by sealing the Coldlight within that stone.
String.Dest: Indeed. Were I to hazard a guess, I suspect the victims of the curse tried to save themselves by sealing the Coldlight within that stone.

String.Source: Of course, such an effort was for naught. One cannot stop the light merely by storing its excess glimmer.
String.Dest: Of course, such an effort was for naught. One cannot stop the light merely by storing its excess glimmer.

String.Source: Still, the magic sealed within the stone does them no good now. Indeed, I suspect the energy leaking forth merely worsens their torment.
String.Dest: Still, the magic sealed within the stone does them no good now. Indeed, I suspect the energy leaking forth merely worsens their torment.

String.Source: Shall we find a way to lower this barrier? We'll have no luck examining the stone from a distance.
String.Dest: Shall we find a way to lower this barrier? We'll have no luck examining the stone from a distance.

String.Source: Ah, there we are. Now, let's have a look at you, shall we?
String.Dest: Ah, there we are. Now, let's have a look at you, shall we?

String.Source: Ah, good. 'Tis in good condition still. I had feared it would be leaking the Coldlight, but the stored magic seems still contained.
String.Dest: Ah, good. 'Tis in good condition still. I had feared it would be leaking the Coldlight, but the stored magic seems still contained.

String.Source: Let me dispel the remaining wards, and we can claim it.
String.Dest: Let me dispel the remaining wards, and we can claim it.

String.Source: Regrettably, I must confess I missed a trap.
String.Dest: Regrettably, I must confess I missed a trap.

String.Source: You've my thanks for destroying that guardian... 'tis a pity the crystal was destroyed in the explosion as well.
String.Dest: You've my thanks for destroying that guardian... 'tis a pity the crystal was destroyed in the explosion as well.

String.Source: ...Ahaha! Well, serves me right for trying to deceive thee, I suppose!
String.Dest: ...Ahaha! Well, serves me right for trying to deceive thee, I suppose!

String.Source: I confess. I've a great interest in these stones, and faking its destruction seemed the quickest route to obtaining it.
String.Dest: I confess. I've a great interest in these stones, and faking its destruction seemed the quickest route to obtaining it.

String.Source: Still, you needn't worry. I've the knowledge to ensure the light within this stone is not unleashed by my studies.
String.Dest: Still, you needn't worry. I've the knowledge to ensure the light within this stone is not unleashed by my studies.

String.Source: While I'll still insist on keeping it for myself, I suppose you deserve some extra compensation for my attempt to fool you.
String.Dest: While I'll still insist on keeping it for myself, I suppose you deserve some extra compensation for my attempt to fool you.

String.Source: ...Heh, I suppose I underestimated thee. Yes, thou art correct. 'Twas an attempt to deceive thee.
String.Dest: ...Heh, I suppose I underestimated thee. Yes, thou art correct. 'Twas an attempt to deceive thee.

String.Source: Nay, you've nothing to fear there. Destroying these stones merely returns the light to its caster.
String.Dest: Nay, you've nothing to fear there. Destroying these stones merely returns the light to its caster.

String.Source: 'Tis a shame the stone could not be recovered, but at least we've lessened the suffering of the cursed souls here. A victory, even if a small one.
String.Dest: 'Tis a shame the stone could not be recovered, but at least we've lessened the suffering of the cursed souls here. A victory, even if a small one.

String.Source: Here, thy well-deserved reward.
String.Dest: Here, thy well-deserved reward.

String.Source: I must say, traveling with thee was enjoyable. I shall return to the village for now, but do tell me if thou doth desire my company in thy travels.
String.Dest: I must say, traveling with thee was enjoyable. I shall return to the village for now, but do tell me if thou doth desire my company in thy travels.

String.Source: 'Twould be a delight.
String.Dest: 'Twould be a delight.

String.Source: 'Twill be good to stretch my legs.
String.Dest: 'Twill be good to stretch my legs.

String.Source: You're traveling with someone already, no? I prefer to avoid large groups.
String.Dest: You're traveling with someone already, no? I prefer to avoid large groups.

String.Source: Will you be long? I brought a book.
String.Dest: Will you be long? I brought a book.

String.Source: Very well. I suppose I'll return to Dry Sands Village for now.
String.Dest: Very well. I suppose I'll return to Dry Sands Village for now.

String.Source: Let me know if you wish to travel together once more.
String.Dest: Let me know if you wish to travel together once more.

String.Source: I'll share in thy burdens.
String.Dest: I'll share in thy burdens.

String.Source: Ah, but of course.
String.Dest: Ah, but of course.

String.Source: Hm, I suppose.
String.Dest: Hm, I suppose.

String.Source: Always. The xanmeers hold many dangers.
String.Dest: Always. The xanmeers hold many dangers.

String.Source: The monsters in particular. If their numbers are thinned, fewer miners will die.
String.Dest: The monsters in particular. If their numbers are thinned, fewer miners will die.

String.Source: There are several I know of that are especially strong. If it kills them, all will benefit.
String.Dest: There are several I know of that are especially strong. If it kills them, all will benefit.

String.Source: If you had arrived six millennia ago, perhaps we could still have been saved. But the Coldlight of the Glass Star has had too long to warp our souls.
String.Dest: If you had arrived six millennia ago, perhaps we could still have been saved. But the Coldlight of the Glass Star has had too long to warp our souls.

String.Source: Though if you intend to venture into the Academy regardless, perhaps there is a way for you to lessen our torment.
String.Dest: Though if you intend to venture into the Academy regardless, perhaps there is a way for you to lessen our torment.

String.Source: Before the Glass Star abandoned us, its power created several great magical wards.
String.Dest: Before the Glass Star abandoned us, its power created several great magical wards.

String.Source: The power of the wards traps the souls of those nearby, forcing them to endlessly relive their deaths.
String.Dest: The power of the wards traps the souls of those nearby, forcing them to endlessly relive their deaths.

String.Source: If you can shatter the wards, perhaps our pain will be lessened. Even if not, you would have my thanks for the attempt.
String.Dest: If you can shatter the wards, perhaps our pain will be lessened. Even if not, you would have my thanks for the attempt.

String.Source: Indeed... I felt as though a weight was lifted from my soul.
String.Dest: Indeed... I felt as though a weight was lifted from my soul.

String.Source: Our curse will bind us here eternally, but at least the pain is somewhat lessened. You have my gratitude.
String.Dest: Our curse will bind us here eternally, but at least the pain is somewhat lessened. You have my gratitude.

String.Source: I can't say I have... My apologies. I regret that I've no knowledge to share on this matter.
String.Dest: I can't say I have... My apologies. I regret that I've no knowledge to share on this matter.

String.Source: No. I had no idea a place like this existed...
String.Dest: No. I had no idea a place like this existed...

String.Source: It feels... different from the rest of the Old Lands. More alien.
String.Dest: It feels... different from the rest of the Old Lands. More alien.

String.Source: I don't think we should spend too long here. Whatever caused this seems to have left, but... I don't want to risk drawing it back.
String.Dest: I don't think we should spend too long here. Whatever caused this seems to have left, but... I don't want to risk drawing it back.

String.Source: When I sensed interference with the Roots, I wondered who dared think themselves able to usurp me.
String.Dest: When I sensed interference with the Roots, I wondered who dared think themselves able to usurp me.

String.Source: It was your creator, wasn't it, little doll?
String.Dest: It was your creator, wasn't it, little doll?

String.Source: Hehehe... Yes, I can see you. Did you think that paltry cloaking spell would hide you from my gaze?
String.Dest: Hehehe... Yes, I can see you. Did you think that paltry cloaking spell would hide you from my gaze?

String.Source: I am the Hollow Princess. I see all. Your creator continues to live only because I permit it.
String.Dest: I am the Hollow Princess. I see all. Your creator continues to live only because I permit it.

String.Source: Once you fall, the Roots will strangle him as well.
String.Dest: Once you fall, the Roots will strangle him as well.

String.Source: Scramble in the dark all you like, little worms.
String.Dest: Scramble in the dark all you like, little worms.

String.Source: My Hollow Palace is no mere castle. It is a gateway to the Void Itself.
String.Dest: My Hollow Palace is no mere castle. It is a gateway to the Void Itself.

String.Source: The darkness will devour you as it has all others who dared defy me.
String.Dest: The darkness will devour you as it has all others who dared defy me.

String.Source: I condemn your souls to the Void!
String.Dest: I condemn your souls to the Void!

String.Source: Let me hear your screams!
String.Dest: Let me hear your screams!

String.Source: I am eternal!
String.Dest: I am eternal!

String.Source: Cease this pointless struggle.
String.Dest: Cease this pointless struggle.

String.Source: I'll turn your remains into a flesh garden.
String.Dest: I'll turn your remains into a flesh garden.

String.Source: Hahaha... Death is nothing to fear. What I have planned for your soul is far worse.
String.Dest: Hahaha... Death is nothing to fear. What I have planned for your soul is far worse.

String.Source: Burn in emerald fire!
String.Dest: Burn in emerald fire!

String.Source: Your flesh will fertilize the Heart!
String.Dest: Your flesh will fertilize the Heart!

String.Source: Your suffering shall never end!
String.Dest: Your suffering shall never end!

String.Source: Let the darkness consume you.
String.Dest: Let the darkness consume you.

String.Source: This one never ventured into the woods before. Do not lower your guard.
String.Dest: This one never ventured into the woods before. Do not lower your guard.

String.Source: Swamps... This one does not like his fur getting wet.
String.Dest: Swamps... This one does not like his fur getting wet.

String.Source: This one smells the stench of dro-m'Athra.
String.Dest: This one smells the stench of dro-m'Athra.

String.Source: The Bent Dance echoes loudly here. Do not give in.
String.Dest: The Bent Dance echoes loudly here. Do not give in.

String.Source: Vampires. Guard your flesh, lest their fangs strike true.
String.Dest: Vampires. Guard your flesh, lest their fangs strike true.

String.Source: Be careful. Voriplasm slime does not easily wash out of fur.
String.Dest: Be careful. Voriplasm slime does not easily wash out of fur.

String.Source: Khh. These waters smell foul.
String.Dest: Khh. These waters smell foul.

String.Source: There are many tombs in Elsweyr. This one was never keen to explore them.
String.Dest: There are many tombs in Elsweyr. This one was never keen to explore them.

String.Source: Bandits. Let us sharpen our claws on their hide.
String.Dest: Bandits. Let us sharpen our claws on their hide.

String.Source: Do you think the inn serves sugar?
String.Dest: Do you think the inn serves sugar?

String.Source: This one has been getting many odd looks. The Nords here do not trust him.
String.Dest: This one has been getting many odd looks. The Nords here do not trust him.

String.Source: This one heard legends of dragons in Elsweyr. He never expected to see a live one.
String.Dest: This one heard legends of dragons in Elsweyr. He never expected to see a live one.

String.Source: Enemies approach. Keep your claws unsheathed.
String.Dest: Enemies approach. Keep your claws unsheathed.

String.Source: This one was raised in the warm sands. This cold is not good for him.
String.Dest: This one was raised in the warm sands. This cold is not good for him.

String.Source: My eyes are suited for hunting in this darkness. Our prey will not escape.
String.Dest: My eyes are suited for hunting in this darkness. Our prey will not escape.

String.Source: It is a good day for a hunt.
String.Dest: It is a good day for a hunt.

String.Source: Of course. You are sharp of claw and swift of spirit. Any would find you a good mate.
String.Dest: Of course. You are sharp of claw and swift of spirit. Any would find you a good mate.

String.Source: The question is, are you interested in this one?
String.Dest: The question is, are you interested in this one?

String.Source: Truly? This one would be happy to join with you in marriage, if you would have him.
String.Dest: Truly? This one would be happy to join with you in marriage, if you would have him.

String.Source: Then this one is sorry he asked.
String.Dest: Then this one is sorry he asked.

String.Source: Then this one is lesser for the loss.
String.Dest: Then this one is lesser for the loss.

String.Source: Your words are like warm sunshine. This one will hurry to the Temple of Mara and prepare.
String.Dest: Your words are like warm sunshine. This one will hurry to the Temple of Mara and prepare.

String.Source: (Pant) (Pant)
String.Dest: (Pant) (Pant)

String.Source: In the meantime, I'm going back to Twisted Root with a detachment of guards. Need to make sure that the tunnel the monsters used is fully sealed off.
String.Dest: In the meantime, I'm going back to Twisted Root with a detachment of guards. Need to make sure that the tunnel the monsters used is fully sealed off.

String.Source: I hear it was not always. I have no memories of such days.
String.Dest: I hear it was not always. I have no memories of such days.

String.Source: Drybloods stalk the paths. I must often flee from their ambushes - and avoid dropping any Meat as I do.
String.Dest: Drybloods stalk the paths. I must often flee from their ambushes - and avoid dropping any Meat as I do.

String.Source: It is not all bad. I have much strength in my legs from all the running.
String.Dest: It is not all bad. I have much strength in my legs from all the running.

String.Source: There are not enough guards. Sometimes one offers to guide me a short way, but that is the most they can do.
String.Dest: There are not enough guards. Sometimes one offers to guide me a short way, but that is the most they can do.

String.Source: Tensions between the village and the mines do not help matters. Guards from the village think we are withholding the Meat.
String.Dest: Tensions between the village and the mines do not help matters. Guards from the village think we are withholding the Meat.

String.Source: I cannot blame them. When the rivers run dry, all feel the thirst.
String.Dest: I cannot blame them. When the rivers run dry, all feel the thirst.

String.Source: None. But I learn the Drybloods' habits over time, which helps me avoid the worst of it.
String.Dest: None. But I learn the Drybloods' habits over time, which helps me avoid the worst of it.

String.Source: For example, many Drybloods lurk in the abandoned outpost of Swampwatch. I take the long way around to avoid it.
String.Dest: For example, many Drybloods lurk in the abandoned outpost of Swampwatch. I take the long way around to avoid it.

String.Source: Should it try, it will have our gratitude.
String.Dest: Should it try, it will have our gratitude.

String.Source: Truly? It has my gratitude. This makes my deliveries safer and faster.
String.Dest: Truly? It has my gratitude. This makes my deliveries safer and faster.

String.Source: Here. I have little by way of coin, but I wish it to have these.
String.Dest: Here. I have little by way of coin, but I wish it to have these.

String.Source: No. Overseer Dokazeek says I am too young for the dangers in the mines.
String.Dest: No. Overseer Dokazeek says I am too young for the dangers in the mines.

String.Source: So I train myself with my deliveries. I make sure I am prepared when Dokazeek asks me to join the miners.
String.Dest: So I train myself with my deliveries. I make sure I am prepared when Dokazeek asks me to join the miners.

String.Source: It has my gratitude for asking, but I do not impose on others. My troubles are my own.
String.Dest: It has my gratitude for asking, but I do not impose on others. My troubles are my own.

String.Source: If it wishes to help, perhaps it can help the others.
String.Dest: If it wishes to help, perhaps it can help the others.

String.Source: Hm. To think of it, I hear the guards complaining about Wetroot Grotto.
String.Dest: Hm. To think of it, I hear the guards complaining about Wetroot Grotto.

String.Source: They say a new vein of Meat is discovered there, but a monster emerges when they try to mine it.
String.Dest: They say a new vein of Meat is discovered there, but a monster emerges when they try to mine it.

String.Source: If it kills that monster, the other miners surely raise their scales in joy.
String.Dest: If it kills that monster, the other miners surely raise their scales in joy.

String.Source: I raise my hands in thanks. This lowers the burden on the guards and miners.
String.Dest: I raise my hands in thanks. This lowers the burden on the guards and miners.

String.Source: If all were as noble as it, the rivers would flow clear and gentle.
String.Dest: If all were as noble as it, the rivers would flow clear and gentle.

String.Source: It has my thanks. Its actions help to save lives.
String.Dest: It has my thanks. Its actions help to save lives.

String.Source: Less than I would like. Much about them is a mystery.
String.Dest: Less than I would like. Much about them is a mystery.

String.Source: The first Saxhleel to dwell here constructed the xanmeers to be their homes.
String.Dest: The first Saxhleel to dwell here constructed the xanmeers to be their homes.

String.Source: The ancients did not understand Sithis. They mistook change for destruction, and so they feared him. They built stone nests to shield against him.
String.Dest: The ancients did not understand Sithis. They mistook change for destruction, and so they feared him. They built stone nests to shield against him.

String.Source: But Sithis cannot be resisted. Change always happens, and so it did for them. The age of stone nests ended with Duskfall.
String.Dest: But Sithis cannot be resisted. Change always happens, and so it did for them. The age of stone nests ended with Duskfall.

String.Source: All that remains behind are empty xanmeers.
String.Dest: All that remains behind are empty xanmeers.

String.Source: It asks a question I wish answered as well. I ask many scholars that visit, but none know. The ancients destroyed all records of Duskfall.
String.Dest: It asks a question I wish answered as well. I ask many scholars that visit, but none know. The ancients destroyed all records of Duskfall.

String.Source: Duskfall is the great mystery of the ancient times. All that remained were the stone nests, and they were left hollow.
String.Dest: Duskfall is the great mystery of the ancient times. All that remained were the stone nests, and they were left hollow.

String.Source: The Saxhleel to come after all fear the xanmeers. They believe them cursed.
String.Dest: The Saxhleel to come after all fear the xanmeers. They believe them cursed.

String.Source: If the Meat had not been discovered, the xanmeers here would have remained sealed as well.
String.Dest: If the Meat had not been discovered, the xanmeers here would have remained sealed as well.

String.Source: Too long ago to be remembered in speech or writing. Stories say the xanmeers were reopened after the coming of the Hollow Princess.
String.Dest: Too long ago to be remembered in speech or writing. Stories say the xanmeers were reopened after the coming of the Hollow Princess.

String.Source: That is the story I was told. The story says the Saxhleel first found this realm, and the Hollow Princess came after.
String.Dest: That is the story I was told. The story says the Saxhleel first found this realm, and the Hollow Princess came after.

String.Source: But nothing more is known. Too much history was lost.
String.Dest: But nothing more is known. Too much history was lost.

String.Source: I widen my eyes eagerly. It wishes to help?
String.Dest: I widen my eyes eagerly. It wishes to help?

String.Source: I do not refuse those who offer. Yes, there is something it can do.
String.Dest: I do not refuse those who offer. Yes, there is something it can do.

String.Source: In many of the xanmeers, I see carved tablets. Each has a unique symbol.
String.Dest: In many of the xanmeers, I see carved tablets. Each has a unique symbol.

String.Source: Each xanmeer has exactly one. This cannot be coincidence, but I cannot read the ancient writings.
String.Dest: Each xanmeer has exactly one. This cannot be coincidence, but I cannot read the ancient writings.

String.Source: I ask it to take rubbings of the symbols. When the next traders come to the Old Lands, they can bring the rubbings to scholars in Tamriel.
String.Dest: I ask it to take rubbings of the symbols. When the next traders come to the Old Lands, they can bring the rubbings to scholars in Tamriel.

String.Source: But I caution it to be careful. I have not taken rubbings myself because of the monsters. Do not become their prey.
String.Dest: But I caution it to be careful. I have not taken rubbings myself because of the monsters. Do not become their prey.

String.Source: None willingly offer help. Is it mad, or merely naive?
String.Dest: None willingly offer help. Is it mad, or merely naive?

String.Source: It does not matter. We are not in a position to refuse.
String.Dest: It does not matter. We are not in a position to refuse.

String.Source: If it wishes to help, it may do so. I ask it to deal with the monsters in Dimik-Tzel.
String.Dest: If it wishes to help, it may do so. I ask it to deal with the monsters in Dimik-Tzel.

String.Source: They only appear recently, but already many miners fall to them.
String.Dest: They only appear recently, but already many miners fall to them.

String.Source: Hm. It does not have enough. I will buy it in sets of ten. Any less will not help.
String.Dest: Hm. It does not have enough. I will buy it in sets of ten. Any less will not help.

String.Source: So it does. I will pay it 200 gold for ten.
String.Dest: So it does. I will pay it 200 gold for ten.

String.Source: Most.
String.Dest: Most.

String.Source: But the Meat is often in the lowest parts. The upper veins are empty.
String.Dest: But the Meat is often in the lowest parts. The upper veins are empty.

String.Source: Mining is difficult. The lower we go, the more monsters appear.
String.Dest: Mining is difficult. The lower we go, the more monsters appear.

String.Source: But we have no other choice. Without Meat, we cannot stave off the Dryblood madness.
String.Dest: But we have no other choice. Without Meat, we cannot stave off the Dryblood madness.

String.Source: Hm. I raise my brows in surprise.
String.Dest: Hm. I raise my brows in surprise.

String.Source: I do not expect help, even if it is offered. But I am glad to be wrong.
String.Dest: I do not expect help, even if it is offered. But I am glad to be wrong.

String.Source: Here. It earns this payment.
String.Dest: Here. It earns this payment.

String.Source: If it wishes to help further, I will pay it for any Meat it digs up.
String.Dest: If it wishes to help further, I will pay it for any Meat it digs up.

String.Source: I will purchase the Meat in sets of ten at a time. If it has enough, consider selling to me.
String.Dest: I will purchase the Meat in sets of ten at a time. If it has enough, consider selling to me.

String.Source: Then it may have the gold, with our thanks.
String.Dest: Then it may have the gold, with our thanks.

String.Source: Tch. It wastes our time.
String.Dest: Tch. It wastes our time.

String.Source: I grin my teeth in joy. These are of great value.
String.Dest: I grin my teeth in joy. These are of great value.

String.Source: It has my thanks. Next time traders visit, I will have them take these to scholars.
String.Dest: It has my thanks. Next time traders visit, I will have them take these to scholars.

String.Source: It may be many years of study, but a translation may now be found. Who knows what we may learn?
String.Dest: It may be many years of study, but a translation may now be found. Who knows what we may learn?

String.Source: If it slays the monsters, I will reward it.
String.Dest: If it slays the monsters, I will reward it.
